Aw kasayyibim minas-samaa'i feehi zulumaatuw wara`duw wabarq, yaj`aloona asaabi`ahum fee aadhaanihim minas-sawaa`iqi hadharal-mawt, wallaahu muheetum bil-kaafireen

Yaa ayyuhan-naasu`budoo rabbakumul-ladhee khalaqakum wal-ladheena min qablikum la`allakum tattaqoon

Wazallalnaa `alaykumul-ghamaama wa'anzalnaa `alaykumul-manna was-salwaa, kuloo min tayyibaati maa razaqnaakum, wamaa zalamoonaa walaakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon

Wa'idhibtalaa ibraaheema rabbuhoo bikalimaatin fa'atammahunn, qaala innee jaa`iluka lin-naasi imaamaa, qaala wamin dhurriyyatee, qaala laa yanaalu `ahdiz-zaalimeen
Wa'idh ja`alnal-bayta mathaabatal lin-naasi wa'amnaa, wattakhidhoo mim maqaami ibraaheema musallaa, wa`ahidnaa ilaa ibraaheema wa'ismaa`eela an tahhiraa baytiya lit-taa'ifeena wal-`aakifeena war-rukka`is-sujood
Wa'idh qaala ibraaheemu rabbij`al haadhaa baladan aaminaw warzuq ahlahoo minath-thamaraati man aamana minhum billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhir, qaala waman kafara fa'umatti`uhoo qaleelan thumma adtarruhoo ilaa `adhaabin-naar, wabi'sal-maseer
Wa'idh yarfa`u ibraaheemul-qawaa`ida minal-bayti wa'ismaa`eel, rabbanaa taqabbal minnaa, innaka antas-samee`ul-`aleem
Rabbanaa waj`alnaa muslimayni laka wamin dhurriyyatinaa ummatam muslimatal lak, wa'arinaa manaasikanaa watub `alaynaa, innaka antat-tawwaabur-raheem
Rabbanaa wab`ath feehim rasoolam minhum yatloo `alayhim aayaatika wayu`allimuhumul-kitaaba wal-hikmata wayuzakkeehim, innaka antal-`azeezul-hakeem
Wamay yarghabu `am millati ibraaheema illaa man safiha nafsah, walaqadistafaynaahu fid-dunyaa, wa'innahoo fil-aakhirati laminas-saaliheen
Idh qaala lahoo rabbuhoo aslim qaala aslamtu lirabbil-`aalameen
Wawassaa bihaa ibraaheemu baneehi waya`qoob, yaabaniyya innallaahastafaa lakumud-deena falaa tamootunna illaa wa'antum muslimoon
Am kuntum shuhadaa'a idh hadara ya`qoobal-mawtu idh qaala libaneehi maa ta`budoona mim ba`dee, qaaloo na`budu ilaahaka wa'ilaaha aabaa'ika ibraaheema wa'ismaa`eela wa'ishaaqa ilaahaw waahidaa, wanahnu lahoo muslimoon
Tilka ummatun qad khalat, lahaa maa kasabat walakum maa kasabtum, walaa tus'aloona `ammaa kaanoo ya`maloon
Waqaaloo koonoo hoodan aw nasaaraa tahtadoo, qul bal millata ibraaheema haneefaa, wamaa kaana minal-mushrikeen
Qooloo aamannaa billaahi wamaa unzila ilaynaa wamaa unzila ilaa ibraaheema wa'ismaa`eela wa'ishaaqa waya`qooba wal-asbaati wamaa ootiya moosaa wa`eesaa wamaa ootiyan-nabiyyoona mir rabbihim, laa nufarriqu bayna ahadim minhum, wanahnu lahoo muslimoon
Fa'in aamanoo bimithli maa aamantum bihee faqadihtadaw, wa'in tawallaw fa'innamaa hum fee shiqaaq, fasayakfeekahumullaah, wahuwas-samee`ul-`aleem
Sibghatallaah, waman ahsanu minallaahi sibghah, wanahnu lahoo `aabidoon
Qul atuhaajjoonanaa fillaahi wahuwa rabbunaa warabbukum, walanaa a`maalunaa walakum a`maalukum, wanahnu lahoo mukhlisoon
Am taqooloona inna ibraaheema wa'ismaa`eela wa'ishaaqa waya`qooba wal-asbaata kaanoo hoodan aw nasaaraa, qul a'antum a`lamu amillaah, waman azlamu mimman katama shahaadatan `indahoo minallaah, wamallaahu bighaafilin `ammaa ta`maloon
Tilka ummatun qad khalat, lahaa maa kasabat walakum maa kasabtum, walaa tus'aloona `ammaa kaanoo ya`maloon
Sayaqoolus-sufahaa'u minan-naasi maa wallaahum `an qiblatihimul-latee kaanoo `alayhaa, qul lillaahil-mashriqu wal-maghrib, yahdee may yashaa'u ilaa siraatim mustaqeem
Wakadhaalika ja`alnaakum ummataw wasatal litakoonoo shuhadaa'a `alan-naasi wayakoonar-rasoolu `alaykum shaheedaa, wamaa ja`alnal-qiblatal-latee kunta `alayhaa illaa lina`lama may yattabi`ur-rasoola mimmay yanqalibu `alaa `aqibayh, wa'in kaanat lakabeeratan illaa `alal-ladheena hadallaah, wamaa kaanallaahu liyudee`a eemaanakum, innallaaha bin-naasi lara'oofur raheem
Qad naraa taqalluba wajhika fis-samaa', falanuwalliyannaka qiblatan tardaahaa, fawalli wajhaka shatral-masjidil-haraam, wahaythu maa kuntum fawalloo wujoohakum shatrah, wa'innal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba laya`lamoona annahul-haqqu mir rabbihim, wamallaahu bighaafilin `ammaa ya`maloon
Wala'in ataytal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba bikulli aayatim maa tabi`oo qiblatak, wamaa anta bitaabi`in qiblatahum, wamaa ba`duhum bitaabi`in qiblata ba`d, wala'inittaba`ta ahwaa'ahum mim ba`di maa jaa'aka minal-`ilmi innaka idhal laminaz-zaalimeen
Alladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba ya`rifoonahoo kamaa ya`rifoona abnaa'ahum, wa'inna fareeqam minhum layaktumoonal-haqqa wahum ya`lamoon
Al-haqqu mir rabbika falaa takoonanna minal-mumtareen
Walikulliw wijhatun huwa muwalleehaa fastabiqul-khayraat, ayna maa takoonoo ya'ti bikumullaahu jamee`aa, innallaaha `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Wamin haythu kharajta fawalli wajhaka shatral-masjidil-haraam, wa'innahoo lal-haqqu mir rabbik, wamallaahu bighaafilin `ammaa ta`maloon
Wamin haythu kharajta fawalli wajhaka shatral-masjidil-haraam, wahaythu maa kuntum fawalloo wujoohakum shatrahoo li'allaa yakoona lin-naasi `alaykum hujjatun illal-ladheena zalamoo minhum falaa takhshawhum wakhshawnee wali'utimma ni`matee `alaykum wala`allakum tahtadoon
Kamaa arsalnaa feekum rasoolam minkum yatloo `alaykum aayaatinaa wayuzakkeekum wayu`allimukumul-kitaaba wal-hikmata wayu`allimukum maa lam takoonoo ta`lamoon
Fadhkuroonee adhkurkum washkuroo lee walaa takfuroon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanusta`eenoo bis-sabri was-salaah, innallaaha ma`as-saabireen
Walaa taqooloo limay yuqtalu fee sabeelillaahi amwaat, bal ahyaa'uw walaakil laa tash`uroon
Walanabluwannakum bishay'im minal-khawfi wal-joo`i wanaqsim minal-amwaali wal-anfusi wath-thamaraat, wabashshiris-saabireen
Alladheena idhaa asaabathum museebah, qaaloo innaa lillaahi wa'innaa ilayhi raaji`oon
Ulaa'ika `alayhim salawaatum mir rabbihim warahmah, wa'ulaa'ika humul-muhtadoon
Innas-safaa wal-marwata min sha`aa'irillaah, faman hajjal-bayta awi`tamara falaa junaaha `alayhi ay yattawwafa bihimaa, waman tatawwa`a khayran fa'innallaaha shaakirun `aleem
Innal-ladheena yaktumoona maa anzalnaa minal-bayyinaati wal-hudaa mim ba`di maa bayyannaahu lin-naasi fil-kitaabi ulaa'ika yal`anuhumullaahu wayal`anuhumullaa`inoon
Illal-ladheena taaboo wa'aslahoo wabayyanoo fa'ulaa'ika atoobu `alayhim, wa'anat-tawwaabur-raheem
Innal-ladheena kafaroo wamaatoo wahum kuffaarun ulaa'ika `alayhim la`natullaahi wal-malaa'ikati wan-naasi ajma`een
Khaalideena feehaa, laa yukhaffafu `anhumul-`adhaabu walaa hum yunzaroon
Wa'ilaahukum ilaahuw waahid, laa ilaaha illaa huwar-rahmaanur-raheem
Inna fee khalqis-samaawaati wal-ardi wakhtilaafil-layli wan-nahaari wal-fulkil-latee tajree fil-bahri bimaa yanfa`un-naasa wamaa anzalallaahu minas-samaa'i mim maa'in fa'ahyaa bihil-arda ba`da mawtihaa wabaththa feehaa min kulli daabbah, watasreefir-riyaahi was-sahaabil-musakhkhari baynas-samaa'i wal-ardi la'aayaatil liqawmiy ya`qiloon
Waminan-naasi may yattakhidhu min doonillaahi andaaday yuhibboonahum kahubbillaah, wal-ladheena aamanoo ashaddu hubbal lillaahi walaw yaral-ladheena zalamoo idh yarawnal-`adhaaba annal-quwwata lillaahi jamee`aw wa'annallaaha shadeedul-`adhaab
Idh tabarra'al-ladheenattubi`oo minal-ladheenattaba`oo wara'awul-`adhaaba wataqatta`at bihimul-asbaab
Waqaalal-ladheenattaba`oo law anna lanaa karratan fanatabarra'a minhum, kamaa tabarra'oo minnaa, kadhaalika yureehimullaahu a`maalahum hasaraatin `alayhim, wamaa hum bikhaarijeena minan-naar
Yaa ayyuhan-naasu kuloo mimmaa fil-ardi halaalan tayyibaa, walaa tattabi`oo khutuwaatish-shaytaan, innahoo lakum `aduwwum mubeen
Innamaa ya'murukum bis-soo'i wal-fahshaa'i wa'an taqooloo `alallaahi maa laa ta`lamoon
Wa'idhaa qeela lahumuttabi`oo maa anzalallaahu qaaloo bal nattabi`u maa alfaynaa `alayhi aabaa'anaa, awalaw kaana aabaa'uhum laa ya`qiloona shay'aw walaa yahtadoon
Wamathalul-ladheena kafaroo kamathalil-ladhee yan`iqu bimaa laa yasma`u illaa du`aa'aw wanidaa'aa, summum bukmun `umyun fahum laa ya`qiloon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo kuloo min tayyibaati maa razaqnaakum washkuroo lillaahi in kuntum iyyaahu ta`budoon
Innamaa harrama `alaykumul-maytata wad-dama walahmal-khinzeeri wamaa uhilla bihee lighayrillaah, famanidturra ghayra baaghiw walaa `aadin falaa ithma `alayh, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
Innal-ladheena yaktumoona maa anzalallaahu minal-kitaabi wayashtaroona bihee thamanan qaleelan ulaa'ika maa ya'kuloona fee butoonihim illan-naara walaa yukallimuhumullaahu yawmal-qiyaamati walaa yuzakkeehim, walahum `adhaabun aleem
Ulaa'ikal-ladheenashtarawud-dalaalata bil-hudaa wal-`adhaaba bil-maghfirah, famaa asbarahum `alan-naar
Dhaalika bi'annallaaha nazzalal-kitaaba bil-haqq, wa'innal-ladheenakhtalafoo fil-kitaabi lafee shiqaaqim ba`eed
Laysal-birra an tuwalloo wujoohakum qibalal-mashriqi wal-maghribi walaakinnal-birra man aamana billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wal-malaa'ikati wal-kitaabi wan-nabiyyeen, wa'aatal-maala `alaa hubbihee dhawil-qurbaa wal-yataamaa wal-masaakeena wabnas-sabeeli was-saa'ileena wafir-riqaab, wa'aqaamas-salaata wa'aataz-zakaah, wal-moofoona bi`ahdihim idhaa `aahadoo, was-saabireena fil-ba'saa'i wad-darraa'i waheenal-ba's, ulaa'ikal-ladheena sadaqoo, wa'ulaa'ika humul-muttaqoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo kutiba `alaykumul-qisaasu fil-qatlaa, al-hurru bil-hurri wal-`abdu bil-`abdi wal-unthaa bil-unthaa, faman `ufiya lahoo min akheehi shay'un fattibaa`um bil-ma`roofi wa'adaa'un ilayhi bi'ihsaan, dhaalika takhfeefum mir rabbikum warahmah, famani`tadaa ba`da dhaalika falahoo `adhaabun aleem
Walakum fil-qisaasi hayaatuy yaa ulil-albaabi la`allakum tattaqoon
Kutiba `alaykum idhaa hadara ahadakumul-mawtu in taraka khayraa, al-wasiyyatu lil-waalidayni wal-aqrabeena bil-ma`roof, haqqan `alal-muttaqeen
Famam baddalahoo ba`da maa sami`ahoo fa'innamaa ithmuhoo `alal-ladheena yubaddiloonah, innallaaha samee`un `aleem
Faman khaafa mim moosin janafan aw ithman fa'aslaha baynahum falaa ithma `alayh, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo kutiba `alaykumus-siyaamu kamaa kutiba `alal-ladheena min qablikum la`allakum tattaqoon
Ayyaamam ma`doodaat, faman kaana minkum mareedan aw `alaa safarin fa`iddatum min ayyaamin ukhar, wa`alal-ladheena yuteeqoonahoo fidyatun ta`aamu miskeen, faman tatawwa`a khayran fahuwa khayrul lah, wa'an tasoomoo khayrul lakum in kuntum ta`lamoon
Shahru ramadaanal-ladhee unzila feehil-qur'aanu hudal lin-naasi wabayyinaatim minal-hudaa wal-furqaan, faman shahida minkumush-shahra falyasumh, waman kaana mareedan aw `alaa safarin fa`iddatum min ayyaamin ukhar, yureedullaahu bikumul-yusra walaa yureedu bikumul-`usr, walitukmilul-`iddata walitukabbirullaaha `alaa maa hadaakum wala`allakum tashkuroon
Wa'idhaa sa'alaka `ibaadee `annee fa'innee qareeb, ujeebu da`watad-daa`i idhaa da`aani falyastajeeboo lee walyu'minoo bee la`allahum yarshudoon
Uhilla lakum laylatas-siyaamir-rafathu ilaa nisaa'ikum, hunna libaasul lakum wa'antum libaasul lahunn, `alimallaahu annakum kuntum takhtaanoona anfusakum fataaba `alaykum wa`afaa `ankum, fal-aana baashiroohunna wabtaghoo maa kataballaahu lakum, wakuloo washraboo hattaa yatabayyana lakumul-khaytul-abyadu minal-khaytil-aswadi minal-fajr, thumma atimmus-siyaama ilal-layl, walaa tubaashiroohunna wa'antum `aakifoona fil-masaajid, tilka hudoodullaahi falaa taqraboohaa, kadhaalika yubayyinullaahu aayaatihee lin-naasi la`allahum yattaqoon
Walaa ta'kuloo amwaalakum baynakum bil-baatili watudloo bihaa ilal-hukkaami lita'kuloo fareeqam min amwaalin-naasi bil-ithmi wa'antum ta`lamoon
Yas'aloonaka `anil-ahillah, qul hiya mawaaqeetu lin-naasi wal-hajj, walaysal-birru bi'an ta'tul-buyoota min zuhoorihaa walaakinnal-birra manittaqaa, wa'tul-buyoota min abwaabihaa, wattaqullaaha la`allakum tuflihoon
Waqaatiloo fee sabeelillaahil-ladheena yuqaatiloonakum walaa ta`tadoo, innallaaha laa yuhibbul-mu`tadeen
Waqtuloohum haythu thaqiftumoohum wa'akhrijoohum min haythu akhrajookum wal-fitnatu ashaddu minal-qatl, walaa tuqaatiloohum `indal-masjidil-haraami hattaa yuqaatilookum feeh, fa'in qaatalookum faqtuloohum, kadhaalika jazaa'ul-kaafireen
Fa'inintahaw fa'innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
Waqaatiloohum hattaa laa takoona fitnatuw wayakoonad-deenu lillaah, fa'inintahaw falaa `udwaana illaa `alaz-zaalimeen
Ash-shahrul-haraamu bish-shahril-haraami wal-hurumaatu qisaas, famani`tadaa `alaykum fa`tadoo `alayhi bimithli ma`tadaa `alaykum, wattaqullaaha wa`lamoo annallaaha ma`al-muttaqeen
Wa'anfiqoo fee sabeelillaahi walaa tulqoo bi'aydeekum ilat-tahlukati wa'ahsinoo, innallaaha yuhibbul-muhsineen
Wa'atimmul-hajja wal-`umrata lillaah, fa'in uhsirtum famastaysara minal-hady, walaa tahliqoo ru'oosakum hattaa yablughal-hadyu mahillah, faman kaana minkum mareedan aw bihee adham mir ra'sihee fafidyatum min siyaamin aw sadaqatin aw nusuk, fa'idhaa amintum, faman tamatta`a bil-`umrati ilal-hajji famastaysara minal-hady, famal lam yajid fasiyaamu thalaathati ayyaamin fil-hajji wasab`atin idhaa raja`tum, tilka `asharatun kaamilah, dhaalika limal lam yakun ahluhoo haadiril-masjidil-haraam, wattaqullaaha wa`lamoo annallaaha shadeedul-`iqaab
Al-hajju ashhurum ma`loomaat, faman farada feehinnal-hajja falaa rafatha walaa fusooqa walaa jidaala fil-hajj, wamaa taf`aloo min khayriy ya`lamhullaah, watazawwadoo fa'inna khayraz-zaadit-taqwaa, wattaqooni yaa ulil-albaab
Laysa `alaykum junaahun an tabtaghoo fadlam mir rabbikum, fa'idhaa afadtum min `arafaatin fadhkurullaaha `indal-mash`aril-haraam, wadhkuroohu kamaa hadaakum, wa'in kuntum min qablihee laminad-daalleen
Thumma afeedoo min haythu afaadan-naasu wastaghfirullaah, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
Fa'idhaa qadaytum manaasikakum fadhkurullaaha kadhikrikum aabaa'akum aw ashadda dhikraa, faminan-naasi may yaqoolu rabbanaa aatinaa fid-dunyaa wamaa lahoo fil-aakhirati min khalaaq
Waminhum may yaqoolu rabbanaa aatinaa fid-dunyaa hasanataw wafil-aakhirati hasanataw waqinaa `adhaaban-naar
Ulaa'ika lahum naseebum mimmaa kasaboo, wallaahu saree`ul-hisaab
Wadhkurullaaha fee ayyaamim ma`doodaat, faman ta`ajjala fee yawmayni falaa ithma `alayh, waman ta'akhkhara falaa ithma `alayhi limanittaqaa, wattaqullaaha wa`lamoo annakum ilayhi tuhsharoon
Waminan-naasi may yu`jibuka qawluhoo fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wayushhidullaaha `alaa maa fee qalbihee wahuwa aladdul-khisaam
Wa'idhaa tawallaa sa`aa fil-ardi liyufsida feehaa wayuhlikal-hartha wan-nasl, wallaahu laa yuhibbul-fasaad
Wa'idhaa qeela lahuttaqillaaha akhadhathul-`izzatu bil-ithmi fahasbuhoo jahannam, walabi'sal-mihaad
Waminan-naasi may yashree nafsahubtighaa'a mardaatillaah, wallaahu ra'oofum bil-`ibaad
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanudkhuloo fis-silmi kaaffah, walaa tattabi`oo khutuwaatish-shaytaan, innahoo lakum `aduwwum mubeen
Fa'in zalaltum mim ba`di maa jaa'atkumul-bayyinaatu fa`lamoo annallaaha `azeezun hakeem
Hal yanzuroona illaa ay ya'tiyahumullaahu fee zulalim minal-ghamaami wal-malaa'ikatu waqudiyal-amr, wa'ilallaahi turja`ul-umoor
Sal banee israa'eela kam aataynaahum min aayatim bayyinah, wamay yubaddil ni`matallaahi mim ba`di maa jaa'athu fa'innallaaha shadeedul-`iqaab
Zuyyina lilladheena kafarul-hayaatud-dunyaa wayaskharoona minal-ladheena aamanoo, wal-ladheenattaqaw fawqahum yawmal-qiyaamah, wallaahu yarzuqu may yashaa'u bighayri hisaab
Kaanan-naasu ummataw waahidah, faba`athallaahun-nabiyyeena mubashshireena wamundhireen, wa'anzala ma`ahumul-kitaaba bil-haqqi liyahkuma baynan-naasi feemakhtalafoo feeh, wamakhtalafa feehi illal-ladheena ootoohu mim ba`di maa jaa'athumul-bayyinaatu baghyam baynahum, fahadallaahul-ladheena aamanoo limakhtalafoo feehi minal-haqqi bi'idhnih, wallaahu yahdee may yashaa'u ilaa siraatim mustaqeem
Am hasibtum an tadkhulul-jannata walammaa ya'tikum mathalul-ladheena khalaw min qablikum, massathumul-ba'saa'u wad-darraa'u wazulziloo hattaa yaqoolar-rasoolu wal-ladheena aamanoo ma`ahoo mataa nasrullaah, alaa inna nasrallaahi qareeb
Yas'aloonaka maadhaa yunfiqoon, qul maa anfaqtum min khayrin falilwaalidayni wal-aqrabeena wal-yataamaa wal-masaakeeni wabnis-sabeel, wamaa taf`aloo min khayrin fa'innallaaha bihee `aleem
Kutiba `alaykumul-qitaalu wahuwa kurhul lakum, wa`asaa an takrahoo shay'aw wahuwa khayrul lakum, wa`asaa an tuhibboo shay'aw wahuwa sharrul lakum, wallaahu ya`lamu wa'antum laa ta`lamoon
Yas'aloonaka `anish-shahril-haraami qitaalin feeh, qul qitaalun feehi kabeer, wasaddun `an sabeelillaahi wakufrum bihee wal-masjidil-haraami wa'ikhraaju ahlihee minhu akbaru `indallaah, wal-fitnatu akbaru minal-qatl, walaa yazaaloona yuqaatiloonakum hattaa yaruddookum `an deenikum inistataa`oo, wamay yartadid minkum `an deenihee fayamut wahuwa kaafirun fa'ulaa'ika habitat a`maaluhum fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, wa'ulaa'ika ashaabun-naar, hum feehaa khaalidoon
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wal-ladheena haajaroo wajaahadoo fee sabeelillaahi ulaa'ika yarjoona rahmatallaah, wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
Yas'aloonaka `anil-khamri wal-maysir, qul feehimaa ithmun kabeeruw wamanaafi`u lin-naas, wa'ithmuhumaa akbaru min naf`ihimaa, wayas'aloonaka maadhaa yunfiqoon, qulil-`afw, kadhaalika yubayyinullaahu lakumul-aayaati la`allakum tatafakkaroon
Fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, wayas'aloonaka `anil-yataamaa, qul islaahul lahum khayr, wa'in tukhaalitoohum fa'ikhwaanukum, wallaahu ya`lamul-mufsida minal-muslih, walaw shaa'allaahu la'a`natakum innallaaha `azeezun hakeem
Walaa tankihul-mushrikaati hattaa yu'minn, wala'amatum mu'minatun khayrum mim mushrikatiw walaw a`jabatkum, walaa tunkihul-mushrikeena hattaa yu'minoo, wala`abdum mu'minun khayrum mim mushrikiw walaw a`jabakum, ulaa'ika yad`oona ilan-naar, wallaahu yad`oo ilal-jannati wal-maghfirati bi'idhnih, wayubayyinu aayaatihee lin-naasi la`allahum yatadhakkaroon
Wayas'aloonaka `anil-maheed, qul huwa adhan fa`tazilun-nisaa'a fil-maheedi walaa taqraboohunna hattaa yathurn, fa'idhaa tatahharna fa'toohunna min haythu amarakumullaah, innallaaha yuhibbut-tawwaabeena wayuhibbul-mutatahhireen
Nisaa'ukum harthul lakum, fa'too harthakum annaa shi'tum, waqaddimoo li'anfusikum, wattaqullaaha wa`lamoo annakum mulaaqooh, wabashshiril-mu'mineen
Walaa taj`alullaaha `urdatal li'aymaanikum an tabarroo watattaqoo watuslihoo baynan-naas, wallaahu samee`un `aleem
Laa yu'aakhidhukumullaahu bil-laghwi fee aymaanikum walaakiy yu'aakhidhukum bimaa kasabat quloobukum, wallaahu ghafoorun haleem
Lilladheena yu'loona min nisaa'ihim tarabbusu arba`ati ashhur, fa'in faa'oo fa'innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
Wa'in `azamut-talaaqa fa'innallaaha samee`un `aleem
Wal-mutallaqaatu yatarabbasna bi'anfusihinna thalaathata quroo', walaa yahillu lahunna ay yaktumna maa khalaqallaahu fee arhaamihinna in kunna yu'minna billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhir, wabu`oolatuhunna ahaqqu biraddihinna fee dhaalika in araadoo islaahaa, walahunna mithlul-ladhee `alayhinna bil-ma`roof, walir-rijaali `alayhinna darajah, wallaahu `azeezun hakeem
At-talaaqu marrataan, fa'imsaakum bima`roofin aw tasreehum bi'ihsaan, walaa yahillu lakum an ta'khudhoo mimmaa aataytumoohunna shay'an illaa ay yakhaafaa allaa yuqeemaa hudoodallaah, fa'in khiftum allaa yuqeemaa hudoodallaahi falaa junaaha `alayhimaa feemaftadat bih, tilka hudoodullaahi falaa ta`tadoohaa, wamay yata`adda hudoodallaahi fa'ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon
Fa'in tallaqahaa falaa tahillu lahoo mim ba`du hattaa tankiha zawjan ghayrah, fa'in tallaqahaa falaa junaaha `alayhimaa ay yataraaja`aa in zannaa ay yuqeemaa hudoodallaah, watilka hudoodullaahi yubayyinuhaa liqawmiy ya`lamoon
Wa'idhaa tallaqtumun-nisaa'a fabalaghna ajalahunna fa'amsikoohunna bima`roofin aw sarrihoohunna bima`roof, walaa tumsikoohunna diraaral lita`tadoo, wamay yaf`al dhaalika faqad zalama nafsah, walaa tattakhidhoo aayaatillaahi huzuwaw wadhkuroo ni`matallaahi `alaykum wamaa anzala `alaykum minal-kitaabi wal-hikmati ya`izukum bih, wattaqullaaha wa`lamoo annallaaha bikulli shay'in `aleem
Wa'idhaa tallaqtumun-nisaa'a fabalaghna ajalahunna falaa ta`duloohunna ay yankihna azwaajahunna idhaa taraadaw baynahum bil-ma`roof, dhaalika yoo`azu bihee man kaana minkum yu'minu billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhir, dhaalikum azkaa lakum wa'athar, wallaahu ya`lamu wa'antum laa ta`lamoon
Wal-waalidaatu yurdi`na awlaadahunna hawlayni kaamilayni liman araada ay yutimmar-radaa`ah, wa`alal-mawloodi lahoo rizquhunna wakiswatuhunna bil-ma`roof, laa tukallafu nafsun illaa wus`ahaa, laa tudaarra waalidatum biwaladihaa walaa mawloodul lahoo biwaladihee wa`alal-waarithi mithlu dhaalik, fa'in araadaa fisaalan `an taraadim minhumaa watashaawurin falaa junaaha `alayhimaa, wa'in arattum an tastardi`oo awlaadakum falaa junaaha `alaykum idhaa sallamtum maa aataytum bil-ma`roof, wattaqullaaha wa`lamoo annallaaha bimaa ta`maloona baseer
Wal-ladheena yutawaffawna minkum wayadharoona azwaajay yatarabbasna bi'anfusihinna arba`ata ashhuriw wa`ashraa, fa'idhaa balaghna ajalahunna falaa junaaha `alaykum feemaa fa`alna fee anfusihinna bil-ma`roof, wallaahu bimaa ta`maloona khabeer
Walaa junaaha `alaykum feemaa `arradtum bihee min khitbatin-nisaa'i aw aknantum fee anfusikum, `alimallaahu annakum satadhkuroonahunna walaakil laa tuwaa`idoohunna sirran illaa an taqooloo qawlam ma`roofaa, walaa ta`zimoo `uqdatan-nikaahi hattaa yablughal-kitaabu ajalah, wa`lamoo annallaaha ya`lamu maa fee anfusikum fahdharooh, wa`lamoo annallaaha ghafoorun haleem
Laa junaaha `alaykum in tallaqtumun-nisaa'a maa lam tamassoohunna aw tafridoo lahunna fareedah, wamatti`oohunna `alal-moosi`i qadaruhoo wa`alal-muqtiri qadaruh, mataa`am bil-ma`roof, haqqan `alal-muhsineen
Wa'in tallaqtumoohunna min qabli an tamassoohunna waqad faradtum lahunna fareedatan fanisfu maa faradtum illaa ay ya`foona aw ya`fuwal-ladhee biyadihee `uqdatun-nikaah, wa'an ta`foo aqrabu lit-taqwaa, walaa tansawul-fadla baynakum, innallaaha bimaa ta`maloona baseer
Haafizoo `alas-salawaati was-salaatil-wustaa waqoomoo lillaahi qaaniteen
Fa'in khiftum farijaalan aw rukbaanaa, fa'idhaa amintum fadhkurullaaha kamaa `allamakum maa lam takoonoo ta`lamoon
Wal-ladheena yutawaffawna minkum wayadharoona azwaajaa, wasiyyatal li'azwaajihim mataa`an ilal-hawli ghayra ikhraaj, fa'in kharajna falaa junaaha `alaykum fee maa fa`alna fee anfusihinna mim ma`roof, wallaahu `azeezun hakeem
Walilmutallaqaati mataa`um bil-ma`roof, haqqan `alal-muttaqeen
Kadhaalika yubayyinullaahu lakum aayaatihee la`allakum ta`qiloon
Alam tara ilal-ladheena kharajoo min diyaarihim wahum uloofun hadharal-mawt, faqaala lahumullaahu mootoo, thumma ahyaahum, innallaaha ladhoo fadlin `alan-naasi walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa yashkuroon
Waqaatiloo fee sabeelillaahi wa`lamoo annallaaha samee`un `aleem
Man dhal-ladhee yuqridullaaha qardan hasanan fayudaa`ifahoo lahoo ad`aafan katheerah, wallaahu yaqbidu wayabsut, wa'ilayhi turja`oon
Alam tara ilal-mala'i mim banee israa'eela mim ba`di moosaa, idh qaaloo linabiyyil lahumub`ath lanaa malikan nuqaatil fee sabeelillaah, qaala hal `asaytum in kutiba `alaykumul-qitaalu allaa tuqaatiloo, qaaloo wamaa lanaa allaa nuqaatila fee sabeelillaahi waqad ukhrijnaa min diyaarinaa wa'abnaa'inaa, falammaa kutiba `alayhimul-qitaalu tawallaw illaa qaleelam minhum, wallaahu `aleemum biz-zaalimeen
Waqaala lahum nabiyyuhum innallaaha qad ba`atha lakum taaloota malikaa, qaaloo annaa yakoonu lahul-mulku `alaynaa wanahnu ahaqqu bil-mulki minhu walam yu'ta sa`atam minal-maal, qaala innallaahastafaahu `alaykum wazaadahoo bastatan fil-`ilmi wal-jism, wallaahu yu'tee mulkahoo may yashaa', wallaahu waasi`un `aleem
Waqaala lahum nabiyyuhum inna aayata mulkihee ay ya'tiyakumut-taabootu feehi sakeenatum mir rabbikum wabaqiyyatum mimmaa taraka aalu moosaa wa'aalu haaroona tahmiluhul-malaa'ikah, inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal lakum in kuntum mu'mineen
Falammaa fasala taalootu bil-junoodi qaala innallaaha mubtaleekum binahar, faman shariba minhu falaysa minnee, wamal lam yat`amhu fa'innahoo minnee illaa manightarafa ghurfatam biyadih, fashariboo minhu illaa qaleelam minhum, falammaa jaawazahoo huwa wal-ladheena aamanoo ma`ahoo qaaloo laa taaqata lanal-yawma bijaaloota wajunoodih, qaalal-ladheena yazunnoona annahum mulaaqullaahi kam min fi'atin qaleelatin ghalabat fi'atan katheeratam bi'idhnillaah, wallaahu ma`as-saabireen
Walammaa barazoo lijaaloota wajunoodihee qaaloo rabbanaa afrigh `alaynaa sabraw wathabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa `alal-qawmil-kaafireen
Fahazamoohum bi'idhnillaah, waqatala daawoodu jaaloota wa'aataahullaahul-mulka wal-hikmata wa`allamahoo mimmaa yashaa', walawlaa daf`ullaahin-naasa ba`dahum biba`dil lafasadatil-ardu walaakinnallaaha dhoo fadlin `alal-`aalameen
Tilka aayaatullaahi natloohaa `alayka bil-haqq, wa'innaka laminal-mursaleen
Tilkar-rusulu faddalnaa ba`dahum `alaa ba`d, minhum man kallamallaahu warafa`a ba`dahum darajaat, wa'aataynaa `eesabna maryamal-bayyinaati wa'ayyadnaahu biroohil-qudus, walaw shaa'allaahu maqtatalal-ladheena mim ba`dihim mim ba`di maa jaa'athumul-bayyinaatu walaakinikhtalafoo faminhum man aamana waminhum man kafar, walaw shaa'allaahu maqtataloo, walaakinnallaaha yaf`alu maa yureed
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo anfiqoo mimmaa razaqnaakum min qabli ay ya'tiya yawmul laa bay`un feehi walaa khullatuw walaa shafaa`ah, wal-kaafiroona humuz-zaalimoon
Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huw, al-hayyul-qayyoom, laa ta'khudhuhoo sinatuw walaa nawm, lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, man dhal-ladhee yashfa`u `indahoo illaa bi'idhnih, ya`lamu maa bayna aydeehim wamaa khalfahum, walaa yuheetoona bishay'im min `ilmihee illaa bimaa shaa', wasi`a kursiyyuhus-samaawaati wal-ard, walaa ya'ooduhoo hifzuhumaa, wahuwal-`aliyyul-`azeem
Laa ikraaha fid-deen, qat tabayyanar-rushdu minal-ghayy, famay yakfur bit-taaghooti wayu'mim billaahi faqadistamsaka bil-`urwatil-wuthqaa lanfisaama lahaa, wallaahu samee`un `aleem
Allaahu waliyyul-ladheena aamanoo yukhrijuhum minaz-zulumaati ilan-noor, wal-ladheena kafaroo awliyaa'uhumut-taaghootu yukhrijoonahum minan-noori ilaz-zulumaat, ulaa'ika ashaabun-naar, hum feehaa khaalidoon
Alam tara ilal-ladhee haajja ibraaheema fee rabbihee an aataahullaahul-mulk, idh qaala ibraaheemu rabbiyal-ladhee yuhyee wayumeetu qaala ana uhyee wa'umeet, qaala ibraaheemu fa'innallaaha ya'tee bish-shamsi minal-mashriqi fa'ti bihaa minal-maghribi fabuhital-ladhee kafar, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
Aw kal-ladhee marra `alaa qaryatiw wahiya khaawiyatun `alaa `urooshihaa, qaala annaa yuhyee haadhihillaahu ba`da mawtihaa, fa'amaatahullaahu mi'ata `aamin thumma ba`athah, qaala kam labitht, qaala labithtu yawman aw ba`da yawm, qaala bal labithta mi'ata `aamin fanzur ilaa ta`aamika washaraabika lam yatasannah, wanzur ilaa himaarik, walinaj`alaka aayatal lin-naasi wanzur ilal-`izaami kayfa nunshizuhaa thumma naksoohaa lahmaa, falammaa tabayyana lahoo qaala a`lamu annallaaha `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Wa'idh qaala ibraaheemu rabbi arinee kayfa tuhyil-mawtaa, qaala awalam tu'min, qaala balaa walaakil liyatma'inna qalbee, qaala fakhudh arba`atam minat-tayri fasurhunna ilayka thummaj`al `alaa kulli jabalim minhunna juz'an thummad`uhunna ya'teenaka sa`yaa, wa`lam annallaaha `azeezun hakeem
Mathalul-ladheena yunfiqoona amwaalahum fee sabeelillaahi kamathali habbatin ambatat sab`a sanaabila fee kulli sumbulatim mi'atu habbah, wallaahu yudaa`ifu limay yashaa', wallaahu waasi`un `aleem
Alladheena yunfiqoona amwaalahum fee sabeelillaahi thumma laa yutbi`oona maa anfaqoo mannaw walaa adhal lahum ajruhum `inda rabbihim, walaa khawfun `alayhim walaa hum yahzanoon
Qawlum ma`roofuw wamaghfiratun khayrum min sadaqatiy yatba`uhaa adhaa, wallaahu ghaniyyun haleem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tubtiloo sadaqaatikum bil-manni wal-adhaa kal-ladhee yunfiqu maalahoo ri'aa'an-naasi walaa yu'minu billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhir, famathaluhoo kamathali safwaanin `alayhi turaabun fa'asaabahoo waabilun fatarakahoo saldaa, laa yaqdiroona `alaa shay'im mimmaa kasaboo, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmal-kaafireen
Wamathalul-ladheena yunfiqoona amwaalahumubtighaa'a mardaatillaahi watathbeetam min anfusihim kamathali jannatim birabwatin asaabahaa waabilun fa'aatat ukulahaa di`fayn, fa'il lam yusibhaa waabilun fatall, wallaahu bimaa ta`maloona baseer
Ayawaddu ahadukum an takoona lahoo jannatum min nakheeliw wa'a`naabin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru lahoo feehaa min kullith-thamaraati wa'asaabahul-kibaru walahoo dhurriyyatun du`afaa', fa'asaabahaa i`saarun feehi naarun fahtaraqat, kadhaalika yubayyinullaahu lakumul-aayaati la`allakum tatafakkaroon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo anfiqoo min tayyibaati maa kasabtum wamimmaa akhrajnaa lakum minal-ard, walaa tayammamul-khabeetha minhu tunfiqoona walastum bi'aakhidheehi illaa an tughmidoo feeh, wa`lamoo annallaaha ghaniyyun hameed
Ash-shaytaanu ya`idukumul-faqra waya'murukum bil-fahshaa', wallaahu ya`idukum maghfiratam minhu wafadlaa, wallaahu waasi`un `aleem
Yu'til-hikmata may yashaa', wamay yu'tal-hikmata faqad ootiya khayran katheeraa, wamaa yadhdhakkaru illaa ulul-albaab
Wamaa anfaqtum min nafaqatin aw nadhartum min nadhrin fa'innallaaha ya`lamuh, wamaa liz-zaalimeena min ansaar
In tubdus-sadaqaati fani`immaa hiy, wa'in tukhfoohaa watu'toohal-fuqaraa'a fahuwa khayrul lakum, wayukaffiru `ankum min sayyi'aatikum, wallaahu bimaa ta`maloona khabeer
Laysa `alayka hudaahum walaakinnallaaha yahdee may yashaa', wamaa tunfiqoo min khayrin fali'anfusikum, wamaa tunfiqoona illabtighaa'a wajhillaah, wamaa tunfiqoo min khayriy yuwaffa ilaykum wa'antum laa tuzlamoon
Lil-fuqaraa'il-ladheena uhsiroo fee sabeelillaahi laa yastatee`oona darban fil-ard, yahsabuhumul-jaahilu aghniyaa'a minat-ta`affuf, ta`rifuhum biseemaahum, laa yas'aloonan-naasa ilhaafaa, wamaa tunfiqoo min khayrin fa'innallaaha bihee `aleem
Alladheena yunfiqoona amwaalahum bil-layli wan-nahaari sirraw wa`alaaniyatan falahum ajruhum `inda rabbihim, walaa khawfun `alayhim walaa hum yahzanoon
Alladheena ya'kuloonar-ribaa laa yaqoomoona illaa kamaa yaqoomul-ladhee yatakhabbatuhush-shaytaanu minal-mass, dhaalika bi'annahum qaaloo innamal-bay`u mithlur-ribaa, wa'ahallallaahul-bay`a waharramar-ribaa, faman jaa'ahoo maw`izatum mir rabbihee fantahaa falahoo maa salaf, wa'amruhoo ilallaah, waman `aada fa'ulaa'ika ashaabun-naar, hum feehaa khaalidoon
Yamhaqullaahur-ribaa wayurbis-sadaqaat, wallaahu laa yuhibbu kulla kaffaarin atheem
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati wa'aqaamus-salaata wa'aatawuz-zakaata lahum ajruhum `inda rabbihim, walaa khawfun `alayhim walaa hum yahzanoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanuttaqullaaha wadharoo maa baqiya minar-ribaa in kuntum mu'mineen
Fa'il lam taf`aloo fa'dhanoo biharbim minallaahi warasoolih, wa'in tubtum falakum ru'oosu amwaalikum, laa tazlimoona walaa tuzlamoon
Wa'in kaana dhoo `usratin fanaziratun ilaa maysarah, wa'an tasaddaqoo khayrul lakum in kuntum ta`lamoon
Wattaqoo yawman turja`oona feehi ilallaah, thumma tuwaffaa kullu nafsim maa kasabat wahum laa yuzlamoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa tadaayantum bidaynin ilaa ajalim musamman faktubooh, walyaktub baynakum kaatibum bil-`adl, walaa ya'ba kaatibun ay yaktuba kamaa `allamahullaahu falyaktub, walyumlilil-ladhee `alayhil-haqqu walyattaqillaaha rabbahoo walaa yabkhas minhu shay'aa, fa'in kaanal-ladhee `alayhil-haqqu safeehan aw da`eefan aw laa yastatee`u ay yumilla huwa falyumlil waliyyuhoo bil-`adl, wastashhidoo shaheedayni mir rijaalikum, fa'il lam yakoonaa rajulayni farajuluw wamra'ataani mimman tardawna minash-shuhadaa'i an tadilla ihdaahumaa fatudhakkira ihdaahumal-ukhraa, walaa ya'bash-shuhadaa'u idhaa maa du`oo, walaa tas'amoo an taktuboohu sagheeran aw kabeeran ilaa ajalih, dhaalikum aqsatu `indallaahi wa'aqwamu lish-shahaadati wa'adnaa allaa tartaaboo illaa an takoona tijaaratan haadiratan tudeeroonahaa baynakum falaysa `alaykum junaahun allaa taktuboohaa, wa'ashhidoo idhaa tabaaya`tum, walaa yudaarra kaatibuw walaa shaheed, wa'in taf`aloo fa'innahoo fusooqum bikum, wattaqullaah, wayu`allimukumullaah, wallaahu bikulli shay'in `aleem
Wa'in kuntum `alaa safariw walam tajidoo kaatiban farihaanum maqboodah, fa'in amina ba`dukum ba`dan falyu'addil-ladhi'tumina amaanatahoo walyattaqillaaha rabbah, walaa taktumush-shahaadah, wamay yaktumhaa fa'innahoo aathimun qalbuh, wallaahu bimaa ta`maloona `aleem
Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wa'in tubdoo maa fee anfusikum aw tukhfoohu yuhaasibkum bihillaah, fayaghfiru limay yashaa'u wayu`adhdhibu may yashaa', wallaahu `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Aamanar-rasoolu bimaa unzila ilayhi mir rabbihee wal-mu'minoon, kullun aamana billaahi wamalaa'ikatihee wakutubihee warusulih, laa nufarriqu bayna ahadim mir rusulih, waqaaloo sami`naa wa'ata`naa ghufraanaka rabbanaa wa'ilaykal-maseer
Laa yukallifullaahu nafsan illaa wus`ahaa, lahaa maa kasabat wa`alayhaa maktasabat, rabbanaa laa tu'aakhidhnaa in naseenaa aw akhta'naa, rabbanaa walaa tahmil `alaynaa isran kamaa hamaltahoo `alal-ladheena min qablinaa, rabbanaa walaa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bih, wa`fu `annaa, waghfir lanaa, warhamnaa, anta mawlaanaa fansurnaa `alal-qawmil-kaafireen

Alif laam meem
Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huwal-hayyul-qayyoom
Nazzala `alaykal-kitaaba bil-haqqi musaddiqal limaa bayna yadayhi wa'anzalat-tawraata wal-injeel
Min qablu hudal lin-naasi wa'anzalal-furqaan, innal-ladheena kafaroo bi'aayaatillaahi lahum `adhaabun shadeed, wallaahu `azeezun dhuntiqaam
Innallaaha laa yakhfaa `alayhi shay'un fil-ardi walaa fis-samaa'
Huwal-ladhee yusawwirukum fil-arhaami kayfa yashaa', laa ilaaha illaa huwal-`azeezul-hakeem
Huwal-ladhee anzala `alaykal-kitaaba minhu aayaatum muhkamaatun hunna ummul-kitaabi wa'ukharu mutashaabihaat, fa'ammal-ladheena fee quloobihim zayghun fayattabi`oona maa tashaabaha minhubtighaa'al-fitnati wabtighaa'a ta'weelih, wamaa ya`lamu ta'weelahoo illallaah, war-raasikhoona fil-`ilmi yaqooloona aamannaa bihee kullum min `indi rabbinaa, wamaa yadhdhakkaru illaa ulul-albaab
Rabbanaa laa tuzigh quloobanaa ba`da idh hadaytanaa wahab lanaa mil ladunka rahmah, innaka antal-wahhaab
Rabbanaa innaka jaami`un-naasi liyawmil laa rayba feeh, innallaaha laa yukhliful-mee`aad
Innal-ladheena kafaroo lan tughniya `anhum amwaaluhum walaa awlaaduhum minallaahi shay'aa, wa'ulaa'ika hum waqoodun-naar
Kada'bi aali fir`awna wal-ladheena min qablihim, kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa, fa'akhadhahumullaahu bidhunoobihim, wallaahu shadeedul-`iqaab
Qul lilladheena kafaroo satughlaboona watuhsharoona ilaa jahannam, wabi'sal-mihaad
Qad kaana lakum aayatun fee fi'ataynil-taqataa, fi'atun tuqaatilu fee sabeelillaahi wa'ukhraa kaafiratuy yarawnahum mithlayhim ra'yal-`ayn, wallaahu yu'ayyidu binasrihee may yashaa', inna fee dhaalika la`ibratal li'ulil-absaar
Zuyyina lin-naasi hubbush-shahawaati minan-nisaa'i wal-baneena wal-qanaateeril-muqantarati minadh-dhahabi wal-fiddati wal-khaylil-musawwamati wal-an`aami wal-harth, dhaalika mataa`ul-hayaatid-dunyaa, wallaahu `indahoo husnul-ma'aab
Qul a'unabbi'ukum bikhayrim min dhaalikum, lilladheenattaqaw `inda rabbihim jannaatun tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa wa'azwaajum mutahharatuw waridwaanum minallaah, wallaahu baseerum bil-`ibaad
Alladheena yaqooloona rabbanaa innanaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa waqinaa `adhaaban-naar
As-saabireena was-saadiqeena wal-qaaniteena wal-munfiqeena wal-mustaghfireena bil-ashaar
Shahidallaahu annahoo laa ilaaha illaa huwa wal-malaa'ikatu wa'ulul-`ilmi qaa'imam bil-qist, laa ilaaha illaa huwal-`azeezul-hakeem
Innad-deena `indallaahil-islaam, wamakhtalafal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba illaa mim ba`di maa jaa'ahumul-`ilmu baghyam baynahum, wamay yakfur bi'aayaatillaahi fa'innallaaha saree`ul-hisaab
Fa'in haajjooka faqul aslamtu wajhiya lillaahi wamanittaba`an, waqul lilladheena ootul-kitaaba wal-ummiyyeena a'aslamtum, fa'in aslamoo faqadihtadaw, wa'in tawallaw fa'innamaa `alaykal-balaagh, wallaahu baseerum bil-`ibaad
Innal-ladheena yakfuroona bi'aayaatillaahi wayaqtuloonan-nabiyyeena bighayri haqq, wayaqtuloonal-ladheena ya'muroona bil-qisti minan-naasi fabashshirhum bi`adhaabin aleem
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena habitat a`maaluhum fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, wamaa lahum min naasireen
Alam tara ilal-ladheena ootoo naseebam minal-kitaabi yud`awna ilaa kitaabillaahi liyahkuma baynahum thumma yatawallaa fareequm minhum wahum mu`ridoon
Dhaalika bi'annahum qaaloo lan tamassanan-naaru illaa ayyaamam ma`doodaat, wagharrahum fee deenihim maa kaanoo yaftaroon
Fakayfa idhaa jama`naahum liyawmil laa rayba feeh, wawuffiyat kullu nafsim maa kasabat wahum laa yuzlamoon

Yaa ahlal-kitaabi lima talbisoonal-haqqa bil-baatili wataktumoonal-haqqa wa'antum ta`lamoon

Wamay yabtaghi ghayral-islaami deenan falay yuqbala minh, wahuwa fil-aakhirati minal-khaasireen

Ulaa'ika jazaa'uhum anna `alayhim la`natallaahi wal-malaa'ikati wan-naasi ajma`een
Khaalideena feehaa, laa yukhaffafu `anhumul-`adhaabu walaa hum yunzaroon
Illal-ladheena taaboo mim ba`di dhaalika wa'aslahoo, fa'innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
Innal-ladheena kafaroo ba`da eemaanihim thummazdaadoo kufral lan tuqbala tawbatuhum, wa'ulaa'ika humud-daalloon
Innal-ladheena kafaroo wamaatoo wahum kuffaarun falay yuqbala min ahadihim mil'ul-ardi dhahabaw walawiftadaa bih, ulaa'ika lahum `adhaabun aleemuw wamaa lahum min naasireen
Lan tanaalul-birra hattaa tunfiqoo mimmaa tuhibboon, wamaa tunfiqoo min shay'in fa'innallaaha bihee `aleem
Kullut-ta`aami kaana hillal libanee israa'eela illaa maa harrama israa'eelu `alaa nafsihee min qabli an tunazzalat-tawraah, qul fa'too bit-tawraati fatloohaa in kuntum saadiqeen
Famaniftaraa `alallaahil-kadhiba mim ba`di dhaalika fa'ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon

Qul yaa ahlal-kitaabi lima takfuroona bi'aayaatillaahi wallaahu shaheedun `alaa maa ta`maloon

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo in tutee`oo fareeqam minal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba yaruddookum ba`da eemaanikum kaafireen

Waltakum minkum ummatuy yad`oona ilal-khayri waya'muroona bil-ma`roofi wayanhawna `anil-munkar, wa'ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon

Wa'ammal-ladheenabyaddat wujoohuhum fafee rahmatillaah, hum feehaa khaalidoon
Tilka aayaatullaahi natloohaa `alayka bil-haqq, wamallaahu yureedu zulmal lil-`aalameen
Walillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wa'ilallaahi turja`ul-umoor
Kuntum khayra ummatin ukhrijat lin-naasi ta'muroona bil-ma`roofi watanhawna `anil-munkari watu'minoona billaah, walaw aamana ahlul-kitaabi lakaana khayral lahum, minhumul-mu'minoona wa'aktharuhumul-faasiqoon

Walaqad sadaqakumullaahu wa`dahoo idh tahussoonahum bi'idhnih, hattaa idhaa fashiltum watanaaza`tum fil-amri wa`asaytum mim ba`di maa araakum maa tuhibboon, minkum may yureedud-dunyaa waminkum may yureedul-aakhirah, thumma sarafakum `anhum liyabtaliyakum, walaqad `afaa `ankum, wallaahu dhoo fadlin `alal-mu'mineen
Idh tus`idoona walaa talwoona `alaa ahadiw war-rasoolu yad`ookum fee ukhraakum fa'athaabakum ghammam bighammil likaylaa tahzanoo `alaa maa faatakum walaa maa asaabakum, wallaahu khabeerum bimaa ta`maloon
Thumma anzala `alaykum mim ba`dil-ghammi amanatan nu`aasay yaghshaa taa'ifatam minkum wataa'ifatun qad ahammathum anfusuhum yazunnoona billaahi ghayral-haqqi zannal-jaahiliyyah, yaqooloona hal lanaa minal-amri min shay', qul innal-amra kullahoo lillaah, yukhfoona fee anfusihim maa laa yubdoona lak, yaqooloona law kaana lanaa minal-amri shay'um maa qutilnaa haahunaa, qul law kuntum fee buyootikum labarazal-ladheena kutiba `alayhimul-qatlu ilaa madaaji`ihim, waliyabtaliyallaahu maa fee sudoorikum waliyumahhisa maa fee quloobikum, wallaahu `aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
Innal-ladheena tawallaw minkum yawmal-taqal-jam`aani innamastazallahumush-shaytaanu biba`di maa kasaboo, walaqad `afallaahu `anhum, innallaaha ghafoorun haleem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa takoonoo kal-ladheena kafaroo waqaaloo li'ikhwaanihim idhaa daraboo fil-ardi aw kaanoo ghuzzal law kaanoo `indanaa maa maatoo wamaa qutiloo, liyaj`alallaahu dhaalika hasratan fee quloobihim, wallaahu yuhyee wayumeet, wallaahu bimaa ta`maloona baseer
Wala'in qutiltum fee sabeelillaahi aw muttum lamaghfiratum minallaahi warahmatun khayrum mimmaa yajma`oon
Wala'im muttum aw qutiltum la'ilallaahi tuhsharoon
Fabimaa rahmatim minallaahi linta lahum, walaw kunta fazzan ghaleezal-qalbi lanfaddoo min hawlik, fa`fu `anhum wastaghfir lahum washaawirhum fil-amr, fa'idhaa `azamta fatawakkal `alallaah, innallaaha yuhibbul-mutawakkileen
Iy yansurkumullaahu falaa ghaaliba lakum, wa'iy yakhdhulkum faman dhal-ladhee yansurukum mim ba`dih, wa`alallaahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minoon
Wamaa kaana linabiyyin ay yaghull, wamay yaghlul ya'ti bimaa ghalla yawmal-qiyaamah, thumma tuwaffaa kullu nafsim maa kasabat wahum laa yuzlamoon
Afamanittaba`a ridwaanallaahi kamam baa'a bisakhatim minallaahi wama'waahu jahannam, wabi'sal-maseer
Hum darajaatun `indallaah, wallaahu baseerum bimaa ya`maloon
Laqad mannallaahu `alal-mu'mineena idh ba`atha feehim rasoolam min anfusihim yatloo `alayhim aayaatihee wayuzakkeehim wayu`allimuhumul-kitaaba wal-hikmah, wa'in kaanoo min qablu lafee dalaalim mubeen
Awalammaa asaabatkum museebatun qad asabtum mithlayhaa qultum annaa haadhaa, qul huwa min `indi anfusikum, innallaaha `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Wamaa asaabakum yawmal-taqal-jam`aani fabi'idhnillaahi waliya`lamal-mu'mineen
Waliya`lamal-ladheena naafaqoo, waqeela lahum ta`aalaw qaatiloo fee sabeelillaahi awidfa`oo, qaaloo law na`lamu qitaalal lattaba`naakum, hum lil-kufri yawma'idhin aqrabu minhum lil-eemaan, yaqooloona bi'afwaahihim maa laysa fee quloobihim, wallaahu a`lamu bimaa yaktumoon
Alladheena qaaloo li'ikhwaanihim waqa`adoo law ataa`oonaa maa qutiloo, qul fadra'oo `an anfusikumul-mawta in kuntum saadiqeen
Walaa tahsabannal-ladheena qutiloo fee sabeelillaahi amwaataa, bal ahyaa'un `inda rabbihim yurzaqoon
Fariheena bimaa aataahumullaahu min fadlihee wayastabshiroona bil-ladheena lam yalhaqoo bihim min khalfihim allaa khawfun `alayhim walaa hum yahzanoon
Yastabshiroona bini`matim minallaahi wafadl, wa'annallaaha laa yudee`u ajral-mu'mineen
Alladheenastajaaboo lillaahi war-rasooli mim ba`di maa asaabahumul-qarh, lilladheena ahsanoo minhum wattaqaw ajrun `azeem
Alladheena qaala lahumun-naasu innan-naasa qad jama`oo lakum fakhshawhum fazaadahum eemaanaa, waqaaloo hasbunallaahu wani`mal-wakeel
Fanqalaboo bini`matim minallaahi wafadlil lam yamsashum soo'uw wattaba`oo ridwaanallaah, wallaahu dhoo fadlin `azeem
Innamaa dhaalikumush-shaytaanu yukhawwifu awliyaa'ah, falaa takhaafoohum wakhaafooni in kuntum mu'mineen
Walaa yahzunkal-ladheena yusaari`oona fil-kufr, innahum lay yadurrullaaha shay'aa, yureedullaahu allaa yaj`ala lahum hazzan fil-aakhirati walahum `adhaabun `azeem
Innal-ladheenashtarawul-kufra bil-eemaani lay yadurrullaaha shay'aa, walahum `adhaabun aleem
Walaa yahsabannal-ladheena kafaroo annamaa numlee lahum khayrul li'anfusihim, innamaa numlee lahum liyazdaadoo ithmaa, walahum `adhaabum muheen
Maa kaanallaahu liyadharal-mu'mineena `alaa maa antum `alayhi hattaa yameezal-khabeetha minat-tayyib, wamaa kaanallaahu liyutli`akum `alal-ghaybi walaakinnallaaha yajtabee mir rusulihee may yashaa', fa'aaminoo billaahi warusulih, wa'in tu'minoo watattaqoo falakum ajrun `azeem
Walaa yahsabannal-ladheena yabkhaloona bimaa aataahumullaahu min fadlihee huwa khayral lahum, bal huwa sharrul lahum, sayutawwaqoona maa bakhiloo bihee yawmal-qiyaamah, walillaahi meeraathus-samaawaati wal-ard, wallaahu bimaa ta`maloona khabeer
Laqad sami`allaahu qawlal-ladheena qaaloo innallaaha faqeeruw wanahnu aghniyaa', sanaktubu maa qaaloo waqatlahumul-ambiyaa'a bighayri haqqiw wanaqoolu dhooqoo `adhaabal-hareeq
Dhaalika bimaa qaddamat aydeekum wa'annallaaha laysa bizallaamil lil-`abeed
Alladheena qaaloo innallaaha `ahida ilaynaa allaa nu'mina lirasoolin hattaa ya'tiyanaa biqurbaanin ta'kuluhun-naar, qul qad jaa'akum rusulum min qablee bil-bayyinaati wabil-ladhee qultum falima qataltumoohum in kuntum saadiqeen
Fa'in kadhdhabooka faqad kudhdhiba rusulum min qablika jaa'oo bil-bayyinaati waz-zuburi wal-kitaabil-muneer
Kullu nafsin dhaa'iqatul-mawt, wa'innamaa tuwaffawna ujoorakum yawmal-qiyaamah, faman zuhziha `anin-naari wa'udkhilal-jannata faqad faaz, wamal-hayaatud-dunyaa illaa mataa`ul-ghuroor
Latublawunna fee amwaalikum wa'anfusikum, walatasma`unna minal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba min qablikum waminal-ladheena ashrakoo adhan katheeraa, wa'in tasbiroo watattaqoo fa'inna dhaalika min `azmil-umoor
Wa'idh akhadhallaahu meethaaqal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba latubayyinunnahoo lin-naasi walaa taktumoonah, fanabadhoohu waraa'a zuhoorihim washtaraw bihee thamanan qaleelaa, fabi'sa maa yashtaroon
Laa tahsabannal-ladheena yafrahoona bimaa ataw wayuhibboona ay yuhmadoo bimaa lam yaf`aloo falaa tahsabannahum bimafaazatim minal-`adhaab, walahum `adhaabun aleem
Walillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ard, wallaahu `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Inna fee khalqis-samaawaati wal-ardi wakhtilaafil-layli wan-nahaari la'aayaatil li'ulil-albaab
Al-ladheena yadhkuroonallaaha qiyaamaw waqu`oodaw wa`alaa junoobihim wayatafakkaroona fee khalqis-samaawaati wal-ard, rabbanaa maa khalaqta haadhaa baatilaa, subhaanaka faqinaa `adhaaban-naar
Rabbanaa innaka man tudkhilin-naara faqad akhzaytah, wamaa liz-zaalimeena min ansaar
Rabbanaa innanaa sami`naa munaadiyay yunaadee lil-eemaani an aaminoo birabbikum fa'aamannaa, rabbanaa faghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa wakaffir `annaa sayyi'aatinaa watawaffanaa ma`al-abraar
Rabbanaa wa'aatinaa maa wa`attanaa `alaa rusulika walaa tukhzinaa yawmal-qiyaamah, innaka laa tukhliful-mee`aad
Fastajaaba lahum rabbuhum annee laa udee`u `amala `aamilim minkum min dhakarin aw unthaa, ba`dukum mim ba`d, fal-ladheena haajaroo wa'ukhrijoo min diyaarihim wa'oodhoo fee sabeelee waqaataloo waqutiloo la'ukaffiranna `anhum sayyi'aatihim wala'udkhilannahum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaar, thawaabam min `indillaah, wallaahu `indahoo husnuth-thawaab
Laa yaghurrannaka taqallubul-ladheena kafaroo fil-bilaad
Mataa`un qaleel, thumma ma'waahum jahannam, wabi'sal-mihaad
Laakinil-ladheenattaqaw rabbahum lahum jannaatun tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa nuzulam min `indillaah, wamaa `indallaahi khayrul lil-abraar
Wa'inna min ahlil-kitaabi lamay yu'minu billaahi wamaa unzila ilaykum wamaa unzila ilayhim khaashi`eena lillaahi laa yashtaroona bi'aayaatillaahi thamanan qaleelaa, ulaa'ika lahum ajruhum `inda rabbihim, innallaaha saree`ul-hisaab
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanusbiroo wasaabiroo waraabitoo, wattaqullaaha la`allakum tuflihoon

Yaa ayyuhan-naasuttaqoo rabbakumul-ladhee khalaqakum min nafsiw waahidatiw wakhalaqa minhaa zawjahaa wabaththa minhumaa rijaalan katheeraw wanisaa'aa, wattaqullaahal-ladhee tasaa'aloona bihee wal-arhaam, innallaaha kaana `alaykum raqeebaa
Wa'aatul-yataamaa amwaalahum walaa tatabaddalul-khabeetha bit-tayyib, walaa ta'kuloo amwaalahum ilaa amwaalikum, innahoo kaana hooban kabeeraa
Wa'in khiftum allaa tuqsitoo fil-yataamaa fankihoo maa taaba lakum minan-nisaa'i mathnaa wathulaatha warubaa`, fa'in khiftum allaa ta`diloo fawaahidatan aw maa malakat aymaanukum, dhaalika adnaa allaa ta`ooloo
Wa'aatun-nisaa'a saduqaatihinna nihlah, fa'in tibna lakum `an shay'im minhu nafsan fakuloohu hanee'am maree'aa
Walaa tu'tus-sufahaa'a amwaalakumul-latee ja`alallaahu lakum qiyaamaw warzuqoohum feehaa waksoohum waqooloo lahum qawlam ma`roofaa
Wabtalul-yataamaa hattaa idhaa balaghun-nikaah, fa'in aanastum minhum rushdan fadfa`oo ilayhim amwaalahum, walaa ta'kuloohaa israafaw wabidaaran ay yakbaroo, waman kaana ghaniyyan falyasta`fif, waman kaana faqeeran falya'kul bil-ma`roof, fa'idhaa dafa`tum ilayhim amwaalahum fa'ashhidoo `alayhim, wakafaa billaahi haseebaa
Lir-rijaali naseebum mimmaa tarakal-waalidaani wal-aqraboon, walin-nisaa'i naseebum mimmaa tarakal-waalidaani wal-aqraboona mimmaa qalla minhu aw kathur, naseebam mafroodaa
Wa'idhaa hadaral-qismata ulul-qurbaa wal-yataamaa wal-masaakeenu farzuqoohum minhu waqooloo lahum qawlam ma`roofaa
Walyakhshal-ladheena law tarakoo min khalfihim dhurriyyatan di`aafan khaafoo `alayhim, falyattaqullaaha walyaqooloo qawlan sadeedaa
Innal-ladheena ya'kuloona amwaalal-yataamaa zulman innamaa ya'kuloona fee butoonihim naaraa, wasayaslawna sa`eeraa
Yooseekumullaahu fee awlaadikum lidh-dhakari mithlu hazzil-unthayayn, fa'in kunna nisaa'an fawqathnatayni falahunna thuluthaa maa tarak, wa'in kaanat waahidatan falahan-nisf, wali'abawayhi likulli waahidim minhumas-sudusu mimmaa taraka in kaana lahoo walad, fa'il lam yakul lahoo waladuw wawarithahoo abawaahu fali'ummihith-thuluth, fa'in kaana lahoo ikhwatun fali'ummihis-sudusu mim ba`di wasiyyatiy yoosee bihaa aw dayn, aabaa'ukum wa'abnaa'ukum, laa tadroona ayyuhum aqrabu lakum naf`aa, fareedatam minallaah, innallaaha kaana `aleeman hakeemaa
Walakum nisfu maa taraka azwaajukum il lam yakul lahunna walad, fa'in kaana lahunna waladun falakumur-rubu`u mimmaa tarakna mim ba`di wasiyyatiy yooseena bihaa aw dayn, walahunnar-rubu`u mimmaa taraktum il lam yakul lakum walad, fa'in kaana lakum waladun falahunnath-thumunu mimmaa taraktum mim ba`di wasiyyatin toosoona bihaa aw dayn, wa'in kaana rajuluy yoorathu kalaalatan awimra'atuw walahoo akhun aw ukhtun falikulli waahidim minhumas-sudus, fa'in kaanoo akthara min dhaalika fahum shurakaa'u fith-thuluthi mim ba`di wasiyyatiy yoosaa bihaa aw daynin ghayra mudaarr, wasiyyatam minallaah, wallaahu `aleemun haleem
Tilka hudoodullaah, wamay yuti`illaaha warasoolahoo yudkhilhu jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa, wadhaalikal-fawzul-`azeem
Wamay ya`sillaaha warasoolahoo wayata`adda hudoodahoo yudkhilhu naaran khaalidan feehaa, walahoo `adhaabum muheen
Wallaatee ya'teenal-faahishata min nisaa'ikum fastashhidoo `alayhinna arba`atam minkum, fa'in shahidoo fa'amsikoohunna fil-buyooti hattaa yatawaffaahunnal-mawtu aw yaj`alallaahu lahunna sabeelaa
Wal-ladhaani ya'tiyaanihaa minkum fa'aadhoohumaa, fa'in taabaa wa'aslahaa fa'a`ridoo `anhumaa, innallaaha kaana tawwaabar raheemaa
Innamat-tawbatu `alallaahi lilladheena ya`maloonas-soo'a bijahaalatin thumma yatooboona min qareebin fa'ulaa'ika yatoobullaahu `alayhim, wakaanallaahu `aleeman hakeemaa
Walaysatit-tawbatu lilladheena ya`maloonas-sayyi'aat, hattaa idhaa hadara ahadahumul-mawtu qaala innee tubtul-aana walal-ladheena yamootoona wahum kuffaar, ulaa'ika a`tadnaa lahum `adhaaban aleemaa
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa yahillu lakum an tarithun-nisaa'a karhaa, walaa ta`duloohunna litadhhaboo biba`di maa aataytumoohunna illaa ay ya'teena bifaahishatim mubayyinah, wa`aashiroohunna bil-ma`roof, fa'in karihtumoohunna fa`asaa an takrahoo shay'aw wayaj`alallaahu feehi khayran katheeraa
Wa'in arattumustibdaala zawjim makaana zawjiw wa'aataytum ihdaahunna qintaaran falaa ta'khudhoo minhu shay'aa, ata'khudhoonahoo buhtaanaw wa'ithmam mubeenaa
Wakayfa ta'khudhoonahoo waqad afdaa ba`dukum ilaa ba`diw wa'akhadhna minkum meethaaqan ghaleezaa
Walaa tankihoo maa nakaha aabaa'ukum minan-nisaa'i illaa maa qad salaf, innahoo kaana faahishataw wamaqtaa, wasaa'a sabeelaa
Hurrimat `alaykum ummahaatukum wabanaatukum wa'akhawaatukum wa`ammaatukum wakhaalaatukum wabanaatul-akhi wabanaatul-ukhti wa'ummahaatukumullaatee arda`nakum wa'akhawaatukum minar-radaa`ati wa'ummahaatu nisaa'ikum warabaa'ibukumullaatee fee hujoorikum min nisaa'ikumullaatee dakhaltum bihinn, fa'il lam takoonoo dakhaltum bihinna falaa junaaha `alaykum, wahalaa'ilu abnaa'ikumul-ladheena min aslaabikum wa'an tajma`oo baynal-ukhtayni illaa maa qad salaf, innallaaha kaana ghafoorar raheemaa
Wal-muhsanaatu minan-nisaa'i illaa maa malakat aymaanukum, kitaaballaahi `alaykum, wa'uhilla lakum maa waraa'a dhaalikum an tabtaghoo bi'amwaalikum muhsineena ghayra musaafiheen, famastamta`tum bihee minhunna fa'aatoohunna ujoorahunna fareedah, walaa junaaha `alaykum feemaa taraadaytum bihee mim ba`dil-fareedah, innallaaha kaana `aleeman hakeemaa
Wamal lam yastati` minkum tawlan ay yankihal-muhsanaatil-mu'minaati famim maa malakat aymaanukum min fatayaatikumul-mu'minaat, wallaahu a`lamu bi'eemaanikum, ba`dukum mim ba`d, fankihoohunna bi'idhni ahlihinna wa'aatoohunna ujoorahunna bil-ma`roofi muhsanaatin ghayra musaafihaatiw walaa muttakhidhaati akhdaan, fa'idhaa uhsinna fa'in atayna bifaahishatin fa`alayhinna nisfu maa `alal-muhsanaati minal-`adhaab, dhaalika liman khashiyal-`anata minkum, wa'an tasbiroo khayrul lakum, wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
Yureedullaahu liyubayyina lakum wayahdiyakum sunanal-ladheena min qablikum wayatooba `alaykum, wallaahu `aleemun hakeem
Wallaahu yureedu ay yatooba `alaykum, wayureedul-ladheena yattabi`oonash-shahawaati an tameeloo maylan `azeemaa
Yureedullaahu ay yukhaffifa `ankum, wakhuliqal-insaanu da`eefaa
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa ta'kuloo amwaalakum baynakum bil-baatili illaa an takoona tijaaratan `an taraadim minkum, walaa taqtuloo anfusakum, innallaaha kaana bikum raheemaa
Wamay yaf`al dhaalika `udwaanaw wazulman fasawfa nusleehi naaraa, wakaana dhaalika `alallaahi yaseeraa
In tajtaniboo kabaa'ira maa tunhawna `anhu nukaffir `ankum sayyi'aatikum wanudkhilkum mudkhalan kareemaa
Walaa tatamannaw maa faddalallaahu bihee ba`dakum `alaa ba`d, lir-rijaali naseebum mimmaktasaboo, walin-nisaa'i naseebum mimmaktasabn, was'alullaaha min fadlih, innallaaha kaana bikulli shay'in `aleemaa
Walikullin ja`alnaa mawaaliya mimmaa tarakal-waalidaani wal-aqraboon, wal-ladheena `aqadat aymaanukum fa'aatoohum naseebahum, innallaaha kaana `alaa kulli shay'in shaheedaa
Ar-rijaalu qawwaamoona `alan-nisaa'i bimaa faddalallaahu ba`dahum `alaa ba`diw wabimaa anfaqoo min amwaalihim, fas-saalihaatu qaanitaatun haafizaatul lil-ghaybi bimaa hafizallaah, wallaatee takhaafoona nushoozahunna fa`izoohunna wahjuroohunna fil-madaaji`i wadriboohunn, fa'in ata`nakum falaa tabghoo `alayhinna sabeelaa, innallaaha kaana `aliyyan kabeeraa
Wa'in khiftum shiqaaqa baynihimaa fab`athoo hakamam min ahlihee wahakamam min ahlihaa, iy yureedaa islaahay yuwaffiqillaahu baynahumaa, innallaaha kaana `aleeman khabeeraa
Wa`budullaaha walaa tushrikoo bihee shay'aw wabil-waalidayni ihsaanaw wabidhil-qurbaa wal-yataamaa wal-masaakeeni wal-jaari dhil-qurbaa wal-jaaril-junubi was-saahibi bil-jambi wabnis-sabeeli wamaa malakat aymaanukum, innallaaha laa yuhibbu man kaana mukhtaalan fakhooraa
Al-ladheena yabkhaloona waya'muroonan-naasa bil-bukhli wayaktumoona maa aataahumullaahu min fadlih, wa'a`tadnaa lil-kaafireena `adhaabam muheenaa
Wal-ladheena yunfiqoona amwaalahum ri'aa'an-naasi walaa yu'minoona billaahi walaa bil-yawmil-aakhir, wamay yakunish-shaytaanu lahoo qareenan fasaa'a qareenaa
Wamaadhaa `alayhim law aamanoo billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wa'anfaqoo mimmaa razaqahumullaah, wakaanallaahu bihim `aleemaa
Innallaaha laa yazlimu mithqaala dharrah, wa'in taku hasanatay yudaa`ifhaa wayu'ti mil ladunhu ajran `azeemaa
Fakayfa idhaa ji'naa min kulli ummatim bishaheediw waji'naa bika `alaa haa'ulaa'i shaheedaa
Yawma'idhiy yawaddul-ladheena kafaroo wa`asawur-rasoola law tusawwaa bihimul-ard, walaa yaktumoonallaaha hadeethaa
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa taqrabus-salaata wa'antum sukaaraa hattaa ta`lamoo maa taqooloona walaa junuban illaa `aabiree sabeelin hattaa taghtasiloo, wa'in kuntum mardaa aw `alaa safarin aw jaa'a ahadum minkum minal-ghaa'iti aw laamastumun-nisaa'a falam tajidoo maa'an fatayammamoo sa`eedan tayyiban famsahoo biwujoohikum wa'aydeekum, innallaaha kaana `afuwwan ghafooraa
Alam tara ilal-ladheena ootoo naseebam minal-kitaabi yashtaroonad-dalaalata wayureedoona an tadillus-sabeel
Wallaahu a`lamu bi'a`daa'ikum, wakafaa billaahi waliyyaw wakafaa billaahi naseeraa
Minal-ladheena haadoo yuharrifoonal-kalima `am mawaadi`ihee wayaqooloona sami`naa wa`asaynaa wasma` ghayra musma`iw waraa`inaa layyam bi'alsinatihim wata`nan fid-deen, walaw annahum qaaloo sami`naa wa'ata`naa wasma` wanzurnaa lakaana khayral lahum wa'aqwama walaakil la`anahumullaahu bikufrihim falaa yu'minoona illaa qaleelaa
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba aaminoo bimaa nazzalnaa musaddiqal limaa ma`akum min qabli an natmisa wujoohan fanaruddahaa `alaa adbaarihaa aw nal`anahum kamaa la`annaa ashaabas-sabt, wakaana amrullaahi maf`oolaa
Innallaaha laa yaghfiru ay yushraka bihee wayaghfiru maa doona dhaalika limay yashaa', wamay yushrik billaahi faqadiftaraa ithman `azeemaa
Alam tara ilal-ladheena yuzakkoona anfusahum, balillaahu yuzakkee may yashaa'u walaa yuzlamoona fateelaa
Unzur kayfa yaftaroona `alallaahil-kadhib, wakafaa bihee ithmam mubeenaa
Alam tara ilal-ladheena ootoo naseebam minal-kitaabi yu'minoona bil-jibti wat-taaghooti wayaqooloona lilladheena kafaroo haa'ulaa'i ahdaa minal-ladheena aamanoo sabeelaa
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena la`anahumullaah, wamay yal`anillaahu falan tajida lahoo naseeraa
