Fabizulmim minal-ladheena haadoo harramnaa `alayhim tayyibaatin uhillat lahum wabisaddihim `an sabeelillaahi katheeraa
Wa'akhdhihimur-ribaa waqad nuhoo `anhu wa'aklihim amwaalan-naasi bil-baatil, wa'a`tadnaa lil-kaafireena minhum `adhaaban aleemaa
Laakinir-raasikhoona fil-`ilmi minhum wal-mu'minoona yu'minoona bimaa unzila ilayka wamaa unzila min qablika wal-muqeemeenas-salaata wal-mu'toonaz-zakaata wal-mu'minoona billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhir, ulaa'ika sanu'teehim ajran `azeemaa
Innaa awhaynaa ilayka kamaa awhaynaa ilaa noohiw wan-nabiyyeena mim ba`dih, wa'awhaynaa ilaa ibraaheema wa'ismaa`eela wa'ishaaqa waya`qooba wal-asbaati wa`eesaa wa'ayyooba wayoonusa wahaaroona wasulaymaan, wa'aataynaa daawooda zabooraa
Warusulan qad qasasnaahum `alayka min qablu warusulal lam naqsushum `alayk, wakallamallaahu moosaa takleemaa
Rusulam mubashshireena wamundhireena li'allaa yakoona lin-naasi `alallaahi hujjatum ba`dar-rusul, wakaanallaahu `azeezan hakeemaa
Laakinillaahu yashhadu bimaa anzala ilayka anzalahoo bi`ilmih, wal-malaa'ikatu yashhadoon, wakafaa billaahi shaheedaa
Innal-ladheena kafaroo wasaddoo `an sabeelillaahi qad dalloo dalaalam ba`eedaa
Innal-ladheena kafaroo wazalamoo lam yakunillaahu liyaghfira lahum walaa liyahdiyahum tareeqaa
Illaa tareeqa jahannama khaalideena feehaa abadaa, wakaana dhaalika `alallaahi yaseeraa
Yaa ayyuhan-naasu qad jaa'akumur-rasoolu bil-haqqi mir rabbikum fa'aaminoo khayral lakum, wa'in takfuroo fa'inna lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, wakaanallaahu `aleeman hakeemaa
Yaa ahlal-kitaabi laa taghloo fee deenikum walaa taqooloo `alallaahi illal-haqq, innamal-maseehu `eesabnu maryama rasoolullaahi wakalimatuh, al-qaahaa ilaa maryama waroohum minh, fa'aaminoo billaahi warusulih, walaa taqooloo thalaathah, intahoo khayral lakum, innamallaahu ilaahuw waahid, subhaanahoo ay yakoona lahoo walad, lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wakafaa billaahi wakeelaa
Lay yastankifal-maseehu ay yakoona `abdal lillaahi walal-malaa'ikatul-muqarraboon, wamay yastankif `an `ibaadatihee wayastakbir fasayahshuruhum ilayhi jamee`aa
Fa'ammal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati fayuwaffeehim ujoorahum wayazeeduhum min fadlih, wa'ammal-ladheenastankafoo wastakbaroo fayu`adhdhibuhum `adhaaban aleemaw walaa yajidoona lahum min doonillaahi waliyyaw walaa naseeraa
Yaa ayyuhan-naasu qad jaa'akum burhaanum mir rabbikum wa'anzalnaa ilaykum nooram mubeenaa
Fa'ammal-ladheena aamanoo billaahi wa`tasamoo bihee fasayudkhiluhum fee rahmatim minhu wafadliw wayahdeehim ilayhi siraatam mustaqeemaa
Yastaftoonak, qulillaahu yufteekum fil-kalaalah, inimru'un halaka laysa lahoo waladuw walahoo ukhtun falahaa nisfu maa tarak, wahuwa yarithuhaa il lam yakul lahaa walad, fa'in kaanatathnatayni falahumath-thuluthaani mimmaa tarak, wa'in kaanoo ikhwatar rijaalaw wanisaa'an falidh-dhakari mithlu hazzil-unthayayn, yubayyinullaahu lakum an tadilloo, wallaahu bikulli shay'in `aleem

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo awfoo bil-`uqood, uhillat lakum baheematul-an`aami illaa maa yutlaa `alaykum ghayra muhillis-saydi wa'antum hurum, innallaaha yahkumu maa yureed
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tuhilloo sha`aa'irallaahi walash-shahral-haraama walal-hadya walal-qalaa'ida walaa aammeenal-baytal-haraama yabtaghoona fadlam mir rabbihim waridwaanaa, wa'idhaa halaltum fastaadoo, walaa yajrimannakum shana'aanu qawmin an saddookum `anil-masjidil-haraami an ta`tadoo, wata`aawanoo `alal-birri wat-taqwaa, walaa ta`aawanoo `alal-ithmi wal-`udwaan, wattaqullaah, innallaaha shadeedul-`iqaab
Hurrimat `alaykumul-maytatu wad-damu walahmul-khinzeeri wamaa uhilla lighayrillaahi bihee wal-munkhaniqatu wal-mawqoodhatu wal-mutaraddiyatu wan-nateehatu wamaa akalas-sabu`u illaa maa dhakkaytum, wamaa dhubiha `alan-nusubi wa'an tastaqsimoo bil-azlaam, dhaalikum fisq, al-yawma ya'isal-ladheena kafaroo min deenikum falaa takhshawhum wakhshawn, al-yawma akmaltu lakum deenakum wa'atmamtu `alaykum ni`matee waradeetu lakumul-islaama deenaa, famanidturra fee makhmasatin ghayra mutajaanifil li'ithmin fa'innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
Yas'aloonaka maadhaa uhilla lahum, qul uhilla lakumut-tayyibaatu wamaa `allamtum minal-jawaarihi mukallibeena tu`allimoonahunna mimmaa `allamakumullaahu fakuloo mimmaa amsakna `alaykum wadhkurusmallaahi `alayh, wattaqullaah, innallaaha saree`ul-hisaab
Al-yawma uhilla lakumut-tayyibaat, wata`aamul-ladheena ootul-kitaaba hillul lakum, wata`aamukum hillul lahum, wal-muhsanaatu minal-mu'minaati wal-muhsanaatu minal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba min qablikum idhaa aataytumoohunna ujoorahunna muhsineena ghayra musaafiheena walaa muttakhidhee akhdaan, wamay yakfur bil-eemaani faqad habita `amaluh, wahuwa fil-aakhirati minal-khaasireen
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa qumtum ilas-salaati faghsiloo wujoohakum wa'aydiyakum ilal-maraafiqi wamsahoo biru'oosikum wa'arjulakum ilal-ka`bayn, wa'in kuntum junuban fattahharoo, wa'in kuntum mardaa aw `alaa safarin aw jaa'a ahadum minkum minal-ghaa'iti aw laamastumun-nisaa'a falam tajidoo maa'an fatayammamoo sa`eedan tayyiban famsahoo biwujoohikum wa'aydeekum minh, maa yureedullaahu liyaj`ala `alaykum min harajiw walaakiy yureedu liyutahhirakum waliyutimma ni`matahoo `alaykum la`allakum tashkuroon
Wadhkuroo ni`matallaahi `alaykum wameethaaqahul-ladhee waathaqakum bihee idh qultum sami`naa wa'ata`naa, wattaqullaah, innallaaha `aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo koonoo qawwaameena lillaahi shuhadaa'a bil-qist, walaa yajrimannakum shana'aanu qawmin `alaa allaa ta`diloo, i`diloo, huwa aqrabu lit-taqwaa, wattaqullaah, innallaaha khabeerum bimaa ta`maloon
Wa`adallaahul-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati lahum maghfiratuw wa'ajrun `azeem
Wal-ladheena kafaroo wakadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa ulaa'ika ashaabul-jaheem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanudhkuroo ni`matallaahi `alaykum idh hamma qawmun ay yabsutoo ilaykum aydiyahum fakaffa aydiyahum `ankum, wattaqullaah, wa`alallaahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minoon
Walaqad akhadhallaahu meethaaqa banee israa'eel, waba`athnaa minhumuthnay `ashara naqeebaa, waqaalallaahu innee ma`akum, la'in aqamtumus-salaata wa'aataytumuz-zakaata wa'aamantum birusulee wa`azzartumoohum wa'aqradtumullaaha qardan hasanal la'ukaffiranna `ankum sayyi'aatikum wala'udkhilannakum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaar, faman kafara ba`da dhaalika minkum faqad dalla sawaa'as-sabeel
Fabimaa naqdihim meethaaqahum la`annaahum waja`alnaa quloobahum qaasiyah, yuharrifoonal-kalima `am mawaadi`ihee wanasoo hazzam mimmaa dhukkiroo bih, walaa tazaalu tattali`u `alaa khaa'inatim minhum illaa qaleelam minhum, fa`fu `anhum wasfah, innallaaha yuhibbul-muhsineen
Waminal-ladheena qaaloo innaa nasaaraa akhadhnaa meethaaqahum fanasoo hazzam mimmaa dhukkiroo bih, fa'aghraynaa baynahumul-`adaawata wal-baghdaa'a ilaa yawmil-qiyaamah, wasawfa yunabbi'uhumullaahu bimaa kaanoo yasna`oon
Yaa ahlal-kitaabi qad jaa'akum rasoolunaa yubayyinu lakum katheeram mimmaa kuntum tukhfoona minal-kitaabi waya`foo `an katheer, qad jaa'akum minallaahi nooruw wakitaabum mubeen
Yahdee bihillaahu manittaba`a ridwaanahoo subulas-salaami wayukhrijuhum minaz-zulumaati ilan-noori bi'idhnihee wayahdeehim ilaa siraatim mustaqeem
Laqad kafaral-ladheena qaaloo innallaaha huwal-maseehubnu maryam, qul famay yamliku minallaahi shay'an in araada ay yuhlikal-maseehabna maryama wa'ummahoo waman fil-ardi jamee`aa, walillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa baynahumaa, yakhluqu maa yashaa', wallaahu `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Waqaalatil-yahoodu wan-nasaaraa nahnu abnaa'ullaahi wa'ahibbaa'uh, qul falima yu`adhdhibukum bidhunoobikum, bal antum basharum mimman khalaq, yaghfiru limay yashaa'u wayu`adhdhibu may yashaa', walillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa baynahumaa, wa'ilayhil-maseer
Yaa ahlal-kitaabi qad jaa'akum rasoolunaa yubayyinu lakum `alaa fatratim minar-rusuli an taqooloo maa jaa'anaa mim basheeriw walaa nadheer, faqad jaa'akum basheeruw wanadheer, wallaahu `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Wa'idh qaala moosaa liqawmihee yaaqawmidhkuroo ni`matallaahi `alaykum idh ja`ala feekum ambiyaa'a waja`alakum mulookaw wa'aataakum maa lam yu'ti ahadam minal-`aalameen
Yaaqawmidkhulul-ardal-muqaddasatal-latee kataballaahu lakum walaa tartaddoo `alaa adbaarikum fatanqaliboo khaasireen
Qaaloo yaamoosaa inna feehaa qawman jabbaareen, wa'innaa lan nadkhulahaa hattaa yakhrujoo minhaa, fa'iy yakhrujoo minhaa fa'innaa daakhiloon
Qaala rajulaani minal-ladheena yakhaafoona an`amallaahu `alayhimadkhuloo `alayhimul-baab, fa'idhaa dakhaltumoohu fa'innakum ghaaliboona wa`alallaahi fatawakkaloo in kuntum mu'mineen
Qaaloo yaamoosaa innaa lan nadkhulahaa abadam maa daamoo feehaa, fadhhab anta warabbuka faqaatilaa innaa haahunaa qaa`idoon
Qaala rabbi innee laa amliku illaa nafsee wa'akhee fafruq baynanaa wabaynal-qawmil-faasiqeen
Qaala fa'innahaa muharramatun `alayhim arba`eena sanah, yateehoona fil-ard, falaa ta'sa `alal-qawmil-faasiqeen
Watlu `alayhim naba'abnay aadama bil-haqq, idh qarrabaa qurbaanan fatuqubbila min ahadihimaa walam yutaqabbal minal-aakhar, qaala la'aqtulannak, qaala innamaa yataqabbalullaahu minal-muttaqeen
La'im basatta ilayya yadaka litaqtulanee maa ana bibaasitiy yadiya ilayka li'aqtulak, innee akhaafullaaha rabbal-`aalameen
Innee ureedu an taboo'a bi'ithmee wa'ithmika fatakoona min ashaabin-naar, wadhaalika jazaa'uz-zaalimeen
Fatawwa`at lahoo nafsuhoo qatla akheehi faqatalahoo fa'asbaha minal-khaasireen
Faba`athallaahu ghuraabay yabhathu fil-ardi liyuriyahoo kayfa yuwaaree saw'ata akheeh, qaala yaawaylataa a`ajaztu an akoona mithla haadhal-ghuraabi fa'uwaariya saw'ata akhee, fa'asbaha minan-naadimeen
Min ajli dhaalika katabnaa `alaa banee israa'eela annahoo man qatala nafsam bighayri nafsin aw fasaadin fil-ardi faka'annamaa qatalan-naasa jamee`aa, waman ahyaahaa faka'annamaa ahyan-naasa jamee`aa, walaqad jaa'athum rusulunaa bil-bayyinaati thumma inna katheeram minhum ba`da dhaalika fil-ardi lamusrifoon
Innamaa jazaa'ul-ladheena yuhaariboonallaaha warasoolahoo wayas`awna fil-ardi fasaadan ay yuqattaloo aw yusallaboo aw tuqatta`a aydeehim wa'arjuluhum min khilaafin aw yunfaw minal-ard, dhaalika lahum khizyun fid-dunyaa walahum fil-aakhirati `adhaabun `azeem
Illal-ladheena taaboo min qabli an taqdiroo `alayhim, fa`lamoo annallaaha ghafoorur raheem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanuttaqullaaha wabtaghoo ilayhil-waseelata wajaahidoo fee sabeelihee la`allakum tuflihoon
Innal-ladheena kafaroo law anna lahum maa fil-ardi jamee`aw wamithlahoo ma`ahoo liyaftadoo bihee min `adhaabi yawmil-qiyaamati maa tuqubbila minhum, walahum `adhaabun aleem
Yureedoona ay yakhrujoo minan-naari wamaa hum bikhaarijeena minhaa, walahum `adhaabum muqeem
Was-saariqu was-saariqatu faqta`oo aydiyahumaa jazaa'am bimaa kasabaa nakaalam minallaah, wallaahu `azeezun hakeem
Faman taaba mim ba`di zulmihee wa'aslaha fa'innallaaha yatoobu `alayh, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
Alam ta`lam annallaaha lahoo mulkus-samaawaati wal-ard, yu`adhdhibu may yashaa'u wayaghfiru limay yashaa', wallaahu `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Yaa ayyuhar-rasoolu laa yahzunkal-ladheena yusaari`oona fil-kufri minal-ladheena qaaloo aamannaa bi'afwaahihim walam tu'min quloobuhum waminal-ladheena haadoo, sammaa`oona lil-kadhibi sammaa`oona liqawmin aakhareena lam ya'took, yuharrifoonal-kalima mim ba`di mawaadi`ih, yaqooloona in ooteetum haadhaa fakhudhoohu wa'il lam tu'tawhu fahdharoo, wamay yuridillaahu fitnatahoo falan tamlika lahoo minallaahi shay'aa, ulaa'ikal-ladheena lam yuridillaahu ay yutahhira quloobahum, lahum fid-dunyaa khizy, walahum fil-aakhirati `adhaabun `azeem
Sammaa`oona lil-kadhibi akkaaloona lis-suht, fa'in jaa'ooka fahkum baynahum aw a`rid `anhum, wa'in tu`rid `anhum falay yadurrooka shay'aa, wa'in hakamta fahkum baynahum bil-qist, innallaaha yuhibbul-muqsiteen
Wakayfa yuhakkimoonaka wa`indahumut-tawraatu feehaa hukmullaahi thumma yatawallawna mim ba`di dhaalik, wamaa ulaa'ika bil-mu'mineen
Innaa anzalnat-tawraata feehaa hudaw wanoor, yahkumu bihan-nabiyyoonal-ladheena aslamoo lilladheena haadoo war-rabbaaniyyoona wal-ahbaaru bimastuhfizoo min kitaabillaahi wakaanoo `alayhi shuhadaa', falaa takhshawun-naasa wakhshawni walaa tashtaroo bi'aayaatee thamanan qaleelaa, wamal lam yahkum bimaa anzalallaahu fa'ulaa'ika humul-kaafiroon
Wakatabnaa `alayhim feehaa annan-nafsa bin-nafsi wal-`ayna bil-`ayni wal-anfa bil-anfi wal-udhuna bil-udhuni was-sinna bis-sinni wal-jurooha qisaas, faman tasaddaqa bihee fahuwa kaffaaratul lah, wamal lam yahkum bimaa anzalallaahu fa'ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon
Waqaffaynaa `alaa aathaarihim bi`eesabni maryama musaddiqal limaa bayna yadayhi minat-tawraah, wa'aataynaahul-injeela feehi hudaw wanooruw wamusaddiqal limaa bayna yadayhi minat-tawraati wahudaw wamaw`izatal lil-muttaqeen
Walyahkum ahlul-injeeli bimaa anzalallaahu feeh, wamal lam yahkum bimaa anzalallaahu fa'ulaa'ika humul-faasiqoon
Wa'anzalnaa ilaykal-kitaaba bil-haqqi musaddiqal limaa bayna yadayhi minal-kitaabi wamuhayminan `alayhi fahkum baynahum bimaa anzalallaahu walaa tattabi` ahwaa'ahum `ammaa jaa'aka minal-haqq, likullin ja`alnaa minkum shir`ataw waminhaajaa, walaw shaa'allaahu laja`alakum ummataw waahidataw walaakil liyabluwakum fee maa aataakum fastabiqul-khayraat, ilallaahi marji`ukum jamee`an fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum feehi takhtalifoon
Wa'anihkum baynahum bimaa anzalallaahu walaa tattabi` ahwaa'ahum wahdharhum ay yaftinooka `am ba`di maa anzalallaahu ilayk, fa'in tawallaw fa`lam annamaa yureedullaahu ay yuseebahum biba`di dhunoobihim, wa'inna katheeram minan-naasi lafaasiqoon
Afahukmal-jaahiliyyati yabghoon, waman ahsanu minallaahi hukmal liqawmiy yooqinoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tattakhidhul-yahooda wan-nasaaraa awliyaa', ba`duhum awliyaa'u ba`d, wamay yatawallahum minkum fa'innahoo minhum, innallaaha laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
Fataral-ladheena fee quloobihim maraduy yusaari`oona feehim yaqooloona nakhshaa an tuseebanaa daa'irah, fa`asallaahu ay ya'tiya bil-fathi aw amrim min `indihee fayusbihoo `alaa maa asarroo fee anfusihim naadimeen
Wayaqoolul-ladheena aamanoo ahaa'ulaa'il-ladheena aqsamoo billaahi jahda aymaanihim innahum lama`akum, habitat a`maaluhum fa'asbahoo khaasireen
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo may yartadda minkum `an deenihee fasawfa ya'tillaahu biqawmiy yuhibbuhum wayuhibboonahoo adhillatin `alal-mu'mineena a`izzatin `alal-kaafireen, yujaahidoona fee sabeelillaahi walaa yakhaafoona lawmata laa'im, dhaalika fadlullaahi yu'teehi may yashaa', wallaahu waasi`un `aleem
Innamaa waliyyukumullaahu warasooluhoo wal-ladheena aamanul-ladheena yuqeemoonas-salaata wayu'toonaz-zakaata wahum raaki`oon
Wamay yatawallallaaha warasoolahoo wal-ladheena aamanoo fa'inna hizballaahi humul-ghaaliboon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tattakhidhul-ladheenattakhadhoo deenakum huzuwaw wala`ibam minal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba min qablikum wal-kuffaara awliyaa', wattaqullaaha in kuntum mu'mineen
Wa'idhaa naadaytum ilas-salaatittakhadhoohaa huzuwaw wala`ibaa, dhaalika bi'annahum qawmul laa ya`qiloon
Qul yaa ahlal-kitaabi hal tanqimoona minnaa illaa an aamannaa billaahi wamaa unzila ilaynaa wamaa unzila min qablu wa'anna aktharakum faasiqoon
Qul hal unabbi'ukum bisharrim min dhaalika mathoobatan `indallaah, mal la`anahullaahu waghadiba `alayhi waja`ala minhumul-qiradata wal-khanaazeera wa`abadat-taaghoot, ulaa'ika sharrum makaanaw wa'adallu `an sawaa'is-sabeel
Wa'idhaa jaa'ookum qaaloo aamannaa waqad dakhaloo bil-kufri wahum qad kharajoo bih, wallaahu a`lamu bimaa kaanoo yaktumoon
Wataraa katheeram minhum yusaari`oona fil-ithmi wal-`udwaani wa'aklihimus-suht, labi'sa maa kaanoo ya`maloon
Lawlaa yanhaahumur-rabbaaniyyoona wal-ahbaaru `an qawlihimul-ithma wa'aklihimus-suht, labi'sa maa kaanoo yasna`oon
Waqaalatil-yahoodu yadullaahi maghloolah, ghullat aydeehim walu`inoo bimaa qaaloo, bal yadaahu mabsootataani yunfiqu kayfa yashaa', walayazeedanna katheeram minhum maa unzila ilayka mir rabbika tughyaanaw wakufraa, wa'alqaynaa baynahumul-`adaawata wal-baghdaa'a ilaa yawmil-qiyaamah, kullamaa awqadoo naaral lil-harbi atfa'ahallaahu wayas`awna fil-ardi fasaadaa, wallaahu laa yuhibbul-mufsideen
Walaw anna ahlal-kitaabi aamanoo wattaqaw lakaffarnaa `anhum sayyi'aatihim wala'adkhalnaahum jannaatin-na`eem
Walaw annahum aqaamut-tawraata wal-injeela wamaa unzila ilayhim mir rabbihim la'akaloo min fawqihim wamin tahti arjulihim, minhum ummatum muqtasidah, wakatheerum minhum saa'a maa ya`maloon
Yaa ayyuhar-rasoolu balligh maa unzila ilayka mir rabbik, wa'il lam taf`al famaa ballaghta risaalatah, wallaahu ya`simuka minan-naas, innallaaha laa yahdil-qawmal-kaafireen
Qul yaa ahlal-kitaabi lastum `alaa shay'in hattaa tuqeemut-tawraata wal-injeela wamaa unzila ilaykum mir rabbikum, walayazeedanna katheeram minhum maa unzila ilayka mir rabbika tughyaanaw wakufraa, falaa ta'sa `alal-qawmil-kaafireen
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wal-ladheena haadoo was-saabi'oona wan-nasaaraa man aamana billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wa`amila saalihan falaa khawfun `alayhim walaa hum yahzanoon
Laqad akhadhnaa meethaaqa banee israa'eela wa'arsalnaa ilayhim rusulaa, kullamaa jaa'ahum rasoolum bimaa laa tahwaa anfusuhum fareeqan kadhdhaboo wafareeqay yaqtuloon
Wahasiboo allaa takoona fitnatun fa`amoo wasammoo thumma taaballaahu `alayhim thumma `amoo wasammoo katheerum minhum, wallaahu baseerum bimaa ya`maloon
Laqad kafaral-ladheena qaaloo innallaaha huwal-maseehubnu maryam, waqaalal-maseehu yaabanee israa'eela`budullaaha rabbee warabbakum, innahoo may yushrik billaahi faqad harramallaahu `alayhil-jannata wama'waahun-naar, wamaa liz-zaalimeena min ansaar
Laqad kafaral-ladheena qaaloo innallaaha thaalithu thalaathah, wamaa min ilaahin illaa ilaahuw waahid, wa'il lam yantahoo `ammaa yaqooloona layamassannal-ladheena kafaroo minhum `adhaabun aleem
Afalaa yatooboona ilallaahi wayastaghfiroonah, wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
Mal-maseehubnu maryama illaa rasool, qad khalat min qablihir-rusul, wa'ummuhoo siddeeqah, kaanaa ya'kulaanit-ta`aam, unzur kayfa nubayyinu lahumul-aayaati thummanzur annaa yu'fakoon
Qul ata`budoona min doonillaahi maa laa yamliku lakum darraw walaa naf`aa, wallaahu huwas-samee`ul-`aleem
Qul yaa ahlal-kitaabi laa taghloo fee deenikum ghayral-haqqi walaa tattabi`oo ahwaa'a qawmin qad dalloo min qablu wa'adalloo katheeraw wadalloo `an sawaa'is-sabeel
Lu`inal-ladheena kafaroo mim banee israa'eela `alaa lisaani daawooda wa`eesabni maryam, dhaalika bimaa `asaw wakaanoo ya`tadoon
Kaanoo laa yatanaahawna `am munkarin fa`alooh, labi'sa maa kaanoo yaf`aloon
Taraa katheeram minhum yatawallawnal-ladheena kafaroo, labi'sa maa qaddamat lahum anfusuhum an sakhitallaahu `alayhim wafil-`adhaabi hum khaalidoon
Walaw kaanoo yu'minoona billaahi wan-nabiyyi wamaa unzila ilayhi mattakhadhoohum awliyaa'a walaakinna katheeram minhum faasiqoon
Latajidanna ashaddan-naasi `adaawatal lilladheena aamanul-yahooda wal-ladheena ashrakoo, walatajidanna aqrabahum mawaddatal lilladheena aamanul-ladheena qaaloo innaa nasaaraa, dhaalika bi'anna minhum qisseeseena waruhbaanaw wa'annahum laa yastakbiroon
Wa'idhaa sami`oo maa unzila ilar-rasooli taraa a`yunahum tafeedu minad-dam`i mimmaa `arafoo minal-haqq, yaqooloona rabbanaa aamannaa faktubnaa ma`ash-shaahideen
Wamaa lanaa laa nu'minu billaahi wamaa jaa'anaa minal-haqqi wanatma`u ay yudkhilanaa rabbunaa ma`al-qawmis-saaliheen
Fa'athaabahumullaahu bimaa qaaloo jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa, wadhaalika jazaa'ul-muhsineen
Wal-ladheena kafaroo wakadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa ulaa'ika ashaabul-jaheem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tuharrimoo tayyibaati maa ahallallaahu lakum walaa ta`tadoo, innallaaha laa yuhibbul-mu`tadeen
Wakuloo mimmaa razaqakumullaahu halaalan tayyibaa, wattaqullaahal-ladhee antum bihee mu'minoon
Laa yu'aakhidhukumullaahu bil-laghwi fee aymaanikum walaakiy yu'aakhidhukum bimaa `aqqattumul-aymaan, fakaffaaratuhoo it`aamu `asharati masaakeena min awsati maa tut`imoona ahleekum aw kiswatuhum aw tahreeru raqabah, famal lam yajid fasiyaamu thalaathati ayyaam, dhaalika kaffaaratu aymaanikum idhaa halaftum, wahfazoo aymaanakum, kadhaalika yubayyinullaahu lakum aayaatihee la`allakum tashkuroon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo innamal-khamru wal-maysiru wal-ansaabu wal-azlaamu rijsum min `amalish-shaytaani fajtaniboohu la`allakum tuflihoon
Innamaa yureedush-shaytaanu ay yooqi`a baynakumul-`adaawata wal-baghdaa'a fil-khamri wal-maysiri wayasuddakum `an dhikrillaahi wa`anis-salaati fahal antum muntahoon
Wa'atee`ullaaha wa'atee`ur-rasoola wahdharoo, fa'in tawallaytum fa`lamoo annamaa `alaa rasoolinal-balaaghul-mubeen
Laysa `alal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati junaahun feemaa ta`imoo idhaa mattaqaw wa'aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati thummattaqaw wa'aamanoo thummattaqaw wa'ahsanoo, wallaahu yuhibbul-muhsineen
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo layabluwannakumullaahu bishay'im minas-saydi tanaaluhoo aydeekum warimaahukum liya`lamallaahu may yakhaafuhoo bil-ghayb, famani`tadaa ba`da dhaalika falahoo `adhaabun aleem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa taqtulus-sayda wa'antum hurum, waman qatalahoo minkum muta`ammidan fajazaa'um mithlu maa qatala minan-na`ami yahkumu bihee dhawaa `adlim minkum hadyam baalighal-ka`bati aw kaffaaratun ta`aamu masaakeena aw `adlu dhaalika siyaamal liyadhooqa wabaala amrih, `afallaahu `ammaa salaf, waman `aada fayantaqimullaahu minh, wallaahu `azeezun dhuntiqaam
Uhilla lakum saydul-bahri wata`aamuhoo mataa`al lakum walis-sayyaarah, wahurrima `alaykum saydul-barri maa dumtum hurumaa, wattaqullaahal-ladhee ilayhi tuhsharoon
Ja`alallaahul-ka`batal-baytal-haraama qiyaamal lin-naasi wash-shahral-haraama wal-hadya wal-qalaa'id, dhaalika lita`lamoo annallaaha ya`lamu maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ardi wa'annallaaha bikulli shay'in `aleem
I`lamoo annallaaha shadeedul-`iqaabi wa'annallaaha ghafoorur raheem
Maa `alar-rasooli illal-balaagh, wallaahu ya`lamu maa tubdoona wamaa taktumoon
Qul laa yastawil-khabeethu wat-tayyibu walaw a`jabaka kathratul-khabeeth, fattaqullaaha yaa ulil-albaabi la`allakum tuflihoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tas'aloo `an ashyaa'a in tubda lakum tasu'kum, wa'in tas'aloo `anhaa heena yunazzalul-qur'aanu tubda lakum, `afallaahu `anhaa, wallaahu ghafoorun haleem
Qad sa'alahaa qawmum min qablikum thumma asbahoo bihaa kaafireen
Maa ja`alallaahu mim baheeratiw walaa saa'ibatiw walaa waseelatiw walaa haamiw walaakinnal-ladheena kafaroo yaftaroona `alallaahil-kadhib, wa'aktharuhum laa ya`qiloon
Wa'idhaa qeela lahum ta`aalaw ilaa maa anzalallaahu wa'ilar-rasooli qaaloo hasbunaa maa wajadnaa `alayhi aabaa'anaa, awalaw kaana aabaa'uhum laa ya`lamoona shay'aw walaa yahtadoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo `alaykum anfusakum, laa yadurrukum man dalla idhahtadaytum, ilallaahi marji`ukum jamee`an fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta`maloon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo shahaadatu baynikum idhaa hadara ahadakumul-mawtu heenal-wasiyyatithnaani dhawaa `adlim minkum aw aakharaani min ghayrikum in antum darabtum fil-ardi fa'asaabatkum museebatul-mawt, tahbisoonahumaa mim ba`dis-salaati fayuqsimaani billaahi inirtabtum laa nashtaree bihee thamanaw walaw kaana dhaa qurbaa walaa naktumu shahaadatallaahi innaa idhal laminal-aathimeen
Fa'in `uthira `alaa annahumastahaqqaa ithman fa'aakharaani yaqoomaani maqaamahumaa minal-ladheenastahaqqa `alayhimul-awlayaani fayuqsimaani billaahi lashahaadatunaa ahaqqu min shahaadatihimaa wama`tadaynaa, innaa idhal laminaz-zaalimeen
Dhaalika adnaa ay ya'too bish-shahaadati `alaa wajhihaa aw yakhaafoo an turadda aymaanum ba`da aymaanihim, wattaqullaaha wasma`oo, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmal-faasiqeen
Yawma yajma`ullaahur-rusula fayaqoolu maadhaa ujibtum, qaaloo laa `ilma lanaa, innaka anta `allaamul-ghuyoob
Idh qaalallaahu yaa`eesabna maryamadhkur ni`matee `alayka wa`alaa waalidatik, idh ayyattuka biroohil-qudus, tukallimun-naasa fil-mahdi wakahlaa, wa'idh `allamtukal-kitaaba wal-hikmata wat-tawraata wal-injeel, wa'idh takhluqu minat-teeni kahay'atit-tayri bi'idhnee fatanfukhu feehaa fatakoonu tayram bi'idhnee watubri'ul-akmaha wal-abrasa bi'idhnee, wa'idh tukhrijul-mawtaa bi'idhnee, wa'idh kafaftu banee israa'eela `anka idh ji'tahum bil-bayyinaati faqaalal-ladheena kafaroo minhum in haadhaa illaa sihrum mubeen
Wa'idh awhaytu ilal-hawaariyyeena an aaminoo bee wabirasoolee, qaaloo aamannaa washhad bi'annanaa muslimoon
Idh qaalal-hawaariyyoona yaa`eesabna maryama hal yastatee`u rabbuka ay yunazzila `alaynaa maa'idatam minas-samaa', qaalattaqullaaha in kuntum mu'mineen
Qaaloo nureedu an na'kula minhaa watatma'inna quloobunaa wana`lama an qad sadaqtanaa wanakoona `alayhaa minash-shaahideen
Qaala `eesabnu maryamallaahumma rabbanaa anzil `alaynaa maa'idatam minas-samaa'i takoonu lanaa `eedal li'awwalinaa wa'aakhirinaa wa'aayatam minka warzuqnaa wa'anta khayrur-raaziqeen
Qaalallaahu innee munazziluhaa `alaykum, famay yakfur ba`du minkum fa'innee u`adhdhibuhoo `adhaabal laa u`adhdhibuhoo ahadam minal-`aalameen
Wa'idh qaalallaahu yaa`eesabna maryama a'anta qulta lin-naasittakhidhoonee wa'ummiya ilaahayni min doonillaah, qaala subhaanaka maa yakoonu lee an aqoola maa laysa lee bihaqq, in kuntu qultuhoo faqad `alimtah, ta`lamu maa fee nafsee walaa a`lamu maa fee nafsik, innaka anta `allaamul-ghuyoob
Maa qultu lahum illaa maa amartanee bihee ani`budullaaha rabbee warabbakum, wakuntu `alayhim shaheedam maa dumtu feehim, falammaa tawaffaytanee kunta antar-raqeeba `alayhim, wa'anta `alaa kulli shay'in shaheed
In tu`adhdhibhum fa'innahum `ibaaduk, wa'in taghfir lahum fa'innaka antal-`azeezul-hakeem
Qaalallaahu haadhaa yawmu yanfa`us-saadiqeena sidquhum, lahum jannaatun tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa abadaa, radiyallaahu `anhum waradoo `anh, dhaalikal-fawzul-`azeem
Lillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa feehinn, wahuwa `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer

Al-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda waja`alaz-zulumaati wan-noor, thummal-ladheena kafaroo birabbihim ya`diloon
Huwal-ladhee khalaqakum min teenin thumma qadaa ajalaa, wa'ajalum musamman `indahoo thumma antum tamtaroon
Wahuwallaahu fis-samaawaati wafil-ard, ya`lamu sirrakum wajahrakum waya`lamu maa taksiboon
Wamaa ta'teehim min aayatim min aayaati rabbihim illaa kaanoo `anhaa mu`rideen
Faqad kadhdhaboo bil-haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum, fasawfa ya'teehim ambaa'u maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
Alam yaraw kam ahlaknaa min qablihim min qarnim makkannaahum fil-ardi maa lam numakkil lakum wa'arsalnas-samaa'a `alayhim midraaraa, waja`alnal-anhaara tajree min tahtihim fa'ahlaknaahum bidhunoobihim wa'ansha'naa mim ba`dihim qarnan aakhareen
Walaw nazzalnaa `alayka kitaaban fee qirtaasin falamasoohu bi'aydeehim laqaalal-ladheena kafaroo in haadhaa illaa sihrum mubeen
Waqaaloo lawlaa unzila `alayhi malak, walaw anzalnaa malakal laqudiyal-amru thumma laa yunzaroon
Walaw ja`alnaahu malakal laja`alnaahu rajulaw walalabasnaa `alayhim maa yalbisoon
Walaqadistuhzi'a birusulim min qablika fahaaqa bil-ladheena sakhiroo minhum maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
Qul seeroo fil-ardi thummanzuroo kayfa kaana `aaqibatul-mukadhdhibeen
Qul limam maa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, qul lillaah, kataba `alaa nafsihir-rahmah, layajma`annakum ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati laa rayba feeh, alladheena khasiroo anfusahum fahum laa yu'minoon
Walahoo maa sakana fil-layli wan-nahaar, wahuwas-samee`ul-`aleem
Qul aghayrallaahi attakhidhu waliyyan faatiris-samaawaati wal-ardi wahuwa yut`imu walaa yut`am, qul innee umirtu an akoona awwala man aslama walaa takoonanna minal-mushrikeen
Qul innee akhaafu in `asaytu rabbee `adhaaba yawmin `azeem
May yusraf `anhu yawma'idhin faqad rahimah, wadhaalikal-fawzul-mubeen
Wa'iy yamsaskallaahu bidurrin falaa kaashifa lahoo illaa huw, wa'iy yamsaska bikhayrin fahuwa `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Wahuwal-qaahiru fawqa `ibaadih, wahuwal-hakeemul-khabeer
Qul ayyu shay'in akbaru shahaadah, qulillaah, shaheedum baynee wabaynakum, wa'oohiya ilayya haadhal-qur'aanu li'undhirakum bihee wamam balagh, a'innakum latashhadoona anna ma`allaahi aalihatan ukhraa, qul laa ashhad, qul innamaa huwa ilaahuw waahiduw wa'innanee baree'um mimmaa tushrikoon
Alladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba ya`rifoonahoo kamaa ya`rifoona abnaa'ahum, alladheena khasiroo anfusahum fahum laa yu'minoon
Waman azlamu mimmaniftaraa `alallaahi kadhiban aw kadhdhaba bi'aayaatih, innahoo laa yuflihuz-zaalimoon
Wayawma nahshuruhum jamee`an thumma naqoolu lilladheena ashrakoo ayna shurakaa'ukumul-ladheena kuntum taz`umoon
Thumma lam takun fitnatuhum illaa an qaaloo wallaahi rabbinaa maa kunnaa mushrikeen
Unzur kayfa kadhaboo `alaa anfusihim wadalla `anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon
Waminhum may yastami`u ilayk, waja`alnaa `alaa quloobihim akinnatan ay yafqahoohu wafee aadhaanihim waqraa, wa'iy yaraw kulla aayatil laa yu'minoo bihaa, hattaa idhaa jaa'ooka yujaadiloonaka yaqoolul-ladheena kafaroo in haadhaa illaa asaateerul-awwaleen
Wahum yanhawna `anhu wayan'awna `anh, wa'iy yuhlikoona illaa anfusahum wamaa yash`uroon
Walaw taraa idh wuqifoo `alan-naari faqaaloo yaalaytanaa nuraddu walaa nukadhdhiba bi'aayaati rabbinaa wanakoona minal-mu'mineen
Bal badaa lahum maa kaanoo yukhfoona min qabl, walaw ruddoo la`aadoo limaa nuhoo `anhu wa'innahum lakaadhiboon
Waqaaloo in hiya illaa hayaatunad-dunyaa wamaa nahnu bimab`ootheen
Walaw taraa idh wuqifoo `alaa rabbihim, qaala alaysa haadhaa bil-haqq, qaaloo balaa warabbinaa, qaala fadhooqul-`adhaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon
Qad khasiral-ladheena kadhdhaboo biliqaa'illaah, hattaa idhaa jaa'athumus-saa`atu baghtatan qaaloo yaahasratanaa `alaa maa farratnaa feehaa wahum yahmiloona awzaarahum `alaa zuhoorihim, alaa saa'a maa yaziroon
Wamal-hayaatud-dunyaa illaa la`ibuw walahw, walad-daarul-aakhiratu khayrul lilladheena yattaqoon, afalaa ta`qiloon
Qad na`lamu innahoo layahzunukal-ladhee yaqooloona fa'innahum laa yukadhdhiboonaka walaakinnaz-zaalimeena bi'aayaatillaahi yajhadoon
Walaqad kudhdhibat rusulum min qablika fasabaroo `alaa maa kudhdhiboo wa'oodhoo hattaa ataahum nasrunaa, walaa mubaddila likalimaatillaah, walaqad jaa'aka min naba'il-mursaleen
Wa'in kaana kabura `alayka i`raaduhum fa'inistata`ta an tabtaghiya nafaqan fil-ardi aw sullaman fis-samaa'i fata'tiyahum bi'aayah, walaw shaa'allaahu lajama`ahum `alal-hudaa falaa takoonanna minal-jaahileen
Innamaa yastajeebul-ladheena yasma`oon, wal-mawtaa yab`athuhumullaahu thumma ilayhi yurja`oon
Waqaaloo lawlaa nuzzila `alayhi aayatum mir rabbih, qul innallaaha qaadirun `alaa ay yunazzila aayataw walaakinna aktharahum laa ya`lamoon
Wamaa min daabbatin fil-ardi walaa taa'iriy yateeru bijanaahayhi illaa umamun amthaalukum, maa farratnaa fil-kitaabi min shay'in thumma ilaa rabbihim yuhsharoon
Wal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa summuw wabukmun fiz-zulumaat, may yasha'illaahu yudlilhu wamay yasha' yaj`alhu `alaa siraatim mustaqeem
Qul ara'aytakum in ataakum `adhaabullaahi aw atatkumus-saa`atu aghayrallaahi tad`oon, in kuntum saadiqeen
Bal iyyaahu tad`oona fayakshifu maa tad`oona ilayhi in shaa'a watansawna maa tushrikoon
Walaqad arsalnaa ilaa umamim min qablika fa'akhadhnaahum bil-ba'saa'i wad-darraa'i la`allahum yatadarra`oon
Falawlaa idh jaa'ahum ba'sunaa tadarra`oo walaakin qasat quloobuhum wazayyana lahumush-shaytaanu maa kaanoo ya`maloon
Falammaa nasoo maa dhukkiroo bihee fatahnaa `alayhim abwaaba kulli shay', hattaa idhaa farihoo bimaa ootoo akhadhnaahum baghtatan fa'idhaa hum mublisoon
Faquti`a daabirul-qawmil-ladheena zalamoo, wal-hamdu lillaahi rabbil-`aalameen
Qul ara'aytum in akhadhallaahu sam`akum wa'absaarakum wakhatama `alaa quloobikum man ilaahun ghayrullaahi ya'teekum bih, unzur kayfa nusarriful-aayaati thumma hum yasdifoon
Qul ara'aytakum in ataakum `adhaabullaahi baghtatan aw jahratan hal yuhlaku illal-qawmuz-zaalimoon
Wamaa nursilul-mursaleena illaa mubashshireena wamundhireen, faman aamana wa'aslaha falaa khawfun `alayhim walaa hum yahzanoon
Wal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa yamassuhumul-`adhaabu bimaa kaanoo yafsuqoon
Qul laa aqoolu lakum `indee khazaa'inullaahi walaa a`lamul-ghayba walaa aqoolu lakum innee malak, in attabi`u illaa maa yoohaa ilayy, qul hal yastawil-a`maa wal-baseer, afalaa tatafakkaroon
Wa'andhir bihil-ladheena yakhaafoona ay yuhsharoo ilaa rabbihim laysa lahum min doonihee waliyyuw walaa shafee`ul la`allahum yattaqoon
Walaa tatrudil-ladheena yad`oona rabbahum bil-ghadaati wal-`ashiyyi yureedoona wajhah, maa `alayka min hisaabihim min shay'iw wamaa min hisaabika `alayhim min shay'in fatatrudahum fatakoona minaz-zaalimeen
Wakadhaalika fatannaa ba`dahum biba`dil liyaqooloo ahaa'ulaa'i mannallaahu `alayhim mim bayninaa, alaysallaahu bi'a`lama bish-shaakireen
Wa'idhaa jaa'akal-ladheena yu'minoona bi'aayaatinaa faqul salaamun `alaykum kataba rabbukum `alaa nafsihir-rahmata annahoo man `amila minkum soo'am bijahaalatin thumma taaba mim ba`dihee wa'aslaha fa'annahoo ghafoorur raheem
Wakadhaalika nufassilul-aayaati walitastabeena sabeelul-mujrimeen
Qul innee nuheetu an a`budal-ladheena tad`oona min doonillaah, qul laa attabi`u ahwaa'akum qad dalaltu idhaw wamaa ana minal-muhtadeen
Qul innee `alaa bayyinatim mir rabbee wakadhdhabtum bih, maa `indee maa tasta`jiloona bih, inil-hukmu illaa lillaah, yaqussul-haqqa wahuwa khayrul-faasileen
Qul law anna `indee maa tasta`jiloona bihee laqudiyal-amru baynee wabaynakum, wallaahu a`lamu biz-zaalimeen
Wa`indahoo mafaatihul-ghaybi laa ya`lamuhaa illaa huw, waya`lamu maa fil-barri wal-bahr, wamaa tasqutu miw waraqatin illaa ya`lamuhaa walaa habbatin fee zulumaatil-ardi walaa ratbiw walaa yaabisin illaa fee kitaabim mubeen
Wahuwal-ladhee yatawaffaakum bil-layli waya`lamu maa jarahtum bin-nahaari thumma yab`athukum feehi liyuqdaa ajalum musammaa, thumma ilayhi marji`ukum thumma yunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta`maloon
Wahuwal-qaahiru fawqa `ibaadihee wayursilu `alaykum hafazah, hattaa idhaa jaa'a ahadakumul-mawtu tawaffathu rusulunaa wahum laa yufarritoon
Thumma ruddoo ilallaahi mawlaahumul-haqq, alaa lahul-hukmu wahuwa asra`ul-haasibeen
Qul may yunajjeekum min zulumaatil-barri wal-bahri tad`oonahoo tadarru`aw wakhufyah, la'in anjaanaa min haadhihee lanakoonanna minash-shaakireen
Qulillaahu yunajjeekum minhaa wamin kulli karbin thumma antum tushrikoon
Qul huwal-qaadiru `alaa ay yab`atha `alaykum `adhaabam min fawqikum aw min tahti arjulikum aw yalbisakum shiya`aw wayudheeqa ba`dakum ba'sa ba`d, unzur kayfa nusarriful-aayaati la`allahum yafqahoon
Wakadhdhaba bihee qawmuka wahuwal-haqq, qul lastu `alaykum biwakeel
Likulli naba'im mustaqarruw wasawfa ta`lamoon
Wa'idhaa ra'aytal-ladheena yakhoodoona fee aayaatinaa fa'a`rid `anhum hattaa yakhoodoo fee hadeethin ghayrih, wa'immaa yunsiyannakash-shaytaanu falaa taq`ud ba`dadh-dhikraa ma`al-qawmiz-zaalimeen
Wamaa `alal-ladheena yattaqoona min hisaabihim min shay'iw walaakin dhikraa la`allahum yattaqoon
Wadharil-ladheenattakhadhoo deenahum la`ibaw walahwaw wagharrathumul-hayaatud-dunyaa wadhakkir bihee an tubsala nafsum bimaa kasabat, laysa lahaa min doonillaahi waliyyuw walaa shafee`, wa'in ta`dil kulla `adlil laa yu'khadh minhaa, ulaa'ikal-ladheena ubsiloo bimaa kasaboo lahum sharaabum min hameemiw wa`adhaabun aleemum bimaa kaanoo yakfuroon
Qul anad`oo min doonillaahi maa laa yanfa`unaa walaa yadurrunaa wanuraddu `alaa a`qaabinaa ba`da idh hadaanallaahu kal-ladhistahwathush-shayaateenu fil-ardi hayraana lahoo ashaabuy yad`oonahoo ilal-huda'tinaa, qul inna hudallaahi huwal-hudaa, wa'umirnaa linuslima lirabbil-`aalameen
Wa'an aqeemus-salaata wattaqooh, wahuwal-ladhee ilayhi tuhsharoon
Wahuwal-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqq, wayawma yaqoolu kun fayakoon, qawluhul-haqq, walahul-mulku yawma yunfakhu fis-soor, `aalimul-ghaybi wash-shahaadati wahuwal-hakeemul-khabeer
Wa'idh qaala ibraaheemu li'abeehi aazara atattakhidhu asnaaman aalihah, innee araaka waqawmaka fee dalaalim mubeen
Wakadhaalika nuree ibraaheema malakootas-samaawaati wal-ardi waliyakoona minal-mooqineen
Falammaa janna `alayhil-laylu ra'aa kawkabaa, qaala haadhaa rabbee, falammaa afala qaala laa uhibbul-aafileen
Falammaa ra'al-qamara baazighan qaala haadhaa rabbee, falammaa afala qaala la'il lam yahdinee rabbee la'akoonanna minal-qawmid-daalleen
Falammaa ra'ash-shamsa baazighatan qaala haadhaa rabbee haadhaa akbar, falammaa afalat qaala yaaqawmi innee baree'um mimmaa tushrikoon
Innee wajjahtu wajhiya lilladhee fataras-samaawaati wal-arda haneefaw wamaa ana minal-mushrikeen
Wahaajjahoo qawmuh, qaala atuhaajjoonnee fillaahi waqad hadaan, walaa akhaafu maa tushrikoona bihee illaa ay yashaa'a rabbee shay'aa, wasi`a rabbee kulla shay'in `ilmaa, afalaa tatadhakkaroon
Wakayfa akhaafu maa ashraktum walaa takhaafoona annakum ashraktum billaahi maa lam yunazzil bihee `alaykum sultaanaa, fa'ayyul-fareeqayni ahaqqu bil-amn, in kuntum ta`lamoon
Alladheena aamanoo walam yalbisoo eemaanahum bizulmin ulaa'ika lahumul-amnu wahum muhtadoon
Watilka hujjatunaa aataynaahaa ibraaheema `alaa qawmih, narfa`u darajaatim man nashaa', inna rabbaka hakeemun `aleem
Wawahabnaa lahoo ishaaqa waya`qoob, kullan hadaynaa wanoohan hadaynaa min qablu wamin dhurriyyatihee daawooda wasulaymaana wa'ayyooba wayoosufa wamoosaa wahaaroon, wakadhaalika najzil-muhsineen
Wazakariyyaa wayahyaa wa`eesaa wa'ilyaas, kullum minas-saaliheen
Wa'ismaa`eela wal-yasa`a wayoonusa walootaa, wakullan faddalnaa `alal-`aalameen
Wamin aabaa'ihim wadhurriyyaatihim wa'ikhwaanihim, wajtabaynaahum wahadaynaahum ilaa siraatim mustaqeem
Dhaalika hudallaahi yahdee bihee may yashaa'u min `ibaadih, walaw ashrakoo lahabita `anhum maa kaanoo ya`maloon
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba wal-hukma wan-nubuwwah, fa'iy yakfur bihaa haa'ulaa'i faqad wakkalnaa bihaa qawmal laysoo bihaa bikaafireen
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena hadallaahu fabihudaahumuqtadih, qul laa as'alukum `alayhi ajraa, in huwa illaa dhikraa lil-`aalameen
Wamaa qadarullaaha haqqa qadrihee idh qaaloo maa anzalallaahu `alaa basharim min shay', qul man anzalal-kitaabal-ladhee jaa'a bihee moosaa nooraw wahudal lin-naasi taj`aloonahoo qaraateesa tubdoonahaa watukhfoona katheeraa, wa`ullimtum maa lam ta`lamoo antum walaa aabaa'ukum, qulillaahu thumma dharhum fee khawdihim yal`aboon
Wahaadhaa kitaabun anzalnaahu mubaarakum musaddiqul-ladhee bayna yadayhi walitundhira ummal-quraa waman hawlahaa, wal-ladheena yu'minoona bil-aakhirati yu'minoona bihee wahum `alaa salaatihim yuhaafizoon
Waman azlamu mimmaniftaraa `alallaahi kadhiban aw qaala oohiya ilayya walam yooha ilayhi shay'uw waman qaala sa'unzilu mithla maa anzalallaah, walaw taraa idhiz-zaalimoona fee ghamaraatil-mawti wal-malaa'ikatu baasitoo aydeehim, akhrijoo anfusakum, al-yawma tujzawna `adhaabal-hooni bimaa kuntum taqooloona `alallaahi ghayral-haqqi wakuntum `an aayaatihee tastakbiroon
Walaqad ji'tumoonaa furaadaa kamaa khalaqnaakum awwala marratiw wataraktum maa khawwalnaakum waraa'a zuhoorikum, wamaa naraa ma`akum shufa`aa'akumul-ladheena za`amtum annahum feekum shurakaa', laqat taqatta`a baynakum wadalla `ankum maa kuntum taz`umoon
Innallaaha faaliqul-habbi wan-nawaa, yukhrijul-hayya minal-mayyiti wamukhrijul-mayyiti minal-hayy, dhaalikumullaahu fa'annaa tu'fakoon
Faaliqul-isbaah, waja`alal-layla sakanaw wash-shamsa wal-qamara husbaanaa, dhaalika taqdeerul-`azeezil-`aleem
Wahuwal-ladhee ja`ala lakumun-nujooma litahtadoo bihaa fee zulumaatil-barri wal-bahr, qad fassalnal-aayaati liqawmiy ya`lamoon
Wahuwal-ladhee ansha'akum min nafsiw waahidatin famustaqarruw wamustawda`, qad fassalnal-aayaati liqawmiy yafqahoon
Wahuwal-ladhee anzala minas-samaa'i maa'aa, fa'akhrajnaa bihee nabaata kulli shay'in fa'akhrajnaa minhu khadiran nukhriju minhu habbam mutaraakibaa, waminan-nakhli min tal`ihaa qinwaanun daaniyatuw wajannaatim min a`naabiw waz-zaytoona war-rummaana mushtabihaw waghayra mutashaabih, unzuroo ilaa thamarihee idhaa athmara wayan`ih, inna fee dhaalikum la'aayaatil liqawmiy yu'minoon
Waja`aloo lillaahi shurakaa'al-jinna wakhalaqahum wakharaqoo lahoo baneena wabanaatim bighayri `ilm, subhaanahoo wata`aalaa `ammaa yasifoon
Badee`us-samaawaati wal-ard, annaa yakoonu lahoo waladuw walam takul lahoo saahibah, wakhalaqa kulla shay', wahuwa bikulli shay'in `aleem
Dhaalikumullaahu rabbukum, laa ilaaha illaa huw, khaaliqu kulli shay'in fa`budooh, wahuwa `alaa kulli shay'iw wakeel
Laa tudrikuhul-absaaru wahuwa yudrikul-absaar, wahuwal-lateeful-khabeer
Qad jaa'akum basaa'iru mir rabbikum, faman absara falinafsih, waman `amiya fa`alayhaa, wamaa ana `alaykum bihafeez
Wakadhaalika nusarriful-aayaati waliyaqooloo darasta walinubayyinahoo liqawmiy ya`lamoon
Ittabi` maa oohiya ilayka mir rabbik, laa ilaaha illaa huw, wa'a`rid `anil-mushrikeen
Walaw shaa'allaahu maa ashrakoo, wamaa ja`alnaaka `alayhim hafeezaa, wamaa anta `alayhim biwakeel
Walaa tasubbul-ladheena yad`oona min doonillaahi fayasubbullaaha `adwam bighayri `ilm, kadhaalika zayyannaa likulli ummatin `amalahum, thumma ilaa rabbihim marji`uhum fayunabbi'uhum bimaa kaanoo ya`maloon
Wa'aqsamoo billaahi jahda aymaanihim la'in jaa'athum aayatul layu'minunna bihaa, qul innamal-aayaatu `indallaahi wamaa yush`irukum annahaa idhaa jaa'at laa yu'minoon
Wanuqallibu af'idatahum wa'absaarahum kamaa lam yu'minoo bihee awwala marratiw wanadharuhum fee tughyaanihim ya`mahoon
Walaw annanaa nazzalnaa ilayhimul-malaa'ikata wakallamahumul-mawtaa wahasharnaa `alayhim kulla shay'in qubulam maa kaanoo liyu'minoo illaa ay yashaa'allaahu walaakinna aktharahum yajhaloon
Wakadhaalika ja`alnaa likulli nabiyyin `aduwwan shayaateenal-insi wal-jinni yoohee ba`duhum ilaa ba`din zukhrufal-qawli ghurooraa, walaw shaa'a rabbuka maa fa`aloohu fadharhum wamaa yaftaroon
Walitasghaa ilayhi af'idatul-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati waliyardawhu waliyaqtarifoo maa hum muqtarifoon
Afaghayrallaahi abtaghee hakamaw wahuwal-ladhee anzala ilaykumul-kitaaba mufassalaa, wal-ladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba ya`lamoona annahoo munazzalum mir rabbika bil-haqqi falaa takoonanna minal-mumtareen
Watammat kalimatu rabbika sidqaw wa`adlaa, laa mubaddila likalimaatih, wahuwas-samee`ul-`aleem
Wa'in tuti` akthara man fil-ardi yudillooka `an sabeelillaah, iy yattabi`oona illaz-zanna wa'in hum illaa yakhrusoon
Inna rabbaka huwa a`lamu may yadillu `an sabeelih, wahuwa a`lamu bil-muhtadeen
Fakuloo mimmaa dhukirasmullaahi `alayhi in kuntum bi'aayaatihee mu'mineen
Wamaa lakum allaa ta'kuloo mimmaa dhukirasmullaahi `alayhi waqad fassala lakum maa harrama `alaykum illaa madturirtum ilayh, wa'inna katheeral layudilloona bi'ahwaa'ihim bighayri `ilm, inna rabbaka huwa a`lamu bil-mu`tadeen
Wadharoo zaahiral-ithmi wabaatinah, innal-ladheena yaksiboonal-ithma sayujzawna bimaa kaanoo yaqtarifoon
Walaa ta'kuloo mimmaa lam yudhkarismullaahi `alayhi wa'innahoo lafisq, wa'innash-shayaateena layoohoona ilaa awliyaa'ihim liyujaadilookum, wa'in ata`tumoohum innakum lamushrikoon
Awaman kaana maytan fa'ahyaynaahu waja`alnaa lahoo nooray yamshee bihee fin-naasi kamam mathaluhoo fiz-zulumaati laysa bikhaarijim minhaa, kadhaalika zuyyina lil-kaafireena maa kaanoo ya`maloon
Wakadhaalika ja`alnaa fee kulli qaryatin akaabira mujrimeehaa liyamkuroo feehaa, wamaa yamkuroona illaa bi'anfusihim wamaa yash`uroon
Wa'idhaa jaa'athum aayatun qaaloo lan nu'mina hattaa nu'taa mithla maa ootiya rusulullaah, allaahu a`lamu haythu yaj`alu risaalatah, sayuseebul-ladheena ajramoo saghaarun `indallaahi wa`adhaabun shadeedum bimaa kaanoo yamkuroon
Famay yuridillaahu ay yahdiyahoo yashrah sadrahoo lil-islaam, wamay yurid ay yudillahoo yaj`al sadrahoo dayyiqan harajan ka'annamaa yassa``adu fis-samaa', kadhaalika yaj`alullaahur-rijsa `alal-ladheena laa yu'minoon
Wahaadhaa siraatu rabbika mustaqeemaa, qad fassalnal-aayaati liqawmiy yadhdhakkaroon
Lahum daarus-salaami `inda rabbihim wahuwa waliyyuhum bimaa kaanoo ya`maloon
Wayawma yahshuruhum jamee`aa, yaama`sharal-jinni qadistakthartum minal-ins, waqaala awliyaa'uhum minal-insi rabbanastamta`a ba`dunaa biba`diw wabalaghnaa ajalanal-ladhee ajjalta lanaa, qaalan-naaru mathwaakum khaalideena feehaa illaa maa shaa'allaah, inna rabbaka hakeemun `aleem
Wakadhaalika nuwallee ba`daz-zaalimeena ba`dam bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
Yaama`sharal-jinni wal-insi alam ya'tikum rusulum minkum yaqussoona `alaykum aayaatee wayundhiroonakum liqaa'a yawmikum haadhaa, qaaloo shahidnaa `alaa anfusinaa wagharrathumul-hayaatud-dunyaa washahidoo `alaa anfusihim annahum kaanoo kaafireen
Dhaalika al lam yakur rabbuka muhlikal-quraa bizulmiw wa'ahluhaa ghaafiloon
Walikullin darajaatum mimmaa `amiloo, wamaa rabbuka bighaafilin `ammaa ya`maloon
Warabbukal-ghaniyyu dhur-rahmah, iy yasha' yudhhibkum wayastakhlif mim ba`dikum maa yashaa'u kamaa ansha'akum min dhurriyyati qawmin aakhareen
Inna maa too`adoona la'aatiw wamaa antum bimu`jizeen
Qul yaaqawmi`maloo `alaa makaanatikum innee `aamil, fasawfa ta`lamoona man takoonu lahoo `aaqibatud-daar, innahoo laa yuflihuz-zaalimoon
Waja`aloo lillaahi mimmaa dhara'a minal-harthi wal-an`aami naseeban faqaaloo haadhaa lillaahi biza`mihim wahaadhaa lishurakaa'inaa, famaa kaana lishurakaa'ihim falaa yasilu ilallaah, wamaa kaana lillaahi fahuwa yasilu ilaa shurakaa'ihim, saa'a maa yahkumoon
Wakadhaalika zayyana likatheerim minal-mushrikeena qatla awlaadihim shurakaa'uhum liyurdoohum waliyalbisoo `alayhim deenahum, walaw shaa'allaahu maa fa`aloohu fadharhum wamaa yaftaroon
Waqaaloo haadhihee an`aamuw waharthun hijrul laa yat`amuhaa illaa man nashaa'u biza`mihim wa'an`aamun hurrimat zuhooruhaa wa'an`aamul laa yadhkuroonasmallaahi `alayhaftiraa'an `alayh, sayajzeehim bimaa kaanoo yaftaroon
Waqaaloo maa fee butooni haadhihil-an`aami khaalisatul lidhukoorinaa wamuharramun `alaa azwaajinaa, wa'iy yakum maytatan fahum feehi shurakaa', sayajzeehim wasfahum, innahoo hakeemun `aleem
Qad khasiral-ladheena qataloo awlaadahum safaham bighayri `ilmiw waharramoo maa razaqahumullaahuftiraa'an `alallaah, qad dalloo wamaa kaanoo muhtadeen
Wahuwal-ladhee ansha'a jannaatim ma`rooshaatiw waghayra ma`rooshaatiw wan-nakhla waz-zar`a mukhtalifan ukuluhoo waz-zaytoona war-rummaana mutashaabihaw waghayra mutashaabih, kuloo min thamarihee idhaa athmara wa'aatoo haqqahoo yawma hasaadih, walaa tusrifoo, innahoo laa yuhibbul-musrifeen
Waminal-an`aami hamoolataw wafarshaa, kuloo mimmaa razaqakumullaahu walaa tattabi`oo khutuwaatish-shaytaan, innahoo lakum `aduwwum mubeen
Thamaaniyata azwaaj, minad-da'nithnayni waminal-ma`zithnayn, qul aadh-dhakarayni harrama amil-unthayayni ammashtamalat `alayhi arhaamul-unthayayn, nabbi'oonee bi`ilmin in kuntum saadiqeen
Waminal-ibilithnayni waminal-baqarithnayn, qul aadh-dhakarayni harrama amil-unthayayni ammashtamalat `alayhi arhaamul-unthayayn, am kuntum shuhadaa'a idh wassaakumullaahu bihaadhaa, faman azlamu mimmaniftaraa `alallaahi kadhibal liyudillan-naasa bighayri `ilm, innallaaha laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
Qul laa ajidu fee maa oohiya ilayya muharraman `alaa taa`imiy yat`amuhoo illaa ay yakoona maytatan aw damam masfoohan aw lahma khinzeerin fa'innahoo rijsun aw fisqan uhilla lighayrillaahi bih, famanidturra ghayra baaghiw walaa `aadin fa'inna rabbaka ghafoorur raheem
Wa`alal-ladheena haadoo harramnaa kulla dhee zufur, waminal-baqari wal-ghanami harramnaa `alayhim shuhoomahumaa illaa maa hamalat zuhooruhumaa awil-hawaayaa aw makhtalata bi`azm, dhaalika jazaynaahum bibaghyihim, wa'innaa lasaadiqoon
Fa'in kadhdhabooka faqur rabbukum dhoo rahmatiw waasi`ah, walaa yuraddu ba'suhoo `anil-qawmil-mujrimeen
Sayaqoolul-ladheena ashrakoo law shaa'allaahu maa ashraknaa walaa aabaa'unaa walaa harramnaa min shay', kadhaalika kadhdhabal-ladheena min qablihim hattaa dhaaqoo ba'sanaa, qul hal `indakum min `ilmin fatukhrijoohu lanaa, in tattabi`oona illaz-zanna wa'in antum illaa takhrusoon
Qul falillaahil-hujjatul-baalighah, falaw shaa'a lahadaakum ajma`een
Qul halumma shuhadaa'akumul-ladheena yashhadoona annallaaha harrama haadhaa, fa'in shahidoo falaa tashhad ma`ahum, walaa tattabi` ahwaa'al-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa wal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati wahum birabbihim ya`diloon
Qul ta`aalaw atlu maa harrama rabbukum `alaykum allaa tushrikoo bihee shay'aw wabil-waalidayni ihsaanaa, walaa taqtuloo awlaadakum min imlaaq, nahnu narzuqukum wa'iyyaahum, walaa taqrabul-fawaahisha maa zahara minhaa wamaa batan, walaa taqtulun-nafsal-latee harramallaahu illaa bil-haqq, dhaalikum wassaakum bihee la`allakum ta`qiloon
Walaa taqraboo maalal-yateemi illaa bil-latee hiya ahsanu hattaa yablugha ashuddah, wa'awful-kayla wal-meezaana bil-qist, laa nukallifu nafsan illaa wus`ahaa, wa'idhaa qultum fa`diloo walaw kaana dhaa qurbaa, wabi`ahdillaahi awfoo, dhaalikum wassaakum bihee la`allakum tadhakkaroon
Wa'anna haadhaa siraatee mustaqeeman fattabi`ooh, walaa tattabi`us-subula fatafarraqa bikum `an sabeelih, dhaalikum wassaakum bihee la`allakum tattaqoon
Thumma aataynaa moosal-kitaaba tamaaman `alal-ladhee ahsana watafseelal likulli shay'iw wahudaw warahmatal la`allahum biliqaa'i rabbihim yu'minoon
Wahaadhaa kitaabun anzalnaahu mubaarakun fattabi`oohu wattaqoo la`allakum turhamoon
An taqooloo innamaa unzilal-kitaabu `alaa taa'ifatayni min qablinaa, wa'in kunnaa `an diraasatihim laghaafileen
Aw taqooloo law annaa unzila `alaynal-kitaabu lakunnaa ahdaa minhum, faqad jaa'akum bayyinatum mir rabbikum wahudaw warahmah, faman azlamu mimman kadhdhaba bi'aayaatillaahi wasadafa `anhaa, sanajzil-ladheena yasdifoona `an aayaatinaa soo'al-`adhaabi bimaa kaanoo yasdifoon
Hal yanzuroona illaa an ta'tiyahumul-malaa'ikatu aw ya'tiya rabbuka aw ya'tiya ba`du aayaati rabbik, yawma ya'tee ba`du aayaati rabbika laa yanfa`u nafsan eemaanuhaa lam takun aamanat min qablu aw kasabat fee eemaanihaa khayraa, qulintaziroo innaa muntaziroon
Innal-ladheena farraqoo deenahum wakaanoo shiya`al lasta minhum fee shay', innamaa amruhum ilallaahi thumma yunabbi'uhum bimaa kaanoo yaf`aloon
Man jaa'a bil-hasanati falahoo `ashru amthaalihaa, waman jaa'a bis-sayyi'ati falaa yujzaa illaa mithlahaa wahum laa yuzlamoon
Qul innanee hadaanee rabbee ilaa siraatim mustaqeem, deenan qiyamam millata ibraaheema haneefaa, wamaa kaana minal-mushrikeen
Qul inna salaatee wanusukee wamahyaaya wamamaatee lillaahi rabbil-`aalameen
Laa shareeka lah, wabidhaalika umirtu wa'ana awwalul-muslimeen
Qul aghayrallaahi abghee rabbaw wahuwa rabbu kulli shay', walaa taksibu kullu nafsin illaa `alayhaa, walaa taziru waaziratuw wizra ukhraa, thumma ilaa rabbikum marji`ukum fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum feehi takhtalifoon
Wahuwal-ladhee ja`alakum khalaa'ifal-ardi warafa`a ba`dakum fawqa ba`din darajaatil liyabluwakum fee maa aataakum, inna rabbaka saree`ul-`iqaab, wa'innahoo laghafoorur raheem

Walammaa sakata `am moosal-ghadabu akhadhal-alwaah, wafee nuskhatihaa hudaw warahmatul lilladheena hum lirabbihim yarhaboon
Wakhtaara moosaa qawmahoo sab`eena rajulal limeeqaatinaa, falammaa akhadhathumur-rajfatu qaala rabbi law shi'ta ahlaktahum min qablu wa'iyyaay, atuhlikunaa bimaa fa`alas-sufahaa'u minnaa, in hiya illaa fitnatuk, tudillu bihaa man tashaa'u watahdee man tashaa', anta waliyyunaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa wa'anta khayrul-ghaafireen
Waktub lanaa fee haadhihid-dunyaa hasanataw wafil-aakhirati innaa hudnaa ilayk, qaala `adhaabee useebu bihee man ashaa', warahmatee wasi`at kulla shay', fasa'aktubuhaa lilladheena yattaqoona wayu'toonaz-zakaata wal-ladheena hum bi'aayaatinaa yu'minoon
Alladheena yattabi`oonar-rasoolan-nabiyyal-ummiyyal-ladhee yajidoonahoo maktooban `indahum fit-tawraati wal-injeeli ya'muruhum bil-ma`roofi wayanhaahum `anil-munkari wayuhillu lahumut-tayyibaati wayuharrimu `alayhimul-khabaa'itha wayada`u `anhum israhum wal-aghlaalal-latee kaanat `alayhim, fal-ladheena aamanoo bihee wa`azzaroohu wanasaroohu wattaba`un-nooral-ladhee unzila ma`ahoo ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
Qul yaa ayyuhan-naasu innee rasoolullaahi ilaykum jamee`anil-ladhee lahoo mulkus-samaawaati wal-ard, laa ilaaha illaa huwa yuhyee wayumeet, fa'aaminoo billaahi warasoolihin-nabiyyil-ummiyyil-ladhee yu'minu billaahi wakalimaatihee wattabi`oohu la`allakum tahtadoon
Wamin qawmi moosaa ummatuy yahdoona bil-haqqi wabihee ya`diloon
Waqatta`naahumuthnatay `ashrata asbaatan umamaa, wa'awhaynaa ilaa moosaa idhistasqaahu qawmuhoo anidrib bi`asaakal-hajar, fambajasat minhuthnataa `ashrata `aynaa, qad `alima kullu unaasim mashrabahum, wazallalnaa `alayhimul-ghamaama wa'anzalnaa `alayhimul-manna was-salwaa, kuloo min tayyibaati maa razaqnaakum, wamaa zalamoonaa walaakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
Wa'idh qeela lahumuskunoo haadhihil-qaryata wakuloo minhaa haythu shi'tum waqooloo hittatuw wadkhulul-baaba sujjadan naghfir lakum khatee'aatikum, sanazeedul-muhsineen
Fabaddalal-ladheena zalamoo minhum qawlan ghayral-ladhee qeela lahum fa'arsalnaa `alayhim rijzam minas-samaa'i bimaa kaanoo yazlimoon
Was'alhum `anil-qaryatil-latee kaanat haadiratal-bahr, idh ya`doona fis-sabti idh ta'teehim heetaanuhum yawma sabtihim shurra`aw wayawma laa yasbitoona laa ta'teehim kadhaalik, nabloohum bimaa kaanoo yafsuqoon
Wa'idh qaalat ummatum minhum lima ta`izoona qawmanillaahu muhlikuhum aw mu`adhdhibuhum `adhaaban shadeedaa, qaaloo ma`dhiratan ilaa rabbikum wala`allahum yattaqoon
Falammaa nasoo maa dhukkiroo bihee anjaynal-ladheena yanhawna `anis-soo'i wa'akhadhnal-ladheena zalamoo bi`adhaabim ba'eesim bimaa kaanoo yafsuqoon
Falammaa `ataw `am maa nuhoo `anhu qulnaa lahum koonoo qiradatan khaasi'een
Wa'idh ta'adhdhana rabbuka layab`athanna `alayhim ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati may yasoomuhum soo'al-`adhaab, inna rabbaka lasaree`ul-`iqaab, wa'innahoo laghafoorur raheem
Waqatta`naahum fil-ardi umamaa, minhumus-saalihoona waminhum doona dhaalik, wabalawnaahum bil-hasanaati was-sayyi'aati la`allahum yarji`oon
Fakhalafa mim ba`dihim khalfuw warithul-kitaaba ya'khudhoona `arada haadhal-adnaa wayaqooloona sayughfaru lanaa, wa'iy ya'tihim `aradum mithluhoo ya'khudhooh, alam yu'khadh `alayhim meethaaqul-kitaabi al laa yaqooloo `alallaahi illal-haqqa wadarasoo maa feeh, wad-daarul-aakhiratu khayrul lilladheena yattaqoon, afalaa ta`qiloon
Wal-ladheena yumassikoona bil-kitaabi wa'aqaamus-salaah, innaa laa nudee`u ajral-musliheen
Wa'idh nataqnal-jabala fawqahum ka'annahoo zullatuw wazannoo annahoo waaqi`um bihim, khudhoo maa aataynaakum biquwwatiw wadhkuroo maa feehi la`allakum tattaqoon
Wa'idh akhadha rabbuka mim banee aadama min zuhoorihim dhurriyyatahum wa'ashhadahum `alaa anfusihim, alastu birabbikum, qaaloo balaa shahidnaa, an taqooloo yawmal-qiyaamati innaa kunnaa `an haadhaa ghaafileen
Aw taqooloo innamaa ashraka aabaa'unaa min qablu wakunnaa dhurriyyatam mim ba`dihim, afatuhlikunaa bimaa fa`alal-mubtiloon
Wakadhaalika nufassilul-aayaati wala`allahum yarji`oon
Watlu `alayhim naba'al-ladhee aataynaahu aayaatinaa fansalakha minhaa fa'atba`ahush-shaytaanu fakaana minal-ghaaween
Walaw shi'naa larafa`naahu bihaa walaakinnahoo akhlada ilal-ardi wattaba`a hawaah, famathaluhoo kamathalil-kalb, in tahmil `alayhi yalhath aw tatrukhu yalhath, dhaalika mathalul-qawmil-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa, faqsusil-qasasa la`allahum yatafakkaroon
Saa'a mathalanil-qawmul-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa wa'anfusahum kaanoo yazlimoon
May yahdillaahu fahuwal-muhtadee, wamay yudlil fa'ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon
Walaqad dhara'naa lijahannama katheeram minal-jinni wal-ins, lahum quloobul laa yafqahoona bihaa, walahum a`yunul laa yubsiroona bihaa, walahum aadhaanul laa yasma`oona bihaa, ulaa'ika kal-an`aami bal hum adall, ulaa'ika humul-ghaafiloon
Walillaahil-asmaa'ul-husnaa fad`oohu bihaa, wadharul-ladheena yulhidoona fee asmaa'ih, sayujzawna maa kaanoo ya`maloon
Wamimman khalaqnaa ummatuy yahdoona bil-haqqi wabihee ya`diloon
Wal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa sanastadrijuhum min haythu laa ya`lamoon
Wa'umlee lahum, inna kaydee mateen
Awalam yatafakkaroo maa bisaahibihim min jinnah, in huwa illaa nadheerum mubeen
Awalam yanzuroo fee malakootis-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa khalaqallaahu min shay'iw wa'an `asaa ay yakoona qadiqtaraba ajaluhum, fabi'ayyi hadeethim ba`dahoo yu'minoon
May yudlilillaahu falaa haadiya lah, wayadharuhum fee tughyaanihim ya`mahoon
Yas'aloonaka `anis-saa`ati ayyaana mursaahaa, qul innamaa `ilmuhaa `inda rabbee, laa yujalleehaa liwaqtihaa illaa huw, thaqulat fis-samaawaati wal-ard, laa ta'teekum illaa baghtah, yas'aloonaka ka'annaka hafiyyun `anhaa, qul innamaa `ilmuhaa `indallaahi walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya`lamoon
Qul laa amliku linafsee naf`aw walaa darran illaa maa shaa'allaah, walaw kuntu a`lamul-ghayba lastakthartu minal-khayri wamaa massaniyas-soo', in ana illaa nadheeruw wabasheerul liqawmiy yu'minoon
Huwal-ladhee khalaqakum min nafsiw waahidatiw waja`ala minhaa zawjahaa liyaskuna ilayhaa, falammaa taghashshaahaa hamalat hamlan khafeefan famarrat bih, falammaa athqalad da`awallaaha rabbahumaa la'in aataytanaa saalihal lanakoonanna minash-shaakireen
Falammaa aataahumaa saalihan ja`alaa lahoo shurakaa'a feemaa aataahumaa, fata`aalallaahu `ammaa yushrikoon
Ayushrikoona maa laa yakhluqu shay'aw wahum yukhlaqoon
Walaa yastatee`oona lahum nasraw walaa anfusahum yansuroon
Wa'in tad`oohum ilal-hudaa laa yattabi`ookum, sawaa'un `alaykum ada`awtumoohum am antum saamitoon
Innal-ladheena tad`oona min doonillaahi `ibaadun amthaalukum fad`oohum falyastajeeboo lakum in kuntum saadiqeen
Alahum arjuluy yamshoona bihaa, am lahum aydiy yabtishoona bihaa, am lahum a`yunuy yubsiroona bihaa, am lahum aadhaanuy yasma`oona bihaa, qulid`oo shurakaa'akum thumma keedooni falaa tunziroon
Inna waliyyillaahul-ladhee nazzalal-kitaab, wahuwa yatawallas-saaliheen
Wal-ladheena tad`oona min doonihee laa yastatee`oona nasrakum walaa anfusahum yansuroon
Wa'in tad`oohum ilal-hudaa laa yasma`oo, wataraahum yanzuroona ilayka wahum laa yubsiroon
Khudhil-`afwa wa'mur bil-`urfi wa'a`rid `anil-jaahileen
Wa'immaa yanzaghannaka minash-shaytaani nazghun fasta`idh billaah, innahoo samee`un `aleem
Innal-ladheenattaqaw idhaa massahum taa'ifum minash-shaytaani tadhakkaroo fa'idhaa hum mubsiroon
Wa'ikhwaanuhum yamuddoonahum fil-ghayyi thumma laa yuqsiroon
Wa'idhaa lam ta'tihim bi'aayatin qaaloo lawlajtabaytahaa, qul innamaa attabi`u maa yoohaa ilayya mir rabbee, haadhaa basaa'iru mir rabbikum wahudaw warahmatul liqawmiy yu'minoon
Wa'idhaa quri'al-qur'aanu fastami`oo lahoo wa'ansitoo la`allakum turhamoon
Wadhkur rabbaka fee nafsika tadarru`aw wakheefataw wadoonal-jahri minal-qawli bil-ghuduwwi wal-aasaali walaa takum minal-ghaafileen
Innal-ladheena `inda rabbika laa yastakbiroona `an `ibaadatihee wayusabbihoonahoo walahoo yasjudoon

Yas'aloonaka `anil-anfaal, qulil-anfaalu lillaahi war-rasool, fattaqullaaha wa'aslihoo dhaata baynikum, wa'atee`ullaaha warasoolahoo in kuntum mu'mineen
Innamal-mu'minoonal-ladheena idhaa dhukirallaahu wajilat quloobuhum wa'idhaa tuliyat `alayhim aayaatuhoo zaadathum eemaanaw wa`alaa rabbihim yatawakkaloon
Al-ladheena yuqeemoonas-salaata wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Ulaa'ika humul-mu'minoona haqqaa, lahum darajaatun `inda rabbihim wamaghfiratuw warizqun kareem
Kamaa akhrajaka rabbuka mim baytika bil-haqq, wa'inna fareeqam minal-mu'mineena lakaarihoon
Yujaadiloonaka fil-haqqi ba`da maa tabayyana ka'annamaa yusaaqoona ilal-mawti wahum yanzuroon
Wa'idh ya`idukumullaahu ihdat-taa'ifatayni annahaa lakum watawaddoona anna ghayra dhaatish-shawkati takoonu lakum wayureedullaahu ay yuhiqqal-haqqa bikalimaatihee wayaqta`a daabiral-kaafireen
Liyuhiqqal-haqqa wayubtilal-baatila walaw karihal-mujrimoon
Idh tastagheethoona rabbakum fastajaaba lakum annee mumiddukum bi'alfim minal-malaa'ikati murdifeen
Wamaa ja`alahullaahu illaa bushraa walitatma'inna bihee quloobukum, waman-nasru illaa min `indillaah, innallaaha `azeezun hakeem
Idh yughashsheekumun-nu`aasa amanatam minhu wayunazzilu `alaykum minas-samaa'i maa'al liyutahhirakum bihee wayudhhiba `ankum rijzash-shaytaani waliyarbita `alaa quloobikum wayuthabbita bihil-aqdaam
Idh yoohee rabbuka ilal-malaa'ikati annee ma`akum fathabbitul-ladheena aamanoo, sa'ulqee fee quloobil-ladheena kafarur-ru`ba fadriboo fawqal-a`naaqi wadriboo minhum kulla banaan
Dhaalika bi'annahum shaaqqullaaha warasoolah, wamay yushaaqiqillaaha warasoolahoo fa'innallaaha shadeedul-`iqaab
Dhaalikum fadhooqoohu wa'anna lil-kaafireena `adhaaban-naar
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa laqeetumul-ladheena kafaroo zahfan falaa tuwalloohumul-adbaar
Wamay yuwallihim yawma'idhin duburahoo illaa mutaharrifal liqitaalin aw mutahayyizan ilaa fi'atin faqad baa'a bighadabim minallaahi wama'waahu jahannam, wabi'sal-maseer
Falam taqtuloohum walaakinnallaaha qatalahum, wamaa ramayta idh ramayta walaakinnallaaha ramaa, waliyubliyal-mu'mineena minhu balaa'an hasanaa, innallaaha samee`un `aleem
Dhaalikum wa'annallaaha moohinu kaydil-kaafireen
In tastaftihoo faqad jaa'akumul-fath, wa'in tantahoo fahuwa khayrul lakum, wa'in ta`oodoo na`ud, walan tughniya `ankum fi'atukum shay'aw walaw kathurat wa'annallaaha ma`al-mu'mineen
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo atee`ullaaha warasoolahoo walaa tawallaw `anhu wa'antum tasma`oon
Walaa takoonoo kal-ladheena qaaloo sami`naa wahum laa yasma`oon
Inna sharrad-dawaabbi `indallaahis-summul-bukmul-ladheena laa ya`qiloon
Walaw `alimallaahu feehim khayral la'asma`ahum, walaw asma`ahum latawallaw wahum mu`ridoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanustajeeboo lillaahi walir-rasooli idhaa da`aakum limaa yuhyeekum, wa`lamoo annallaaha yahoolu baynal-mar'i waqalbihee wa'annahoo ilayhi tuhsharoon
Wattaqoo fitnatal laa tuseebannal-ladheena zalamoo minkum khaassah, wa`lamoo annallaaha shadeedul-`iqaab
Wadhkuroo idh antum qaleelum mustad`afoona fil-ardi takhaafoona ay yatakhattafakumun-naasu fa'aawaakum wa'ayyadakum binasrihee warazaqakum minat-tayyibaati la`allakum tashkuroon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa takhoonullaaha war-rasoola watakhoonoo amaanaatikum wa'antum ta`lamoon
Wa`lamoo annamaa amwaalukum wa'awlaadukum fitnatuw wa'annallaaha `indahoo ajrun `azeem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo in tattaqullaaha yaj`al lakum furqaanaw wayukaffir `ankum sayyi'aatikum wayaghfir lakum, wallaahu dhul-fadlil-`azeem
Wa'idh yamkuru bikal-ladheena kafaroo liyuthbitooka aw yaqtulooka aw yukhrijook, wayamkuroona wayamkurullaah, wallaahu khayrul-maakireen
Wa'idhaa tutlaa `alayhim aayaatunaa qaaloo qad sami`naa law nashaa'u laqulnaa mithla haadhaa in haadhaa illaa asaateerul-awwaleen
Wa'idh qaalullaahumma in kaana haadhaa huwal-haqqa min `indika fa'amtir `alaynaa hijaaratam minas-samaa'i awi'tinaa bi`adhaabin aleem
Wamaa kaanallaahu liyu`adhdhibahum wa'anta feehim, wamaa kaanallaahu mu`adhdhibahum wahum yastaghfiroon
Wamaa lahum allaa yu`adhdhibahumullaahu wahum yasuddoona `anil-masjidil-haraami wamaa kaanoo awliyaa'ah, in awliyaa'uhoo illal-muttaqoona walaakinna aktharahum laa ya`lamoon
Wamaa kaana salaatuhum `indal-bayti illaa mukaa'aw watasdiyah, fadhooqul-`adhaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon
Innal-ladheena kafaroo yunfiqoona amwaalahum liyasuddoo `an sabeelillaah, fasayunfiqoonahaa thumma takoonu `alayhim hasratan thumma yughlaboon, wal-ladheena kafaroo ilaa jahannama yuhsharoon
Liyameezallaahul-khabeetha minat-tayyibi wayaj`alal-khabeetha ba`dahoo `alaa ba`din fayarkumahoo jamee`an fayaj`alahoo fee jahannam, ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon
Qul lilladheena kafaroo iy yantahoo yughfar lahum maa qad salaf, wa'iy ya`oodoo faqad madat sunnatul-awwaleen
Waqaatiloohum hattaa laa takoona fitnatuw wayakoonad-deenu kulluhoo lillaah, fa'inintahaw fa'innallaaha bimaa ya`maloona baseer
Wa'in tawallaw fa`lamoo annallaaha mawlaakum, ni`mal-mawlaa wani`man-naseer
Wa`lamoo annamaa ghanimtum min shay'in fa'anna lillaahi khumusahoo walir-rasooli walidhil-qurbaa wal-yataamaa wal-masaakeeni wabnis-sabeeli in kuntum aamantum billaahi wamaa anzalnaa `alaa `abdinaa yawmal-furqaani yawmal-taqal-jam`aan, wallaahu `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Idh antum bil-`udwatid-dunyaa wahum bil-`udwatil-quswaa war-rakbu asfala minkum, walaw tawaa`attum lakhtalaftum fil-mee`aadi walaakil liyaqdiyallaahu amran kaana maf`oolal liyahlika man halaka `am bayyinatiw wayahyaa man hayya `am bayyinah, wa'innallaaha lasamee`un `aleem
Idh yureekahumullaahu fee manaamika qaleelaa, walaw araakahum katheeral lafashiltum walatanaaza`tum fil-amri walaakinnallaaha sallam, innahoo `aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
Wa'idh yureekumoohum idhil-taqaytum fee a`yunikum qaleelaw wayuqallilukum fee a`yunihim liyaqdiyallaahu amran kaana maf`oolaa, wa'ilallaahi turja`ul-umoor
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa laqeetum fi'atan fathbutoo wadhkurullaaha katheeral la`allakum tuflihoon
Wa'atee`ullaaha warasoolahoo walaa tanaaza`oo fatafshaloo watadhhaba reehukum wasbiroo, innallaaha ma`as-saabireen
Walaa takoonoo kal-ladheena kharajoo min diyaarihim bataraw wari'aa'an-naasi wayasuddoona `an sabeelillaah, wallaahu bimaa ya`maloona muheet
Wa'idh zayyana lahumush-shaytaanu a`maalahum waqaala laa ghaaliba lakumul-yawma minan-naasi wa'innee jaarul lakum, falammaa taraa'atil-fi'ataani nakasa `alaa `aqibayhi waqaala innee baree'um minkum innee araa maa laa tarawna innee akhaafullaah, wallaahu shadeedul-`iqaab
Idh yaqoolul-munaafiqoona wal-ladheena fee quloobihim maradun gharra haa'ulaa'i deenuhum, wamay yatawakkal `alallaahi fa'innallaaha `azeezun hakeem
Walaw taraa idh yatawaffal-ladheena kafarul-malaa'ikatu yadriboona wujoohahum wa'adbaarahum, wadhooqoo `adhaabal-hareeq
Dhaalika bimaa qaddamat aydeekum wa'annallaaha laysa bizallaamil lil-`abeed
Kada'bi aali fir`awna wal-ladheena min qablihim, kafaroo bi'aayaatillaahi fa'akhadhahumullaahu bidhunoobihim, innallaaha qawiyyun shadeedul-`iqaab
Dhaalika bi'annallaaha lam yaku mughayyiran ni`matan an`amahaa `alaa qawmin hattaa yughayyiroo maa bi'anfusihim wa'annallaaha samee`un `aleem
Kada'bi aali fir`awna wal-ladheena min qablihim, kadhdhaboo bi'aayaati rabbihim fa'ahlaknaahum bidhunoobihim wa'aghraqnaa aala fir`awn, wakullun kaanoo zaalimeen
Inna sharrad-dawaabbi `indallaahil-ladheena kafaroo fahum laa yu'minoon
Al-ladheena `aahatta minhum thumma yanqudoona `ahdahum fee kulli marratiw wahum laa yattaqoon
Fa'immaa tathqafannahum fil-harbi fasharrid bihim man khalfahum la`allahum yadhdhakkaroon
Wa'immaa takhaafanna min qawmin khiyaanatan fambidh ilayhim `alaa sawaa', innallaaha laa yuhibbul-khaa'ineen
Walaa yahsabannal-ladheena kafaroo sabaqoo, innahum laa yu`jizoon
Wa'a`iddoo lahum mastata`tum min quwwatiw wamir ribaatil-khayli turhiboona bihee `aduwwallaahi wa`aduwwakum wa'aakhareena min doonihim, laa ta`lamoonahum, allaahu ya`lamuhum, wamaa tunfiqoo min shay'in fee sabeelillaahi yuwaffa ilaykum wa'antum laa tuzlamoon
Wa'in janahoo lis-salmi fajnah lahaa watawakkal `alallaah, innahoo huwas-samee`ul-`aleem
Wa'iy yureedoo ay yakhda`ooka fa'inna hasbakallaah, huwal-ladhee ayyadaka binasrihee wabil-mu'mineen
Wa'allafa bayna quloobihim, law anfaqta maa fil-ardi jamee`am maa allafta bayna quloobihim walaakinnallaaha allafa baynahum, innahoo `azeezun hakeem
Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu hasbukallaahu wamanittaba`aka minal-mu'mineen
Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu harridil-mu'mineena `alal-qitaal, iy yakum minkum `ishroona saabiroona yaghliboo mi'atayn, wa'iy yakum minkum mi'atuy yaghliboo alfam minal-ladheena kafaroo bi'annahum qawmul laa yafqahoon
Al-aana khaffafallaahu `ankum wa`alima anna feekum da`faa, fa'iy yakum minkum mi'atun saabiratuy yaghliboo mi'atayn, wa'iy yakum minkum alfuy yaghliboo alfayni bi'idhnillaah, wallaahu ma`as-saabireen
Maa kaana linabiyyin ay yakoona lahoo asraa hattaa yuthkhina fil-ard, tureedoona `aradad-dunyaa, wallaahu yureedul-aakhirah, wallaahu `azeezun hakeem
Lawlaa kitaabum minallaahi sabaqa lamassakum feemaa akhadhtum `adhaabun `azeem
Fakuloo mimmaa ghanimtum halaalan tayyibaa, wattaqullaah, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu qul liman fee aydeekum minal-asraa iy ya`lamillaahu fee quloobikum khayray yu'tikum khayram mimmaa ukhidha minkum wayaghfir lakum, wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
Wa'iy yureedoo khiyaanataka faqad khaanullaaha min qablu fa'amkana minhum wallaahu `aleemun hakeem
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wahaajaroo wajaahadoo bi'amwaalihim wa'anfusihim fee sabeelillaahi wal-ladheena aawaw wanasaroo ulaa'ika ba`duhum awliyaa'u ba`d, wal-ladheena aamanoo walam yuhaajiroo maa lakum miw walaayatihim min shay'in hattaa yuhaajiroo, wa'inistansarookum fid-deeni fa`alaykumun-nasru illaa `alaa qawmim baynakum wabaynahum meethaaq, wallaahu bimaa ta`maloona baseer
Wal-ladheena kafaroo ba`duhum awliyaa'u ba`d, illaa taf`aloohu takun fitnatun fil-ardi wafasaadun kabeer
Wal-ladheena aamanoo wahaajaroo wajaahadoo fee sabeelillaahi wal-ladheena aawaw wanasaroo ulaa'ika humul-mu'minoona haqqaa, lahum maghfiratuw warizqun kareem
Wal-ladheena aamanoo mim ba`du wahaajaroo wajaahadoo ma`akum fa'ulaa'ika minkum, wa'ulul-arhaami ba`duhum awlaa biba`din fee kitaabillaah, innallaaha bikulli shay'in `aleem

Baraa'atum minallaahi warasoolihee ilal-ladheena `aahattum minal-mushrikeen
Faseehoo fil-ardi arba`ata ashhuriw wa`lamoo annakum ghayru mu`jizillaahi wa'annallaaha mukhzil-kaafireen
Wa'adhaanum minallaahi warasoolihee ilan-naasi yawmal-hajjil-akbari annallaaha baree'um minal-mushrikeena warasooluh, fa'in tubtum fahuwa khayrul lakum, wa'in tawallaytum fa`lamoo annakum ghayru mu`jizillaah, wabashshiril-ladheena kafaroo bi`adhaabin aleem
Illal-ladheena `aahattum minal-mushrikeena thumma lam yanqusookum shay'aw walam yuzaahiroo `alaykum ahadan fa'atimmoo ilayhim `ahdahum ilaa muddatihim, innallaaha yuhibbul-muttaqeen
Fa'idhansalakhal-ashhurul-hurumu faqtulul-mushrikeena haythu wajattumoohum wakhudhoohum wahsuroohum waq`udoo lahum kulla marsad, fa'in taaboo wa'aqaamus-salaata wa'aatawuz-zakaata fakhalloo sabeelahum, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
Wa'in ahadum minal-mushrikeenastajaaraka fa'ajirhu hattaa yasma`a kalaamallaahi thumma ablighhu ma'manah, dhaalika bi'annahum qawmul laa ya`lamoon
Kayfa yakoonu lil-mushrikeena `ahdun `indallaahi wa`inda rasoolihee illal-ladheena `aahattum `indal-masjidil-haraam, famastaqaamoo lakum fastaqeemoo lahum, innallaaha yuhibbul-muttaqeen
Kayfa wa'iy yazharoo `alaykum laa yarquboo feekum illaw walaa dhimmah, yurdoonakum bi'afwaahihim wata'baa quloobuhum, wa'aktharuhum faasiqoon
Ishtaraw bi'aayaatillaahi thamanan qaleelan fasaddoo `an sabeelih, innahum saa'a maa kaanoo ya`maloon
Laa yarquboona fee mu'minin illaw walaa dhimmah, wa'ulaa'ika humul-mu`tadoon
Fa'in taaboo wa'aqaamus-salaata wa'aatawuz-zakaata fa'ikhwaanukum fid-deen, wanufassilul-aayaati liqawmiy ya`lamoon
Wa'in nakathoo aymaanahum mim ba`di `ahdihim wata`anoo fee deenikum faqaatiloo a'immatal-kufri innahum laa aymaana lahum la`allahum yantahoon
Alaa tuqaatiloona qawman nakathoo aymaanahum wahammoo bi'ikhraajir-rasooli wahum bada'ookum awwala marrah, atakhshawnahum, fallaahu ahaqqu an takhshawhu in kuntum mu'mineen
Qaatiloohum yu`adhdhibhumullaahu bi'aydeekum wayukhzihim wayansurkum `alayhim wayashfi sudoora qawmim mu'mineen
Wayudhhib ghayza quloobihim, wayatoobullaahu `alaa may yashaa', wallaahu `aleemun hakeem
Am hasibtum an tutrakoo walammaa ya`lamillaahul-ladheena jaahadoo minkum walam yattakhidhoo min doonillaahi walaa rasoolihee walal-mu'mineena waleejah, wallaahu khabeerum bimaa ta`maloon
Maa kaana lil-mushrikeena ay ya`muroo masaajidallaahi shaahideena `alaa anfusihim bil-kufr, ulaa'ika habitat a`maaluhum, wafin-naari hum khaalidoon
Innamaa ya`muru masaajidallaahi man aamana billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wa'aqaamas-salaata wa'aataz-zakaata walam yakhsha illallaah, fa`asaa ulaa'ika ay yakoonoo minal-muhtadeen
Aja`altum siqaayatal-haajji wa`imaaratal-masjidil-haraami kaman aamana billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wajaahada fee sabeelillaah, laa yastawoona `indallaah, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
Alladheena aamanoo wahaajaroo wajaahadoo fee sabeelillaahi bi'amwaalihim wa'anfusihim a`zamu darajatan `indallaah, wa'ulaa'ika humul-faa'izoon
Yubashshiruhum rabbuhum birahmatim minhu waridwaaniw wajannaatil lahum feehaa na`eemum muqeem
Khaalideena feehaa abadaa, innallaaha `indahoo ajrun `azeem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tattakhidhoo aabaa'akum wa'ikhwaanakum awliyaa'a inistahabbul-kufra `alal-eemaan, wamay yatawallahum minkum fa'ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon
Qul in kaana aabaa'ukum wa'abnaa'ukum wa'ikhwaanukum wa'azwaajukum wa`asheeratukum wa'amwaaluniqtaraftumoohaa watijaaratun takhshawna kasaadahaa wamasaakinu tardawnahaa ahabba ilaykum minallaahi warasoolihee wajihaadin fee sabeelihee fatarabbasoo hattaa ya'tiyallaahu bi'amrih, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmal-faasiqeen
Laqad nasarakumullaahu fee mawaatina katheeratiw wayawma hunaynin idh a`jabatkum kathratukum falam tughni `ankum shay'aw wadaaqat `alaykumul-ardu bimaa rahubat thumma wallaytum mudbireen
Thumma anzalallaahu sakeenatahoo `alaa rasoolihee wa`alal-mu'mineena wa'anzala junoodal lam tarawhaa wa`adhdhabal-ladheena kafaroo, wadhaalika jazaa'ul-kaafireen
Thumma yatoobullaahu mim ba`di dhaalika `alaa may yashaa', wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo innamal-mushrikoona najasun falaa yaqrabul-masjidal-haraama ba`da `aamihim haadhaa, wa'in khiftum `aylatan fasawfa yughneekumullaahu min fadlihee in shaa', innallaaha `aleemun hakeem
Qaatilul-ladheena laa yu'minoona billaahi walaa bil-yawmil-aakhiri walaa yuharrimoona maa harramallaahu warasooluhoo walaa yadeenoona deenal-haqqi minal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba hattaa yu`tul-jizyata `ay yadiw wahum saaghiroon
Waqaalatil-yahoodu `uzayrunibnullaahi waqaalatin-nasaaral-maseehubnullaah, dhaalika qawluhum bi'afwaahihim, yudaahi'oona qawlal-ladheena kafaroo min qabl, qaatalahumullaah, annaa yu'fakoon
Ittakhadhoo ahbaarahum waruhbaanahum arbaabam min doonillaahi wal-maseehabna maryam, wamaa umiroo illaa liya`budoo ilaahaw waahidaa, laa ilaaha illaa huw, subhaanahoo `ammaa yushrikoon
Yureedoona ay yutfi'oo noorallaahi bi'afwaahihim waya'ballaahu illaa ay yutimma noorahoo walaw karihal-kaafiroon
Huwal-ladhee arsala rasoolahoo bil-hudaa wadeenil-haqqi liyuzhirahoo `alad-deeni kullihee walaw karihal-mushrikoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo inna katheeram minal-ahbaari war-ruhbaani laya'kuloona amwaalan-naasi bil-baatili wayasuddoona `an sabeelillaah, wal-ladheena yaknizoonadh-dhahaba wal-fiddata walaa yunfiqoonahaa fee sabeelillaahi fabashshirhum bi`adhaabin aleem
Yawma yuhmaa `alayhaa fee naari jahannama fatukwaa bihaa jibaahuhum wajunoobuhum wazuhooruhum, haadhaa maa kanaztum li'anfusikum fadhooqoo maa kuntum taknizoon
Inna `iddatash-shuhoori `indallaahithnaa `ashara shahran fee kitaabillaahi yawma khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda minhaa arba`atun hurum, dhaalikad-deenul-qayyimu falaa tazlimoo feehinna anfusakum waqaatilul-mushrikeena kaaffatan kamaa yuqaatiloonakum kaaffah, wa`lamoo annallaaha ma`al-muttaqeen
Innaman-nasee'u ziyaadatun fil-kufri yudallu bihil-ladheena kafaroo yuhilloonahoo `aamaw wayuharrimoonahoo `aamal liyuwaati'oo `iddata maa harramallaahu fayuhilloo maa harramallaah, zuyyina lahum soo'u a`maalihim, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmal-kaafireen
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo maa lakum idhaa qeela lakumunfiroo fee sabeelillaahiththaaqaltum ilal-ard, aradeetum bil-hayaatid-dunyaa minal-aakhirah, famaa mataa`ul-hayaatid-dunyaa fil-aakhirati illaa qaleel
Illaa tanfiroo yu`adhdhibkum `adhaaban aleemaw wayastabdil qawman ghayrakum walaa tadurroohu shay'aa, wallaahu `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Illaa tansuroohu faqad nasarahullaahu idh akhrajahul-ladheena kafaroo thaaniyathnayni idh humaa fil-ghaari idh yaqoolu lisaahibihee laa tahzan innallaaha ma`anaa, fa'anzalallaahu sakeenatahoo `alayhi wa'ayyadahoo bijunoodil lam tarawhaa waja`ala kalimatal-ladheena kafarus-suflaa, wakalimatullaahi hiyal-`ulyaa, wallaahu `azeezun hakeem
Infiroo khifaafaw wathiqaalaw wajaahidoo bi'amwaalikum wa'anfusikum fee sabeelillaah, dhaalikum khayrul lakum in kuntum ta`lamoon
Law kaana `aradan qareebaw wasafaran qaasidal lattaba`ooka walaakim ba`udat `alayhimush-shuqqah, wasayahlifoona billaahi lawistata`naa lakharajnaa ma`akum, yuhlikoona anfusahum, wallaahu ya`lamu innahum lakaadhiboon
`Afallaahu `ank, lima adhinta lahum hattaa yatabayyana lakal-ladheena sadaqoo wata`lamal-kaadhibeen
Laa yasta'dhinukal-ladheena yu'minoona billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri ay yujaahidoo bi'amwaalihim wa'anfusihim, wallaahu `aleemum bil-muttaqeen
Innamaa yasta'dhinukal-ladheena laa yu'minoona billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wartaabat quloobuhum fahum fee raybihim yataraddadoon
Walaw araadul-khurooja la'a`addoo lahoo `uddataw walaakin karihallaahumbi`aathahum fathabbatahum waqeelaq`udoo ma`al-qaa`ideen
Law kharajoo feekum maa zaadookum illaa khabaalaw wala'awda`oo khilaalakum yabghoonakumul-fitnah, wafeekum sammaa`oona lahum, wallaahu `aleemum biz-zaalimeen
Laqadibtaghawul-fitnata min qablu waqallaboo lakal-umoora hattaa jaa'al-haqqu wazahara amrullaahi wahum kaarihoon
Waminhum may yaqoolu'dhal lee walaa taftinnee, alaa fil-fitnati saqatoo, wa'inna jahannama lamuheetatum bil-kaafireen
In tusibka hasanatun tasu'hum, wa'in tusibka museebatuy yaqooloo qad akhadhnaa amranaa min qablu wayatawallaw wahum farihoon
Qul lay yuseebanaa illaa maa kataballaahu lanaa, huwa mawlaanaa wa`alallaahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minoon
Qul hal tarabbasoona binaa illaa ihdal-husnayayn, wanahnu natarabbasu bikum ay yuseebakumullaahu bi`adhaabim min `indihee aw bi'aydeenaa, fatarabbasoo innaa ma`akum mutarabbisoon
Qul anfiqoo taw`an aw karhal lay yutaqabbala minkum, innakum kuntum qawman faasiqeen
Wamaa mana`ahum an tuqbala minhum nafaqaatuhum illaa annahum kafaroo billaahi wabirasoolihee walaa ya'toonas-salaata illaa wahum kusaalaa walaa yunfiqoona illaa wahum kaarihoon
Falaa tu`jibka amwaaluhum walaa awlaaduhum, innamaa yureedullaahu liyu`adhdhibahum bihaa fil-hayaatid-dunyaa watazhaqa anfusuhum wahum kaafiroon
Wayahlifoona billaahi innahum laminkum, wamaa hum minkum walaakinnahum qawmuy yafraqoon
Law yajidoona malja'an aw maghaaraatin aw muddakhalal lawallaw ilayhi wahum yajmahoon
Waminhum may yalmizuka fis-sadaqaat, fa'in u`too minhaa radoo wa'il lam yu`taw minhaa idhaa hum yaskhatoon
Walaw annahum radoo maa aataahumullaahu warasooluhoo waqaaloo hasbunallaahu sayu'teenallaahu min fadlihee warasooluhoo innaa ilallaahi raaghiboon
Innamas-sadaqaatu lil-fuqaraa'i wal-masaakeeni wal-`aamileena `alayhaa wal-mu'allafati quloobuhum wafir-riqaabi wal-ghaarimeena wafee sabeelillaahi wabnis-sabeel, fareedatam minallaah, wallaahu `aleemun hakeem
Waminhumul-ladheena yu'dhoonan-nabiyya wayaqooloona huwa udhun, qul udhunu khayril lakum yu'minu billaahi wayu'minu lil-mu'mineena warahmatul lilladheena aamanoo minkum, wal-ladheena yu'dhoona rasoolallaahi lahum `adhaabun aleem
Yahlifoona billaahi lakum liyurdookum wallaahu warasooluhoo ahaqqu ay yurdoohu in kaanoo mu'mineen
Alam ya`lamoo annahoo may yuhaadidillaaha warasoolahoo fa'anna lahoo naara jahannama khaalidan feehaa, dhaalikal-khizyul-`azeem
Yahdharul-munaafiqoona an tunazzala `alayhim sooratun tunabbi'uhum bimaa fee quloobihim, qulistahzi'oo, innallaaha mukhrijum maa tahdharoon
Wala'in sa'altahum layaqoolunna innamaa kunnaa nakhoodu wanal`ab, qul abillaahi wa'aayaatihee warasoolihee kuntum tastahzi'oon
Laa ta`tadhiroo qad kafartum ba`da eemaanikum, in na`fu `an taa'ifatim minkum nu`adhdhib taa'ifatam bi'annahum kaanoo mujrimeen
Al-munaafiqoona wal-munaafiqaatu ba`duhum mim ba`d, ya'muroona bil-munkari wayanhawna `anil-ma`roofi wayaqbidoona aydiyahum, nasullaaha fanasiyahum, innal-munaafiqeena humul-faasiqoon
Wa`adallaahul-munaafiqeena wal-munaafiqaati wal-kuffaara naara jahannama khaalideena feehaa, hiya hasbuhum, wala`anahumullaah, walahum `adhaabum muqeem
Kal-ladheena min qablikum kaanoo ashadda minkum quwwataw wa'akthara amwaalaw wa'awlaadaa, fastamta`oo bikhalaaqihim fastamta`tum bikhalaaqikum kamastamta`al-ladheena min qablikum bikhalaaqihim wakhudtum kal-ladhee khaadoo, ulaa'ika habitat a`maaluhum fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, wa'ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon
Alam ya'tihim naba'ul-ladheena min qablihim qawmi noohiw wa`aadiw wathamooda waqawmi ibraaheema wa'ashaabi madyana wal-mu'tafikaat, atathum rusuluhum bil-bayyinaat, famaa kaanallaahu liyazlimahum walaakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
Wal-mu'minoona wal-mu'minaatu ba`duhum awliyaa'u ba`d, ya'muroona bil-ma`roofi wayanhawna `anil-munkari wayuqeemoonas-salaata wayu'toonaz-zakaata wayutee`oonallaaha warasoolah, ulaa'ika sayarhamuhumullaah, innallaaha `azeezun hakeem
Wa`adallaahul-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaati jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa wamasaakina tayyibatan fee jannaati `adn, waridwaanum minallaahi akbar, dhaalika huwal-fawzul-`azeem
Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu jaahidil-kuffaara wal-munaafiqeena waghluz `alayhim, wama'waahum jahannamu wabi'sal-maseer
Yahlifoona billaahi maa qaaloo, walaqad qaaloo kalimatal-kufri wakafaroo ba`da islaamihim wahammoo bimaa lam yanaaloo, wamaa naqamoo illaa an aghnaahumullaahu warasooluhoo min fadlih, fa'iy yatooboo yaku khayral lahum, wa'iy yatawallaw yu`adhdhibhumullaahu `adhaaban aleeman fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, wamaa lahum fil-ardi miw waliyyiw walaa naseer
