Waminhum man `aahadallaaha la'in aataanaa min fadlihee lanassaddaqanna walanakoonanna minas-saaliheen
Falammaa aataahum min fadlihee bakhiloo bihee watawallaw wahum mu`ridoon
Fa'a`qabahum nifaaqan fee quloobihim ilaa yawmi yalqawnahoo bimaa akhlafullaaha maa wa`adoohu wabimaa kaanoo yakdhiboon
Alam ya`lamoo annallaaha ya`lamu sirrahum wanajwaahum wa'annallaaha `allaamul-ghuyoob
Alladheena yalmizoonal-muttawwi`eena minal-mu'mineena fis-sadaqaati wal-ladheena laa yajidoona illaa juhdahum fayaskharoona minhum, sakhirallaahu minhum, walahum `adhaabun aleem
Istaghfir lahum aw laa tastaghfir lahum, in tastaghfir lahum sab`eena marratan falay yaghfirallaahu lahum, dhaalika bi'annahum kafaroo billaahi warasoolih, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmal-faasiqeen
Farihal-mukhallafoona bimaq`adihim khilaafa rasoolillaahi wakarihoo ay yujaahidoo bi'amwaalihim wa'anfusihim fee sabeelillaahi waqaaloo laa tanfiroo fil-harr, qul naaru jahannama ashaddu harraa, law kaanoo yafqahoon
Falyadhakoo qaleelaw walyabkoo katheeraa, jazaa'am bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
Fa'ir raja`akallaahu ilaa taa'ifatim minhum fasta'dhanooka lil-khurooji faqul lan takhrujoo ma`iya abadaw walan tuqaatiloo ma`iya `aduwwaa, innakum radeetum bil-qu`oodi awwala marrah, faq`udoo ma`al-khaalifeen
Walaa tusalli `alaa ahadim minhum maata abadaw walaa taqum `alaa qabrih, innahum kafaroo billaahi warasoolihee wamaatoo wahum faasiqoon
Walaa tu`jibka amwaaluhum wa'awlaaduhum, innamaa yureedullaahu ay yu`adhdhibahum bihaa fid-dunyaa watazhaqa anfusuhum wahum kaafiroon
Wa'idhaa unzilat sooratun an aaminoo billaahi wajaahidoo ma`a rasoolihista'dhanaka ulut-tawli minhum waqaaloo dharnaa nakum ma`al-qaa`ideen
Radoo bi'ay yakoonoo ma`al-khawaalifi watubi`a `alaa quloobihim fahum laa yafqahoon
Laakinir-rasoolu wal-ladheena aamanoo ma`ahoo jaahadoo bi'amwaalihim wa'anfusihim, wa'ulaa'ika lahumul-khayraat, wa'ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
A`addallaahu lahum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa, dhaalikal-fawzul-`azeem
Wajaa'al-mu`adhdhiroona minal-a`raabi liyu'dhana lahum waqa`adal-ladheena kadhabullaaha warasoolah, sayuseebul-ladheena kafaroo minhum `adhaabun aleem
Laysa `alad-du`afaa'i walaa `alal-mardaa walaa `alal-ladheena laa yajidoona maa yunfiqoona harajun idhaa nasahoo lillaahi warasoolih, maa `alal-muhsineena min sabeel, wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
Walaa `alal-ladheena idhaa maa atawka litahmilahum qulta laa ajidu maa ahmilukum `alayh, tawallaw wa'a`yunuhum tafeedu minad-dam`i hazanan allaa yajidoo maa yunfiqoon
Innamas-sabeelu `alal-ladheena yasta'dhinoonaka wahum aghniyaa', radoo bi'ay yakoonoo ma`al-khawaalifi wataba`allaahu `alaa quloobihim fahum laa ya`lamoon
Ya`tadhiroona ilaykum idhaa raja`tum ilayhim, qul laa ta`tadhiroo lan nu'mina lakum qad nabba'anallaahu min akhbaarikum wasayarallaahu `amalakum warasooluhoo thumma turaddoona ilaa `aalimil-ghaybi wash-shahaadati fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta`maloon
Sayahlifoona billaahi lakum idhanqalabtum ilayhim litu`ridoo `anhum, fa'a`ridoo `anhum, innahum rijsuw wama'waahum jahannamu jazaa'am bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
Yahlifoona lakum litardaw `anhum, fa'in tardaw `anhum fa'innallaaha laa yardaa `anil-qawmil-faasiqeen
Al-a`raabu ashaddu kufraw wanifaaqaw wa'ajdaru allaa ya`lamoo hudooda maa anzalallaahu `alaa rasoolih, wallaahu `aleemun hakeem
Waminal-a`raabi may yattakhidhu maa yunfiqu maghramaw wayatarabbasu bikumud-dawaa'ir, `alayhim daa'iratus-saw', wallaahu samee`un `aleem
Waminal-a`raabi may yu'minu billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wayattakhidhu maa yunfiqu qurubaatin `indallaahi wasalawaatir-rasool, alaa innahaa qurbatul lahum, sayudkhiluhumullaahu fee rahmatih, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
Was-saabiqoonal-awwaloona minal-muhaajireena wal-ansaari wal-ladheenattaba`oohum bi'ihsaanir radiyallaahu `anhum waradoo `anhu wa'a`adda lahum jannaatin tajree tahtahal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa abadaa, dhaalikal-fawzul-`azeem
Wamimman hawlakum minal-a`raabi munaafiqoon, wamin ahlil-madeenati maradoo `alan-nifaaq, laa ta`lamuhum, nahnu na`lamuhum, sanu`adhdhibuhum marratayni thumma yuraddoona ilaa `adhaabin `azeem
Wa'aakharoona`tarafoo bidhunoobihim khalatoo `amalan saalihaw wa'aakhara sayyi'aa, `asallaahu ay yatooba `alayhim, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
Khudh min amwaalihim sadaqatan tutahhiruhum watuzakkeehim bihaa wasalli `alayhim, inna salaataka sakanul lahum, wallaahu samee`un `aleem
Alam ya`lamoo annallaaha huwa yaqbalut-tawbata `an `ibaadihee waya'khudhus-sadaqaati wa'annallaaha huwat-tawwaabur-raheem
Waquli`maloo fasayarallaahu `amalakum warasooluhoo wal-mu'minoon, wasaturaddoona ilaa `aalimil-ghaybi wash-shahaadati fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta`maloon
Wa'aakharoona murjawna li'amrillaahi immaa yu`adhdhibuhum wa'immaa yatoobu `alayhim, wallaahu `aleemun hakeem
Wal-ladheenattakhadhoo masjidan diraaraw wakufraw watafreeqam baynal-mu'mineena wa'irsaadal liman haaraballaaha warasoolahoo min qabl, walayahlifunna in aradnaa illal-husnaa, wallaahu yashhadu innahum lakaadhiboon
Laa taqum feehi abadaa, lamasjidun ussisa `alat-taqwaa min awwali yawmin ahaqqu an taqooma feeh, feehi rijaaluy yuhibboona ay yatatahharoo, wallaahu yuhibbul-muttahhireen
Afaman assasa bunyaanahoo `alaa taqwaa minallaahi waridwaanin khayrun am man assasa bunyaanahoo `alaa shafaa jurufin haarin fanhaara bihee fee naari jahannam, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
Laa yazaalu bunyaanuhumul-ladhee banaw reebatan fee quloobihim illaa an taqatta`a quloobuhum, wallaahu `aleemun hakeem
Innallaahashtaraa minal-mu'mineena anfusahum wa'amwaalahum bi'anna lahumul-jannah, yuqaatiloona fee sabeelillaahi fayaqtuloona wayuqtaloona wa`dan `alayhi haqqan fit-tawraati wal-injeeli wal-qur'aan, waman awfaa bi`ahdihee minallaahi fastabshiroo bibay`ikumul-ladhee baaya`tum bih, wadhaalika huwal-fawzul-`azeem
At-taa'iboonal-`aabidoonal-haamidoonas-saa'ihoonar-raaki`oonas-saajidoonal-aamiroona bil-ma`roofi wan-naahoona `anil-munkari wal-haafizoona lihudoodillaah, wabashshiril-mu'mineen
Maa kaana lin-nabiyyi wal-ladheena aamanoo ay yastaghfiroo lil-mushrikeena walaw kaanoo ulee qurbaa mim ba`di maa tabayyana lahum annahum ashaabul-jaheem
Wamaa kaanastighfaaru ibraaheema li'abeehi illaa `am maw`idatiw wa`adahaa iyyaah, falammaa tabayyana lahoo annahoo `aduwwul lillaahi tabarra'a minh, inna ibraaheema la'awwaahun haleem
Wamaa kaanallaahu liyudilla qawmam ba`da idh hadaahum hattaa yubayyina lahum maa yattaqoon, innallaaha bikulli shay'in `aleem
Innallaaha lahoo mulkus-samaawaati wal-ard, yuhyee wayumeet, wamaa lakum min doonillaahi miw waliyyiw walaa naseer
Laqat taaballaahu `alan-nabiyyi wal-muhaajireena wal-ansaaril-ladheenattaba`oohu fee saa`atil-`usrati mim ba`di maa kaada yazeeghu quloobu fareeqim minhum thumma taaba `alayhim, innahoo bihim ra'oofur raheem
Wa`alath-thalaathatil-ladheena khullifoo, hattaa idhaa daaqat `alayhimul-ardu bimaa rahubat wadaaqat `alayhim anfusuhum wazannoo al laa malja'a minallaahi illaa ilayh, thumma taaba `alayhim liyatooboo, innallaaha huwat-tawwaabur-raheem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanuttaqullaaha wakoonoo ma`as-saadiqeen
Maa kaana li'ahlil-madeenati waman hawlahum minal-a`raabi ay yatakhallafoo `ar rasoolillaahi walaa yarghaboo bi'anfusihim `an nafsih, dhaalika bi'annahum laa yuseebuhum zama'uw walaa nasabuw walaa makhmasatun fee sabeelillaahi walaa yata'oona mawti'ay yagheezul-kuffaara walaa yanaaloona min `aduwwin naylan illaa kutiba lahum bihee `amalun saalih, innallaaha laa yudee`u ajral-muhsineen
Walaa yunfiqoona nafaqatan sagheerataw walaa kabeerataw walaa yaqta`oona waadiyan illaa kutiba lahum liyajziyahumullaahu ahsana maa kaanoo ya`maloon
Wamaa kaanal-mu'minoona liyanfiroo kaaffah, falawlaa nafara min kulli firqatim minhum taa'ifatul liyatafaqqahoo fid-deeni waliyundhiroo qawmahum idhaa raja`oo ilayhim la`allahum yahdharoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo qaatilul-ladheena yaloonakum minal-kuffaari walyajidoo feekum ghilzah, wa`lamoo annallaaha ma`al-muttaqeen
Wa'idhaa maa unzilat sooratun faminhum may yaqoolu ayyukum zaadathu haadhihee eemaanaa, fa'ammal-ladheena aamanoo fazaadathum eemaanaw wahum yastabshiroon
Wa'ammal-ladheena fee quloobihim maradun fazaadathum rijsan ilaa rijsihim wamaatoo wahum kaafiroon
Awalaa yarawna annahum yuftanoona fee kulli `aamim marratan aw marratayni thumma laa yatooboona walaa hum yadhdhakkaroon
Wa'idhaa maa unzilat sooratun nazara ba`duhum ilaa ba`d, hal yaraakum min ahadin thummansarafoo, sarafallaahu quloobahum bi'annahum qawmul laa yafqahoon
Laqad jaa'akum rasoolum min anfusikum `azeezun `alayhi maa `anittum hareesun `alaykum bil-mu'mineena ra'oofur raheem
Fa'in tawallaw faqul hasbiyallaahu laa ilaaha illaa huw, `alayhi tawakkaltu wahuwa rabbul-`arshil-`azeem

Alif laam raa, tilka aayaatul-kitaabil-hakeem
Akaana lin-naasi `ajaban an awhaynaa ilaa rajulim minhum an andhirin-naasa wabashshiril-ladheena aamanoo anna lahum qadama sidqin `inda rabbihim, qaalal-kaafiroona inna haadhaa lasaahirum mubeen
Inna rabbakumullaahul-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda fee sittati ayyaamin thummastawaa `alal-`arshi yudabbirul-amr, maa min shafee`in illaa mim ba`di idhnih, dhaalikumullaahu rabbukum fa`budooh, afalaa tadhakkaroon
Ilayhi marji`ukum jamee`aa, wa`dallaahi haqqaa, innahoo yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu`eeduhoo liyajziyal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati bil-qist, wal-ladheena kafaroo lahum sharaabum min hameemiw wa`adhaabun aleemum bimaa kaanoo yakfuroon
Huwal-ladhee ja`alash-shamsa diyaa'aw wal-qamara nooraw waqaddarahoo manaazila lita`lamoo `adadas-sineena wal-hisaab, maa khalaqallaahu dhaalika illaa bil-haqq, yufassilul-aayaati liqawmiy ya`lamoon
Inna fikhtilaafil-layli wan-nahaari wamaa khalaqallaahu fis-samaawaati wal-ardi la'aayaatil liqawmiy yattaqoon
Innal-ladheena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa waradoo bil-hayaatid-dunyaa watma'annoo bihaa wal-ladheena hum `an aayaatinaa ghaafiloon
Ulaa'ika ma'waahumun-naaru bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati yahdeehim rabbuhum bi'eemaanihim, tajree min tahtihimul-anhaaru fee jannaatin-na`eem
Da`waahum feehaa subhaanakallaahumma watahiyyatuhum feehaa salaam, wa'aakhiru da`waahum anil-hamdu lillaahi rabbil-`aalameen
Walaw yu`ajjilullaahu lin-naasish-sharrasti`jaalahum bil-khayri laqudiya ilayhim ajaluhum, fanadharul-ladheena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa fee tughyaanihim ya`mahoon
Wa'idhaa massal-insaanad-durru da`aanaa lijambihee aw qaa`idan aw qaa'imaa, falammaa kashafnaa `anhu durrahoo marra ka'al lam yad`unaa ilaa durrim massah, kadhaalika zuyyina lil-musrifeena maa kaanoo ya`maloon
Walaqad ahlaknal-quroona min qablikum lammaa zalamoo wajaa'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati wamaa kaanoo liyu'minoo, kadhaalika najzil-qawmal-mujrimeen
Thumma ja`alnaakum khalaa'ifa fil-ardi mim ba`dihim linanzura kayfa ta`maloon
Wa'idhaa tutlaa `alayhim aayaatunaa bayyinaatin qaalal-ladheena laa yarjoona liqaa'ana'ti biqur'aanin ghayri haadhaa aw baddilh, qul maa yakoonu lee an ubaddilahoo min tilqaa'i nafsee, in attabi`u illaa maa yoohaa ilayy, innee akhaafu in `asaytu rabbee `adhaaba yawmin `azeem
Qul law shaa'allaahu maa talawtuhoo `alaykum walaa adraakum bih, faqad labithtu feekum `umuram min qablih, afalaa ta`qiloon
Faman azlamu mimmaniftaraa `alallaahi kadhiban aw kadhdhaba bi'aayaatih, innahoo laa yuflihul-mujrimoon
Waya`budoona min doonillaahi maa laa yadurruhum walaa yanfa`uhum wayaqooloona haa'ulaa'i shufa`aa'unaa `indallaah, qul atunabbi'oonallaaha bimaa laa ya`lamu fis-samaawaati walaa fil-ard, subhaanahoo wata`aalaa `ammaa yushrikoon
Wamaa kaanan-naasu illaa ummataw waahidatan fakhtalafoo, walawlaa kalimatun sabaqat mir rabbika laqudiya baynahum feemaa feehi yakhtalifoon
Wayaqooloona lawlaa unzila `alayhi aayatum mir rabbih, faqul innamal-ghaybu lillaahi fantaziroo, innee ma`akum minal-muntazireen
Wa'idhaa adhaqnan-naasa rahmatam mim ba`di darraa'a massathum idhaa lahum makrun fee aayaatinaa, qulillaahu asra`u makraa, inna rusulanaa yaktuboona maa tamkuroon
Huwal-ladhee yusayyirukum fil-barri wal-bahr, hattaa idhaa kuntum fil-fulk, wajarayna bihim bireehin tayyibatiw wafarihoo bihaa jaa'athaa reehun `aasifuw wajaa'ahumul-mawju min kulli makaaniw wazannoo annahum uheeta bihim da`awullaaha mukhliseena lahud-deen, la'in anjaytanaa min haadhihee lanakoonanna minash-shaakireen
Falammaa anjaahum idhaa hum yabghoona fil-ardi bighayril-haqq, yaa ayyuhan-naasu innamaa baghyukum `alaa anfusikum mataa`al-hayaatid-dunyaa, thumma ilaynaa marji`ukum fanunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta`maloon
Innamaa mathalul-hayaatid-dunyaa kamaa'in anzalnaahu minas-samaa'i fakhtalata bihee nabaatul-ardi mimmaa ya'kulun-naasu wal-an`aam, hattaa idhaa akhadhatil-ardu zukhrufahaa wazzayyanat wazanna ahluhaa annahum qaadiroona `alayhaa ataahaa amrunaa laylan aw nahaaran faja`alnaahaa haseedan ka'al lam taghna bil-ams, kadhaalika nufassilul-aayaati liqawmiy yatafakkaroon
Wallaahu yad`oo ilaa daaris-salaam, wayahdee may yashaa'u ilaa siraatim mustaqeem
Lilladheena ahsanul-husnaa waziyaadah, walaa yarhaqu wujoohahum qataruw walaa dhillah, ulaa'ika ashaabul-jannati hum feehaa khaalidoon
Wal-ladheena kasabus-sayyi'aati jazaa'u sayyi'atim bimithlihaa watarhaquhum dhillah, maa lahum minallaahi min `aasim, ka'annamaa ughshiyat wujoohuhum qita`am minal-layli muzlimaa, ulaa'ika ashaabun-naar, hum feehaa khaalidoon
Wayawma nahshuruhum jamee`an thumma naqoolu lilladheena ashrakoo makaanakum antum washurakaa'ukum, fazayyalnaa baynahum waqaala shurakaa'uhum maa kuntum iyyaanaa ta`budoon
Fakafaa billaahi shaheedam baynanaa wabaynakum in kunnaa `an `ibaadatikum laghaafileen
Hunaalika tabloo kullu nafsim maa aslafat waruddoo ilallaahi mawlaahumul-haqqi wadalla `anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon
Qul may yarzuqukum minas-samaa'i wal-ardi ammay yamlikus-sam`a wal-absaara wamay yukhrijul-hayya minal-mayyiti wayukhrijul-mayyita minal-hayyi wamay yudabbirul-amr, fasayaqooloonallaah, faqul afalaa tattaqoon
Fadhaalikumullaahu rabbukumul-haqq, famaadhaa ba`dal-haqqi illad-dalaal, fa'annaa tusrafoon
Kadhaalika haqqat kalimatu rabbika `alal-ladheena fasaqoo annahum laa yu'minoon
Qul hal min shurakaa'ikum may yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu`eeduh, qulillaahu yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu`eeduhoo fa'annaa tu'fakoon
Qul hal min shurakaa'ikum may yahdee ilal-haqq, qulillaahu yahdee lil-haqq, afamay yahdee ilal-haqqi ahaqqu ay yuttaba`a ammal laa yahiddee illaa ay yuhdaa, famaa lakum, kayfa tahkumoon
Wamaa yattabi`u aktharuhum illaa zannaa, innaz-zanna laa yughnee minal-haqqi shay'aa, innallaaha `aleemum bimaa yaf`aloon
Wamaa kaana haadhal-qur'aanu ay yuftaraa min doonillaahi walaakin tasdeeqal-ladhee bayna yadayhi watafseelal-kitaabi laa rayba feehi mir rabbil-`aalameen
Am yaqooloonaftaraah, qul fa'too bisooratim mithlihee wad`oo manistata`tum min doonillaahi in kuntum saadiqeen
Bal kadhdhaboo bimaa lam yuheetoo bi`ilmihee walammaa ya'tihim ta'weeluh, kadhaalika kadhdhabal-ladheena min qablihim fanzur kayfa kaana `aaqibatuz-zaalimeen
Waminhum may yu'minu bihee waminhum mal laa yu'minu bih, warabbuka a`lamu bil-mufsideen
Wa'in kadhdhabooka faqul lee `amalee walakum `amalukum, antum baree'oona mimmaa a`malu wa'ana baree'um mimmaa ta`maloon
Waminhum may yastami`oona ilayk, afa'anta tusmi`us-summa walaw kaanoo laa ya`qiloon
Waminhum may yanzuru ilayk, afa'anta tahdil-`umya walaw kaanoo laa yubsiroon
Innallaaha laa yazlimun-naasa shay'aw walaakinnan-naasa anfusahum yazlimoon
Wayawma yahshuruhum ka'al lam yalbathoo illaa saa`atam minan-nahaari yata`aarafoona baynahum, qad khasiral-ladheena kadhdhaboo biliqaa'illaahi wamaa kaanoo muhtadeen
Wa'immaa nuriyannaka ba`dal-ladhee na`iduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa'ilaynaa marji`uhum thummallaahu shaheedun `alaa maa yaf`aloon
Walikulli ummatir rasool, fa'idhaa jaa'a rasooluhum qudiya baynahum bil-qisti wahum laa yuzlamoon
Wayaqooloona mataa haadhal-wa`du in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul laa amliku linafsee darraw walaa naf`an illaa maa shaa'allaah, likulli ummatin ajal, idhaa jaa'a ajaluhum falaa yasta'khiroona saa`ataw walaa yastaqdimoon
Qul ara'aytum in ataakum `adhaabuhoo bayaatan aw nahaaram maadhaa yasta`jilu minhul-mujrimoon
Athumma idhaa maa waqa`a aamantum bih, aal-aana waqad kuntum bihee tasta`jiloon
Thumma qeela lilladheena zalamoo dhooqoo `adhaabal-khuld, hal tujzawna illaa bimaa kuntum taksiboon
Wayastambi'oonaka ahaqqun huw, qul ee warabbee innahoo lahaqq, wamaa antum bimu`jizeen
Walaw anna likulli nafsin zalamat maa fil-ardi laftadat bih, wa'asarrun-nadaamata lammaa ra'awul-`adhaab, waqudiya baynahum bil-qisti wahum laa yuzlamoon
Alaa inna lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, alaa inna wa`dallaahi haqquw walaakinna aktharahum laa ya`lamoon
Huwa yuhyee wayumeetu wa'ilayhi turja`oon
Yaa ayyuhan-naasu qad jaa'atkum maw`izatum mir rabbikum washifaa'ul limaa fis-sudoori wahudaw warahmatul lil-mu'mineen
Qul bifadlillaahi wabirahmatihee fabidhaalika falyafrahoo, huwa khayrum mimmaa yajma`oon
Qul ara'aytum maa anzalallaahu lakum mir rizqin faja`altum minhu haraamaw wahalaalaa, qul aallaahu adhina lakum am `alallaahi taftaroon
Wamaa zannul-ladheena yaftaroona `alallaahil-kadhiba yawmal-qiyaamah, innallaaha ladhoo fadlin `alan-naasi walaakinna aktharahum laa yashkuroon
Wamaa takoonu fee sha'niw wamaa tatloo minhu min qur'aaniw walaa ta`maloona min `amalin illaa kunnaa `alaykum shuhoodan idh tufeedoona feeh, wamaa ya`zubu `ar rabbika mim mithqaali dharratin fil-ardi walaa fis-samaa'i walaa asghara min dhaalika walaa akbara illaa fee kitaabim mubeen
Alaa inna awliyaa'allaahi laa khawfun `alayhim walaa hum yahzanoon
Alladheena aamanoo wakaanoo yattaqoon
Lahumul-bushraa fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wafil-aakhirah, laa tabdeela likalimaatillaah, dhaalika huwal-fawzul-`azeem
Walaa yahzunka qawluhum, innal-`izzata lillaahi jamee`aa, huwas-samee`ul-`aleem
Alaa inna lillaahi man fis-samaawaati waman fil-ard, wamaa yattabi`ul-ladheena yad`oona min doonillaahi shurakaa', iy yattabi`oona illaz-zanna wa'in hum illaa yakhrusoon
Huwal-ladhee ja`ala lakumul-layla litaskunoo feehi wan-nahaara mubsiraa, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy yasma`oon
Qaaluttakhadhallaahu waladan subhaanah, huwal-ghaniyy, lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, in `indakum min sultaanim bihaadhaa, ataqooloona `alallaahi maa laa ta`lamoon
Qul innal-ladheena yaftaroona `alallaahil-kadhiba laa yuflihoon
Mataa`un fid-dunyaa thumma ilaynaa marji`uhum thumma nudheequhumul-`adhaabash-shadeeda bimaa kaanoo yakfuroon
Watlu `alayhim naba'a nooh, idh qaala liqawmihee yaaqawmi in kaana kabura `alaykum maqaamee watadhkeeree bi'aayaatillaahi fa`alallaahi tawakkaltu fa'ajmi`oo amrakum washurakaa'akum thumma laa yakun amrukum `alaykum ghummatan thummaqdoo ilayya walaa tunziroon
Fa'in tawallaytum famaa sa'altukum min ajr, in ajriya illaa `alallaahi wa'umirtu an akoona minal-muslimeen
Fakadhdhaboohu fanajjaynaahu wamam ma`ahoo fil-fulki waja`alnaahum khalaa'ifa wa'aghraqnal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa, fanzur kayfa kaana `aaqibatul-mundhareen
Thumma ba`athnaa mim ba`dihee rusulan ilaa qawmihim fajaa'oohum bil-bayyinaati famaa kaanoo liyu'minoo bimaa kadhdhaboo bihee min qabl, kadhaalika natba`u `alaa quloobil-mu`tadeen
Thumma ba`athnaa mim ba`dihim moosaa wahaaroona ilaa fir`awna wamala'ihee bi'aayaatinaa fastakbaroo wakaanoo qawmam mujrimeen
Falammaa jaa'ahumul-haqqu min `indinaa qaaloo inna haadhaa lasihrum mubeen
Qaala moosaa ataqooloona lil-haqqi lammaa jaa'akum, asihrun haadhaa, walaa yuflihus-saahiroon
Qaaloo aji'tanaa litalfitanaa `ammaa wajadnaa `alayhi aabaa'anaa watakoona lakumal-kibriyaa'u fil-ard, wamaa nahnu lakumaa bimu'mineen
Waqaala fir`awnu'toonee bikulli saahirin `aleem
Falammaa jaa'as-saharatu qaala lahum moosaa alqoo maa antum mulqoon
Falammaa alqaw qaala moosaa maa ji'tum bihis-sihr, innallaaha sayubtiluh, innallaaha laa yuslihu `amalal-mufsideen
Wayuhiqqullaahul-haqqa bikalimaatihee walaw karihal-mujrimoon
Famaa aamana limoosaa illaa dhurriyyatum min qawmihee `alaa khawfim min fir`awna wamala'ihim ay yaftinahum, wa'inna fir`awna la`aalin fil-ard, wa'innahoo laminal-musrifeen
Waqaala moosaa yaaqawmi in kuntum aamantum billaahi fa`alayhi tawakkaloo in kuntum muslimeen
Faqaaloo `alallaahi tawakkalnaa, rabbanaa laa taj`alnaa fitnatal lil-qawmiz-zaalimeen
Wanajjinaa birahmatika minal-qawmil-kaafireen
Wa'awhaynaa ilaa moosaa wa'akheehi an tabawwa'aa liqawmikumaa bimisra buyootaw waj`aloo buyootakum qiblataw wa'aqeemus-salaah, wabashshiril-mu'mineen
Waqaala moosaa rabbanaa innaka aatayta fir`awna wamala'ahoo zeenataw wa'amwaalan fil-hayaatid-dunyaa, rabbanaa liyudilloo `an sabeelik, rabbanatmis `alaa amwaalihim washdud `alaa quloobihim falaa yu'minoo hattaa yarawul-`adhaabal-aleem
Qaala qad ujeebad da`watukumaa fastaqeemaa walaa tattabi`aanni sabeelal-ladheena laa ya`lamoon
Wajaawaznaa bibanee israa'eelal-bahra fa'atba`ahum fir`awnu wajunooduhoo baghyaw wa`adwaa, hattaa idhaa adrakahul-gharaqu qaala aamantu annahoo laa ilaaha illal-ladhee aamanat bihee banoo israa'eela wa'ana minal-muslimeen
Aal-aana waqad `asayta qablu wakunta minal-mufsideen
Fal-yawma nunajjeeka bibadanika litakoona liman khalfaka aayah, wa'inna katheeram minan-naasi `an aayaatinaa laghaafiloon
Walaqad bawwa'naa banee israa'eela mubawwa'a sidqiw warazaqnaahum minat-tayyibaat, famakhtalafoo hattaa jaa'ahumul-`ilm, inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum yawmal-qiyaamati feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
Fa'in kunta fee shakkim mimmaa anzalnaa ilayka fas'alil-ladheena yaqra'oonal-kitaaba min qablik, laqad jaa'akal-haqqu mir rabbika falaa takoonanna minal-mumtareen
Walaa takoonanna minal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatillaahi fatakoona minal-khaasireen
Innal-ladheena haqqat `alayhim kalimatu rabbika laa yu'minoon
Walaw jaa'athum kullu aayatin hattaa yarawul-`adhaabal-aleem
Falawlaa kaanat qaryatun aamanat fanafa`ahaa eemaanuhaa illaa qawma yoonus, lammaa aamanoo kashafnaa `anhum `adhaabal-khizyi fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wamatta`naahum ilaa heen
Walaw shaa'a rabbuka la'aamana man fil-ardi kulluhum jamee`aa, afa'anta tukrihun-naasa hattaa yakoonoo mu'mineen
Wamaa kaana linafsin an tu'mina illaa bi'idhnillaah, wayaj`alur-rijsa `alal-ladheena laa ya`qiloon
Qulinzuroo maadhaa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, wamaa tughnil-aayaatu wan-nudhuru `an qawmil laa yu'minoon
Fahal yantaziroona illaa mithla ayyaamil-ladheena khalaw min qablihim, qul fantaziroo innee ma`akum minal-muntazireen
Thumma nunajjee rusulanaa wal-ladheena aamanoo kadhaalik, haqqan `alaynaa nunjil-mu'mineen
Qul yaa ayyuhan-naasu in kuntum fee shakkim min deenee falaa a`budul-ladheena ta`budoona min doonillaahi walaakin a`budullaahal-ladhee yatawaffaakum, wa'umirtu an akoona minal-mu'mineen
Wa'an aqim wajhaka lid-deeni haneefaa, walaa takoonanna minal-mushrikeen
Walaa tad`u min doonillaahi maa laa yanfa`uka walaa yadurruk, fa'in fa`alta fa'innaka idham minaz-zaalimeen
Wa'iy yamsaskallaahu bidurrin falaa kaashifa lahoo illaa huw, wa'iy yuridka bikhayrin falaa raadda lifadlih, yuseebu bihee may yashaa'u min `ibaadih, wahuwal-ghafoorur-raheem
Qul yaa ayyuhan-naasu qad jaa'akumul-haqqu mir rabbikum, famanihtadaa fa'innamaa yahtadee linafsih, waman dalla fa'innamaa yadillu `alayhaa, wamaa ana `alaykum biwakeel
Wattabi` maa yoohaa ilayka wasbir hattaa yahkumallaah, wahuwa khayrul-haakimeen

Alif laam raa, kitaabun uhkimat aayaatuhoo thumma fussilat mil ladun hakeemin khabeer
Allaa ta`budoo illallaah, innanee lakum minhu nadheeruw wabasheer
Wa'anistaghfiroo rabbakum thumma tooboo ilayhi yumatti`kum mataa`an hasanan ilaa ajalim musammaw wayu'ti kulla dhee fadlin fadlah, wa'in tawallaw fa'innee akhaafu `alaykum `adhaaba yawmin kabeer
Ilallaahi marji`ukum, wahuwa `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Alaa innahum yathnoona sudoorahum liyastakhfoo minh, alaa heena yastaghshoona thiyaabahum ya`lamu maa yusirroona wamaa yu`linoon, innahoo `aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
Wamaa min daabbatin fil-ardi illaa `alallaahi rizquhaa waya`lamu mustaqarrahaa wamustawda`ahaa, kullun fee kitaabim mubeen
Wahuwal-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda fee sittati ayyaamiw wakaana `arshuhoo `alal-maa'i liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu `amalaa, wala'in qulta innakum mab`oothoona mim ba`dil-mawti layaqoolannal-ladheena kafaroo in haadhaa illaa sihrum mubeen
Wala'in akhkharnaa `anhumul-`adhaaba ilaa ummatim ma`doodatil layaqoolunna maa yahbisuh, alaa yawma ya'teehim laysa masroofan `anhum wahaaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
Wala'in adhaqnal-insaana minnaa rahmatan thumma naza`naahaa minh, innahoo laya'oosun kafoor
Wala'in adhaqnaahu na`maa'a ba`da darraa'a massathu layaqoolanna dhahabas-sayyi'aatu `annee, innahoo lafarihun fakhoor
Illal-ladheena sabaroo wa`amilus-saalihaat, ulaa'ika lahum maghfiratuw wa'ajrun kabeer
Fala`allaka taarikum ba`da maa yoohaa ilayka wadaa'iqum bihee sadruka ay yaqooloo lawlaa unzila `alayhi kanzun aw jaa'a ma`ahoo malak, innamaa anta nadheer, wallaahu `alaa kulli shay'iw wakeel
Am yaqooloonaftaraah, qul fa'too bi`ashri suwarim mithlihee muftarayaatiw wad`oo manistata`tum min doonillaahi in kuntum saadiqeen
Fa'illam yastajeeboo lakum fa`lamoo annamaa unzila bi`ilmillaahi wa'al laa ilaaha illaa huw, fahal antum muslimoon
Man kaana yureedul-hayaatad-dunyaa wazeenatahaa nuwaffi ilayhim a`maalahum feehaa wahum feehaa laa yubkhasoon
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena laysa lahum fil-aakhirati illan-naar, wahabita maa sana`oo feehaa wabaatilum maa kaanoo ya`maloon
Afaman kaana `alaa bayyinatim mir rabbihee wayatloohu shaahidum minhu wamin qablihee kitaabu moosaa imaamaw warahmah, ulaa'ika yu'minoona bih, wamay yakfur bihee minal-ahzaabi fan-naaru maw`iduhoo falaa taku fee miryatim minhu innahul-haqqu mir rabbika walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa yu'minoon
Waman azlamu mimmaniftaraa `alallaahi kadhibaa, ulaa'ika yu`radoona `alaa rabbihim wayaqoolul-ashhaadu haa'ulaa'il-ladheena kadhaboo `alaa rabbihim, alaa la`natullaahi `alaz-zaalimeen
Al-ladheena yasuddoona `an sabeelillaahi wayabghoonahaa `iwajaa, wahum bil-aakhirati hum kaafiroon
Ulaa'ika lam yakoonoo mu`jizeena fil-ardi wamaa kaana lahum min doonillaahi min awliyaa', yudaa`afu lahumul-`adhaab, maa kaanoo yastatee`oonas-sam`a wamaa kaanoo yubsiroon
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena khasiroo anfusahum wadalla `anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon
Laa jarama annahum fil-aakhirati humul-akhsaroon
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati wa'akhbatoo ilaa rabbihim ulaa'ika ashaabul-jannah, hum feehaa khaalidoon
Mathalul-fareeqayni kal-a`maa wal-asammi wal-baseeri was-samee`, hal yastawiyaani mathalaa, afalaa tadhakkaroon
Walaqad arsalnaa noohan ilaa qawmihee innee lakum nadheerum mubeen
Al laa ta`budoo illallaah, innee akhaafu `alaykum `adhaaba yawmin aleem
Faqaalal-mala'ul-ladheena kafaroo min qawmihee maa naraaka illaa basharam mithlanaa wamaa naraakattaba`aka illal-ladheena hum araadhilunaa baadiyar-ra'y, wamaa naraa lakum `alaynaa min fadlim bal nazunnukum kaadhibeen
Qaala yaaqawmi ara'aytum in kuntu `alaa bayyinatim mir rabbee wa'aataanee rahmatam min `indihee fa`ummiyat `alaykum, anulzimukumoohaa wa'antum lahaa kaarihoon
Wayaaqawmi laa as'alukum `alayhi maalaa, in ajriya illaa `alallaahi wamaa ana bitaaridil-ladheena aamanoo, innahum mulaaqoo rabbihim walaakinnee araakum qawman tajhaloon
Wayaaqawmi may yansurunee minallaahi in tarattuhum, afalaa tadhakkaroon
Walaa aqoolu lakum `indee khazaa'inullaahi walaa a`lamul-ghayba walaa aqoolu innee malakuw walaa aqoolu lilladheena tazdaree a`yunukum lay yu'tiyahumullaahu khayraa, allaahu a`lamu bimaa fee anfusihim, innee idhal laminaz-zaalimeen
Qaaloo yaanoohu qad jaadaltanaa fa'aktharta jidaalanaa fa'tinaa bimaa ta`idunaa in kunta minas-saadiqeen
Qaala innamaa ya'teekum bihillaahu in shaa'a wamaa antum bimu`jizeen
Walaa yanfa`ukum nushee in arattu an ansaha lakum in kaanallaahu yureedu ay yughwiyakum, huwa rabbukum, wa'ilayhi turja`oon
Am yaqooloonaftaraah, qul iniftaraytuhoo fa`alayya ijraamee wa'ana baree'um mimmaa tujrimoon
Wa'oohiya ilaa noohin annahoo lay yu'mina min qawmika illaa man qad aamana falaa tabta'is bimaa kaanoo yaf`aloon
Wasna`il-fulka bi'a`yuninaa wawahyinaa walaa tukhaatibnee fil-ladheena zalamoo, innahum mughraqoon
Wayasna`ul-fulk, wakullamaa marra `alayhi mala'um min qawmihee sakhiroo minh, qaala in taskharoo minnaa fa'innaa naskharu minkum kamaa taskharoon
Fasawfa ta`lamoona may ya'teehi `adhaabuy yukhzeehi wayahillu `alayhi `adhaabum muqeem
Hattaa idhaa jaa'a amrunaa wafaarat-tannooru qulnahmil feehaa min kullin zawjaynithnayni wa'ahlaka illaa man sabaqa `alayhil-qawlu waman aaman, wamaa aamana ma`ahoo illaa qaleel
Waqaalarkaboo feehaa bismillaahi majrayhaa wamursaahaa, inna rabbee laghafoorur raheem
Wahiya tajree bihim fee mawjin kal-jibaal, wanaadaa noohunibnahoo wakaana fee ma`ziliy yaabunayyarkam ma`anaa walaa takum ma`al-kaafireen
Qaala sa'aawee ilaa jabaliy ya`simunee minal-maa', qaala laa `aasimal-yawma min amrillaahi illaa mar rahim, wahaala baynahumal-mawju fakaana minal-mughraqeen
Waqeela yaa ardubla`ee maa'aki wayaasamaa'u aqli`ee wagheedal-maa'u waqudiyal-amru wastawat `alal-joodiyyi waqeela bu`dal lil-qawmiz-zaalimeen
Wanaadaa noohur rabbahoo faqaala rabbi innabnee min ahlee, wa'inna wa`dakal-haqqu wa'anta ahkamul-haakimeen
Qaala yaanoohu innahoo laysa min ahlik, innahoo `amalun ghayru saalihin falaa tas'alni maa laysa laka bihee `ilm, innee a`izuka an takoona minal-jaahileen
Qaala rabbi innee a`oodhu bika an as'alaka maa laysa lee bihee `ilm, wa'illaa taghfir lee watarhamnee akum minal-khaasireen
Qeela yaanoohuhbit bisalaamim minnaa wabarakaatin `alayka wa`alaa umamim mimmam ma`ak, wa'umamun sanumatti`uhum thumma yamassuhum minnaa `adhaabun aleem
Tilka min ambaa'il-ghaybi nooheehaa ilayk, maa kunta ta`lamuhaa anta walaa qawmuka min qabli haadhaa, fasbir, innal-`aaqibata lil-muttaqeen
Wa'ilaa `aadin akhaahum hoodaa, qaala yaaqawmi`budullaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruh, in antum illaa muftaroon
Yaaqawmi laa as'alukum `alayhi ajraa, in ajriya illaa `alal-ladhee fataranee, afalaa ta`qiloon
Wayaaqawmistaghfiroo rabbakum thumma tooboo ilayhi yursilis-samaa'a `alaykum midraaraw wayazidkum quwwatan ilaa quwwatikum walaa tatawallaw mujrimeen
Qaaloo yaahoodu maa ji'tanaa bibayyinatiw wamaa nahnu bitaarikee aalihatinaa `an qawlika wamaa nahnu laka bimu'mineen
In naqoolu illa`taraaka ba`du aalihatinaa bisoo', qaala innee ushhidullaaha washhadoo annee baree'um mimmaa tushrikoon
Min doonihee fakeedoonee jamee`an thumma laa tunziroon
Innee tawakkaltu `alallaahi rabbee warabbikum, maa min daabbatin illaa huwa aakhidhum binaasiyatihaa, inna rabbee `alaa siraatim mustaqeem
Fa'in tawallaw faqad ablaghtukum maa ursiltu bihee ilaykum, wayastakhlifu rabbee qawman ghayrakum, walaa tadurroonahoo shay'aa, inna rabbee `alaa kulli shay'in hafeez
Walammaa jaa'a amrunaa najjaynaa hoodaw wal-ladheena aamanoo ma`ahoo birahmatim minnaa, wanajjaynaahum min `adhaabin ghaleez
Watilka `aad, jahadoo bi'aayaati rabbihim wa`asaw rusulahoo wattaba`oo amra kulli jabbaarin `aneed
Wa'utbi`oo fee haadhihid-dunyaa la`nataw wayawmal-qiyaamah, alaa inna `aadan kafaroo rabbahum, alaa bu`dal li`aadin qawmi hood
Wa'ilaa thamooda akhaahum saalihaa, qaala yaaqawmi`budullaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruh, huwa ansha'akum minal-ardi wasta`marakum feehaa fastaghfiroohu thumma tooboo ilayh, inna rabbee qareebum mujeeb
Qaaloo yaasaalihu qad kunta feenaa marjuwwan qabla haadhaa atanhaanaa an na`buda maa ya`budu aabaa'unaa wa'innanaa lafee shakkim mimmaa tad`oonaa ilayhi mureeb
Qaala yaaqawmi ara'aytum in kuntu `alaa bayyinatim mir rabbee, wa'aataanee minhu rahmatan famay yansurunee minallaahi in `asaytuh, famaa tazeedoonanee ghayra takhseer
Wayaaqawmi haadhihee naaqatullaahi lakum aayatan fadharoohaa ta'kul fee ardillaahi walaa tamassoohaa bisoo'in faya'khudhakum `adhaabun qareeb
Fa`aqaroohaa faqaala tamatta`oo fee daarikum thalaathata ayyaam, dhaalika wa`dun ghayru makdhoob
Falammaa jaa'a amrunaa najjaynaa saalihaw wal-ladheena aamanoo ma`ahoo birahmatim minnaa wamin khizyi yawmi'idh, inna rabbaka huwal-qawiyyul-`azeez
Wa'akhadhal-ladheena zalamus-sayhatu fa'asbahoo fee diyaarihim jaathimeen
Ka'al lam yaghnaw feehaa, alaa inna thamooda kafaroo rabbahum, alaa bu`dal lithamood
Walaqad jaa'at rusulunaa ibraaheema bil-bushraa qaaloo salaamaa, qaala salaamun famaa labitha an jaa'a bi`ijlin haneedh
Falammaa ra'aa aydiyahum laa tasilu ilayhi nakirahum wa'awjasa minhum kheefah, qaaloo laa takhaf innaa ursilnaa ilaa qawmi loot
Wamra'atuhoo qaa'imatun fadahikat fabashsharnaahaa bi'ishaaqa wamiw waraa'i ishaaqa ya`qoob
Qaalat yaawaylataa a'alidu wa'ana `ajoozuw wahaadhaa ba`lee shaykhaa, inna haadhaa lashay'un `ajeeb
Qaaloo ata`jabeena min amrillaahi rahmatullaahi wabarakaatuhoo `alaykum ahlal-bayt, innahoo hameedum majeed
Falammaa dhahaba `an ibraaheemar-raw`u wajaa'athul-bushraa yujaadilunaa fee qawmi loot
Inna ibraaheema lahaleemun awwaahum muneeb
Yaa ibraaheemu a`rid `an haadhaa, innahoo qad jaa'a amru rabbik, wa'innahum aateehim `adhaabun ghayru mardood
Walammaa jaa'at rusulunaa lootan see'a bihim wadaaqa bihim dhar`aw waqaala haadhaa yawmun `aseeb
Wajaa'ahoo qawmuhoo yuhra`oona ilayh, wamin qablu kaanoo ya`maloonas-sayyi'aat, qaala yaaqawmi haa'ulaa'i banaatee hunna atharu lakum fattaqullaaha walaa tukhzooni fee dayfee, alaysa minkum rajulur rasheed
Qaaloo laqad `alimta maa lanaa fee banaatika min haqq, wa'innaka lata`lamu maa nureed
Qaala law anna lee bikum quwwatan aw aawee ilaa ruknin shadeed
Qaaloo yaalootu innaa rusulu rabbika lay yasiloo ilayka fa'asri bi'ahlika biqit`im minal-layli walaa yaltafit minkum ahadun illamra'atak, innahoo museebuhaa maa asaabahum, inna maw`idahumus-subh, alaysas-subhu biqareeb
Falammaa jaa'a amrunaa ja`alnaa `aaliyahaa saafilahaa wa'amtarnaa `alayhaa hijaaratam min sijjeelim mandood
Musawwamatan `inda rabbik, wamaa hiya minaz-zaalimeena biba`eed
Wa'ilaa madyana akhaahum shu`aybaa, qaala yaaqawmi`budullaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruh, walaa tanqusul-mikyaala wal-meezaana innee araakum bikhayriw wa'innee akhaafu `alaykum `adhaaba yawmim muheet
Wayaaqawmi awful-mikyaala wal-meezaana bil-qisti walaa tabkhasun-naasa ashyaa'ahum walaa ta`thaw fil-ardi mufsideen
Baqiyyatullaahi khayrul lakum in kuntum mu'mineen, wamaa ana `alaykum bihafeez
Qaaloo yaashu`aybu asalaatuka ta'muruka an natruka maa ya`budu aabaa'unaa aw an naf`ala fee amwaalinaa maa nashaa', innaka la'antal-haleemur-rasheed
Qaala yaaqawmi ara'aytum in kuntu `alaa bayyinatim mir rabbee warazaqanee minhu rizqan hasanaw wamaa ureedu an ukhaalifakum ilaa maa anhaakum `anh, in ureedu illal-islaaha mastata`t, wamaa tawfeeqee illaa billaah, `alayhi tawakkaltu wa'ilayhi uneeb
Wayaaqawmi laa yajrimannakum shiqaaqee ay yuseebakum mithlu maa asaaba qawma noohin aw qawma hoodin aw qawma saalih, wamaa qawmu lootim minkum biba`eed
Wastaghfiroo rabbakum thumma tooboo ilayh, inna rabbee raheemuw wadood
Qaaloo yaashu`aybu maa nafqahu katheeram mimmaa taqoolu wa'innaa lanaraaka feenaa da`eefaa, walawlaa rahtuka larajamnaak, wamaa anta `alaynaa bi`azeez
Qaala yaaqawmi arahtee a`azzu `alaykum minallaah, wattakhadhtumoohu waraa'akum zihriyyaa, inna rabbee bimaa ta`maloona muheet
Wayaaqawmi`maloo `alaa makaanatikum innee `aamil, sawfa ta`lamoona may ya'teehi `adhaabuy yukhzeehi waman huwa kaadhib, wartaqiboo innee ma`akum raqeeb
Walammaa jaa'a amrunaa najjaynaa shu`aybaw wal-ladheena aamanoo ma`ahoo birahmatim minnaa, wa'akhadhatil-ladheena zalamus-sayhatu fa'asbahoo fee diyaarihim jaathimeen
Ka'al lam yaghnaw feehaa, alaa bu`dal limadyana kamaa ba`idat thamood
Walaqad arsalnaa moosaa bi'aayaatinaa wasultaanim mubeen
Ilaa fir`awna wamala'ihee fattaba`oo amra fir`awn, wamaa amru fir`awna birasheed
Yaqdumu qawmahoo yawmal-qiyaamati fa'awradahumun-naar, wabi'sal-wirdul-mawrood
Wa'utbi`oo fee haadhihee la`nataw wayawmal-qiyaamah, bi'sar-rifdul-marfood
Dhaalika min ambaa'il-quraa naqussuhoo `alayka minhaa qaa'imuw wahaseed
Wamaa zalamnaahum walaakin zalamoo anfusahum famaa aghnat `anhum aalihatuhumul-latee yad`oona min doonillaahi min shay'il lammaa jaa'a amru rabbik, wamaa zaadoohum ghayra tatbeeb
Wakadhaalika akhdhu rabbika idhaa akhadhal-quraa wahiya zaalimah, inna akhdhahoo aleemun shadeed
Inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal liman khaafa `adhaabal-aakhirah, dhaalika yawmum majmoo`ul lahun-naasu wadhaalika yawmum mashhood
Wamaa nu'akhkhiruhoo illaa li'ajalim ma`dood
Yawma ya'ti laa takallamu nafsun illaa bi'idhnih, faminhum shaqiyyuw wasa`eed
Fa'ammal-ladheena shaqoo fafin-naari lahum feehaa zafeeruw washaheeq
Khaalideena feehaa maa daamatis-samaawaatu wal-ardu illaa maa shaa'a rabbuk, inna rabbaka fa``aalul limaa yureed
Wa'ammal-ladheena su`idoo fafil-jannati khaalideena feehaa maa daamatis-samaawaatu wal-ardu illaa maa shaa'a rabbuk, `ataa'an ghayra majdhoodh
Falaa taku fee miryatim mimmaa ya`budu haa'ulaa', maa ya`budoona illaa kamaa ya`budu aabaa'uhum min qabl, wa'innaa lamuwaffoohum naseebahum ghayra manqoos
Walaqad aataynaa moosal-kitaaba fakhtulifa feeh, walawlaa kalimatun sabaqat mir rabbika laqudiya baynahum, wa'innahum lafee shakkim minhu mureeb
Wa'inna kullal lammaa layuwaffiyannahum rabbuka a`maalahum, innahoo bimaa ya`maloona khabeer
Fastaqim kamaa umirta waman taaba ma`aka walaa tatghaw, innahoo bimaa ta`maloona baseer
Walaa tarkanoo ilal-ladheena zalamoo fatamassakumun-naaru wamaa lakum min doonillaahi min awliyaa'a thumma laa tunsaroon
Wa'aqimis-salaata tarafayin-nahaari wazulafam minal-layl, innal-hasanaati yudhhibnas-sayyi'aat, dhaalika dhikraa lidh-dhaakireen
Wasbir fa'innallaaha laa yudee`u ajral-muhsineen
Falawlaa kaana minal-qurooni min qablikum uloo baqiyyatiy yanhawna `anil-fasaadi fil-ardi illaa qaleelam mimman anjaynaa minhum, wattaba`al-ladheena zalamoo maa utrifoo feehi wakaanoo mujrimeen
Wamaa kaana rabbuka liyuhlikal-quraa bizulmiw wa'ahluhaa muslihoon
Walaw shaa'a rabbuka laja`alan-naasa ummataw waahidataw walaa yazaaloona mukhtalifeen
Illaa mar rahima rabbuk, walidhaalika khalaqahum, watammat kalimatu rabbika la'amla'anna jahannama minal-jinnati wan-naasi ajma`een
Wakullan naqussu `alayka min ambaa'ir-rusuli maa nuthabbitu bihee fu'aadaka wajaa'aka fee haadhihil-haqqu wamaw`izatuw wadhikraa lil-mu'mineen
Waqul lilladheena laa yu'minoona`maloo `alaa makaanatikum, innaa `aamiloon
Wantaziroo, innaa muntaziroon
Walillaahi ghaybus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa'ilayhi yurja`ul-amru kulluhoo fa`budhu watawakkal `alayh, wamaa rabbuka bighaafilin `ammaa ta`maloon

Alif laam raa, tilka aayaatul-kitaabil-mubeen
Innaa anzalnaahu qur'aanan `arabiyyal la`allakum ta`qiloon
Nahnu naqussu `alayka ahsanal-qasasi bimaa awhaynaa ilayka haadhal-qur'aan, wa'in kunta min qablihee laminal-ghaafileen
Idh qaala yoosufu li'abeehi yaa abati innee ra'aytu ahada `ashara kawkabaw wash-shamsa wal-qamara ra'aytuhum lee saajideen
Qaala yaabunayya laa taqsus ru'yaaka `alaa ikhwatika fayakeedoo laka kaydaa, innash-shaytaana lil-insaani `aduwwum mubeen
Wakadhaalika yajtabeeka rabbuka wayu`allimuka min ta'weelil-ahaadeethi wayutimmu ni`matahoo `alayka wa`alaa aali ya`qooba kamaa atammahaa `alaa abawayka min qablu ibraaheema wa'ishaaq, inna rabbaka `aleemun hakeem
Laqad kaana fee yoosufa wa'ikhwatihee aayaatul lis-saa'ileen
Idh qaaloo layoosufu wa'akhoohu ahabbu ilaa abeenaa minnaa wanahnu `usbah, inna abaanaa lafee dalaalim mubeen
Uqtuloo yoosufa awitrahoohu arday yakhlu lakum wajhu abeekum watakoonoo mim ba`dihee qawman saaliheen
Qaala qaa'ilum minhum laa taqtuloo yoosufa wa'alqoohu fee ghayaabatil-jubbi yaltaqithu ba`dus-sayyaarati in kuntum faa`ileen
Qaaloo yaa abaanaa maa laka laa ta'mannaa `alaa yoosufa wa'innaa lahoo lanaasihoon
Arsilhu ma`anaa ghaday yarta` wayal`ab wa'innaa lahoo lahaafizoon
Qaala innee layahzununee an tadhhaboo bihee wa'akhaafu ay ya'kulahudh-dhi'bu wa'antum `anhu ghaafiloon
Qaaloo la'in akalahudh-dhi'bu wanahnu `usbatun innaa idhal lakhaasiroon
Falammaa dhahaboo bihee wa'ajma`oo ay yaj`aloohu fee ghayaabatil-jubb, wa'awhaynaa ilayhi latunabbi'annahum bi'amrihim haadhaa wahum laa yash`uroon
Wajaa'oo abaahum `ishaa'ay yabkoon
Qaaloo yaa abaanaa innaa dhahabnaa nastabiqu wataraknaa yoosufa `inda mataa`inaa fa'akalahudh-dhi'b, wamaa anta bimu'minil lanaa walaw kunnaa saadiqeen
Wajaa'oo `alaa qameesihee bidamin kadhib, qaala bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amraa, fasabrun jameel, wallaahul-musta`aanu `alaa maa tasifoon
Wajaa'at sayyaaratun fa'arsaloo waaridahum fa'adlaa dalwah, qaala yaabushraa haadhaa ghulaam, wa'asarroohu bidaa`ah, wallaahu `aleemum bimaa ya`maloon
Washarawhu bithamanim bakhsin daraahima ma`doodah, wakaanoo feehi minaz-zaahideen
Waqaalal-ladhishtaraahu mim misra limra'atihee akrimee mathwaahu `asaa ay yanfa`anaa aw nattakhidhahoo waladaa, wakadhaalika makkannaa liyoosufa fil-ard, walinu`allimahoo min ta'weelil-ahaadeeth, wallaahu ghaalibun `alaa amrihee walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya`lamoon
Walammaa balagha ashuddahoo aataynaahu hukmaw wa`ilmaa, wakadhaalika najzil-muhsineen
Waraawadathul-latee huwa fee baytihaa `an nafsihee waghallaqatil-abwaaba waqaalat hayta lak, qaala ma`aadhallaahi innahoo rabbee ahsana mathwaay, innahoo laa yuflihuz-zaalimoon
Walaqad hammat bihee wahamma bihaa, lawlaa ar ra'aa burhaana rabbih, kadhaalika linasrifa `anhus-soo'a wal-fahshaa', innahoo min `ibaadinal-mukhlaseen
Wastabaqal-baaba waqaddat qameesahoo min duburiw wa'alfayaa sayyidahaa ladal-baab, qaalat maa jazaa'u man araada bi'ahlika soo'an illaa ay yusjana aw `adhaabun aleem
Qaala hiya raawadatnee `an nafsee washahida shaahidum min ahlihaa, in kaana qameesuhoo qudda min qubulin fasadaqat wahuwa minal-kaadhibeen
Wa'in kaana qameesuhoo qudda min duburin fakadhabat wahuwa minas-saadiqeen
Falammaa ra'aa qameesahoo qudda min duburin qaala innahoo min kaydikunn, inna kaydakunna `azeem
Yoosufu a`rid `an haadhaa wastaghfiree lidhambik, innaki kunti minal-khaati'een
Waqaala niswatun fil-madeenatimra'atul-`azeezi turaawidu fataahaa `an nafsih, qad shaghafahaa hubbaa, innaa lanaraahaa fee dalaalim mubeen
Falammaa sami`at bimakrihinna arsalat ilayhinna wa'a`tadat lahunna muttaka'aw wa'aatat kulla waahidatim minhunna sikkeenaw waqaalatikhruj `alayhinn, falammaa ra'aynahoo akbarnahoo waqatta`na aydiyahunn, waqulna haasha lillaahi maa haadhaa basharaa, in haadhaa illaa malakun kareem
Qaalat fadhaalikunnal-ladhee lumtunnanee feeh, walaqad raawattuhoo `an nafsihee fasta`sam, wala'il lam yaf`al maa aamuruhoo layusjananna walayakoonam minas-saaghireen
Qaala rabbis-sijnu ahabbu ilayya mimmaa yad`oonanee ilayh, wa'illaa tasrif `annee kaydahunna asbu ilayhinna wa'akum minal-jaahileen
Fastajaaba lahoo rabbuhoo fasarafa `anhu kaydahunn, innahoo huwas-samee`ul-`aleem
Thumma badaa lahum mim ba`di maa ra'awul-aayaati layasjununnahoo hattaa heen
Wadakhala ma`ahus-sijna fatayaan, qaala ahaduhumaa innee araanee a`siru khamraa, waqaalal-aakharu innee araanee ahmilu fawqa ra'see khubzan ta'kulut-tayru minh, nabbi'naa bita'weelih, innaa naraaka minal-muhsineen
Qaala laa ya'teekumaa ta`aamun turzaqaanihee illaa nabba'tukumaa bita'weelihee qabla ay ya'tiyakumaa, dhaalikumaa mimmaa `allamanee rabbee, innee taraktu millata qawmil laa yu'minoona billaahi wahum bil-aakhirati hum kaafiroon
Wattaba`tu millata aabaa'ee ibraaheema wa'ishaaqa waya`qoob, maa kaana lanaa an nushrika billaahi min shay', dhaalika min fadlillaahi `alaynaa wa`alan-naasi walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa yashkuroon
Yaasaahibayis-sijni a'arbaabum mutafarriqoona khayrun amillaahul-waahidul-qahhaar
Maa ta`budoona min doonihee illaa asmaa'an sammaytumoohaa antum wa'aabaa'ukum maa anzalallaahu bihaa min sultaan, inil-hukmu illaa lillaah, amara allaa ta`budoo illaa iyyaah, dhaalikad-deenul-qayyimu walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya`lamoon
Yaasaahibayis-sijni ammaa ahadukumaa fayasqee rabbahoo khamraa, wa'ammal-aakharu fayuslabu fata'kulut-tayru mir ra'sih, qudiyal-amrul-ladhee feehi tastaftiyaan
Waqaala lilladhee zanna annahoo naajim minhumadhkurnee `inda rabbik, fa'ansaahush-shaytaanu dhikra rabbihee falabitha fis-sijni bid`a sineen
Waqaalal-maliku innee araa sab`a baqaraatin simaaniy ya'kuluhunna sab`un `ijaafuw wasab`a sumbulaatin khudriw wa'ukhara yaabisaat, yaa ayyuhal-mala'u aftoonee fee ru'yaaya in kuntum lir-ru'yaa ta`buroon
Qaaloo adghaathu ahlaam, wamaa nahnu bita'weelil-ahlaami bi`aalimeen
Waqaalal-ladhee najaa minhumaa waddakara ba`da ummatin ana unabbi'ukum bita'weelihee fa'arsiloon
Yoosufu ayyuhas-siddeequ aftinaa fee sab`i baqaraatin simaaniy ya'kuluhunna sab`un `ijaafuw wasab`i sumbulaatin khudriw wa'ukhara yaabisaatil la`allee arji`u ilan-naasi la`allahum ya`lamoon
Qaala tazra`oona sab`a sineena da'abaa, famaa hasattum fadharoohu fee sumbulihee illaa qaleelam mimmaa ta'kuloon
Thumma ya'tee mim ba`di dhaalika sab`un shidaaduy ya'kulna maa qaddamtum lahunna illaa qaleelam mimmaa tuhsinoon
Thumma ya'tee mim ba`di dhaalika `aamun feehi yughaathun-naasu wafeehi ya`siroon
Waqaalal-maliku'toonee bih, falammaa jaa'ahur-rasoolu qaalarji` ilaa rabbika fas'alhu maa baalun-niswatillaatee qatta`na aydiyahunn, inna rabbee bikaydihinna `aleem
Qaala maa khatbukunna idh raawattunna yoosufa `an nafsih, qulna haasha lillaahi maa `alimnaa `alayhi min soo', qaalatimra'atul-`azeezil-aana hashasal-haqq, ana raawattuhoo `an nafsihee wa'innahoo laminas-saadiqeen
Dhaalika liya`lama annee lam akhunhu bil-ghaybi wa'annallaaha laa yahdee kaydal-khaa'ineen
Wamaa ubarri'u nafsee, innan-nafsa la'ammaaratum bis-soo'i illaa maa rahima rabbee, inna rabbee ghafoorur raheem
Waqaalal-maliku'toonee bihee astakhlishu linafsee, falammaa kallamahoo qaala innakal-yawma ladaynaa makeenun ameen
Qaalaj`alnee `alaa khazaa'inil-ard, innee hafeezun `aleem
Wakadhaalika makkannaa liyoosufa fil-ardi yatabawwa'u minhaa haythu yashaa', nuseebu birahmatinaa man nashaa'u walaa nudee`u ajral-muhsineen
Wala'ajrul-aakhirati khayrul lilladheena aamanoo wakaanoo yattaqoon
Wajaa'a ikhwatu yoosufa fadakhaloo `alayhi fa`arafahum wahum lahoo munkiroon
Walammaa jahhazahum bijahaazihim qaala'toonee bi'akhil lakum min abeekum, alaa tarawna annee oofil-kayla wa'ana khayrul-munzileen
Fa'il lam ta'toonee bihee falaa kayla lakum `indee walaa taqraboon
Qaaloo sanuraawidu `anhu abaahu wa'innaa lafaa`iloon
Waqaala lifityaanihij`aloo bidaa`atahum fee rihaalihim la`allahum ya`rifoonahaa idhanqalaboo ilaa ahlihim la`allahum yarji`oon
Falammaa raja`oo ilaa abeehim qaaloo yaa abaanaa muni`a minnal-kaylu fa'arsil ma`anaa akhaanaa naktal wa'innaa lahoo lahaafizoon
Qaala hal aamanukum `alayhi illaa kamaa amintukum `alaa akheehi min qabl, fallaahu khayrun haafizaw wahuwa arhamur-raahimeen
Walammaa fatahoo mataa`ahum wajadoo bidaa`atahum ruddat ilayhim, qaaloo yaa abaanaa maa nabghee, haadhihee bidaa`atunaa ruddat ilaynaa wanameeru ahlanaa wanahfazu akhaanaa wanazdaadu kayla ba`eer, dhaalika kayluy yaseer
Qaala lan ursilahoo ma`akum hattaa tu'tooni mawthiqam minallaahi lata'tunnanee bihee illaa ay yuhaata bikum, falammaa aatawhu mawthiqahum qaalallaahu `alaa maa naqoolu wakeel
Waqaala yaabaniyya laa tadkhuloo mim baabiw waahidiw wadkhuloo min abwaabim mutafarriqah, wamaa ughnee `ankum minallaahi min shay', inil-hukmu illaa lillaah, `alayhi tawakkaltu wa`alayhi falyatawakkalil-mutawakkiloon
Walammaa dakhaloo min haythu amarahum aboohum, maa kaana yughnee `anhum minallaahi min shay'in illaa haajatan fee nafsi ya`qooba qadaahaa, wa'innahoo ladhoo `ilmil limaa `allamnaahu walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya`lamoon
Walammaa dakhaloo `alaa yoosufa aawaa ilayhi akhaahu qaala innee ana akhooka falaa tabta'is bimaa kaanoo ya`maloon
Falammaa jahhazahum bijahaazihim ja`alas-siqaayata fee rahli akheehi thumma adhdhana mu'adhdhinun ayyatuhal-`eeru innakum lasaariqoon
Qaaloo wa'aqbaloo `alayhim maadhaa tafqidoon
Qaaloo nafqidu suwaa`al-maliki waliman jaa'a bihee himlu ba`eeriw wa'ana bihee za`eem
Qaaloo tallaahi laqad `alimtum maa ji'naa linufsida fil-ardi wamaa kunnaa saariqeen
Qaaloo famaa jazaa'uhoo in kuntum kaadhibeen
Qaaloo jazaa'uhoo maw wujida fee rahlihee fahuwa jazaa'uh, kadhaalika najziz-zaalimeen
Fabada'a bi'aw`iyatihim qabla wi`aa'i akheehi thummastakhrajahaa miw wi`aa'i akheeh, kadhaalika kidnaa liyoosuf, maa kaana liya'khudha akhaahu fee deenil-maliki illaa ay yashaa'allaah, narfa`u darajaatim man nashaa', wafawqa kulli dhee `ilmin `aleem
Qaaloo iy yasriq faqad saraqa akhul lahoo min qabl, fa'asarrahaa yoosufu fee nafsihee walam yubdihaa lahum, qaala antum sharrum makaanaa, wallaahu a`lamu bimaa tasifoon
Qaaloo yaa ayyuhal-`azeezu inna lahoo aban shaykhan kabeeran fakhudh ahadanaa makaanah, innaa naraaka minal-muhsineen
Qaala ma`aadhallaahi an na'khudha illaa maw wajadnaa mataa`anaa `indahoo innaa idhal lazaalimoon
Falammastay'asoo minhu khalasoo najiyyaa, qaala kabeeruhum alam ta`lamoo anna abaakum qad akhadha `alaykum mawthiqam minallaahi wamin qablu maa farrattum fee yoosufa falan abrahal-arda hattaa ya'dhana lee abee aw yahkumallaahu lee, wahuwa khayrul-haakimeen
Irji`oo ilaa abeekum faqooloo yaa abaanaa innabnaka saraq, wamaa shahidnaa illaa bimaa `alimnaa wamaa kunnaa lil-ghaybi haafizeen
Was'alil-qaryatal-latee kunnaa feehaa wal-`eeral-latee aqbalnaa feehaa, wa'innaa lasaadiqoon
Qaala bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amraa, fasabrun jameel, `asallaahu ay ya'tiyanee bihim jamee`aa, innahoo huwal-`aleemul-hakeem
Watawallaa `anhum waqaala yaa asafaa `alaa yoosufa wabyaddat `aynaahu minal-huzni fahuwa kazeem
Qaaloo tallaahi tafta'u tadhkuru yoosufa hattaa takoona haradan aw takoona minal-haalikeen
Qaala innamaa ashkoo baththee wahuznee ilallaahi wa'a`lamu minallaahi maa laa ta`lamoon
Yaabaniyyadhhaboo fatahassasoo miy yoosufa wa'akheehi walaa tay'asoo mir rawhillaah, innahoo laa yay'asu mir rawhillaahi illal-qawmul-kaafiroon
Falammaa dakhaloo `alayhi qaaloo yaa ayyuhal-`azeezu massanaa wa'ahlanad-durru waji'naa bibidaa`atim muzjaatin fa'awfi lanal-kayla watasaddaq `alaynaa, innallaaha yajzil-mutasaddiqeen
Qaala hal `alimtum maa fa`altum biyoosufa wa'akheehi idh antum jaahiloon
Qaaloo a'innaka la'anta yoosuf, qaala ana yoosufu wahaadhaa akhee qad mannallaahu `alaynaa, innahoo may yattaqi wayasbir fa'innallaaha laa yudee`u ajral-muhsineen
Qaaloo tallaahi laqad aatharakallaahu `alaynaa wa'in kunnaa lakhaati'een
Qaala laa tathreeba `alaykumul-yawm, yaghfirullaahu lakum, wahuwa arhamur-raahimeen
Idhhaboo biqameesee haadhaa fa'alqoohu `alaa wajhi abee ya'ti baseeraa, wa'toonee bi'ahlikum ajma`een
Walammaa fasalatil-`eeru qaala aboohum innee la'ajidu reeha yoosufa lawlaa an tufannidoon
Qaaloo tallaahi innaka lafee dalaalikal-qadeem
Falammaa an jaa'al-basheeru alqaahu `alaa wajhihee fartadda baseeraa, qaala alam aqul lakum innee a`lamu minallaahi maa laa ta`lamoon
Qaaloo yaa abaanastaghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa innaa kunnaa khaati'een
Qaala sawfa astaghfiru lakum rabbee, innahoo huwal-ghafoorur-raheem
Falammaa dakhaloo `alaa yoosufa aawaa ilayhi abawayhi waqaaladkhuloo misra in shaa'allaahu aamineen
Warafa`a abawayhi `alal-`arshi wakharroo lahoo sujjadaa, waqaala yaa abati haadhaa ta'weelu ru'yaaya min qabl, qad ja`alahaa rabbee haqqaa, waqad ahsana bee idh akhrajanee minas-sijni wajaa'a bikum minal-badwi mim ba`di an nazaghash-shaytaanu baynee wabayna ikhwatee, inna rabbee lateeful limaa yashaa', innahoo huwal-`aleemul-hakeem
Rabbi qad aataytanee minal-mulki wa`allamtanee min ta'weelil-ahaadeeth, faatiras-samaawaati wal-ard, anta waliyyee fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, tawaffanee muslimaw wa'alhiqnee bis-saaliheen
Dhaalika min ambaa'il-ghaybi nooheehi ilayk, wamaa kunta ladayhim idh ajma`oo amrahum wahum yamkuroon
Wamaa aktharun-naasi walaw harasta bimu'mineen
Wamaa tas'aluhum `alayhi min ajr, in huwa illaa dhikrul lil-`aalameen
Waka'ayyim min aayatin fis-samaawaati wal-ardi yamurroona `alayhaa wahum `anhaa mu`ridoon
Wamaa yu'minu aktharuhum billaahi illaa wahum mushrikoon
Afa'aminoo an ta'tiyahum ghaashiyatum min `adhaabillaahi aw ta'tiyahumus-saa`atu baghtataw wahum laa yash`uroon
Qul haadhihee sabeelee ad`oo ilallaah, `alaa baseeratin ana wamanittaba`anee, wasubhaanallaahi wamaa ana minal-mushrikeen
Wamaa arsalnaa min qablika illaa rijaalan noohee ilayhim min ahlil-quraa, afalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fayanzuroo kayfa kaana `aaqibatul-ladheena min qablihim, waladaarul-aakhirati khayrul lilladheenattaqaw, afalaa ta`qiloon
Hattaa idhastay'asar-rusulu wazannoo annahum qad kudhiboo jaa'ahum nasrunaa fanujjiya man nashaa', walaa yuraddu ba'sunaa `anil-qawmil-mujrimeen
Laqad kaana fee qasasihim `ibratul li'ulil-albaab, maa kaana hadeethay yuftaraa walaakin tasdeeqal-ladhee bayna yadayhi watafseela kulli shay'iw wahudaw warahmatal liqawmiy yu'minoon

Alif laam meem raa, tilka aayaatul-kitaab, wal-ladhee unzila ilayka mir rabbikal-haqqu walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa yu'minoon
Allaahul-ladhee rafa`as-samaawaati bighayri `amadin tarawnahaa thummastawaa `alal-`arshi wasakhkharash-shamsa wal-qamar, kulluy yajree li'ajalim musammaa, yudabbirul-amra yufassilul-aayaati la`allakum biliqaa'i rabbikum tooqinoon
Wahuwal-ladhee maddal-arda waja`ala feehaa rawaasiya wa'anhaaraa, wamin kullith-thamaraati ja`ala feehaa zawjaynithnayni yughshil-laylan-nahaar, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy yatafakkaroon
Wafil-ardi qita`um mutajaawiraatuw wajannaatum min a`naabiw wazar`uw wanakheelun sinwaanuw waghayru sinwaaniy yusqaa bimaa'iw waahidiw wanufaddilu ba`dahaa `alaa ba`din fil-ukul, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy ya`qiloon
Wa'in ta`jab fa`ajabun qawluhum a'idhaa kunnaa turaaban a'innaa lafee khalqin jadeed, ulaa'ikal-ladheena kafaroo birabbihim, wa'ulaa'ikal-aghlaalu fee a`naaqihim, wa'ulaa'ika ashaabun-naar, hum feehaa khaalidoon
Wayasta`jiloonaka bis-sayyi'ati qablal-hasanati waqad khalat min qablihimul-mathulaat, wa'inna rabbaka ladhoo maghfiratil lin-naasi `alaa zulmihim, wa'inna rabbaka lashadeedul-`iqaab
Wayaqoolul-ladheena kafaroo lawlaa unzila `alayhi aayatum mir rabbih, innamaa anta mundhiruw walikulli qawmin haad
Allaahu ya`lamu maa tahmilu kullu unthaa wamaa tagheedul-arhaamu wamaa tazdaad, wakullu shay'in `indahoo bimiqdaar
`Aalimul-ghaybi wash-shahaadatil-kabeerul-muta`aal
Sawaa'um minkum man asarral-qawla waman jahara bihee waman huwa mustakhfim bil-layli wasaaribum bin-nahaar
Lahoo mu`aqqibaatum mim bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihee yahfazoonahoo min amrillaah, innallaaha laa yughayyiru maa biqawmin hattaa yughayyiroo maa bi'anfusihim, wa'idhaa araadallaahu biqawmin soo'an falaa maradda lah, wamaa lahum min doonihee miw waal
Huwal-ladhee yureekumul-barqa khawfaw watama`aw wayunshi'us-sahaabath-thiqaal
Wayusabbihur-ra`du bihamdihee wal-malaa'ikatu min kheefatih, wayursilus-sawaa`iqa fayuseebu bihaa may yashaa'u wahum yujaadiloona fillaah, wahuwa shadeedul-mihaal
Lahoo da`watul-haqq, wal-ladheena yad`oona min doonihee laa yastajeeboona lahum bishay'in illaa kabaasiti kaffayhi ilal-maa'i liyablugha faahu wamaa huwa bibaalighih, wamaa du`aa'ul-kaafireena illaa fee dalaal
Walillaahi yasjudu man fis-samaawaati wal-ardi taw`aw wakarhaw wazilaaluhum bil-ghuduwwi wal-aasaal
Qul mar rabbus-samaawaati wal-ard, qulillaah, qul afattakhadhtum min doonihee awliyaa'a laa yamlikoona li'anfusihim naf`aw walaa darraa, qul hal yastawil-a`maa wal-baseeru am hal tastawiz-zulumaatu wan-noor, am ja`aloo lillaahi shurakaa'a khalaqoo kakhalqihee fatashaabahal-khalqu `alayhim, qulillaahu khaaliqu kulli shay'iw wahuwal-waahidul-qahhaar
Anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fasaalat awdiyatum biqadarihaa fahtamalas-saylu zabadar raabiyaa, wamimmaa yooqidoona `alayhi fin-naaribtighaa'a hilyatin aw mataa`in zabadum mithluh, kadhaalika yadribullaahul-haqqa wal-baatil, fa'ammaz-zabadu fayadhhabu jufaa'aa, wa'ammaa maa yanfa`un-naasa fayamkuthu fil-ard, kadhaalika yadribullaahul-amthaal
Lilladheenastajaaboo lirabbihimul-husnaa, wal-ladheena lam yastajeeboo lahoo law anna lahum maa fil-ardi jamee`aw wamithlahoo ma`ahoo laftadaw bih, ulaa'ika lahum soo'ul-hisaabi wama'waahum jahannam, wabi'sal-mihaad
Afamay ya`lamu annamaa unzila ilayka mir rabbikal-haqqu kaman huwa a`maa, innamaa yatadhakkaru ulul-albaab
Al-ladheena yoofoona bi`ahdillaahi walaa yanqudoonal-meethaaq
Wal-ladheena yasiloona maa amarallaahu bihee ay yoosala wayakhshawna rabbahum wayakhaafoona soo'al-hisaab
Wal-ladheena sabarubtighaa'a wajhi rabbihim wa'aqaamus-salaata wa'anfaqoo mimmaa razaqnaahum sirraw wa`alaaniyataw wayadra'oona bil-hasanatis-sayyi'ata ulaa'ika lahum `uqbad-daar
Jannaatu `adniy yadkhuloonahaa waman salaha min aabaa'ihim wa'azwaajihim wadhurriyyaatihim wal-malaa'ikatu yadkhuloona `alayhim min kulli baab
Salaamun `alaykum bimaa sabartum fani`ma `uqbad-daar
Wal-ladheena yanqudoona `ahdallaahi mim ba`di meethaaqihee wayaqta`oona maa amarallaahu bihee ay yoosala wayufsidoona fil-ardi ulaa'ika lahumul-la`natu walahum soo'ud-daar
Allaahu yabsutur-rizqa limay yashaa'u wayaqdir, wafarihoo bil-hayaatid-dunyaa, wamal-hayaatud-dunyaa fil-aakhirati illaa mataa`
Wayaqoolul-ladheena kafaroo lawlaa unzila `alayhi aayatum mir rabbih, qul innallaaha yudillu may yashaa'u wayahdee ilayhi man anaab
Al-ladheena aamanoo watatma'innu quloobuhum bidhikrillaah, alaa bidhikrillaahi tatma'innul-quloob
Alladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati toobaa lahum wahusnu ma'aab
Kadhaalika arsalnaaka fee ummatin qad khalat min qablihaa umamul litatluwa `alayhimul-ladhee awhaynaa ilayka wahum yakfuroona bir-rahmaan, qul huwa rabbee laa ilaaha illaa huw, `alayhi tawakkaltu wa'ilayhi mataab
Walaw anna qur'aanan suyyirat bihil-jibaalu aw qutti`at bihil-ardu aw kullima bihil-mawtaa, bal lillaahil-amru jamee`aa, afalam yay'asil-ladheena aamanoo al law yashaa'ullaahu lahadan-naasa jamee`aa, walaa yazaalul-ladheena kafaroo tuseebuhum bimaa sana`oo qaari`atun aw tahullu qareebam min daarihim hattaa ya'tiya wa`dullaah, innallaaha laa yukhliful-mee`aad
Walaqadistuhzi'a birusulim min qablika fa'amlaytu lilladheena kafaroo thumma akhadhtuhum fakayfa kaana `iqaab
Afaman huwa qaa'imun `alaa kulli nafsim bimaa kasabat, waja`aloo lillaahi shurakaa', qul sammoohum, am tunabbi'oonahoo bimaa laa ya`lamu fil-ardi am bizaahirim minal-qawl, bal zuyyina lilladheena kafaroo makruhum wasuddoo `anis-sabeel, wamay yudlilillaahu famaa lahoo min haad
Lahum `adhaabun fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wala`adhaabul-aakhirati ashaqq, wamaa lahum minallaahi miw waaq
Mathalul-jannatil-latee wu`idal-muttaqoon, tajree min tahtihal-anhaar, ukuluhaa daa'imuw wazilluhaa, tilka `uqbal-ladheenattaqaw, wa`uqbal-kaafireenan-naar
Wal-ladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba yafrahoona bimaa unzila ilayka waminal-ahzaabi may yunkiru ba`dah, qul innamaa umirtu an a`budallaaha walaa ushrika bih, ilayhi ad`oo wa'ilayhi ma'aab
Wakadhaalika anzalnaahu hukman `arabiyyaa, wala'inittaba`ta ahwaa'ahum ba`da maa jaa'aka minal-`ilmi maa laka minallaahi miw waliyyiw walaa waaq
Walaqad arsalnaa rusulam min qablika waja`alnaa lahum azwaajaw wadhurriyyah, wamaa kaana lirasoolin ay ya'tiya bi'aayatin illaa bi'idhnillaah, likulli ajalin kitaab
Yamhullaahu maa yashaa'u wayuthbit, wa`indahoo ummul-kitaab
Wa'im maa nuriyannaka ba`dal-ladhee na`iduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa'innamaa `alaykal-balaaghu wa`alaynal-hisaab
Awalam yaraw annaa na'til-arda nanqusuhaa min atraafihaa, wallaahu yahkumu laa mu`aqqiba lihukmih, wahuwa saree`ul-hisaab
Waqad makaral-ladheena min qablihim falillaahil-makru jamee`aa, ya`lamu maa taksibu kullu nafs, wasaya`lamul-kuffaaru liman `uqbad-daar
Wayaqoolul-ladheena kafaroo lasta mursalaa, qul kafaa billaahi shaheedam baynee wabaynakum waman `indahoo `ilmul-kitaab

Alif laam raa, kitaabun anzalnaahu ilayka litukhrijan-naasa minaz-zulumaati ilan-noori bi'idhni rabbihim ilaa siraatil-`azeezil-hameed
Allaahil-ladhee lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wawaylul lil-kaafireena min `adhaabin shadeed
Al-ladheena yastahibboonal-hayaatad-dunyaa `alal-aakhirati wayasuddoona `an sabeelillaahi wayabghoonahaa `iwajaa, ulaa'ika fee dalaalim ba`eed
Wamaa arsalnaa mir rasoolin illaa bilisaani qawmihee liyubayyina lahum, fayudillullaahu may yashaa'u wayahdee may yashaa', wahuwal-`azeezul-hakeem
Walaqad arsalnaa moosaa bi'aayaatinaa an akhrij qawmaka minaz-zulumaati ilan-noori wadhakkirhum bi'ayyaamillaah, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil likulli sabbaarin shakoor
Wa'idh qaala moosaa liqawmihidhkuroo ni`matallaahi `alaykum idh anjaakum min aali fir`awna yasoomoonakum soo'al-`adhaabi wayudhabbihoona abnaa'akum wayastahyoona nisaa'akum, wafee dhaalikum balaa'um mir rabbikum `azeem
Wa'idh ta'adhdhana rabbukum la'in shakartum la'azeedannakum wala'in kafartum inna `adhaabee lashadeed
Waqaala moosaa in takfuroo antum waman fil-ardi jamee`an fa'innallaaha laghaniyyun hameed
Alam ya'tikum naba'ul-ladheena min qablikum qawmi noohiw wa`aadiw wathamood, wal-ladheena mim ba`dihim, laa ya`lamuhum illallaah, jaa'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati faraddoo aydiyahum fee afwaahihim waqaaloo innaa kafarnaa bimaa ursiltum bihee wa'innaa lafee shakkim mimmaa tad`oonanaa ilayhi mureeb
Qaalat rusuluhum afillaahi shakkun faatiris-samaawaati wal-ard, yad`ookum liyaghfira lakum min dhunoobikum wayu'akhkhirakum ilaa ajalim musammaa, qaaloo in antum illaa basharum mithlunaa, tureedoona an tasuddoonaa `ammaa kaana ya`budu aabaa'unaa fa'toonaa bisultaanim mubeen
Qaalat lahum rusuluhum in nahnu illaa basharum mithlukum walaakinnallaaha yamunnu `alaa may yashaa'u min `ibaadih, wamaa kaana lanaa an na'tiyakum bisultaanin illaa bi'idhnillaah, wa`alallaahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minoon
Wamaa lanaa allaa natawakkala `alallaahi waqad hadaanaa subulanaa, walanasbiranna `alaa maa aadhaytumoonaa, wa`alallaahi falyatawakkalil-mutawakkiloon
Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo lirusulihim lanukhrijannakum min ardinaa aw lata`oodunna fee millatinaa, fa'awhaa ilayhim rabbuhum lanuhlikannaz-zaalimeen
Walanuskinannakumul-arda mim ba`dihim, dhaalika liman khaafa maqaamee wakhaafa wa`eed
Wastaftahoo wakhaaba kullu jabbaarin `aneed
Miw waraa'ihee jahannamu wayusqaa mim maa'in sadeed
Yatajarra`uhoo walaa yakaadu yuseeghuhoo waya'teehil-mawtu min kulli makaaniw wamaa huwa bimayyit, wamiw waraa'ihee `adhaabun ghaleez
Mathalul-ladheena kafaroo birabbihim a`maaluhum karamaadinishtaddat bihir-reehu fee yawmin `aasif, laa yaqdiroona mimmaa kasaboo `alaa shay', dhaalika huwad-dalaalul-ba`eed
Alam tara annallaaha khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqq, iy yasha' yudhhibkum waya'ti bikhalqin jadeed
Wamaa dhaalika `alallaahi bi`azeez
Wabarazoo lillaahi jamee`an faqaalad-du`afaa'u lilladheenastakbaroo innaa kunnaa lakum taba`an fahal antum mughnoona `annaa min `adhaabillaahi min shay', qaaloo law hadaanallaahu lahadaynaakum, sawaa'un `alaynaa ajazi`naa am sabarnaa maa lanaa mim mahees
Waqaalash-shaytaanu lammaa qudiyal-amru innallaaha wa`adakum wa`dal-haqqi wawa`attukum fa'akhlaftukum, wamaa kaana liya `alaykum min sultaanin illaa an da`awtukum fastajabtum lee, falaa taloomoonee waloomoo anfusakum, maa ana bimusrikhikum wamaa antum bimusrikhiyy, innee kafartu bimaa ashraktumooni min qabl, innaz-zaalimeena lahum `adhaabun aleem
Wa'udkhilal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa bi'idhni rabbihim, tahiyyatuhum feehaa salaam
Alam tara kayfa daraballaahu mathalan kalimatan tayyibatan kashajaratin tayyibatin asluhaa thaabituw wafar`uhaa fis-samaa'
Tu'tee ukulahaa kulla heenim bi'idhni rabbihaa, wayadribullaahul-amthaala lin-naasi la`allahum yatadhakkaroon
Wamathalu kalimatin khabeethatin kashajaratin khabeethatinijtuththat min fawqil-ardi maa lahaa min qaraar
Yuthabbitullaahul-ladheena aamanoo bil-qawlith-thaabiti fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wafil-aakhirah, wayudillullaahuz-zaalimeen, wayaf`alullaahu maa yashaa'
Alam tara ilal-ladheena baddaloo ni`matallaahi kufraw wa'ahalloo qawmahum daaral-bawaar
Jahannam, yaslawnahaa, wabi'sal-qaraar
Waja`aloo lillaahi andaadal liyudilloo `an sabeelih, qul tamatta`oo fa'inna maseerakum ilan-naar
Qul li`ibaadiyal-ladheena aamanoo yuqeemus-salaata wayunfiqoo mimmaa razaqnaahum sirraw wa`alaaniyatam min qabli ay ya'tiya yawmul laa bay`un feehi walaa khilaal
Allaahul-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda wa'anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fa'akhraja bihee minath-thamaraati rizqal lakum, wasakhkhara lakumul-fulka litajriya fil-bahri bi'amrih, wasakhkhara lakumul-anhaar
Wasakhkhara lakumush-shamsa wal-qamara daa'ibayn, wasakhkhara lakumul-layla wan-nahaar
Wa'aataakum min kulli maa sa'altumooh, wa'in ta`uddoo ni`matallaahi laa tuhsoohaa, innal-insaana lazaloomun kaffaar
Wa'idh qaala ibraaheemu rabbij`al haadhal-balada aaminaw wajnubnee wabaniyya an na`budal-asnaam
Rabbi innahunna adlalna katheeram minan-naas, faman tabi`anee fa'innahoo minnee, waman `asaanee fa'innaka ghafoorur raheem
Rabbanaa innee askantu min dhurriyyatee biwaadin ghayri dhee zar`in `inda baytikal-muharrami rabbanaa liyuqeemus-salaata faj`al af'idatam minan-naasi tahwee ilayhim warzuqhum minath-thamaraati la`allahum yashkuroon
Rabbanaa innaka ta`lamu maa nukhfee wamaa nu`lin, wamaa yakhfaa `alallaahi min shay'in fil-ardi walaa fis-samaa'
Al-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee wahaba lee `alal-kibari ismaa`eela wa'ishaaq, inna rabbee lasamee`ud-du`aa'
Rabbij`alnee muqeemas-salaati wamin dhurriyyatee, rabbanaa wataqabbal du`aa'
Rabbanaghfir lee waliwaalidayya walilmu'mineena yawma yaqoomul-hisaab
Walaa tahsabannallaaha ghaafilan `ammaa ya`maluz-zaalimoon, innamaa yu'akhkhiruhum liyawmin tashkhasu feehil-absaar
Muhti`eena muqni`ee ru'oosihim laa yartaddu ilayhim tarfuhum, wa'af'idatuhum hawaa'
Wa'andhirin-naasa yawma ya'teehimul-`adhaabu fayaqoolul-ladheena zalamoo rabbanaa akhkhirnaa ilaa ajalin qareebin nujib da`wataka wanattabi`ir-rusul, awalam takoonoo aqsamtum min qablu maa lakum min zawaal
Wasakantum fee masaakinil-ladheena zalamoo anfusahum watabayyana lakum kayfa fa`alnaa bihim wadarabnaa lakumul-amthaal
Waqad makaroo makrahum wa`indallaahi makruhum, wa'in kaana makruhum litazoola minhul-jibaal
Falaa tahsabannallaaha mukhlifa wa`dihee rusulah, innallaaha `azeezun dhuntiqaam
Yawma tubaddalul-ardu ghayral-ardi was-samaawaatu wabarazoo lillaahil-waahidil-qahhaar
Wataral-mujrimeena yawma'idhim muqarraneena fil-asfaad
Saraabeeluhum min qatiraaniw wataghshaa wujoohahumun-naar
Liyajziyallaahu kulla nafsim maa kasabat, innallaaha saree`ul-hisaab
Haadhaa balaaghul lin-naasi waliyundharoo bihee waliya`lamoo annamaa huwa ilaahuw waahiduw waliyadhdhakkara ulul-albaab

Alif laam raa, tilka aayaatul-kitaabi waqur'aanim mubeen
Rubamaa yawaddul-ladheena kafaroo law kaanoo muslimeen
Dharhum ya'kuloo wayatamatta`oo wayulhihimul-amalu fasawfa ya`lamoon
Wamaa ahlaknaa min qaryatin illaa walahaa kitaabum ma`loom
Maa tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahaa wamaa yasta'khiroon
Waqaaloo yaa ayyuhal-ladhee nuzzila `alayhidh-dhikru innaka lamajnoon
Lawmaa ta'teenaa bil-malaa'ikati in kunta minas-saadiqeen
Maa nunazzilul-malaa'ikata illaa bil-haqqi wamaa kaanoo idham munzareen
Innaa nahnu nazzalnadh-dhikra wa'innaa lahoo lahaafizoon
Walaqad arsalnaa min qablika fee shiya`il-awwaleen
Wamaa ya'teehim mir rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
Kadhaalika naslukuhoo fee quloobil-mujrimeen
Laa yu'minoona bihee waqad khalat sunnatul-awwaleen
Walaw fatahnaa `alayhim baabam minas-samaa'i fazalloo feehi ya`rujoon
Laqaaloo innamaa sukkirat absaarunaa bal nahnu qawmum mashooroon
Walaqad ja`alnaa fis-samaa'i buroojaw wazayyannaahaa lin-naazireen
Wahafiznaahaa min kulli shaytaanir rajeem
Illaa manistaraqas-sam`a fa'atba`ahoo shihaabum mubeen
Wal-arda madadnaahaa wa'alqaynaa feehaa rawaasiya wa'ambatnaa feehaa min kulli shay'im mawzoon
Waja`alnaa lakum feehaa ma`aayisha wamal lastum lahoo biraaziqeen
Wa'im min shay'in illaa `indanaa khazaa'inuhoo wamaa nunazziluhoo illaa biqadarim ma`loom
Wa'arsalnar-riyaaha lawaaqiha fa'anzalnaa minas-samaa'i maa'an fa'asqaynaakumooh, wamaa antum lahoo bikhaazineen
Wa'innaa lanahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wanahnul-waarithoon
Walaqad `alimnal-mustaqdimeena minkum walaqad `alimnal-musta'khireen
Wa'inna rabbaka huwa yahshuruhum, innahoo hakeemun `aleem
Walaqad khalaqnal-insaana min salsaalim min hama'im masnoon
Wal-jaanna khalaqnaahu min qablu min naaris-samoom
Wa'idh qaala rabbuka lil-malaa'ikati innee khaaliqum basharam min salsaalim min hama'im masnoon
Fa'idhaa sawwaytuhoo wanafakhtu feehi mir roohee faqa`oo lahoo saajideen
Fasajadal-malaa'ikatu kulluhum ajma`oon
Illaa iblees, abaa ay yakoona ma`as-saajideen
Qaala yaa ibleesu maa laka allaa takoona ma`as-saajideen
Qaala lam akul li'asjuda libasharin khalaqtahoo min salsaalim min hama'im masnoon
Qaala fakhruj minhaa fa'innaka rajeem
Wa'inna `alaykal-la`nata ilaa yawmid-deen
Qaala rabbi fa'anzirnee ilaa yawmi yub`athoon
Qaala fa'innaka minal-munzareen
Ilaa yawmil-waqtil-ma`loom
Qaala rabbi bimaa aghwaytanee la'uzayyinanna lahum fil-ardi wala'ughwiyannahum ajma`een
Illaa `ibaadaka minhumul-mukhlaseen
Qaala haadhaa siraatun `alayya mustaqeem
Inna `ibaadee laysa laka `alayhim sultaanun illaa manittaba`aka minal-ghaaween
Wa'inna jahannama lamaw`iduhum ajma`een
Lahaa sab`atu abwaab, likulli baabim minhum juz'um maqsoom
Innal-muttaqeena fee jannaatiw wa`uyoon
Udkhuloohaa bisalaamin aamineen
Wanaza`naa maa fee sudoorihim min ghillin ikhwaanan `alaa sururim mutaqaabileen
Laa yamassuhum feehaa nasabuw wamaa hum minhaa bimukhrajeen
Nabbi' `ibaadee annee anal-ghafoorur-raheem
Wa'anna `adhaabee huwal-`adhaabul-aleem
Wanabbi'hum `an dayfi ibraaheem
Idh dakhaloo `alayhi faqaaloo salaamaa, qaala innaa minkum wajiloon
Qaaloo laa tawjal innaa nubashshiruka bighulaamin `aleem
Qaala abashshartumoonee `alaa am massaniyal-kibaru fabima tubashshiroon
Qaaloo bashsharnaaka bil-haqqi falaa takum minal-qaaniteen
Qaala wamay yaqnatu mir rahmati rabbihee illad-daalloon
Qaala famaa khatbukum ayyuhal-mursaloon
Qaaloo innaa ursilnaa ilaa qawmim mujrimeen
Illaa aala loot, innaa lamunajjoohum ajma`een
Illamra'atahoo qaddarnaa innahaa laminal-ghaabireen
Falammaa jaa'a aala lootinil-mursaloon
Qaala innakum qawmum munkaroon
Qaaloo bal ji'naaka bimaa kaanoo feehi yamtaroon
Wa'ataynaaka bil-haqqi wa'innaa lasaadiqoon
Fa'asri bi'ahlika biqit`im minal-layli wattabi` adbaarahum walaa yaltafit minkum ahaduw wamdoo haythu tu'maroon
Waqadaynaa ilayhi dhaalikal-amra anna daabira haa'ulaa'i maqtoo`um musbiheen
Wajaa'a ahlul-madeenati yastabshiroon
Qaala inna haa'ulaa'i dayfee falaa tafdahoon
Wattaqullaaha walaa tukhzoon
Qaaloo awalam nanhaka `anil-`aalameen
Qaala haa'ulaa'i banaatee in kuntum faa`ileen
La`amruka innahum lafee sakratihim ya`mahoon
Fa'akhadhathumus-sayhatu mushriqeen
Faja`alnaa `aaliyahaa saafilahaa wa'amtarnaa `alayhim hijaaratam min sijjeel
Inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil lil-mutawassimeen
Wa'innahaa labisabeelim muqeem
Inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal lil-mu'mineen
Wa'in kaana ashaabul-aykati lazaalimeen
Fantaqamnaa minhum, wa'innahumaa labi'imaamim mubeen
Walaqad kadhdhaba ashaabul-hijril-mursaleen
Wa'aataynaahum aayaatinaa fakaanoo `anhaa mu`rideen
Wakaanoo yanhitoona minal-jibaali buyootan aamineen
Fa'akhadhathumus-sayhatu musbiheen
Famaa aghnaa `anhum maa kaanoo yaksiboon
Wamaa khalaqnas-samaawaati wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa illaa bil-haqq, wa'innas-saa`ata la'aatiyatun fasfahis-safhal-jameel
Inna rabbaka huwal-khallaaqul-`aleem
Walaqad aataynaaka sab`am minal-mathaanee wal-qur'aanal-`azeem
Laa tamuddanna `aynayka ilaa maa matta`naa bihee azwaajam minhum walaa tahzan `alayhim wakhfid janaahaka lil-mu'mineen
Waqul innee anan-nadheerul-mubeen
Kamaa anzalnaa `alal-muqtasimeen
Al-ladheena ja`alul-qur'aana `ideen
Fawarabbika lanas'alannahum ajma`een
`Ammaa kaanoo ya`maloon
Fasda` bimaa tu'maru wa'a`rid `anil-mushrikeen
Innaa kafaynaakal-mustahzi'een
Al-ladheena yaj`aloona ma`allaahi ilaahan aakhar, fasawfa ya`lamoon
Walaqad na`lamu annaka yadeequ sadruka bimaa yaqooloon
Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wakum minas-saajideen
Wa`bud rabbaka hattaa ya'tiyakal-yaqeen

Ataa amrullaahi falaa tasta`jilooh, subhaanahoo wata`aalaa `ammaa yushrikoon
Yunazzilul-malaa'ikata bir-roohi min amrihee `alaa may yashaa'u min `ibaadihee an andhiroo annahoo laa ilaaha illaa ana fattaqoon
Khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqq, ta`aalaa `ammaa yushrikoon
Khalaqal-insaana min nutfatin fa'idhaa huwa khaseemum mubeen
Wal-an`aama khalaqahaa lakum feehaa dif'uw wamanaafi`u waminhaa ta'kuloon
Walakum feehaa jamaalun heena tureehoona waheena tasrahoon
Watahmilu athqaalakum ilaa baladil lam takoonoo baaligheehi illaa bishiqqil-anfus, inna rabbakum lara'oofur raheem
Wal-khayla wal-bighaala wal-hameera litarkaboohaa wazeenah, wayakhluqu maa laa ta`lamoon
Wa`alallaahi qasdus-sabeeli waminhaa jaa'ir, walaw shaa'a lahadaakum ajma`een
Huwal-ladhee anzala minas-samaa'i maa'al lakum minhu sharaabuw waminhu shajarun feehi tuseemoon
Yumbitu lakum bihiz-zar`a waz-zaytoona wan-nakheela wal-a`naaba wamin kullith-thamaraat, inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal liqawmiy yatafakkaroon
Wasakhkhara lakumul-layla wan-nahaara wash-shamsa wal-qamar, wan-nujoomu musakhkharaatum bi'amrih, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy ya`qiloon
Wamaa dhara'a lakum fil-ardi mukhtalifan alwaanuh, inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal liqawmiy yadhdhakkaroon
Wahuwal-ladhee sakhkharal-bahra lita'kuloo minhu lahman tariyyaw watastakhrijoo minhu hilyatan talbasoonahaa, wataral-fulka mawaakhira feehi walitabtaghoo min fadlihee wala`allakum tashkuroon
Wa'alqaa fil-ardi rawaasiya an tameeda bikum wa'anhaaraw wasubulal la`allakum tahtadoon
Wa`alaamaat, wabin-najmi hum yahtadoon
Afamay yakhluqu kamal laa yakhluq, afalaa tadhakkaroon
Wa'in ta`uddoo ni`matallaahi laa tuhsoohaa, innallaaha laghafoorur raheem
Wallaahu ya`lamu maa tusirroona wamaa tu`linoon
Wal-ladheena yad`oona min doonillaahi laa yakhluqoona shay'aw wahum yukhlaqoon
Amwaatun ghayru ahyaa', wamaa yash`uroona ayyaana yub`athoon
Ilaahukum ilaahuw waahid, fal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati quloobuhum munkiratuw wahum mustakbiroon
Laa jarama annallaaha ya`lamu maa yusirroona wamaa yu`linoon, innahoo laa yuhibbul-mustakbireen
Wa'idhaa qeela lahum maadhaa anzala rabbukum qaaloo asaateerul-awwaleen
Liyahmiloo awzaarahum kaamilatay yawmal-qiyaamati wamin awzaaril-ladheena yudilloonahum bighayri `ilm, alaa saa'a maa yaziroon
Qad makaral-ladheena min qablihim fa'atallaahu bunyaanahum minal-qawaa`idi fakharra `alayhimus-saqfu min fawqihim wa'ataahumul-`adhaabu min haythu laa yash`uroon
Thumma yawmal-qiyaamati yukhzeehim wayaqoolu ayna shurakaa'iyal-ladheena kuntum tushaaqqoona feehim, qaalal-ladheena ootul-`ilma innal-khizyal-yawma was-soo'a `alal-kaafireen
Al-ladheena tatawaffaahumul-malaa'ikatu zaalimee anfusihim, fa'alqawus-salama maa kunnaa na`malu min soo', balaa innallaaha `aleemum bimaa kuntum ta`maloon
Fadkhuloo abwaaba jahannama khaalideena feehaa, falabi'sa mathwal-mutakabbireen
Waqeela lilladheenattaqaw maadhaa anzala rabbukum, qaaloo khayraa, lilladheena ahsanoo fee haadhihid-dunyaa hasanah, waladaarul-aakhirati khayr, walani`ma daarul-muttaqeen
Jannaatu `adniy yadkhuloonahaa tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru lahum feehaa maa yashaa'oon, kadhaalika yajzillaahul-muttaqeen
Al-ladheena tatawaffaahumul-malaa'ikatu tayyibeena yaqooloona salaamun `alaykumudkhulul-jannata bimaa kuntum ta`maloon
Hal yanzuroona illaa an ta'tiyahumul-malaa'ikatu aw ya'tiya amru rabbik, kadhaalika fa`alal-ladheena min qablihim, wamaa zalamahumullaahu walaakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
Fa'asaabahum sayyi'aatu maa `amiloo wahaaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
Waqaalal-ladheena ashrakoo law shaa'allaahu maa `abadnaa min doonihee min shay'in nahnu walaa aabaa'unaa walaa harramnaa min doonihee min shay', kadhaalika fa`alal-ladheena min qablihim, fahal `alar-rusuli illal-balaaghul-mubeen
