Wamaa mana`anaa an nursila bil-aayaati illaa an kadhdhaba bihal-awwaloon, wa'aataynaa thamoodan-naaqata mubsiratan fazalamoo bihaa, wamaa nursilu bil-aayaati illaa takhweefaa
Wa'idh qulnaa laka inna rabbaka ahaata bin-naas, wamaa ja`alnar-ru'yal-latee araynaaka illaa fitnatal lin-naasi wash-shajaratal-mal`oonata fil-qur'aan, wanukhawwifuhum famaa yazeeduhum illaa tughyaanan kabeeraa
Wa'idh qulnaa lil-malaa'ikatisjudoo li'aadama fasajadoo illaa iblees, qaala a'asjudu liman khalaqta teenaa
Qaala ara'aytaka haadhal-ladhee karramta `alayya la'in akhkhartani ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati la'ahtanikanna dhurriyyatahoo illaa qaleelaa
Qaaladhhab faman tabi`aka minhum fa'inna jahannama jazaa'ukum jazaa'am mawfooraa
Wastafziz manistata`ta minhum bisawtika wa'ajlib `alayhim bikhaylika warajilika washaarikhum fil-amwaali wal-awlaadi wa`idhum, wamaa ya`iduhumush-shaytaanu illaa ghurooraa
Inna `ibaadee laysa laka `alayhim sultaan, wakafaa birabbika wakeelaa
Rabbukumul-ladhee yuzjee lakumul-fulka fil-bahri litabtaghoo min fadlih, innahoo kaana bikum raheemaa
Wa'idhaa massakumud-durru fil-bahri dalla man tad`oona illaa iyyaah, falammaa najjaakum ilal-barri a`radtum, wakaanal-insaanu kafooraa
Afa'amintum ay yakhsifa bikum jaanibal-barri aw yursila `alaykum haasiban thumma laa tajidoo lakum wakeelaa
Am amintum ay yu`eedakum feehi taaratan ukhraa fayursila `alaykum qaasifam minar-reehi fayughriqakum bimaa kafartum thumma laa tajidoo lakum `alaynaa bihee tabee`aa
Walaqad karramnaa banee aadama wahamalnaahum fil-barri wal-bahri warazaqnaahum minat-tayyibaati wafaddalnaahum `alaa katheerim mimman khalaqnaa tafdeelaa
Yawma nad`oo kulla unaasim bi'imaamihim, faman ootiya kitaabahoo biyameenihee fa'ulaa'ika yaqra'oona kitaabahum walaa yuzlamoona fateelaa
Waman kaana fee haadhihee a`maa fahuwa fil-aakhirati a`maa wa'adallu sabeelaa
Wa'in kaadoo layaftinoonaka `anil-ladhee awhaynaa ilayka litaftariya `alaynaa ghayrah, wa'idhal lattakhadhooka khaleelaa
Walawlaa an thabbatnaaka laqad kitta tarkanu ilayhim shay'an qaleelaa
Idhal la'adhaqnaaka di`fal-hayaati wadi`fal-mamaati thumma laa tajidu laka `alaynaa naseeraa
Wa'in kaadoo layastafizzoonaka minal-ardi liyukhrijooka minhaa wa'idhal laa yalbathoona khilaafaka illaa qaleelaa
Sunnata man qad arsalnaa qablaka mir rusulinaa walaa tajidu lisunnatinaa tahweelaa
Aqimis-salaata lidulookish-shamsi ilaa ghasaqil-layli waqur'aanal-fajr, inna qur'aanal-fajri kaana mashhoodaa
Waminal-layli fatahajjad bihee naafilatal lak, `asaa ay yab`athaka rabbuka maqaamam mahmoodaa
Waqur rabbi adkhilnee mudkhala sidqiw wa'akhrijnee mukhraja sidqiw waj`al lee mil ladunka sultaanan naseeraa
Waqul jaa'al-haqqu wazahaqal-baatil, innal-baatila kaana zahooqaa
Wanunazzilu minal-qur'aani maa huwa shifaa'uw warahmatul lil-mu'mineena walaa yazeeduz-zaalimeena illaa khasaaraa
Wa'idhaa an`amnaa `alal-insaani a`rada wana'aa bijaanibih, wa'idhaa massahush-sharru kaana ya'oosaa
Qul kulluy ya`malu `alaa shaakilatih, farabbukum a`lamu biman huwa ahdaa sabeelaa
Wayas'aloonaka `anir-rooh, qulir-roohu min amri rabbee wamaa ooteetum minal-`ilmi illaa qaleelaa
Wala'in shi'naa lanadhhabanna bil-ladhee awhaynaa ilayka thumma laa tajidu laka bihee `alaynaa wakeelaa
Illaa rahmatam mir rabbik, inna fadlahoo kaana `alayka kabeeraa
Qul la'inijtama`atil-insu wal-jinnu `alaa ay ya'too bimithli haadhal-qur'aani laa ya'toona bimithlihee walaw kaana ba`duhum liba`din zaheeraa
Walaqad sarrafnaa lin-naasi fee haadhal-qur'aani min kulli mathal, fa'abaa aktharun-naasi illaa kufooraa
Waqaaloo lan nu'mina laka hattaa tafjura lanaa minal-ardi yamboo`aa
Aw takoona laka jannatum min nakheeliw wa`inabin fatufajjiral-anhaara khilaalahaa tafjeeraa
Aw tusqitas-samaa'a kamaa za`amta `alaynaa kisafan aw ta'tiya billaahi wal-malaa'ikati qabeelaa
Aw yakoona laka baytum min zukhrufin aw tarqaa fis-samaa', walan nu'mina liruqiyyika hattaa tunazzila `alaynaa kitaaban naqra'uh, qul subhaana rabbee hal kuntu illaa basharar rasoolaa
Wamaa mana`an-naasa ay yu'minoo idh jaa'ahumul-hudaa illaa an qaaloo aba`athallaahu basharar rasoolaa
Qul law kaana fil-ardi malaa'ikatuy yamshoona mutma'inneena lanazzalnaa `alayhim minas-samaa'i malakar rasoolaa
Qul kafaa billaahi shaheedam baynee wabaynakum, innahoo kaana bi`ibaadihee khabeeram baseeraa
Wamay yahdillaahu fahuwal-muhtad, wamay yudlil falan tajida lahum awliyaa'a min doonih, wanahshuruhum yawmal-qiyaamati `alaa wujoohihim `umyaw wabukmaw wasummaa, ma'waahum jahannam, kullamaa khabat zidnaahum sa`eeraa
Dhaalika jazaa'uhum bi'annahum kafaroo bi'aayaatinaa waqaaloo a'idhaa kunnaa `izaamaw warufaatan a'innaa lamab`oothoona khalqan jadeedaa
Awalam yaraw annallaahal-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda qaadirun `alaa ay yakhluqa mithlahum waja`ala lahum ajalal laa rayba feeh, fa'abaz-zaalimoona illaa kufooraa
Qul law antum tamlikoona khazaa'ina rahmati rabbee idhal la'amsaktum khashyatal-infaaq, wakaanal-insaanu qatooraa
Walaqad aataynaa moosaa tis`a aayaatim bayyinaatin fas'al banee israa'eela idh jaa'ahum faqaala lahoo fir`awnu innee la'azunnuka yaamoosaa mashooraa
Qaala laqad `alimta maa anzala haa'ulaa'i illaa rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardi basaa'ir, wa'innee la'azunnuka yaafir`awnu mathbooraa
Fa'araada ay yastafizzahum minal-ardi fa'aghraqnaahu wamam ma`ahoo jamee`aa
Waqulnaa mim ba`dihee libanee israa'eelaskunul-arda fa'idhaa jaa'a wa`dul-aakhirati ji'naa bikum lafeefaa
Wabil-haqqi anzalnaahu wabil-haqqi nazal, wamaa arsalnaaka illaa mubashshiraw wanadheeraa
Waqur'aanan faraqnaahu litaqra'ahoo `alan-naasi `alaa mukthiw wanazzalnaahu tanzeelaa
Qul aaminoo bihee aw laa tu'minoo, innal-ladheena ootul-`ilma min qablihee idhaa yutlaa `alayhim yakhirroona lil-adhqaani sujjadaa
Wayaqooloona subhaana rabbinaa in kaana wa`du rabbinaa lamaf`oolaa
Wayakhirroona lil-adhqaani yabkoona wayazeeduhum khushoo`aa
Qulid`ullaaha awid`ur-rahmaan, ayyam maa tad`oo falahul-asmaa'ul-husnaa, walaa tajhar bisalaatika walaa tukhaafit bihaa wabtaghi bayna dhaalika sabeelaa
Waqulil-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee lam yattakhidh waladaw walam yakul lahoo shareekun fil-mulki walam yakul lahoo waliyyum minadh-dhulli wakabbirhu takbeeraa

Al-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee anzala `alaa `abdihil-kitaaba walam yaj`al lahoo `iwajaa
Qayyimal liyundhira ba'san shadeedam mil ladunhu wayubashshiral-mu'mineenal-ladheena ya`maloonas-saalihaati anna lahum ajran hasanaa
Maakitheena feehi abadaa
Wayundhiral-ladheena qaaluttakhadhallaahu waladaa
Maa lahum bihee min `ilmiw walaa li'aabaa'ihim, kaburat kalimatan takhruju min afwaahihim, iy yaqooloona illaa kadhibaa
Fala`allaka baakhi`un nafsaka `alaa aathaarihim il lam yu'minoo bihaadhal-hadeethi asafaa
Innaa ja`alnaa maa `alal-ardi zeenatal lahaa linabluwahum ayyuhum ahsanu `amalaa
Wa'innaa lajaa`iloona maa `alayhaa sa`eedan juruzaa
Am hasibta anna ashaabal-kahfi war-raqeemi kaanoo min aayaatinaa `ajabaa
Idh awal-fityatu ilal-kahfi faqaaloo rabbanaa aatinaa mil ladunka rahmataw wahayyi' lanaa min amrinaa rashadaa
Fadarabnaa `alaa aadhaanihim fil-kahfi sineena `adadaa
Thumma ba`athnaahum lina`lama ayyul-hizbayni ahsaa limaa labithoo amadaa
Nahnu naqussu `alayka naba'ahum bil-haqq, innahum fityatun aamanoo birabbihim wazidnaahum hudaa
Warabatnaa `alaa quloobihim idh qaamoo faqaaloo rabbunaa rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardi lan nad`uwa min doonihee ilaahal laqad qulnaa idhan shatataa
Haa'ulaa'i qawmunattakhadhoo min doonihee aalihah, lawlaa ya'toona `alayhim bisultaanim bayyin, faman azlamu mimmaniftaraa `alallaahi kadhibaa
Wa'idhi`tazaltumoohum wamaa ya`budoona illallaaha fa'woo ilal-kahfi yanshur lakum rabbukum mir rahmatihee wayuhayyi' lakum min amrikum mirfaqaa
Watarash-shamsa idhaa tala`at tazaawaru `an kahfihim dhaatal-yameeni wa'idhaa gharabat taqriduhum dhaatash-shimaali wahum fee fajwatim minh, dhaalika min aayaatillaah, may yahdillaahu fahuwal-muhtadi wamay yudlil falan tajida lahoo waliyyam murshidaa
Watahsabuhum ayqaazaw wahum ruqood, wanuqallibuhum dhaatal-yameeni wadhaatash-shimaal, wakalbuhum baasitun dhiraa`ayhi bil-waseed, lawittala`ta `alayhim lawallayta minhum firaaraw walamuli'ta minhum ru`baa
Wakadhaalika ba`athnaahum liyatasaa'aloo baynahum, qaala qaa'ilum minhum kam labithtum, qaaloo labithnaa yawman aw ba`da yawm, qaaloo rabbukum a`lamu bimaa labithtum, fab`athoo ahadakum biwariqikum haadhihee ilal-madeenati falyanzur ayyuhaa azkaa ta`aaman falya'tikum birizqim minhu walyatalattaf walaa yush`iranna bikum ahadaa
Innahum iy yazharoo `alaykum yarjumookum aw yu`eedookum fee millatihim walan tuflihoo idhan abadaa
Wakadhaalika a`tharnaa `alayhim liya`lamoo anna wa`dallaahi haqquw wa'annas-saa`ata laa rayba feehaa, idh yatanaaza`oona baynahum amrahum faqaalubnoo `alayhim bunyaanaa, rabbuhum a`lamu bihim, qaalal-ladheena ghalaboo `alaa amrihim lanattakhidhanna `alayhim masjidaa
Sayaqooloona thalaathatur raabi`uhum kalbuhum, wayaqooloona khamsatun saadisuhum kalbuhum rajmam bil-ghayb, wayaqooloona sab`atuw wathaaminuhum kalbuhum, qur rabbee a`lamu bi`iddatihim maa ya`lamuhum illaa qaleel, falaa tumaari feehim illaa miraa'an zaahiraa, walaa tastafti feehim minhum ahadaa
Walaa taqoolanna lishay'in innee faa`ilun dhaalika ghadaa
Illaa ay yashaa'allaah, wadhkur rabbaka idhaa naseeta waqul `asaa ay yahdiyani rabbee li'aqraba min haadhaa rashadaa
Walabithoo fee kahfihim thalaatha mi'atin sineena wazdaadoo tis`aa
Qulillaahu a`lamu bimaa labithoo, lahoo ghaybus-samaawaati wal-ard, absir bihee wa'asmi`, maa lahum min doonihee miw waliyy, walaa yushriku fee hukmihee ahadaa
Watlu maa oohiya ilayka min kitaabi rabbik, laa mubaddila likalimaatih, walan tajida min doonihee multahadaa
Wasbir nafsaka ma`al-ladheena yad`oona rabbahum bil-ghadaati wal-`ashiyyi yureedoona wajhahoo walaa ta`du `aynaaka `anhum, tureedu zeenatal-hayaatid-dunyaa, walaa tuti` man aghfalnaa qalbahoo `an dhikrinaa wattaba`a hawaahu wakaana amruhoo furutaa
Waqulil-haqqu mir rabbikum, faman shaa'a falyu'miw waman shaa'a falyakfur, innaa a`tadnaa liz-zaalimeena naaran ahaata bihim suraadiquhaa, wa'iy yastagheethoo yughaathoo bimaa'in kal-muhli yashwil-wujooh, bi'sash-sharaab, wasaa'at murtafaqaa
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati innaa laa nudee`u ajra man ahsana `amalaa
Ulaa'ika lahum jannaatu `adnin tajree min tahtihimul-anhaaru yuhallawna feehaa min asaawira min dhahabiw wayalbasoona thiyaaban khudram min sundusiw wa'istabraqim muttaki'eena feehaa `alal-araa'ik, ni`math-thawaab, wahasunat murtafaqaa
Wadrib lahum mathalar rajulayni ja`alnaa li'ahadihimaa jannatayni min a`naabiw wahafafnaahumaa binakhliw waja`alnaa baynahumaa zar`aa
Kiltal-jannatayni aatat ukulahaa walam tazlim minhu shay'aw wafajjarnaa khilaalahumaa naharaa
Wakaana lahoo thamar, faqaala lisaahibihee wahuwa yuhaawiruhoo ana aktharu minka maalaw wa'a`azzu nafaraa
Wadakhala jannatahoo wahuwa zaalimul linafsih, qaala maa azunnu an tabeeda haadhihee abadaa
Wamaa azunnus-saa`ata qaa'imataw wala'ir rudittu ilaa rabbee la'ajidanna khayram minhaa munqalabaa
Qaala lahoo saahibuhoo wahuwa yuhaawiruhoo akafarta bil-ladhee khalaqaka min turaabin thumma min nutfatin thumma sawwaaka rajulaa
Laakinna huwallaahu rabbee walaa ushriku birabbee ahadaa
Walawlaa idh dakhalta jannataka qulta maa shaa'allaahu laa quwwata illaa billaah, in tarani ana aqalla minka maalaw wawaladaa
Fa`asaa rabbee ay yu'tiyani khayram min jannatika wayursila `alayhaa husbaanam minas-samaa'i fatusbiha sa`eedan zalaqaa
Aw yusbiha maa'uhaa ghawran falan tastatee`a lahoo talabaa
Wa'uheeta bithamarihee fa'asbaha yuqallibu kaffayhi `alaa maa anfaqa feehaa wahiya khaawiyatun `alaa `urooshihaa wayaqoolu yaalaytanee lam ushrik birabbee ahadaa
Walam takul lahoo fi'atuy yansuroonahoo min doonillaahi wamaa kaana muntasiraa
Hunaalikal-walaayatu lillaahil-haqq, huwa khayrun thawaabaw wakhayrun `uqbaa
Wadrib lahum mathalal-hayaatid-dunyaa kamaa'in anzalnaahu minas-samaa'i fakhtalata bihee nabaatul-ardi fa'asbaha hasheeman tadhroohur-riyaah, wakaanallaahu `alaa kulli shay'im muqtadiraa
Al-maalu wal-banoona zeenatul-hayaatid-dunyaa, wal-baaqiyaatus-saalihaatu khayrun `inda rabbika thawaabaw wakhayrun amalaa
Wayawma nusayyirul-jibaala wataral-arda baarizataw wahasharnaahum falam nughaadir minhum ahadaa
Wa`uridoo `alaa rabbika saffaa, laqad ji'tumoonaa kamaa khalaqnaakum awwala marrah, bal za`amtum allan naj`ala lakum maw`idaa
Wawudi`al-kitaabu fataral-mujrimeena mushfiqeena mimmaa feehi wayaqooloona yaawaylatanaa maali haadhal-kitaabi laa yughaadiru sagheerataw walaa kabeeratan illaa ahsaahaa, wawajadoo maa `amiloo haadiraa, walaa yazlimu rabbuka ahadaa
Wa'idh qulnaa lil-malaa'ikatisjudoo li'aadama fasajadoo illaa iblees, kaana minal-jinni fafasaqa `an amri rabbih, afatattakhidhoonahoo wadhurriyyatahoo awliyaa'a min doonee wahum lakum `aduww, bi'sa liz-zaalimeena badalaa
Maa ashhattuhum khalqas-samaawaati wal-ardi walaa khalqa anfusihim, wamaa kuntu muttakhidhal-mudilleena `adudaa
Wayawma yaqoolu naadoo shurakaa'iyal-ladheena za`amtum fada`awhum falam yastajeeboo lahum waja`alnaa baynahum mawbiqaa
Wara'al-mujrimoonan-naara fazannoo annahum muwaaqi`oohaa walam yajidoo `anhaa masrifaa
Walaqad sarrafnaa fee haadhal-qur'aani lin-naasi min kulli mathal, wakaanal-insaanu akthara shay'in jadalaa
Wamaa mana`an-naasa ay yu'minoo idh jaa'ahumul-hudaa wayastaghfiroo rabbahum illaa an ta'tiyahum sunnatul-awwaleena aw ya'tiyahumul-`adhaabu qubulaa
Wamaa nursilul-mursaleena illaa mubashshireena wamundhireen, wayujaadilul-ladheena kafaroo bil-baatili liyudhidoo bihil-haqqa wattakhadhoo aayaatee wamaa undhiroo huzuwaa
Waman azlamu mimman dhukkira bi'aayaati rabbihee fa'a`rada `anhaa wanasiya maa qaddamat yadaah, innaa ja`alnaa `alaa quloobihim akinnatan ay yafqahoohu wafee aadhaanihim waqraa, wa'in tad`uhum ilal-hudaa falay yahtadoo idhan abadaa
Warabbukal-ghafooru dhur-rahmah, law yu'aakhidhuhum bimaa kasaboo la`ajjala lahumul-`adhaab, bal lahum maw`idul lay yajidoo min doonihee maw'ilaa
Watilkal-quraa ahlaknaahum lammaa zalamoo waja`alnaa limahlikihim maw`idaa
Wa'idh qaala moosaa lifataahu laa abrahu hattaa ablugha majma`al-bahrayni aw amdiya huqubaa
Falammaa balaghaa majma`a baynihimaa nasiyaa hootahumaa fattakhadha sabeelahoo fil-bahri sarabaa
Falammaa jaawazaa qaala lifataahu aatinaa ghadaa'anaa, laqad laqeenaa min safarinaa haadhaa nasabaa
Qaala ara'ayta idh awaynaa ilas-sakhrati fa'innee naseetul-hoot, wamaa ansaaneehu illash-shaytaanu an adhkurah, wattakhadha sabeelahoo fil-bahri `ajabaa
Qaala dhaalika maa kunnaa nabgh, fartaddaa `alaa aathaarihimaa qasasaa
Fawajadaa `abdam min `ibaadinaa aataynaahu rahmatam min `indinaa wa`allamnaahu mil ladunnaa `ilmaa
Qaala lahoo moosaa hal attabi`uka `alaa an tu`allimani mimmaa `ullimta rushdaa
Qaala innaka lan tastatee`a ma`iya sabraa
Wakayfa tasbiru `alaa maa lam tuhit bihee khubraa
Qaala satajidunee in shaa'allaahu saabiraw walaa a`see laka amraa
Qaala fa'inittaba`tanee falaa tas'alnee `an shay'in hattaa uhditha laka minhu dhikraa
Fantalaqaa, hattaa idhaa rakibaa fis-safeenati kharaqahaa, qaala akharaqtahaa litughriqa ahlahaa, laqad ji'ta shay'an imraa
Qaala alam aqul innaka lan tastatee`a ma`iya sabraa
Qaala laa tu'aakhidhnee bimaa naseetu walaa turhiqnee min amree `usraa
Fantalaqaa, hattaa idhaa laqiyaa ghulaaman faqatalahoo qaala aqatalta nafsan zakiyyatam bighayri nafs, laqad ji'ta shay'an nukraa
Qaala alam aqul laka innaka lan tastatee`a ma`iya sabraa
Qaala in sa'altuka `an shay'im ba`dahaa falaa tusaahibnee, qad balaghta mil ladunnee `udhraa
Fantalaqaa, hattaa idhaa atayaa ahla qaryatinistat`amaa ahlahaa fa'abaw ay yudayyifoohumaa fawajadaa feehaa jidaaray yureedu ay yanqadda fa'aqaamah, qaala law shi'ta lattakhadhta `alayhi ajraa
Qaala haadhaa firaaqu baynee wabaynik, sa'unabbi'uka bita'weeli maa lam tastati` `alayhi sabraa
Ammas-safeenatu fakaanat limasaakeena ya`maloona fil-bahri fa'arattu an a`eebahaa, wakaana waraa'ahum malikuy ya'khudhu kulla safeenatin ghasbaa
Wa'ammal-ghulaamu fakaana abawaahu mu'minayni fakhasheenaa ay yurhiqahumaa tughyaanaw wakufraa
Fa'aradnaa ay yubdilahumaa rabbuhumaa khayram minhu zakaataw wa'aqraba ruhmaa
Wa'ammal-jidaaru fakaana lighulaamayni yateemayni fil-madeenati wakaana tahtahoo kanzul lahumaa wakaana aboohumaa saalihaa, fa'araada rabbuka ay yablughaa ashuddahumaa wayastakhrijaa kanzahumaa rahmatam mir rabbik, wamaa fa`altuhoo `an amree, dhaalika ta'weelu maa lam tasti` `alayhi sabraa
Wayas'aloonaka `an dhil-qarnayn, qul sa'atloo `alaykum minhu dhikraa
Innaa makkannaa lahoo fil-ardi wa'aataynaahu min kulli shay'in sababaa
Fa'atba`a sababaa
Hattaa idhaa balagha maghribash-shamsi wajadahaa taghrubu fee `aynin hami'atiw wawajada `indahaa qawmaa, qulnaa yaadhal-qarnayni immaa an tu`adhdhiba wa'immaa an tattakhidha feehim husnaa
Qaala ammaa man zalama fasawfa nu`adhdhibuhoo thumma yuraddu ilaa rabbihee fayu`adhdhibuhoo `adhaaban nukraa
Wa'ammaa man aamana wa`amila saalihan falahoo jazaa'anil-husnaa, wasanaqoolu lahoo min amrinaa yusraa
Thumma atba`a sababaa
Hattaa idhaa balagha matli`ash-shamsi wajadahaa tatlu`u `alaa qawmil lam naj`al lahum min doonihaa sitraa
Kadhaalik, waqad ahatnaa bimaa ladayhi khubraa
Thumma atba`a sababaa
Hattaa idhaa balagha baynas-saddayni wajada min doonihimaa qawmal laa yakaadoona yafqahoona qawlaa
Qaaloo yaadhal-qarnayni inna ya'jooja wama'jooja mufsidoona fil-ardi fahal naj`alu laka kharjan `alaa an taj`ala baynanaa wabaynahum saddaa
Qaala maa makkannee feehi rabbee khayrun fa'a`eenoonee biquwwatin aj`al baynakum wabaynahum radmaa
Aatoonee zubaral-hadeed, hattaa idhaa saawaa baynas-sadafayni qaalanfukhoo, hattaa idhaa ja`alahoo naaran qaala aatoonee ufrigh `alayhi qitraa
Famastaa`oo ay yazharoohu wamastataa`oo lahoo naqbaa
Qaala haadhaa rahmatum mir rabbee, fa'idhaa jaa'a wa`du rabbee ja`alahoo dakkaa', wakaana wa`du rabbee haqqaa
Wataraknaa ba`dahum yawma'idhiy yamooju fee ba`diw wanufikha fis-soori fajama`naahum jam`aa
Wa`aradnaa jahannama yawma'idhil lil-kaafireena `ardaa
Al-ladheena kaanat a`yunuhum fee ghitaa'in `an dhikree wakaanoo laa yastatee`oona sam`aa
Afahasibal-ladheena kafaroo ay yattakhidhoo `ibaadee min doonee awliyaa', innaa a`tadnaa jahannama lil-kaafireena nuzulaa
Qul hal nunabbi'ukum bil-akhsareena a`maalaa
Alladheena dalla sa`yuhum fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wahum yahsaboona annahum yuhsinoona sun`aa
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena kafaroo bi'aayaati rabbihim waliqaa'ihee fahabitat a`maaluhum falaa nuqeemu lahum yawmal-qiyaamati waznaa
Dhaalika jazaa'uhum jahannamu bimaa kafaroo wattakhadhoo aayaatee warusulee huzuwaa
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati kaanat lahum jannaatul-firdawsi nuzulaa
Khaalideena feehaa laa yabghoona `anhaa hiwalaa
Qul law kaanal-bahru midaadal likalimaati rabbee lanafidal-bahru qabla an tanfada kalimaatu rabbee walaw ji'naa bimithlihee madadaa
Qul innamaa ana basharum mithlukum yoohaa ilayya annamaa ilaahukum ilaahuw waahid, faman kaana yarjoo liqaa'a rabbihee falya`mal `amalan saalihaw walaa yushrik bi`ibaadati rabbihee ahadaa

Kaaf haa yaa `ayn saad
Dhikru rahmati rabbika `abdahoo zakariyyaa
Idh naadaa rabbahoo nidaa'an khafiyyaa
Qaala rabbi innee wahanal-`azmu minnee washta`alar-ra'su shaybaw walam akum bidu`aa'ika rabbi shaqiyyaa
Wa'innee khiftul-mawaaliya miw waraa'ee wakaanatimra'atee `aaqiran fahab lee mil ladunka waliyyaa
Yarithunee wayarithu min aali ya`qooba waj`alhu rabbi radiyyaa
Yaazakariyyaa innaa nubashshiruka bighulaaminismuhoo yahyaa lam naj`al lahoo min qablu samiyyaa
Qaala rabbi annaa yakoonu lee ghulaamuw wakaanatimra'atee `aaqiraw waqad balaghtu minal-kibari `itiyyaa
Qaala kadhaalik, qaala rabbuka huwa `alayya hayyinuw waqad khalaqtuka min qablu walam taku shay'aa
Qaala rabbij`al lee aayah, qaala aayatuka allaa tukalliman-naasa thalaatha layaalin sawiyyaa
Fakharaja `alaa qawmihee minal-mihraabi fa'awhaa ilayhim an sabbihoo bukrataw wa`ashiyyaa
Yaayahyaa khudhil-kitaaba biquwwah, wa'aataynaahul-hukma sabiyyaa
Wahanaanam mil ladunnaa wazakaah, wakaana taqiyyaa
Wabarram biwaalidayhi walam yakun jabbaaran `asiyyaa
Wasalaamun `alayhi yawma wulida wayawma yamootu wayawma yub`athu hayyaa
Wadhkur fil-kitaabi maryam, idhintabadhat min ahlihaa makaanan sharqiyyaa
Fattakhadhat min doonihim hijaabaa, fa'arsalnaa ilayhaa roohanaa fatamaththala lahaa basharan sawiyyaa
Qaalat innee a`oodhu bir-rahmaani minka in kunta taqiyyaa
Qaala innamaa ana rasoolu rabbik, li'ahaba laki ghulaaman zakiyyaa
Qaalat annaa yakoonu lee ghulaamuw walam yamsasnee basharuw walam aku baghiyyaa
Qaala kadhaalik, qaala rabbuki huwa `alayya hayyin, walinaj`alahoo aayatal lin-naasi warahmatam minnaa, wakaana amram maqdiyyaa
Fahamalathu fantabadhat bihee makaanan qasiyyaa
Fa'ajaa'ahal-makhaadu ilaa jidh`in-nakhlah, qaalat yaalaytanee mittu qabla haadhaa wakuntu nasyam mansiyyaa
Fanaadaahaa min tahtihaa allaa tahzanee qad ja`ala rabbuki tahtaki sariyyaa
Wahuzzee ilayki bijidh`in-nakhlati tusaaqit `alayki rutaban janiyyaa
Fakulee washrabee waqarree `aynaa, fa'immaa tarayinna minal-bashari ahadan faqoolee innee nadhartu lir-rahmaani sawman falan ukallimal-yawma insiyyaa
Fa'atat bihee qawmahaa tahmiluh, qaaloo yaamaryamu laqad ji'ti shay'an fariyyaa
Yaa ukhta haaroona maa kaana abookimra'a saw'iw wamaa kaanat ummuki baghiyyaa
Fa'ashaarat ilayh, qaaloo kayfa nukallimu man kaana fil-mahdi sabiyyaa
Qaala innee `abdullaah, aataaniyal-kitaaba waja`alanee nabiyyaa
Waja`alanee mubaarakan ayna maa kunt, wa'awsaanee bis-salaati waz-zakaati maa dumtu hayyaa
Wabarram biwaalidatee walam yaj`alnee jabbaaran shaqiyyaa
Was-salaamu `alayya yawma wulittu wayawma amootu wayawma ub`athu hayyaa
Dhaalika `eesabnu maryam, qawlal-haqqil-ladhee feehi yamtaroon
Maa kaana lillaahi ay yattakhidha miw waladin subhaanah, idhaa qadaa amran fa'innamaa yaqoolu lahoo kun fayakoon
Wa'innallaaha rabbee warabbukum fa`budooh, haadhaa siraatum mustaqeem
Fakhtalafal-ahzaabu mim baynihim, fawaylul lilladheena kafaroo mim mashhadi yawmin `azeem
Asmi` bihim wa'absir yawma ya'toonanaa laakiniz-zaalimoonal-yawma fee dalaalim mubeen
Wa'andhirhum yawmal-hasrati idh qudiyal-amr, wahum fee ghaflatiw wahum laa yu'minoon
Innaa nahnu narithul-arda waman `alayhaa wa'ilaynaa yurja`oon
Wadhkur fil-kitaabi ibraaheem, innahoo kaana siddeeqan nabiyyaa
Idh qaala li'abeehi yaa abati lima ta`budu maa laa yasma`u walaa yubsiru walaa yughnee `anka shay'aa
Yaa abati innee qad jaa'anee minal-`ilmi maa lam ya'tika fattabi`nee ahdika siraatan sawiyyaa
Yaa abati laa ta`budish-shaytaan, innash-shaytaana kaana lir-rahmaani `asiyyaa
Yaa abati innee akhaafu ay yamassaka `adhaabum minar-rahmaani fatakoona lish-shaytaani waliyyaa
Qaala araaghibun anta `an aalihatee yaa ibraaheem, la'il lam tantahi la'arjumannaka wahjurnee maliyyaa
Qaala salaamun `alayk, sa'astaghfiru laka rabbee, innahoo kaana bee hafiyyaa
Wa'a`tazilukum wamaa tad`oona min doonillaahi wa'ad`oo rabbee, `asaa allaa akoona bidu`aa'i rabbee shaqiyyaa
Falamma`tazalahum wamaa ya`budoona min doonillaahi wahabnaa lahoo ishaaqa waya`qoob, wakullan ja`alnaa nabiyyaa
Wawahabnaa lahum mir rahmatinaa waja`alnaa lahum lisaana sidqin `aliyyaa
Wadhkur fil-kitaabi moosaa, innahoo kaana mukhlasaw wakaana rasoolan nabiyyaa
Wanaadaynaahu min jaanibit-tooril-aymani waqarrabnaahu najiyyaa
Wawahabnaa lahoo mir rahmatinaa akhaahu haaroona nabiyyaa
Wadhkur fil-kitaabi ismaa`eel, innahoo kaana saadiqal-wa`di wakaana rasoolan nabiyyaa
Wakaana ya'muru ahlahoo bis-salaati waz-zakaah, wakaana `inda rabbihee mardiyyaa
Wadhkur fil-kitaabi idrees, innahoo kaana siddeeqan nabiyyaa
Warafa`naahu makaanan `aliyyaa
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena an`amallaahu `alayhim minan-nabiyyeena min dhurriyyati aadama wamimman hamalnaa ma`a nooh, wamin dhurriyyati ibraaheema wa'israa'eel, wamimman hadaynaa wajtabaynaa, idhaa tutlaa `alayhim aayaatur-rahmaani kharroo sujjadaw wabukiyyaa
Fakhalafa mim ba`dihim khalfun adaa`us-salaata wattaba`ush-shahawaati fasawfa yalqawna ghayyaa
Illaa man taaba wa'aamana wa`amila saalihan fa'ulaa'ika yadkhuloonal-jannata walaa yuzlamoona shay'aa
Jannaati `adninil-latee wa`adar-rahmaanu `ibaadahoo bil-ghayb, innahoo kaana wa`duhoo ma'tiyyaa
Laa yasma`oona feehaa laghwan illaa salaamaa, walahum rizquhum feehaa bukrataw wa`ashiyyaa
Tilkal-jannatul-latee noorithu min `ibaadinaa man kaana taqiyyaa
Wamaa natanazzalu illaa bi'amri rabbik, lahoo maa bayna aydeenaa wamaa khalfanaa wamaa bayna dhaalika wamaa kaana rabbuka nasiyyaa
Rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa baynahumaa fa`budhu wastabir li`ibaadatih, hal ta`lamu lahoo samiyyaa
Wayaqoolul-insaanu a'idhaa maa mittu lasawfa ukhraju hayyaa
Awalaa yadhkurul-insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min qablu walam yaku shay'aa
Fawarabbika lanahshurannahum wash-shayaateena thumma lanuhdirannahum hawla jahannama jithiyyaa
Thumma lananzi`anna min kulli shee`atin ayyuhum ashaddu `alar-rahmaani `itiyyaa
Thumma lanahnu a`lamu bil-ladheena hum awlaa bihaa siliyyaa
Wa'im minkum illaa waariduhaa, kaana `alaa rabbika hatmam maqdiyyaa
Thumma nunajjil-ladheenattaqaw wanadharuz-zaalimeena feehaa jithiyyaa
Wa'idhaa tutlaa `alayhim aayaatunaa bayyinaatin qaalal-ladheena kafaroo lilladheena aamanoo ayyul-fareeqayni khayrum maqaamaw wa'ahsanu nadiyyaa
Wakam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu athaathaw wari'yaa
Qul man kaana fid-dalaalati falyamdud lahur-rahmaanu maddaa, hattaa idhaa ra'aw maa yoo`adoona immal-`adhaaba wa'immas-saa`ah, fasaya`lamoona man huwa sharrum makaanaw wa'ad`afu jundaa
Wayazeedullaahul-ladheenahtadaw hudaa, wal-baaqiyaatus-saalihaatu khayrun `inda rabbika thawaabaw wakhayrum maraddaa
Afara'aytal-ladhee kafara bi'aayaatinaa waqaala la'ootayanna maalaw wawaladaa
Attala`al-ghayba amittakhadha `indar-rahmaani `ahdaa
Kallaa, sanaktubu maa yaqoolu wanamuddu lahoo minal-`adhaabi maddaa
Wanarithuhoo maa yaqoolu waya'teenaa fardaa
Wattakhadhoo min doonillaahi aalihatal liyakoonoo lahum `izzaa
Kallaa, sayakfuroona bi`ibaadatihim wayakoonoona `alayhim diddaa
Alam tara annaa arsalnash-shayaateena `alal-kaafireena ta'uzzuhum azzaa
Falaa ta`jal `alayhim, innamaa na`uddu lahum `addaa
Yawma nahshurul-muttaqeena ilar-rahmaani wafdaa
Wanasooqul-mujrimeena ilaa jahannama wirdaa
Laa yamlikoonash-shafaa`ata illaa manittakhadha `indar-rahmaani `ahdaa
Waqaaluttakhadhar-rahmaanu waladaa
Laqad ji'tum shay'an iddaa
Takaadus-samaawaatu yatafattarna minhu watanshaqqul-ardu watakhirrul-jibaalu haddaa
An da`aw lir-rahmaani waladaa
Wamaa yambaghee lir-rahmaani ay yattakhidha waladaa
In kullu man fis-samaawaati wal-ardi illaa aatir-rahmaani `abdaa
Laqad ahsaahum wa`addahum `addaa
Wakulluhum aateehi yawmal-qiyaamati fardaa
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati sayaj`alu lahumur-rahmaanu wuddaa
Fa'innamaa yassarnaahu bilisaanika litubashshira bihil-muttaqeena watundhira bihee qawmal luddaa
Wakam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarn, hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin aw tasma`u lahum rikzaa

Taa haa
Maa anzalnaa `alaykal-qur'aana litashqaa
Illaa tadhkiratal limay yakhshaa
Tanzeelam mimman khalaqal-arda was-samaawaatil-`ulaa
Ar-rahmaanu `alal-`arshistawaa
Lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ardi wamaa baynahumaa wamaa tahtath-tharaa
Wa'in tajhar bil-qawli fa'innahoo ya`lamus-sirra wa'akhfaa
Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huw, lahul-asmaa'ul-husnaa
Wahal ataaka hadeethu moosaa
Idh ra'aa naaran faqaala li'ahlihimkuthoo innee aanastu naaral la`allee aateekum minhaa biqabasin aw ajidu `alan-naari hudaa
Falammaa ataahaa noodiya yaamoosaa
Innee ana rabbuka fakhla` na`layk, innaka bil-waadil-muqaddasi tuwaa
Wa'anakhtartuka fastami` limaa yoohaa
Innanee anallaahu laa ilaaha illaa ana fa`budnee wa'aqimis-salaata lidhikree
Innas-saa`ata aatiyatun akaadu ukhfeehaa litujzaa kullu nafsim bimaa tas`aa
Falaa yasuddannaka `anhaa mal laa yu'minu bihaa wattaba`a hawaahu fatardaa
Wamaa tilka biyameenika yaamoosaa
Qaala hiya `asaay, atawakka'u `alayhaa wa'ahushshu bihaa `alaa ghanamee waliya feehaa ma'aaribu ukhraa
Qaala alqihaa yaamoosaa
Fa'alqaahaa fa'idhaa hiya hayyatun tas`aa
Qaala khudhhaa walaa takhaf, sanu`eeduhaa seeratahal-oolaa
Wadmum yadaka ilaa janaahika takhruj baydaa'a min ghayri soo'in aayatan ukhraa
Linuriyaka min aayaatinal-kubraa
Idhhab ilaa fir`awna innahoo taghaa
Qaala rabbishrah lee sadree
Wayassir lee amree
Wahlul `uqdatam mil lisaanee
Yafqahoo qawlee
Waj`al lee wazeeram min ahlee
Haaroona akhee
Ushdud bihee azree
Wa'ashrikhu fee amree
Kay nusabbihaka katheeraa
Wanadhkuraka katheeraa
Innaka kunta binaa baseeraa
Qaala qad ooteeta su'laka yaamoosaa
Walaqad manannaa `alayka marratan ukhraa
Idh awhaynaa ilaa ummika maa yoohaa
Aniqdhifeehi fit-taabooti faqdhifeehi fil-yammi falyulqihil-yammu bis-saahili ya'khudhhu `aduwwul lee wa`aduwwul lah, wa'alqaytu `alayka mahabbatam minnee, walitusna`a `alaa `aynee
Idh tamshee ukhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum `alaa may yakfuluh, faraja`naaka ilaa ummika kay taqarra `aynuhaa walaa tahzan, waqatalta nafsan fanajjaynaaka minal-ghammi wafatannaaka futoonaa, falabithta sineena fee ahli madyana thumma ji'ta `alaa qadariy yaamoosaa
Wastana`tuka linafsee
Idhhab anta wa'akhooka bi'aayaatee walaa taniyaa fee dhikree
Idhhabaa ilaa fir`awna innahoo taghaa
Faqoolaa lahoo qawlal layyinal la`allahoo yatadhakkaru aw yakhshaa
Qaalaa rabbanaa innanaa nakhaafu ay yafruta `alaynaa aw ay yatghaa
Qaala laa takhaafaa innanee ma`akumaa asma`u wa'araa
Fa'tiyaahu faqoolaa innaa rasoolaa rabbika fa'arsil ma`anaa banee israa'eela walaa tu`adhdhibhum, qad ji'naaka bi'aayatim mir rabbik, was-salaamu `alaa manittaba`al-hudaa
Innaa qad oohiya ilaynaa annal-`adhaaba `alaa man kadhdhaba watawallaa
Qaala famar rabbukumaa yaamoosaa
Qaala rabbunal-ladhee a`taa kulla shay'in khalqahoo thumma hadaa
Qaala famaa baalul-quroonil-oolaa
Qaala `ilmuhaa `inda rabbee fee kitaab, laa yadillu rabbee walaa yansaa
Al-ladhee ja`ala lakumul-arda mahdaw wasalaka lakum feehaa subulaw wa'anzala minas-samaa'i maa'aa, fa'akhrajnaa bihee azwaajam min nabaatin shattaa
Kuloo war`aw an`aamakum, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil li'ulin-nuhaa
Minhaa khalaqnaakum wafeehaa nu`eedukum waminhaa nukhrijukum taaratan ukhraa
Walaqad araynaahu aayaatinaa kullahaa fakadhdhaba wa'abaa
Qaala aji'tanaa litukhrijanaa min ardinaa bisihrika yaamoosaa
Falana'tiyannaka bisihrim mithlihee faj`al baynanaa wabaynaka maw`idal laa nukhlifuhoo nahnu walaa anta makaanan suwaa
Qaala maw`idukum yawmuz-zeenati wa'ay yuhsharan-naasu duhaa
Fatawallaa fir`awnu fajama`a kaydahoo thumma ataa
Qaala lahum moosaa waylakum laa taftaroo `alallaahi kadhiban fayushitakum bi`adhaab, waqad khaaba maniftaraa
Fatanaaza`oo amrahum baynahum wa'asarrun-najwaa
Qaaloo in haadhaani lasaahiraani yureedaani ay yukhrijaakum min ardikum bisihrihimaa wayadhhabaa bitareeqatikumul-muthlaa
Fa'ajmi`oo kaydakum thumma'too saffaa, waqad aflahal-yawma manista`laa
Qaaloo yaamoosaa immaa an tulqiya wa'immaa an nakoona awwala man alqaa
Qaala bal alqoo, fa'idhaa hibaaluhum wa`isiyyuhum yukhayyalu ilayhi min sihrihim annahaa tas`aa
Fa'awjasa fee nafsihee kheefatam moosaa
Qulnaa laa takhaf innaka antal-a`laa
Wa'alqi maa fee yameenika talqaf maa sana`oo, innamaa sana`oo kaydu saahir, walaa yuflihus-saahiru haythu ataa
Fa'ulqiyas-saharatu sujjadan qaaloo aamannaa birabbi haaroona wamoosaa
Qaala aamantum lahoo qabla an aadhana lakum, innahoo lakabeerukumul-ladhee `allamakumus-sihr, fala'uqatti`anna aydiyakum wa'arjulakum min khilaafiw wala'usallibannakum fee judhoo`in-nakhl, walata`lamunna ayyunaa ashaddu `adhaabaw wa'abqaa
Qaaloo lan nu'thiraka `alaa maa jaa'anaa minal-bayyinaati wal-ladhee fataranaa faqdi maa anta qaad, innamaa taqdee haadhihil-hayaatad-dunyaa
Innaa aamannaa birabbinaa liyaghfira lanaa khataayaanaa wamaa akrahtanaa `alayhi minas-sihr, wallaahu khayruw wa'abqaa
Innahoo may ya'ti rabbahoo mujriman fa'inna lahoo jahannam, laa yamootu feehaa walaa yahyaa
Wamay ya'tihee mu'minan qad `amilas-saalihaati fa'ulaa'ika lahumud-darajaatul-`ulaa
Jannaatu `adnin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa, wadhaalika jazaa'u man tazakkaa
Walaqad awhaynaa ilaa moosaa an asri bi`ibaadee fadrib lahum tareeqan fil-bahri yabasal laa takhaafu darakaw walaa takhshaa
Fa'atba`ahum fir`awnu bijunoodihee faghashiyahum minal-yammi maa ghashiyahum
Wa'adalla fir`awnu qawmahoo wamaa hadaa
Yaabanee israa'eela qad anjaynaakum min `aduwwikum wawaa`adnaakum jaanibat-tooril-aymana wanazzalnaa `alaykumul-manna was-salwaa
Kuloo min tayyibaati maa razaqnaakum walaa tatghaw feehi fayahilla `alaykum ghadabee, wamay yahlil `alayhi ghadabee faqad hawaa
Wa'innee laghaffaarul liman taaba wa'aamana wa`amila saalihan thummahtadaa
Wamaa a`jalaka `an qawmika yaamoosaa
Qaala hum ulaa'i `alaa atharee wa`ajiltu ilayka rabbi litardaa
Qaala fa'innaa qad fatannaa qawmaka mim ba`dika wa'adallahumus-saamiriyy
Faraja`a moosaa ilaa qawmihee ghadbaana asifaa, qaala yaaqawmi alam ya`idkum rabbukum wa`dan hasanaa, afataala `alaykumul-`ahdu am arattum ay yahilla `alaykum ghadabum mir rabbikum fa'akhlaftum maw`idee
Qaaloo maa akhlafnaa maw`idaka bimalkinaa walaakinnaa hummilnaa awzaaram min zeenatil-qawmi faqadhafnaahaa fakadhaalika alqas-saamiriyy
Fa'akhraja lahum `ijlan jasadal lahoo khuwaarun faqaaloo haadhaa ilaahukum wa'ilaahu moosaa fanasiy
Afalaa yarawna allaa yarji`u ilayhim qawlaw walaa yamliku lahum darraw walaa naf`aa
Walaqad qaala lahum haaroonu min qablu yaaqawmi innamaa futintum bih, wa'inna rabbakumur-rahmaanu fattabi`oonee wa'atee`oo amree
Qaaloo lan nabraha `alayhi `aakifeena hattaa yarji`a ilaynaa moosaa
Qaala yaahaaroonu maa mana`aka idh ra'aytahum dalloo
Allaa tattabi`an, afa`asayta amree
Qaala yabna'umma laa ta'khudh bilihyatee walaa bira'see, innee khasheetu an taqoola farraqta bayna banee israa'eela walam tarqub qawlee
Qaala famaa khatbuka yaasaamiriyy
Qaala basurtu bimaa lam yabsuroo bihee faqabadtu qabdatam min atharir-rasooli fanabadhtuhaa wakadhaalika sawwalat lee nafsee
Qaala fadhhab fa'inna laka fil-hayaati an taqoola laa misaas, wa'inna laka maw`idal lan tukhlafah, wanzur ilaa ilaahikal-ladhee zalta `alayhi `aakifaa, lanuharriqannahoo thumma lanansifannahoo fil-yammi nasfaa
Innamaa ilaahukumullaahul-ladhee laa ilaaha illaa huw, wasi`a kulla shay'in `ilmaa
Kadhaalika naqussu `alayka min ambaa'i maa qad sabaq, waqad aataynaaka mil ladunnaa dhikraa
Man a`rada `anhu fa'innahoo yahmilu yawmal-qiyaamati wizraa
Khaalideena feeh, wasaa'a lahum yawmal-qiyaamati himlaa
Yawma yunfakhu fis-soori wanahshurul-mujrimeena yawma'idhin zurqaa
Yatakhaafatoona baynahum il labithtum illaa `ashraa
Nahnu a`lamu bimaa yaqooloona idh yaqoolu amthaluhum tareeqatan il labithtum illaa yawmaa
Wayas'aloonaka `anil-jibaali faqul yansifuhaa rabbee nasfaa
Fayadharuhaa qaa`an safsafaa
Laa taraa feehaa `iwajaw walaa amtaa
Yawma'idhiy yattabi`oonad-daa`iya laa `iwaja lah, wakhasha`atil-aswaatu lir-rahmaani falaa tasma`u illaa hamsaa
Yawma'idhil laa tanfa`ush-shafaa`atu illaa man adhina lahur-rahmaanu waradiya lahoo qawlaa
Ya`lamu maa bayna aydeehim wamaa khalfahum walaa yuheetoona bihee `ilmaa
Wa`anatil-wujoohu lil-hayyil-qayyoom, waqad khaaba man hamala zulmaa
Wamay ya`mal minas-saalihaati wahuwa mu'minun falaa yakhaafu zulmaw walaa hadmaa
Wakadhaalika anzalnaahu qur'aanan `arabiyyaw wasarrafnaa feehi minal-wa`eedi la`allahum yattaqoona aw yuhdithu lahum dhikraa
Fata`aalallaahul-malikul-haqq, walaa ta`jal bil-qur'aani min qabli ay yuqdaa ilayka wahyuh, waqur rabbi zidnee `ilmaa
Walaqad `ahidnaa ilaa aadama min qablu fanasiya walam najid lahoo `azmaa
Wa'idh qulnaa lil-malaa'ikatisjudoo li'aadama fasajadoo illaa ibleesa abaa
Faqulnaa yaa aadamu inna haadhaa `aduwwul laka walizawjika falaa yukhrijannakumaa minal-jannati fatashqaa
Inna laka allaa tajoo`a feehaa walaa ta`raa
Wa'annaka laa tazma'u feehaa walaa tadhaa
Fawaswasa ilayhish-shaytaanu qaala yaa aadamu hal adulluka `alaa shajaratil-khuldi wamulkil laa yablaa
Fa'akalaa minhaa fabadat lahumaa saw'aatuhumaa watafiqaa yakhsifaani `alayhimaa miw waraqil-jannah, wa`asaa aadamu rabbahoo faghawaa
Thummajtabaahu rabbuhoo fataaba `alayhi wahadaa
Qaalahbitaa minhaa jamee`am ba`dukum liba`din `aduww, fa'immaa ya'tiyannakum minnee hudan famanittaba`a hudaaya falaa yadillu walaa yashqaa
Waman a`rada `an dhikree fa'inna lahoo ma`eeshatan dankaw wanahshuruhoo yawmal-qiyaamati a`maa
Qaala rabbi lima hashartanee a`maa waqad kuntu baseeraa
Qaala kadhaalika atatka aayaatunaa fanaseetahaa, wakadhaalikal-yawma tunsaa
Wakadhaalika najzee man asrafa walam yu'mim bi'aayaati rabbih, wala`adhaabul-aakhirati ashaddu wa'abqaa
Afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknaa qablahum minal-qurooni yamshoona fee masaakinihim, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil li'ulin-nuhaa
Walawlaa kalimatun sabaqat mir rabbika lakaana lizaamaw wa'ajalum musammaa
Fasbir `alaa maa yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tuloo`ish-shamsi waqabla ghuroobihaa, wamin aanaa'il-layli fasabbih wa'atraafan-nahaari la`allaka tardaa
Walaa tamuddanna `aynayka ilaa maa matta`naa bihee azwaajam minhum zahratal-hayaatid-dunyaa linaftinahum feeh, warizqu rabbika khayruw wa'abqaa
Wa'mur ahlaka bis-salaati wastabir `alayhaa, laa nas'aluka rizqaa, nahnu narzuquk, wal-`aaqibatu lit-taqwaa
Waqaaloo lawlaa ya'teenaa bi'aayatim mir rabbih, awalam ta'tihim bayyinatu maa fis-suhufil-oolaa
Walaw annaa ahlaknaahum bi`adhaabim min qablihee laqaaloo rabbanaa lawlaa arsalta ilaynaa rasoolan fanattabi`a aayaatika min qabli an nadhilla wanakhzaa
Qul kullum mutarabbisun fatarabbasoo, fasata`lamoona man ashaabus-siraatis-sawiyyi wamanihtadaa

Iqtaraba lin-naasi hisaabuhum wahum fee ghaflatim mu`ridoon
Maa ya'teehim min dhikrim mir rabbihim muhdathin illastama`oohu wahum yal`aboon
Laahiyatan quloobuhum, wa'asarrun-najwaa, al-ladheena zalamoo, hal haadhaa illaa basharum mithlukum, afata'toonas-sihra wa'antum tubsiroon
Qaala rabbee ya`lamul-qawla fis-samaa'i wal-ard, wahuwas-samee`ul-`aleem
Bal qaaloo adghaathu ahlaamim baliftaraahu bal huwa shaa`ir, falya'tinaa bi'aayatin kamaa ursilal-awwaloon
Maa aamanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknaahaa, afahum yu'minoon
Wamaa arsalnaa qablaka illaa rijaalan noohee ilayhim fas'aloo ahladh-dhikri in kuntum laa ta`lamoon
Wamaa ja`alnaahum jasadal laa ya'kuloonat-ta`aama wamaa kaanoo khaalideen
Thumma sadaqnaahumul-wa`da fa'anjaynaahum waman nashaa'u wa'ahlaknal-musrifeen
Laqad anzalnaa ilaykum kitaaban feehi dhikrukum, afalaa ta`qiloon
Wakam qasamnaa min qaryatin kaanat zaalimataw wa'ansha'naa ba`dahaa qawman aakhareen
Falammaa ahassoo ba'sanaa idhaa hum minhaa yarkudoon
Laa tarkudoo warji`oo ilaa maa utriftum feehi wamasaakinikum la`allakum tus'aloon
Qaaloo yaawaylanaa innaa kunnaa zaalimeen
Famaa zaalat tilka da`waahum hattaa ja`alnaahum haseedan khaamideen
Wamaa khalaqnas-samaa'a wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa laa`ibeen
Law aradnaa an nattakhidha lahwal lattakhadhnaahu mil ladunnaa, in kunnaa faa`ileen
Bal naqdhifu bil-haqqi `alal-baatili fayadmaghuhoo fa'idhaa huwa zaahiq, walakumul-waylu mimmaa tasifoon
Walahoo man fis-samaawaati wal-ard, waman `indahoo laa yastakbiroona `an `ibaadatihee walaa yastahsiroon
Yusabbihoonal-layla wan-nahaara laa yafturoon
Amittakhadhoo aalihatam minal-ardi hum yunshiroon
Law kaana feehimaa aalihatun illallaahu lafasadataa, fasubhaanallaahi rabbil-`arshi `ammaa yasifoon
Laa yus'alu `ammaa yaf`alu wahum yus'aloon
Amittakhadhoo min doonihee aalihah, qul haatoo burhaanakum, haadhaa dhikru mam ma`iya wadhikru man qablee, bal aktharuhum laa ya`lamoonal-haqqa fahum mu`ridoon
Wamaa arsalnaa min qablika mir rasoolin illaa noohee ilayhi annahoo laa ilaaha illaa ana fa`budoon
Waqaaluttakhadhar-rahmaanu waladan subhaanah, bal `ibaadum mukramoon
Laa yasbiqoonahoo bil-qawli wahum bi'amrihee ya`maloon
Ya`lamu maa bayna aydeehim wamaa khalfahum walaa yashfa`oona illaa limanirtadaa wahum min khashyatihee mushfiqoon
Wamay yaqul minhum innee ilaahum min doonihee fadhaalika najzeehi jahannam, kadhaalika najziz-zaalimeen
Awalam yaral-ladheena kafaroo annas-samaawaati wal-arda kaanataa ratqan fafataqnaahumaa, waja`alnaa minal-maa'i kulla shay'in hayy, afalaa yu'minoon
Waja`alnaa fil-ardi rawaasiya an tameeda bihim, waja`alnaa feehaa fijaajan subulal la`allahum yahtadoon
Waja`alnas-samaa'a saqfam mahfoozaa, wahum `an aayaatihaa mu`ridoon
Wahuwal-ladhee khalaqal-layla wan-nahaara wash-shamsa wal-qamar, kullun fee falakiy yasbahoon
Wamaa ja`alnaa libasharim min qablikal-khuld, afa'im mitta fahumul-khaalidoon
Kullu nafsin dhaa'iqatul-mawt, wanablookum bish-sharri wal-khayri fitnah, wa'ilaynaa turja`oon
Wa'idhaa ra'aakal-ladheena kafaroo iy yattakhidhoonaka illaa huzuwaa, ahaadhal-ladhee yadhkuru aalihatakum, wahum bidhikrir-rahmaani hum kaafiroon
Khuliqal-insaanu min `ajal, sa'ureekum aayaatee falaa tasta`jiloon
Wayaqooloona mataa haadhal-wa`du in kuntum saadiqeen
Law ya`lamul-ladheena kafaroo heena laa yakuffoona `aw wujoohihimun-naara walaa `an zuhoorihim walaa hum yunsaroon
Bal ta'teehim baghtatan fatabhatuhum falaa yastatee`oona raddahaa walaa hum yunzaroon
Walaqadistuhzi'a birusulim min qablika fahaaqa bil-ladheena sakhiroo minhum maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
Qul may yakla'ukum bil-layli wan-nahaari minar-rahmaan, bal hum `an dhikri rabbihim mu`ridoon
Am lahum aalihatun tamna`uhum min dooninaa, laa yastatee`oona nasra anfusihim walaa hum minnaa yushaboon
Bal matta`naa haa'ulaa'i wa'aabaa'ahum hattaa taala `alayhimul-`umur, afalaa yarawna annaa na'til-arda nanqusuhaa min atraafihaa, afahumul-ghaaliboon
Qul innamaa undhirukum bil-wahy, walaa yasma`us-summud-du`aa'a idhaa maa yundharoon
Wala'im massathum nafhatum min `adhaabi rabbika layaqoolunna yaawaylanaa innaa kunnaa zaalimeen
Wanada`ul-mawaazeenal-qista liyawmil-qiyaamati falaa tuzlamu nafsun shay'aa, wa'in kaana mithqaala habbatim min khardalin ataynaa bihaa, wakafaa binaa haasibeen
Walaqad aataynaa moosaa wahaaroonal-furqaana wadiyaa'aw wadhikral lil-muttaqeen
Al-ladheena yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi wahum minas-saa`ati mushfiqoon
Wahaadhaa dhikrum mubaarakun anzalnaah, afa'antum lahoo munkiroon
Walaqad aataynaa ibraaheema rushdahoo min qablu wakunnaa bihee `aalimeen
Idh qaala li'abeehi waqawmihee maa haadhihit-tamaatheelul-latee antum lahaa `aakifoon
Qaaloo wajadnaa aabaa'anaa lahaa `aabideen
Qaala laqad kuntum antum wa'aabaa'ukum fee dalaalim mubeen
Qaaloo aji'tanaa bil-haqqi am anta minallaa`ibeen
Qaala bar rabbukum rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardil-ladhee fatarahunn, wa'ana `alaa dhaalikum minash-shaahideen
Watallaahi la'akeedanna asnaamakum ba`da an tuwalloo mudbireen
Faja`alahum judhaadhan illaa kabeeral lahum la`allahum ilayhi yarji`oon
Qaaloo man fa`ala haadhaa bi'aalihatinaa innahoo laminaz-zaalimeen
Qaaloo sami`naa fatay yadhkuruhum yuqaalu lahoo ibraaheem
Qaaloo fa'too bihee `alaa a`yunin-naasi la`allahum yashhadoon
Qaaloo a'anta fa`alta haadhaa bi'aalihatinaa yaa ibraaheem
Qaala bal fa`alahoo kabeeruhum haadhaa fas'aloohum in kaanoo yantiqoon
Faraja`oo ilaa anfusihim faqaaloo innakum antumuz-zaalimoon
Thumma nukisoo `alaa ru'oosihim, laqad `alimta maa haa'ulaa'i yantiqoon
Qaala afata`budoona min doonillaahi maa laa yanfa`ukum shay'aw walaa yadurrukum
Uffil lakum walimaa ta`budoona min doonillaah, afalaa ta`qiloon
Qaaloo harriqoohu wansuroo aalihatakum in kuntum faa`ileen
Qulnaa yaanaaru koonee bardaw wasalaaman `alaa ibraaheem
Wa'araadoo bihee kaydan faja`alnaahumul-akhsareen
Wanajjaynaahu walootan ilal-ardil-latee baarakn'a feehaa lil-`aalameen
Wawahabnaa lahoo ishaaqa waya`qooba naafilah, wakullan ja`alnaa saaliheen
Waja`alnaahum a'immatay yahdoona bi'amrinaa wa'awhaynaa ilayhim fi`lal-khayraati wa'iqaamas-salaati wa'eetaa'az-zakaah, wakaanoo lanaa `aabideen
Walootan aataynaahu hukmaw wa`ilmaw wanajjaynaahu minal-qaryatil-latee kaanat ta`malul-khabaa'ith, innahum kaanoo qawma saw'in faasiqeen
Wa'adkhalnaahu fee rahmatinaa, innahoo minas-saaliheen
Wanoohan idh naadaa min qablu fastajabnaa lahoo fanajjaynaahu wa'ahlahoo minal-karbil-`azeem
Wanasarnaahu minal-qawmil-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa, innahum kaanoo qawma saw'in fa'aghraqnaahum ajma`een
Wadaawooda wasulaymaana idh yahkumaani fil-harthi idh nafashat feehi ghanamul-qawm, wakunnaa lihukmihim shaahideen
Fafahhamnaahaa sulaymaan, wakullan aataynaa hukmaw wa`ilmaa, wasakhkharnaa ma`a daawoodal-jibaala yusabbihna wat-tayr, wakunnaa faa`ileen
Wa`allamnaahu san`ata laboosil lakum lituhsinakum mim ba'sikum, fahal antum shaakiroon
Walisulaymaanar-reeha `aasifatan tajree bi'amrihee ilal-ardil-latee baaraknaa feehaa, wakunnaa bikulli shay'in `aalimeen
Waminash-shayaateeni may yaghoosoona lahoo waya`maloona `amalan doona dhaalik, wakunnaa lahum haafizeen
Wa'ayyooba idh naadaa rabbahoo annee massaniyad-durru wa'anta arhamur-raahimeen
Fastajabnaa lahoo fakashafnaa maa bihee min durriw wa'aataynaahu ahlahoo wamithlahum ma`ahum rahmatam min `indinaa wadhikraa lil-`aabideen
Wa'ismaa`eela wa'idreesa wadhal-kifl, kullum minas-saabireen
Wa'adkhalnaahum fee rahmatinaa, innahum minas-saaliheen
Wadhan-nooni idh dhahaba mughaadiban fazanna al lan naqdira `alayhi fanaadaa fiz-zulumaati al laa ilaaha illaa anta subhaanaka innee kuntu minaz-zaalimeen
Fastajabnaa lahoo wanajjaynaahu minal-ghamm, wakadhaalika nujil-mu'mineen
Wazakariyyaa idh naadaa rabbahoo rabbi laa tadharnee fardaw wa'anta khayrul-waaritheen
Fastajabnaa lah, wawahabnaa lahoo yahyaa wa'aslahnaa lahoo zawjah, innahum kaanoo yusaari`oona fil-khayraati wayad`oonanaa raghabaw warahabaa, wakaanoo lanaa khaashi`een
Wal-latee ahsanat farjahaa fanafakhnaa feehaa mir roohinaa waja`alnaahaa wabnahaa aayatal lil-`aalameen
Inna haadhihee ummatukum ummataw waahidah, wa'ana rabbukum fa`budoon
Wataqatta`oo amrahum baynahum, kullun ilaynaa raaji`oon
Famay ya`mal minas-saalihaati wahuwa mu'minun falaa kufraana lisa`yih, wa'innaa lahoo kaatiboon
Waharaamun `alaa qaryatin ahlaknaahaa annahum laa yarji`oon
Hattaa idhaa futihat ya'jooju wama'jooju wahum min kulli hadabiy yansiloon
Waqtarabal-wa`dul-haqqu fa'idhaa hiya shaakhisatun absaarul-ladheena kafaroo, yaawaylanaa qad kunnaa fee ghaflatim min haadhaa bal kunnaa zaalimeen
Innakum wamaa ta`budoona min doonillaahi hasabu jahannam, antum lahaa waaridoon
Law kaana haa'ulaa'i aalihatam maa waradoohaa, wakullun feehaa khaalidoon
Lahum feehaa zafeeruw wahum feehaa laa yasma`oon
Innal-ladheena sabaqat lahum minnal-husnaa ulaa'ika `anhaa mub`adoon
Laa yasma`oona haseesahaa, wahum fee mashtahat anfusuhum khaalidoon
Laa yahzunuhumul-faza`ul-akbaru watatalaqqaahumul-malaa'ikah, haadhaa yawmukumul-ladhee kuntum too`adoon
Yawma natwis-samaa'a katayyis-sijilli lil-kutub, kamaa bada'naa awwala khalqin nu`eeduh, wa`dan `alaynaa, innaa kunnaa faa`ileen
Walaqad katabnaa fiz-zaboori mim ba`didh-dhikri annal-arda yarithuhaa `ibaadiyas-saalihoon
Inna fee haadhaa labalaaghal liqawmin `aabideen
Wamaa arsalnaaka illaa rahmatal lil-`aalameen
Qul innamaa yoohaa ilayya annamaa ilaahukum ilaahuw waahid, fahal antum muslimoon
Fa'in tawallaw faqul aadhantukum `alaa sawaa', wa'in adree aqareebun am ba`eedum maa too`adoon
Innahoo ya`lamul-jahra minal-qawli waya`lamu maa taktumoon
Wa'in adree la`allahoo fitnatul lakum wamataa`un ilaa heen
Qaala rabbihkum bil-haqq, warabbunar-rahmaanul-musta`aanu `alaa maa tasifoon

Yaa ayyuhan-naasuttaqoo rabbakum, inna zalzalatas-saa`ati shay'un `azeem
Yawma tarawnahaa tadhhalu kullu murdi`atin `ammaa arda`at watada`u kullu dhaati hamlin hamlahaa wataran-naasa sukaaraa wamaa hum bisukaaraa walaakinna `adhaaballaahi shadeed
Waminan-naasi may yujaadilu fillaahi bighayri `ilmiw wayattabi`u kulla shaytaanim mareed
Kutiba `alayhi annahoo man tawallaahu fa'annahoo yudilluhoo wayahdeehi ilaa `adhaabis-sa`eer
Yaa ayyuhan-naasu in kuntum fee raybim minal-ba`thi fa'innaa khalaqnaakum min turaabin thumma min nutfatin thumma min `alaqatin thumma mim mudghatim mukhallaqatiw waghayri mukhallaqatil linubayyina lakum, wanuqirru fil-arhaami maa nashaa'u ilaa ajalim musamman thumma nukhrijukum tiflan thumma litablughoo ashuddakum, waminkum may yutawaffaa waminkum may yuraddu ilaa ardhalil-`umuri likaylaa ya`lama mim ba`di `ilmin shay'aa, wataral-arda haamidatan fa'idhaa anzalnaa `alayhal-maa'ahtazzat warabat wa'ambatat min kulli zawjim baheej
Dhaalika bi'annallaaha huwal-haqqu wa'annahoo yuhyil-mawtaa wa'annahoo `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Wa'annas-saa`ata aatiyatul laa rayba feehaa wa'annallaaha yab`athu man fil-quboor
Waminan-naasi may yujaadilu fillaahi bighayri `ilmiw walaa hudaw walaa kitaabim muneer
Thaaniya `itfihee liyudilla `an sabeelillaah, lahoo fid-dunyaa khizyuw wanudheequhoo yawmal-qiyaamati `adhaabal-hareeq
Dhaalika bimaa qaddamat yadaaka wa'annallaaha laysa bizallaamil lil-`abeed
Waminan-naasi may ya`budullaaha `alaa harf, fa'in asaabahoo khayrunitma'anna bih, wa'in asaabathu fitnatuninqalaba `alaa wajhih, khasirad-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, dhaalika huwal-khusraanul-mubeen
Yad`oo min doonillaahi maa laa yadurruhoo wamaa laa yanfa`uh, dhaalika huwad-dalaalul-ba`eed
Yad`oo laman darruhoo aqrabu min naf`ih, labi'sal-mawlaa walabi'sal-`asheer
Innallaaha yudkhilul-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaar, innallaaha yaf`alu maa yureed
Man kaana yazunnu al lay yansurahullaahu fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati falyamdud bisababin ilas-samaa'i thumma lyaqta` falyanzur hal yudhhibanna kayduhoo maa yagheez
Wakadhaalika anzalnaahu aayaatim bayyinaatiw wa'annallaaha yahdee may yureed
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wal-ladheena haadoo was-saabi'eena wan-nasaaraa wal-majoosa wal-ladheena ashrakoo, innallaaha yafsilu baynahum yawmal-qiyaamah, innallaaha `alaa kulli shay'in shaheed
Alam tara annallaaha yasjudu lahoo man fis-samaawaati waman fil-ardi wash-shamsu wal-qamaru wan-nujoomu wal-jibaalu wash-shajaru wad-dawaabbu wakatheerum minan-naas, wakatheerun haqqa `alayhil-`adhaab, wamay yuhinillaahu famaa lahoo mim mukrim, innallaaha yaf`alu maa yashaa'
Haadhaani khasmaanikhtasamoo fee rabbihim fal-ladheena kafaroo qutti`at lahum thiyaabum min naar, yusabbu min fawqi ru'oosihimul-hameem
Yusharu bihee maa fee butoonihim wal-julood
Walahum maqaami`u min hadeed
Kullamaa araadoo ay yakhrujoo minhaa min ghammin u`eedoo feehaa wadhooqoo `adhaabal-hareeq
Innallaaha yudkhilul-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru yuhallawna feehaa min asaawira min dhahabiw walu'lu'aa, walibaasuhum feehaa hareer
Wahudoo ilat-tayyibi minal-qawl, wahudoo ilaa siraatil-hameed
Innal-ladheena kafaroo wayasuddoona `an sabeelillaahi wal-masjidil-haraamil-ladhee ja`alnaahu lin-naasi sawaa'anil-`aakifu feehi wal-baad, wamay yurid feehi bi'ilhaadim bizulmin nudhiqhu min `adhaabin aleem
Wa'idh bawwa'naa li'ibraaheema makaanal-bayti al laa tushrik bee shay'aw watahhir baytiya lit-taa'ifeena wal-qaa'imeena war-rukka`is-sujood
Wa'adhdhin fin-naasi bil-hajji ya'tooka rijaalaw wa`alaa kulli daamiriy ya'teena min kulli fajjin `ameeq
Liyashhadoo manaafi`a lahum wayadhkurusmallaahi fee ayyaamim ma`loomaatin `alaa maa razaqahum mim baheematil-an`aam, fakuloo minhaa wa'at`imul-baa'isal-faqeer
Thumma lyaqdoo tafathahum walyoofoo nudhoorahum walyattawwafoo bil-baytil-`ateeq
Dhaalika wamay yu`azzim hurumaatillaahi fahuwa khayrul lahoo `inda rabbih, wa'uhillat lakumul-an`aamu illaa maa yutlaa `alaykum fajtanibur-rijsa minal-awthaani wajtaniboo qawlaz-zoor
Hunafaa'a lillaahi ghayra mushrikeena bih, wamay yushrik billaahi faka'annamaa kharra minas-samaa'i fatakhtafuhut-tayru aw tahwee bihir-reehu fee makaanin saheeq
Dhaalika wamay yu`azzim sha`aa'irallaahi fa'innahaa min taqwal-quloob
Lakum feehaa manaafi`u ilaa ajalim musamman thumma mahilluhaa ilal-baytil-`ateeq
Walikulli ummatin ja`alnaa mansakal liyadhkurusmallaahi `alaa maa razaqahum mim baheematil-an`aam, fa'ilaahukum ilaahuw waahidun falahoo aslimoo, wabashshiril-mukhbiteen
Al-ladheena idhaa dhukirallaahu wajilat quloobuhum was-saabireena `alaa maa asaabahum wal-muqeemis-salaati wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Wal-budna ja`alnaahaa lakum min sha`aa'irillaahi lakum feehaa khayr, fadhkurusmallaahi `alayhaa sawaaff, fa'idhaa wajabat junoobuhaa fakuloo minhaa wa'at`imul-qaani`a wal-mu`tarr, kadhaalika sakhkharnaahaa lakum la`allakum tashkuroon
Lay yanaalallaaha luhoomuhaa walaa dimaa'uhaa walaakiy yanaaluhut-taqwaa minkum, kadhaalika sakhkharahaa lakum litukabbirullaaha `alaa maa hadaakum, wabashshiril-muhsineen
Innallaaha yudaafi`u `anil-ladheena aamanoo, innallaaha laa yuhibbu kulla khawwaanin kafoor
Udhina lilladheena yuqaataloona bi'annahum zulimoo, wa'innallaaha `alaa nasrihim laqadeer

Laysa `alaykum junaahun an tadkhuloo buyootan ghayra maskoonatin feehaa mataa`ul lakum, wallaahu ya`lamu maa tubdoona wamaa taktumoon
Qul lil-mu'mineena yaghuddoo min absaarihim wayahfazoo furoojahum, dhaalika azkaa lahum, innallaaha khabeerum bimaa yasna`oon
Waqul lil-mu'minaati yaghdudna min absaarihinna wayahfazna furoojahunna walaa yubdeena zeenatahunna illaa maa zahara minhaa walyadribna bikhumurihinna `alaa juyoobihinn, walaa yubdeena zeenatahunna illaa libu`oolatihinna aw aabaa'ihinna aw aabaa'i bu`oolatihinna aw abnaa'ihinna aw abnaa'i bu`oolatihinna aw ikhwaanihinna aw banee ikhwaanihinna aw banee akhawaatihinna aw nisaa'ihinna aw maa malakat aymaanuhunna awit-taabi`eena ghayri ulil-irbati minar-rijaali awit-tiflil-ladheena lam yazharoo `alaa `awraatin-nisaa', walaa yadribna bi'arjulihinna liyu`lama maa yukhfeena min zeenatihinn, watooboo ilallaahi jamee`an ayyuhal-mu'minoona la`allakum tuflihoon
Wa'ankihul-ayaamaa minkum was-saaliheena min `ibaadikum wa'imaa'ikum, iy yakoonoo fuqaraa'a yughnihimullaahu min fadlih, wallaahu waasi`un `aleem
Walyasta`fifil-ladheena laa yajidoona nikaahan hattaa yughniyahumullaahu min fadlih, wal-ladheena yabtaghoonal-kitaaba mimmaa malakat aymaanukum fakaatiboohum in `alimtum feehim khayraw wa'aatoohum mim maalillaahil-ladhee aataakum, walaa tukrihoo fatayaatikum `alal-bighaa'i in aradna tahassunal litabtaghoo `aradal-hayaatid-dunyaa, wamay yukrihhunna fa'innallaaha mim ba`di ikraahihinna ghafoorur raheem
Walaqad anzalnaa ilaykum aayaatim mubayyinaatiw wamathalam minal-ladheena khalaw min qablikum wamaw`izatal lil-muttaqeen
Allaahu noorus-samaawaati wal-ard, mathalu noorihee kamishkaatin feehaa misbaah, al-misbaahu fee zujaajah, az-zujaajatu ka'annahaa kawkabun durriyyuy yooqadu min shajaratim mubaarakatin zaytoonatil laa sharqiyyatiw walaa gharbiyyatiy yakaadu zaytuhaa yudee'u walaw lam tamsashu naar, noorun `alaa noor, yahdillaahu linoorihee may yashaa', wayadribullaahul-amthaala lin-naas, wallaahu bikulli shay'in `aleem
Fee buyootin adhinallaahu an turfa`a wayudhkara feehasmuhoo yusabbihu lahoo feehaa bil-ghuduwwi wal-aasaal
Rijaalul laa tulheehim tijaaratuw walaa bay`un `an dhikrillaahi wa'iqaamis-salaati wa'eetaa'iz-zakaati yakhaafoona yawman tataqallabu feehil-quloobu wal-absaar
Liyajziyahumullaahu ahsana maa `amiloo wayazeedahum min fadlih, wallaahu yarzuqu may yashaa'u bighayri hisaab
Wal-ladheena kafaroo a`maaluhum kasaraabim biqee`atiy yahsabuhuz-zam'aanu maa'aa, hattaa idhaa jaa'ahoo lam yajidhu shay'aw wawajadallaaha `indahoo fawaffaahu hisaabah, wallaahu saree`ul-hisaab
Aw kazulumaatin fee bahril lujjiyyiy yaghshaahu mawjum min fawqihee mawjum min fawqihee sahaab, zulumaatum ba`duhaa fawqa ba`d, idhaa akhraja yadahoo lam yakad yaraahaa, wamal lam yaj`alillaahu lahoo nooran famaa lahoo min noor
Alam tara annallaaha yusabbihu lahoo man fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wat-tayru saaffaat, kullun qad `alima salaatahoo watasbeehah, wallaahu `aleemum bimaa yaf`aloon
Walillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ard, wa'ilallaahil-maseer
Alam tara annallaaha yuzjee sahaaban thumma yu'allifu baynahoo thumma yaj`aluhoo rukaaman fataral-wadqa yakhruju min khilaalih, wayunazzilu minas-samaa'i min jibaalin feehaa mim baradin fayuseebu bihee may yashaa'u wayasrifuhoo `am may yashaa', yakaadu sanaa barqihee yadhhabu bil-absaar
Yuqallibullaahul-layla wan-nahaar, inna fee dhaalika la`ibratal li'ulil-absaar
Wallaahu khalaqa kulla daabbatim mim maa', faminhum may yamshee `alaa batnih, waminhum may yamshee `alaa rijlayn, waminhum may yamshee `alaa arba`, yakhluqullaahu maa yashaa', innallaaha `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Laqad anzalnaa aayaatim mubayyinaat, wallaahu yahdee may yashaa'u ilaa siraatim mustaqeem
Wayaqooloona aamannaa billaahi wabir-rasooli wa'ata`naa thumma yatawallaa fareequm minhum mim ba`di dhaalik, wamaa ulaa'ika bil-mu'mineen
Wa'idhaa du`oo ilallaahi warasoolihee liyahkuma baynahum idhaa fareequm minhum mu`ridoon
Wa'iy yakul lahumul-haqqu ya'too ilayhi mudh`ineen
Afee quloobihim maradun amirtaaboo am yakhaafoona ay yaheefallaahu `alayhim warasooluh, bal ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon
Innamaa kaana qawlal-mu'mineena idhaa du`oo ilallaahi warasoolihee liyahkuma baynahum ay yaqooloo sami`naa wa'ata`naa, wa'ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
Wamay yuti`illaaha warasoolahoo wayakhshallaaha wayattaqhi fa'ulaa'ika humul-faa'izoon
Wa'aqsamoo billaahi jahda aymaanihim la'in amartahum layakhrujunn, qul laa tuqsimoo, taa`atum ma`roofah, innallaaha khabeerum bimaa ta`maloon
Qul atee`ullaaha wa'atee`ur-rasool, fa'in tawallaw fa'innamaa `alayhi maa hummila wa`alaykum maa hummiltum, wa'in tutee`oohu tahtadoo, wamaa `alar-rasooli illal-balaaghul-mubeen
Wa`adallaahul-ladheena aamanoo minkum wa`amilus-saalihaati layastakhlifannahum fil-ardi kamastakhlafal-ladheena min qablihim, walayumakkinanna lahum deenahumul-ladhirtadaa lahum walayubaddilannahum mim ba`di khawfihim amnaa, ya`budoonanee laa yushrikoona bee shay'aa, waman kafara ba`da dhaalika fa'ulaa'ika humul-faasiqoon
Wa'aqeemus-salaata wa'aatuz-zakaata wa'atee`ur-rasoola la`allakum turhamoon
Laa tahsabannal-ladheena kafaroo mu`jizeena fil-ard, wama'waahumun-naar, walabi'sal-maseer
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo liyasta'dhinkumul-ladheena malakat aymaanukum wal-ladheena lam yablughul-huluma minkum thalaatha marraat, min qabli salaatil-fajri waheena tada`oona thiyaabakum minaz-zaheerati wamim ba`di salaatil-`ishaa', thalaathu `awraatil lakum, laysa `alaykum walaa `alayhim junaahum ba`dahunn, tawwaafoona `alaykum ba`dukum `alaa ba`d, kadhaalika yubayyinullaahu lakumul-aayaat, wallaahu `aleemun hakeem
Wa'idhaa balaghal-atfaalu minkumul-huluma falyasta'dhinoo kamasta'dhanal-ladheena min qablihim, kadhaalika yubayyinullaahu lakum aayaatih, wallaahu `aleemun hakeem
Wal-qawaa`idu minan-nisaa'illaatee laa yarjoona nikaahan falaysa `alayhinna junaahun ay yada`na thiyaabahunna ghayra mutabarrijaatim bizeenah, wa'ay yasta`fifna khayrul lahunn, wallaahu samee`un `aleem
Laysa `alal-a`maa harajuw walaa `alal-a`raji harajuw walaa `alal-mareedi harajuw walaa `alaa anfusikum an ta'kuloo mim buyootikum aw buyooti aabaa'ikum aw buyooti ummahaatikum aw buyooti ikhwaanikum aw buyooti akhawaatikum aw buyooti a`maamikum aw buyooti `ammaatikum aw buyooti akhwaalikum aw buyooti khaalaatikum aw maa malaktum mafaatihahoo aw sadeeqikum, laysa `alaykum junaahun an ta'kuloo jamee`an aw ashtaataa, fa'idhaa dakhaltum buyootan fasallimoo `alaa anfusikum tahiyyatam min `indillaahi mubaarakatan tayyibah, kadhaalika yubayyinullaahu lakumul-aayaati la`allakum ta`qiloon
Innamal-mu'minoonal-ladheena aamanoo billaahi warasoolihee wa'idhaa kaanoo ma`ahoo `alaa amrin jaami`il lam yadhhaboo hattaa yasta'dhinooh, innal-ladheena yasta'dhinoonaka ulaa'ikal-ladheena yu'minoona billaahi warasoolih, fa'idhasta'dhanooka liba`di sha'nihim fa'dhal liman shi'ta minhum wastaghfir lahumullaah, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
Laa taj`aloo du`aa'ar-rasooli baynakum kadu`aa'i ba`dikum ba`daa, qad ya`lamullaahul-ladheena yatasallaloona minkum liwaadhaa, falyahdharil-ladheena yukhaalifoona `an amrihee an tuseebahum fitnatun aw yuseebahum `adhaabun aleem
Alaa inna lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, qad ya`lamu maa antum `alayh, wayawma yurja`oona ilayhi fayunabbi'uhum bimaa `amiloo, wallaahu bikulli shay'in `aleem

Tabaarakal-ladhee nazzalal-furqaana `alaa `abdihee liyakoona lil-`aalameena nadheeraa
Al-ladhee lahoo mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi walam yattakhidh waladaw walam yakul lahoo shareekun fil-mulki wakhalaqa kulla shay'in faqaddarahoo taqdeeraa
Wattakhadhoo min doonihee aalihatal laa yakhluqoona shay'aw wahum yukhlaqoona walaa yamlikoona li'anfusihim darraw walaa naf`aw walaa yamlikoona mawtaw walaa hayaataw walaa nushooraa
Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo in haadhaa illaa ifkuniftaraahu wa'a`aanahoo `alayhi qawmun aakharoon, faqad jaa'oo zulmaw wazooraa
Waqaaloo asaateerul-awwaleenaktatabahaa fahiya tumlaa `alayhi bukrataw wa'aseelaa
Qul anzalahul-ladhee ya`lamus-sirra fis-samaawaati wal-ard, innahoo kaana ghafoorar raheemaa
Waqaaloo maali haadhar-rasooli ya'kulut-ta`aama wayamshee fil-aswaaq, lawlaa unzila ilayhi malakun fayakoona ma`ahoo nadheeraa
Aw yulqaa ilayhi kanzun aw takoonu lahoo jannatuy ya'kulu minhaa, waqaalaz-zaalimoona in tattabi`oona illaa rajulam mashooraa
Unzur kayfa daraboo lakal-amthaala fadalloo falaa yastatee`oona sabeelaa
Tabaarakal-ladhee in shaa'a ja`ala laka khayram min dhaalika jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru wayaj`al laka qusooraa
Bal kadhdhaboo bis-saa`ati wa'a`tadnaa liman kadhdhaba bis-saa`ati sa`eeraa
Idhaa ra'athum mim makaanim ba`eedin sami`oo lahaa taghayyuzaw wazafeeraa
Wa'idhaa ulqoo minhaa makaanan dayyiqam muqarraneena da`aw hunaalika thubooraa
Laa tad`ul-yawma thubooraw waahidaw wad`oo thubooran katheeraa
Qul adhaalika khayrun am jannatul-khuldil-latee wu`idal-muttaqoon, kaanat lahum jazaa'aw wamaseeraa
Lahum feehaa maa yashaa'oona khaalideen, kaana `alaa rabbika wa`dam mas'oolaa
Wayawma yahshuruhum wamaa ya`budoona min doonillaahi fayaqoolu a'antum adlaltum `ibaadee haa'ulaa'i am hum dallus-sabeel
Qaaloo subhaanaka maa kaana yambaghee lanaa an nattakhidha min doonika min awliyaa'a walaakim matta`tahum wa'aabaa'ahum hattaa nasudh-dhikr, wakaanoo qawmam booraa
Faqad kadhdhabookum bimaa taqooloona famaa tastatee`oona sarfaw walaa nasraa, wamay yazlim minkum nudhiqhu `adhaaban kabeeraa
Wamaa arsalnaa qablaka minal-mursaleena illaa innahum laya'kuloonat-ta`aama wayamshoona fil-aswaaq, waja`alnaa ba`dakum liba`din fitnah, atasbiroon, wakaana rabbuka baseeraa
Waqaalal-ladheena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa lawlaa unzila `alaynal-malaa'ikatu aw naraa rabbanaa, laqadistakbaroo fee anfusihim wa`ataw `utuwwan kabeeraa
Yawma yarawnal-malaa'ikata laa bushraa yawma'idhil lil-mujrimeena wayaqooloona hijram mahjooraa
Waqadimnaa ilaa maa `amiloo min `amalin faja`alnaahu habaa'am manthooraa
Ashaabul-jannati yawma'idhin khayrum mustaqarraw wa'ahsanu maqeelaa
Wayawma tashaqqaqus-samaa'u bil-ghamaami wanuzzilal-malaa'ikatu tanzeelaa
Al-mulku yawma'idhinil-haqqu lir-rahmaan, wakaana yawman `alal-kaafireena `aseeraa
Wayawma ya`adduz-zaalimu `alaa yadayhi yaqoolu yaalaytanittakhadhtu ma`ar-rasooli sabeelaa
Yaawaylataa laytanee lam attakhidh fulaanan khaleelaa
Laqad adallanee `anidh-dhikri ba`da idh jaa'anee, wakaanash-shaytaanu lil-insaani khadhoolaa
Waqaalar-rasoolu yaarabbi inna qawmittakhadhoo haadhal-qur'aana mahjooraa
Wakadhaalika ja`alnaa likulli nabiyyin `aduwwam minal-mujrimeen, wakafaa birabbika haadiyaw wanaseeraa
Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo lawlaa nuzzila `alayhil-qur'aanu jumlataw waahidatan kadhaalik, linuthabbita bihee fu'aadaka warattalnaahu tarteelaa
Walaa ya'toonaka bimathalin illaa ji'naaka bil-haqqi wa'ahsana tafseeraa
Alladheena yuhsharoona `alaa wujoohihim ilaa jahannama ulaa'ika sharrum makaanaw wa'adallu sabeelaa
Walaqad aataynaa moosal-kitaaba waja`alnaa ma`ahoo akhaahu haaroona wazeeraa
Faqulnadhhabaa ilal-qawmil-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa, fadammarnaahum tadmeeraa
Waqawma noohil lammaa kadhdhabur-rusula aghraqnaahum waja`alnaahum lin-naasi aayah, wa'a`tadnaa liz-zaalimeena `adhaaban aleemaa
Wa`aadaw wathamooda wa'ashaabar-rassi waquroonam bayna dhaalika katheeraa
Wakullan darabnaa lahul-amthaal, wakullan tabbarnaa tatbeeraa
Walaqad ataw `alal-qaryatil-latee umtirat mataras-saw', afalam yakoonoo yarawnahaa, bal kaanoo laa yarjoona nushooraa
Wa'idhaa ra'awka iy yattakhidhoonaka illaa huzuwaa, ahaadhal-ladhee ba`athallaahu rasoolaa
In kaada layudillunaa `an aalihatinaa lawlaa an sabarnaa `alayhaa, wasawfa ya`lamoona heena yarawnal-`adhaaba man adallu sabeelaa
Ara'ayta manittakhadha ilaahahoo hawaah, afa'anta takoonu `alayhi wakeelaa
Am tahsabu anna aktharahum yasma`oona aw ya`qiloon, in hum illaa kal-an`aami bal hum adallu sabeelaa
Alam tara ilaa rabbika kayfa maddaz-zill, walaw shaa'a laja`alahoo saakinaa, thumma ja`alnash-shamsa `alayhi daleelaa
Thumma qabadnaahu ilaynaa qabday yaseeraa
Wahuwal-ladhee ja`ala lakumul-layla libaasaw wan-nawma subaataw waja`alan-nahaara nushooraa
Wahuwal-ladhee arsalar-riyaaha bushram bayna yaday rahmatih, wa'anzalnaa minas-samaa'i maa'an tahooraa
Linuhyi bihee baldatam maytaw wanusqiyahoo mimmaa khalaqnaa an`aamaw wa'anaasiyya katheeraa
Walaqad sarrafnaahu baynahum liyadhdhakkaroo, fa'abaa aktharun-naasi illaa kufooraa
Walaw shi'naa laba`athnaa fee kulli qaryatin nadheeraa
Falaa tuti`il-kaafireena wajaahidhum bihee jihaadan kabeeraa
Wahuwal-ladhee marajal-bahrayni haadhaa `adhbun furaatuw wahaadhaa milhun ujaaj, waja`ala baynahumaa barzakhaw wahijram mahjooraa
Wahuwal-ladhee khalaqa minal-maa'i basharan faja`alahoo nasabaw wasihraa, wakaana rabbuka qadeeraa
Waya`budoona min doonillaahi maa laa yanfa`uhum walaa yadurruhum, wakaanal-kaafiru `alaa rabbihee zaheeraa
Wamaa arsalnaaka illaa mubashshiraw wanadheeraa
Qul maa as'alukum `alayhi min ajrin illaa man shaa'a ay yattakhidha ilaa rabbihee sabeelaa
Watawakkal `alal-hayyil-ladhee laa yamootu wasabbih bihamdih, wakafaa bihee bidhunoobi `ibaadihee khabeeraa
Alladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa fee sittati ayyaamin thummastawaa `alal-`arsh, ar-rahmaanu fas'al bihee khabeeraa
Wa'idhaa qeela lahumusjudoo lir-rahmaani qaaloo wamar-rahmaanu anasjudu limaa ta'murunaa wazaadahum nufooraa
Tabaarakal-ladhee ja`ala fis-samaa'i buroojaw waja`ala feehaa siraajaw waqamaram muneeraa
Wahuwal-ladhee ja`alal-layla wan-nahaara khilfatal liman araada ay yadhdhakkara aw araada shukooraa
Wa`ibaadur-rahmaanil-ladheena yamshoona `alal-ardi hawnaw wa'idhaa khaatabahumul-jaahiloona qaaloo salaamaa
Wal-ladheena yabeetoona lirabbihim sujjadaw waqiyaamaa
Wal-ladheena yaqooloona rabbanasrif `annaa `adhaaba jahannam, inna `adhaabahaa kaana gharaamaa
Innahaa saa'at mustaqarraw wamuqaamaa
Wal-ladheena idhaa anfaqoo lam yusrifoo walam yaqturoo wakaana bayna dhaalika qawaamaa
Wal-ladheena laa yad`oona ma`allaahi ilaahan aakhara walaa yaqtuloonan-nafsal-latee harramallaahu illaa bil-haqqi walaa yaznoon, wamay yaf`al dhaalika yalqa athaamaa
Yudaa`af lahul-`adhaabu yawmal-qiyaamati wayakhlud feehee muhaanaa
Illaa man taaba wa'aamana wa`amila `amalan saalihan fa'ulaa'ika yubaddilullaahu sayyi'aatihim hasanaat, wakaanallaahu ghafoorar raheemaa
Waman taaba wa`amila saalihan fa'innahoo yatoobu ilallaahi mataabaa
Wal-ladheena laa yashhadoonaz-zoora wa'idhaa marroo bil-laghwi marroo kiraamaa
Wal-ladheena idhaa dhukkiroo bi'aayaati rabbihim lam yakhirroo `alayhaa summaw wa`umyaanaa
Wal-ladheena yaqooloona rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wadhurriyyaatinaa qurrata a`yuniw waj`alnaa lil-muttaqeena imaamaa
Ulaa'ika yujzawnal-ghurfata bimaa sabaroo wayulaqqawna feehaa tahiyyataw wasalaamaa
Khaalideena feehaa, hasunat mustaqarraw wamuqaamaa
Qul maa ya`ba'u bikum rabbee lawlaa du`aa'ukum, faqad kadhdhabtum fasawfa yakoonu lizaamaa
