Wanumakkina lahum fil-ardi wanuriya fir`awna wahaamaana wajunoodahumaa minhum maa kaanoo yahdharoon
Wa'awhaynaa ilaa ummi moosaa an ardi`eeh, fa'idhaa khifti `alayhi fa'alqeehi fil-yammi walaa takhaafee walaa tahzanee, innaa raaddoohu ilayki wajaa`iloohu minal-mursaleen
Fal-taqatahoo aalu fir`awna liyakoona lahum `aduwwaw wahazanaa, inna fir`awna wahaamaana wajunoodahumaa kaanoo khaati'een
Waqaalatimra'atu fir`awna qurratu `aynil lee walak, laa taqtulooh, `asaa ay yanfa`anaa aw nattakhidhahoo waladaw wahum laa yash`uroon
Wa'asbaha fu'aadu ummi moosaa faarighaa, in kaadat latubdee bihee lawlaa ar rabatnaa `alaa qalbihaa litakoona minal-mu'mineen
Waqaalat li'ukhtihee qusseeh, fabasurat bihee `an junubiw wahum laa yash`uroon
Waharramnaa `alayhil-maraadi`a min qablu faqaalat hal adullukum `alaa ahli baytiy yakfuloonahoo lakum wahum lahoo naasihoon
Faradadnaahu ilaa ummihee kay taqarra `aynuhaa walaa tahzana walita`lama anna wa`dallaahi haqquw walaakinna aktharahum laa ya`lamoon
Walammaa balagha ashuddahoo wastawaa aataynaahu hukmaw wa`ilmaa, wakadhaalika najzil-muhsineen
Wadakhalal-madeenata `alaa heeni ghaflatim min ahlihaa fawajada feehaa rajulayni yaqtatilaan, haadhaa min shee`atihee wahaadhaa min `aduwwih, fastaghaathahul-ladhee min shee`atihee `alal-ladhee min `aduwwihee fawakazahoo moosaa faqadaa `alayh, qaala haadhaa min `amalish-shaytaan, innahoo `aduwwum mudillum mubeen
Qaala rabbi innee zalamtu nafsee faghfir lee faghafara lah, innahoo huwal-ghafoorur-raheem
Qaala rabbi bimaa an`amta `alayya falan akoona zaheeral lil-mujrimeen
Fa'asbaha fil-madeenati khaa'ifay yataraqqabu fa'idhal-ladhistansarahoo bil-amsi yastasrikhuh, qaala lahoo moosaa innaka laghawiyyum mubeen
Falammaa an araada ay yabtisha bil-ladhee huwa `aduwwul lahumaa qaala yaamoosaa atureedu an taqtulanee kamaa qatalta nafsam bil-ams, in tureedu illaa an takoona jabbaaran fil-ardi wamaa tureedu an takoona minal-musliheen
Wajaa'a rajulum min aqsal-madeenati yas`aa, qaala yaamoosaa innal-mala'a ya'tamiroona bika liyaqtulooka fakhruj innee laka minan-naasiheen
Fakharaja minhaa khaa'ifay yataraqqab, qaala rabbi najjinee minal-qawmiz-zaalimeen
Walammaa tawajjaha tilqaa'a madyana qaala `asaa rabbee ay yahdiyanee sawaa'as-sabeel
Walammaa warada maa'a madyana wajada `alayhi ummatam minan-naasi yasqoon, wawajada min doonihimumra'atayni tadhoodaan, qaala maa khatbukumaa, qaalataa laa nasqee hattaa yusdirar-ri`aa'u wa'aboonaa shaykhun kabeer
Fasaqaa lahumaa thumma tawallaa ilaz-zilli faqaala rabbi innee limaa anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqeer
Fajaa'athu ihdaahumaa tamshee `alastihyaa', qaalat inna abee yad`ooka liyajziyaka ajra maa saqayta lanaa, falammaa jaa'ahoo waqassa `alayhil-qasasa qaala laa takhaf, najawta minal-qawmiz-zaalimeen
Qaalat ihdaahumaa yaa abatista'jirh, inna khayra manista'jartal-qawiyyul-ameen
Qaala innee ureedu an unkihaka ihdabnatayya haatayni `alaa an ta'juranee thamaaniya hijaj, fa'in atmamta `ashran famin `indik, wamaa ureedu an ashuqqa `alayk, satajidunee in shaa'allaahu minas-saaliheen
Qaala dhaalika baynee wabaynak, ayyamal-ajalayni qadaytu falaa `udwaana `alayy, wallaahu `alaa maa naqoolu wakeel
Falammaa qadaa moosal-ajala wasaara bi'ahlihee aanasa min jaanibit-toori naaraa, qaala li'ahlihimkuthoo innee aanastu naaral la`allee aateekum minhaa bikhabarin aw jadhwatim minan-naari la`allakum tastaloon
Falammaa ataahaa noodiya min shaati'il-waadil-aymani fil-buq`atil-mubaarakati minash-shajarati ay yaamoosaa innee anallaahu rabbul-`aalameen
Wa'an alqi `asaak, falammaa ra'aahaa tahtazzu ka'annahaa jaannuw wallaa mudbiraw walam yu`aqqib, yaamoosaa aqbil walaa takhaf, innaka minal-aamineen
Usluk yadaka fee jaybika takhruj baydaa'a min ghayri soo', wadmum ilayka janaahaka minar-rahbi fadhaanika burhaanaani mir rabbika ilaa fir`awna wamala'ih, innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen
Qaala rabbi innee qataltu minhum nafsan fa'akhaafu ay yaqtuloon
Wa'akhee haaroonu huwa afsahu minnee lisaanan fa'arsilhu ma`iya rid'ay yusaddiqunee, innee akhaafu ay yukadhdhiboon
Qaala sanashuddu `adudaka bi'akheeka wanaj`alu lakumaa sultaanan falaa yasiloona ilaykumaa bi'aayaatinaa, antumaa wamanittaba`akumal-ghaaliboon
Falammaa jaa'ahum moosaa bi'aayaatinaa bayyinaatin qaaloo maa haadhaa illaa sihrum muftaraw wamaa sami`naa bihaadhaa fee aabaa'inal-awwaleen
Waqaala moosaa rabbee a`lamu biman jaa'a bil-hudaa min `indihee waman takoonu lahoo `aaqibatud-daar, innahoo laa yuflihuz-zaalimoon
Waqaala fir`awnu yaa ayyuhal-mala'u maa `alimtu lakum min ilaahin ghayree, fa'awqid lee yaahaamaanu `alat-teeni faj`al lee sarhal la`allee attali`u ilaa ilaahi moosaa wa'innee la'azunnuhoo minal-kaadhibeen
Wastakbara huwa wajunooduhoo fil-ardi bighayril-haqqi wazannoo annahum ilaynaa laa yurja`oon
Fa'akhadhnaahu wajunoodahoo fanabadhnaahum fil-yamm, fanzur kayfa kaana `aaqibatuz-zaalimeen
Waja`alnaahum a'immatay yad`oona ilan-naar, wayawmal-qiyaamati laa yunsaroon
Wa'atba`naahum fee haadhihid-dunyaa la`nah, wayawmal-qiyaamati hum minal-maqbooheen
Walaqad aataynaa moosal-kitaaba mim ba`di maa ahlaknal-quroonal-oolaa basaa'ira lin-naasi wahudaw warahmatal la`allahum yatadhakkaroon
Wamaa kunta bijaanibil-gharbiyyi idh qadaynaa ilaa moosal-amra wamaa kunta minash-shaahideen
Walaakinnaa ansha'naa quroonan fatataawala `alayhimul-`umur, wamaa kunta thaawiyan fee ahli madyana tatloo `alayhim aayaatinaa walaakinnaa kunnaa mursileen
Wamaa kunta bijaanibit-toori idh naadaynaa walaakir rahmatam mir rabbika litundhira qawmam maa ataahum min nadheerim min qablika la`allahum yatadhakkaroon
Walawlaa an tuseebahum museebatum bimaa qaddamat aydeehim fayaqooloo rabbanaa lawlaa arsalta ilaynaa rasoolan fanattabi`a aayaatika wanakoona minal-mu'mineen
Falammaa jaa'ahumul-haqqu min `indinaa qaaloo lawlaa ootiya mithla maa ootiya moosaa, awalam yakfuroo bimaa ootiya moosaa min qabl, qaaloo sihraani tazaaharaa, waqaaloo innaa bikullin kaafiroon
Qul fa'too bikitaabim min `indillaahi huwa ahdaa minhumaa attabi`hu in kuntum saadiqeen
Fa'il lam yastajeeboo laka fa`lam annamaa yattabi`oona ahwaa'ahum, waman adallu mimmanittaba`a hawaahu bighayri hudam minallaah, innallaaha laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
Walaqad wassalnaa lahumul-qawla la`allahum yatadhakkaroon
Alladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba min qablihee hum bihee yu'minoon
Wa'idhaa yutlaa `alayhim qaaloo aamannaa bihee innahul-haqqu mir rabbinaa innaa kunnaa min qablihee muslimeen
Ulaa'ika yu'tawna ajrahum marratayni bimaa sabaroo wayadra'oona bil-hasanatis-sayyi'ata wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Wa'idhaa sami`ul-laghwa a`radoo `anhu waqaaloo lanaa a`maalunaa walakum a`maalukum, salaamun `alaykum, laa nabtaghil-jaahileen
Innaka laa tahdee man ahbabta walaakinnallaaha yahdee may yashaa', wahuwa a`lamu bil-muhtadeen
Waqaaloo in nattabi`il-hudaa ma`aka nutakhattaf min ardinaa, awalam numakkil lahum haraman aaminay yujbaa ilayhi thamaraatu kulli shay'ir rizqam mil ladunnaa walaakinna aktharahum laa ya`lamoon
Wakam ahlaknaa min qaryatim batirat ma`eeshatahaa, fatilka masaakinuhum lam tuskam mim ba`dihim illaa qaleelaa, wakunnaa nahnul-waaritheen
Wamaa kaana rabbuka muhlikal-quraa hattaa yab`atha fee ummihaa rasoolay yatloo `alayhim aayaatinaa, wamaa kunnaa muhlikil-quraa illaa wa'ahluhaa zaalimoon
Wamaa ooteetum min shay'in famataa`ul-hayaatid-dunyaa wazeenatuhaa, wamaa `indallaahi khayruw wa'abqaa, afalaa ta`qiloon
Afamaw wa`adnaahu wa`dan hasanan fahuwa laaqeehi kamam matta`naahu mataa`al-hayaatid-dunyaa thumma huwa yawmal-qiyaamati minal-muhdareen
Wayawma yunaadeehim fayaqoolu ayna shurakaa'iyal-ladheena kuntum taz`umoon
Qaalal-ladheena haqqa `alayhimul-qawlu rabbanaa haa'ulaa'il-ladheena aghwaynaa, aghwaynaahum kamaa ghawaynaa, tabarra'naa ilayka maa kaanoo iyyaanaa ya`budoon
Waqeelad`oo shurakaa'akum fada`awhum falam yastajeeboo lahum, wara'awul-`adhaab, law annahum kaanoo yahtadoon
Wayawma yunaadeehim fayaqoolu maadhaa ajabtumul-mursaleen
Fa`amiyat `alayhimul-ambaa'u yawma'idhin fahum laa yatasaa'aloon
Fa'ammaa man taaba wa'aamana wa`amila saalihan fa`asaa ay yakoona minal-mufliheen
Warabbuka yakhluqu maa yashaa'u wayakhtaar, maa kaana lahumul-khiyarah, subhaanallaahi wata`aalaa `ammaa yushrikoon
Warabbuka ya`lamu maa tukinnu sudooruhum wamaa yu`linoon
Wahuwallaahu laa ilaaha illaa huw, lahul-hamdu fil-oolaa wal-aakhirah, walahul-hukmu wa'ilayhi turja`oon
Qul ara'aytum in ja`alallaahu `alaykumul-layla sarmadan ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati man ilaahun ghayrullaahi ya'teekum bidiyaa', afalaa tasma`oon
Qul ara'aytum in ja`alallaahu `alaykumun-nahaara sarmadan ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati man ilaahun ghayrullaahi ya'teekum bilaylin taskunoona feeh, afalaa tubsiroon
Wamir rahmatihee ja`ala lakumul-layla wan-nahaara litaskunoo feehi walitabtaghoo min fadlihee wala`allakum tashkuroon
Wayawma yunaadeehim fayaqoolu ayna shurakaa'iyal-ladheena kuntum taz`umoon
Wanaza`naa min kulli ummatin shaheedan faqulnaa haatoo burhaanakum fa`alimoo annal-haqqa lillaahi wadalla `anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon
Inna qaaroona kaana min qawmi moosaa fabaghaa `alayhim, wa'aataynaahu minal-kunoozi maa inna mafaatihahoo latanoo'u bil-`usbati ulil-quwwati idh qaala lahoo qawmuhoo laa tafrah innallaaha laa yuhibbul-fariheen
Wabtaghi feemaa aataakallaahud-daaral-aakhirata walaa tansa naseebaka minad-dunyaa wa'ahsin kamaa ahsanallaahu ilayka walaa tabghil-fasaada fil-ard, innallaaha laa yuhibbul-mufsideen
Qaala innamaa ooteetuhoo `alaa `ilmin `indee, awalam ya`lam annallaaha qad ahlaka min qablihee minal-qurooni man huwa ashaddu minhu quwwataw wa'aktharu jam`aa, walaa yus'alu `an dhunoobihimul-mujrimoon
Fakharaja `alaa qawmihee fee zeenatih, qaalal-ladheena yureedoonal-hayaatad-dunyaa yaalayta lanaa mithla maa ootiya qaaroonu innahoo ladhoo hazzin `azeem
Waqaalal-ladheena ootul-`ilma waylakum thawaabullaahi khayrul liman aamana wa`amila saalihaa, walaa yulaqqaahaa illas-saabiroon
Fakhasafnaa bihee wabidaarihil-ard, famaa kaana lahoo min fi'atiy yansuroonahoo min doonillaah, wamaa kaana minal-muntasireen
Wa'asbahal-ladheena tamannaw makaanahoo bil-amsi yaqooloona wayka'annallaaha yabsutur-rizqa limay yashaa'u min `ibaadihee wayaqdir, lawlaa am mannallaahu `alaynaa lakhasafa binaa, wayka'annahoo laa yuflihul-kaafiroon
Tilkad-daarul-aakhiratu naj`aluhaa lilladheena laa yureedoona `uluwwan fil-ardi walaa fasaadaa, wal-`aaqibatu lil-muttaqeen
Man jaa'a bil-hasanati falahoo khayrum minhaa, waman jaa'a bis-sayyi'ati falaa yujzal-ladheena `amilus-sayyi'aati illaa maa kaanoo ya`maloon
Innal-ladhee farada `alaykal-qur'aana laraadduka ilaa ma`aad, qur rabbee a`lamu man jaa'a bil-hudaa waman huwa fee dalaalim mubeen
Wamaa kunta tarjoo ay yulqaa ilaykal-kitaabu illaa rahmatam mir rabbika falaa takoonanna zaheeral lil-kaafireen
Walaa yasuddunnaka `an aayaatillaahi ba`da idh unzilat ilayka wad`u ilaa rabbika walaa takoonanna minal-mushrikeen
Walaa tad`u ma`allaahi ilaahan aakhar, laa ilaaha illaa huw, kullu shay'in haalikun illaa wajhah, lahul-hukmu wa'ilayhi turja`oon

Alif laam meem
Ahasiban-naasu ay yutrakoo ay yaqooloo aamannaa wahum laa yuftanoon
Walaqad fatannal-ladheena min qablihim falaya`lamannallaahul-ladheena sadaqoo walaya`lamannal-kaadhibeen
Am hasibal-ladheena ya`maloonas-sayyi'aati ay yasbiqoonaa, saa'a maa yahkumoon
Man kaana yarjoo liqaa'allaahi fa'inna ajalallaahi la'aat, wahuwas-samee`ul-`aleem
Waman jaahada fa'innamaa yujaahidu linafsih, innallaaha laghaniyyun `anil-`aalameen
Wal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati lanukaffiranna `anhum sayyi'aatihim walanajziyannahum ahsanal-ladhee kaanoo ya`maloon
Wawassaynal-insaana biwaalidayhi husnaa, wa'in jaahadaaka litushrika bee maa laysa laka bihee `ilmun falaa tuti`humaa, ilayya marji`ukum fa'unabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta`maloon
Wal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati lanudkhilannahum fis-saaliheen
Waminan-naasi may yaqoolu aamannaa billaahi fa'idhaa oodhiya fillaahi ja`ala fitnatan-naasi ka`adhaabillaah, wala'in jaa'a nasrum mir rabbika layaqoolunna innaa kunnaa ma`akum, awalaysallaahu bi'a`lama bimaa fee sudooril-`aalameen
Walaya`lamannallaahul-ladheena aamanoo walaya`lamannal-munaafiqeen
Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo lilladheena aamanuttabi`oo sabeelanaa walnahmil khataayaakum, wamaa hum bihaamileena min khataayaahum min shay', innahum lakaadhiboon
Walayahmilunna athqaalahum wa'athqaalam ma`a athqaalihim walayus'alunna yawmal-qiyaamati `ammaa kaanoo yaftaroon
Walaqad arsalnaa noohan ilaa qawmihee falabitha feehim alfa sanatin illaa khamseena `aamaa, fa'akhadhahumut-toofaanu wahum zaalimoon
Fa'anjaynaahu wa'ashaabas-safeenati waja`alnaahaa aayatal lil-`aalameen
Wa'ibraaheema idh qaala liqawmihi`budullaaha wattaqooh, dhaalikum khayrul lakum in kuntum ta`lamoon
Innamaa ta`budoona min doonillaahi awthaanaw watakhluqoona ifkaa, innal-ladheena ta`budoona min doonillaahi laa yamlikoona lakum rizqan fabtaghoo `indallaahir-rizqa wa`budoohu washkuroo lah, ilayhi turja`oon
Wa'in tukadhdhiboo faqad kadhdhaba umamum min qablikum, wamaa `alar-rasooli illal-balaaghul-mubeen
Awalam yaraw kayfa yubdi'ullaahul-khalqa thumma yu`eeduh, inna dhaalika `alallaahi yaseer
Qul seeroo fil-ardi fanzuroo kayfa bada'al-khalqa thummallaahu yunshi'un-nash'atal-aakhirah, innallaaha `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Yu`adhdhibu may yashaa'u wayarhamu may yashaa', wa'ilayhi tuqlaboon
Wamaa antum bimu`jizeena fil-ardi walaa fis-samaa', wamaa lakum min doonillaahi miw waliyyiw walaa naseer
Wal-ladheena kafaroo bi'aayaatillaahi waliqaa'ihee ulaa'ika ya'isoo mir rahmatee wa'ulaa'ika lahum `adhaabun aleem
Famaa kaana jawaaba qawmihee illaa an qaaluqtuloohu aw harriqoohu fa'anjaahullaahu minan-naar, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy yu'minoon
Waqaala innamattakhadhtum min doonillaahi awthaanam mawaddata baynikum fil-hayaatid-dunyaa, thumma yawmal-qiyaamati yakfuru ba`dukum biba`diw wayal`anu ba`dukum ba`daa, wama'waakumun-naaru wamaa lakum min naasireen
Fa'aamana lahoo loot, waqaala innee muhaajirun ilaa rabbee, innahoo huwal-`azeezul-hakeem
Wawahabnaa lahoo ishaaqa waya`qooba waja`alnaa fee dhurriyyatihin-nubuwwata wal-kitaaba wa'aataynaahu ajrahoo fid-dunyaa, wa'innahoo fil-aakhirati laminas-saaliheen
Walootan idh qaala liqawmihee innakum lata'toonal-faahishah, maa sabaqakum bihaa min ahadim minal-`aalameen
A'innakum lata'toonar-rijaala wataqta`oonas-sabeela wata'toona fee naadeekumul-munkar, famaa kaana jawaaba qawmihee illaa an qaalu'tinaa bi`adhaabillaahi in kunta minas-saadiqeen
Qaala rabbinsurnee `alal-qawmil-mufsideen
Walammaa jaa'at rusulunaa ibraaheema bil-bushraa qaaloo innaa muhlikoo ahli haadhihil-qaryah, inna ahlahaa kaanoo zaalimeen
Qaala inna feehaa lootaa, qaaloo nahnu a`lamu biman feehaa, lanunajjiyannahoo wa'ahlahoo illamra'atahoo kaanat minal-ghaabireen
Walammaa an jaa'at rusulunaa lootan see'a bihim wadaaqa bihim dhar`aw waqaaloo laa takhaf walaa tahzan, innaa munajjooka wa'ahlaka illamra'ataka kaanat minal-ghaabireen
Innaa munziloona `alaa ahli haadhihil-qaryati rijzam minas-samaa'i bimaa kaanoo yafsuqoon
Walaqat taraknaa minhaa aayatam bayyinatal liqawmiy ya`qiloon
Wa'ilaa madyana akhaahum shu`ayban faqaala yaaqawmi`budullaaha warjul-yawmal-aakhira walaa ta`thaw fil-ardi mufsideen
Fakadhdhaboohu fa'akhadhathumur-rajfatu fa'asbahoo fee daarihim jaathimeen
Wa`aadaw wathamooda waqat tabayyana lakum mim masaakinihim, wazayyana lahumush-shaytaanu a`maalahum fasaddahum `anis-sabeeli wakaanoo mustabsireen
Waqaaroona wafir`awna wahaamaan, walaqad jaa'ahum moosaa bil-bayyinaati fastakbaroo fil-ardi wamaa kaanoo saabiqeen
Fakullan akhadhnaa bidhambihee faminhum man arsalnaa `alayhi haasibaa, waminhum man akhadhathus-sayhah, waminhum man khasafnaa bihil-ard, waminhum man aghraqnaa, wamaa kaanallaahu liyazlimahum walaakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
Mathalul-ladheenattakhadhoo min doonillaahi awliyaa'a kamathalil-`ankaboot, ittakhadhat baytaa, wa'inna awhanal-buyooti labaytul-`ankaboot, law kaanoo ya`lamoon
Innallaaha ya`lamu maa yad`oona min doonihee min shay', wahuwal-`azeezul-hakeem
Watilkal-amthaalu nadribuhaa lin-naas, wamaa ya`qiluhaa illal-`aalimoon
Khalaqallaahus-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqq, inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal lil-mu'mineen
Utlu maa oohiya ilayka minal-kitaabi wa'aqimis-salaah, innas-salaata tanhaa `anil-fahshaa'i wal-munkar, waladhikrullaahi akbar, wallaahu ya`lamu maa tasna`oon
Walaa tujaadiloo ahlal-kitaabi illaa bil-latee hiya ahsan, illal-ladheena zalamoo minhum waqooloo aamannaa bil-ladhee unzila ilaynaa wa'unzila ilaykum wa'ilaahunaa wa'ilaahukum waahiduw wanahnu lahoo muslimoon
Wakadhaalika anzalnaa ilaykal-kitaab, fal-ladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba yu'minoona bih, wamin haa'ulaa'i may yu'minu bih, wamaa yajhadu bi'aayaatinaa illal-kaafiroon
Wamaa kunta tatloo min qablihee min kitaabiw walaa takhuttuhoo biyameenika idhal lartaabal-mubtiloon
Bal huwa aayaatum bayyinaatun fee sudooril-ladheena ootul-`ilm, wamaa yajhadu bi'aayaatinaa illaz-zaalimoon
Waqaaloo lawlaa unzila `alayhi aayaatum mir rabbih, qul innamal-aayaatu `indallaah, wa'innamaa ana nadheerum mubeen
Awalam yakfihim annaa anzalnaa `alaykal-kitaaba yutlaa `alayhim, inna fee dhaalika larahmataw wadhikraa liqawmiy yu'minoon
Qul kafaa billaahi baynee wabaynakum shaheedaa, ya`lamu maa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, wal-ladheena aamanoo bil-baatili wakafaroo billaahi ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon
Wayasta`jiloonaka bil-`adhaab, walawlaa ajalum musammal lajaa'ahumul-`adhaab, walaya'tiyannahum baghtataw wahum laa yash`uroon
Yasta`jiloonaka bil-`adhaab, wa'inna jahannama lamuheetatum bil-kaafireen
Yawma yaghshaahumul-`adhaabu min fawqihim wamin tahti arjulihim wayaqoolu dhooqoo maa kuntum ta`maloon
Yaa`ibaadiyal-ladheena aamanoo inna ardee waasi`atun fa'iyyaaya fa`budoon
Kullu nafsin dhaa'iqatul-mawt, thumma ilaynaa turja`oon
Wal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati lanubawwi'annahum minal-jannati ghurafan tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa, ni`ma ajrul-`aamileen
Al-ladheena sabaroo wa`alaa rabbihim yatawakkaloon
Waka'ayyim min daabbatil laa tahmilu rizqahaa, allaahu yarzuquhaa wa'iyyaakum wahuwas-samee`ul-`aleem
Wala'in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda wasakhkharash-shamsa wal-qamara layaqoolunnallaah, fa'annaa yu'fakoon
Allaahu yabsutur-rizqa limay yashaa'u min `ibaadihee wayaqdiru lah, innallaaha bikulli shay'in `aleem
Wala'in sa'altahum man nazzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fa'ahyaa bihil-arda mim ba`di mawtihaa layaqoolunnallaahu qulil-hamdu lillaah, bal aktharuhum laa ya`qiloon
Wamaa haadhihil-hayaatud-dunyaa illaa lahwuw wala`ib, wa'innad-daaral-aakhirata lahiyal-hayawaan, law kaanoo ya`lamoon
Fa'idhaa rakiboo fil-fulki da`awullaaha mukhliseena lahud-deen, falammaa najjaahum ilal-barri idhaa hum yushrikoon
Liyakfuroo bimaa aataynaahum waliyatamatta`oo, fasawfa ya`lamoon
Awalam yaraw annaa ja`alnaa haraman aaminaw wayutakhattafun-naasu min hawlihim, afabilbaatili yu'minoona wabini`matillaahi yakfuroon
Waman azlamu mimmaniftaraa `alallaahi kadhiban aw kadhdhaba bil-haqqi lammaa jaa'ah, alaysa fee jahannama mathwal lil-kaafireen
Wal-ladheena jaahadoo feenaa lanahdiyannahum subulanaa, wa'innallaaha lama`al-muhsineen

Alif laam meem
Ghulibatir-room
Fee adnal-ardi wahum mim ba`di ghalabihim sayaghliboon
Fee bid`i sineen, lillaahil-amru min qablu wamim ba`d, wayawma'idhiy yafrahul-mu'minoon
Binasrillaah, yansuru may yashaa', wahuwal-`azeezur-raheem
Wa`dallaah, laa yukhlifullaahu wa`dahoo walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya`lamoon
Ya`lamoona zaahiram minal-hayaatid-dunyaa, wahum `anil-aakhirati hum ghaafiloon
Awalam yatafakkaroo fee anfusihim, maa khalaqallaahus-samaawaati wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa illaa bil-haqqi wa'ajalim musammaa, wa'inna katheeram minan-naasi biliqaa'i rabbihim lakaafiroon
Awalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fayanzuroo kayfa kaana `aaqibatul-ladheena min qablihim, kaanoo ashadda minhum quwwataw wa'athaarul-arda wa`amaroohaa akthara mimmaa `amaroohaa wajaa'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyinaat, famaa kaanallaahu liyazlimahum walaakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
Thumma kaana `aaqibatal-ladheena asaa'us-soo'aa an kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatillaahi wakaanoo bihaa yastahzi'oon
Allaahu yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu`eeduhoo thumma ilayhi turja`oon
Wayawma taqoomus-saa`atu yublisul-mujrimoon
Walam yakul lahum min shurakaa'ihim shufa`aa'u wakaanoo bishurakaa'ihim kaafireen
Wayawma taqoomus-saa`atu yawma'idhiy yatafarraqoon
Fa'ammal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati fahum fee rawdatiy yuhbaroon
Wa'ammal-ladheena kafaroo wakadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa waliqaa'il-aakhirati fa'ulaa'ika fil-`adhaabi muhdaroon
Fasubhaanallaahi heena tumsoona waheena tusbihoon
Walahul-hamdu fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wa`ashiyyaw waheena tuzhiroon
Yukhrijul-hayya minal-mayyiti wayukhrijul-mayyita minal-hayyi wayuhyil-arda ba`da mawtihaa, wakadhaalika tukhrajoon
Wamin aayaatihee an khalaqakum min turaabin thumma idhaa antum basharun tantashiroon
Wamin aayaatihee an khalaqa lakum min anfusikum azwaajal litaskunoo ilayhaa waja`ala baynakum mawaddataw warahmah, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy yatafakkaroon
Wamin aayaatihee khalqus-samaawaati wal-ardi wakhtilaafu alsinatikum wa'alwaanikum, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil lil-`aalimeen
Wamin aayaatihee manaamukum bil-layli wan-nahaari wabtighaa'ukum min fadlih, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy yasma`oon
Wamin aayaatihee yureekumul-barqa khawfaw watama`aw wayunazzilu minas-samaa'i maa'an fayuhyee bihil-arda ba`da mawtihaa, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy ya`qiloon
Wamin aayaatihee an taqoomas-samaa'u wal-ardu bi'amrih, thumma idhaa da`aakum da`wah, minal-ardi idhaa antum takhrujoon
Walahoo man fis-samaawaati wal-ard, kullul lahoo qaanitoon
Wahuwal-ladhee yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu`eeduhoo wahuwa ahwanu `alayh, walahul-mathalul-a`laa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, wahuwal-`azeezul-hakeem
Daraba lakum mathalam min anfusikum, hal lakum mim maa malakat aymaanukum min shurakaa'a fee maa razaqnaakum fa'antum feehi sawaa'un takhaafoonahum kakheefatikum anfusakum, kadhaalika nufassilul-aayaati liqawmiy ya`qiloon
Balittaba`al-ladheena zalamoo ahwaa'ahum bighayri `ilm, famay yahdee man adallallaah, wamaa lahum min naasireen
Fa'aqim wajhaka lid-deeni haneefaa, fitratallaahil-latee fataran-naasa `alayhaa, laa tabdeela likhalqillaah, dhaalikad-deenul-qayyimu walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya`lamoon
Muneebeena ilayhi wattaqoohu wa'aqeemus-salaata walaa takoonoo minal-mushrikeen
Minal-ladheena farraqoo deenahum wakaanoo shiya`aa, kullu hizbim bimaa ladayhim farihoon
Wa'idhaa massan-naasa durrun da`aw rabbahum muneebeena ilayhi thumma idhaa adhaaqahum minhu rahmatan idhaa fareequm minhum birabbihim yushrikoon
Liyakfuroo bimaa aataynaahum, fatamatta`oo, fasawfa ta`lamoon
Am anzalnaa `alayhim sultaanan fahuwa yatakallamu bimaa kaanoo bihee yushrikoon
Wa'idhaa adhaqnan-naasa rahmatan farihoo bihaa, wa'in tusibhum sayyi'atum bimaa qaddamat aydeehim idhaa hum yaqnatoon
Awalam yaraw annallaaha yabsutur-rizqa limay yashaa'u wayaqdir, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy yu'minoon
Fa'aati dhal-qurbaa haqqahoo wal-miskeena wabnas-sabeel, dhaalika khayrul lilladheena yureedoona wajhallaah, wa'ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
Wamaa aataytum mir ribal liyarbuwa fee amwaalin-naasi falaa yarboo `indallaah, wamaa aataytum min zakaatin tureedoona wajhallaahi fa'ulaa'ika humul-mud`ifoon
Allaahul-ladhee khalaqakum thumma razaqakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum, hal min shurakaa'ikum may yaf`alu min dhaalikum min shay', subhaanahoo wata`aalaa `ammaa yushrikoon
Zaharal-fasaadu fil-barri wal-bahri bimaa kasabat aydin-naasi liyudheeqahum ba`dal-ladhee `amiloo la`allahum yarji`oon
Qul seeroo fil-ardi fanzuroo kayfa kaana `aaqibatul-ladheena min qabl, kaana aktharuhum mushrikeen
Fa'aqim wajhaka lid-deenil-qayyimi min qabli ay ya'tiya yawmul laa maradda lahoo minallaahi yawma'idhiy yassadda`oon
Man kafara fa`alayhi kufruh, waman `amila saalihan fali'anfusihim yamhadoon
Liyajziyal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati min fadlih, innahoo laa yuhibbul-kaafireen
Wamin aayaatihee ay yursilar-riyaaha mubashshiraatiw waliyudheeqakum mir rahmatihee walitajriyal-fulku bi'amrihee walitabtaghoo min fadlihee wala`allakum tashkuroon
Walaqad arsalnaa min qablika rusulan ilaa qawmihim fajaa'oohum bil-bayyinaati fantaqamnaa minal-ladheena ajramoo, wakaana haqqaa, `alaynaa nasrul-mu'mineen
Allaahul-ladhee yursilur-riyaaha fatutheeru sahaaban fayabsutuhoo fis-samaa'i kayfa yashaa'u wayaj`aluhoo kisafan fataral-wadqa yakhruju min khilaalih, fa'idhaa asaaba bihee may yashaa'u min `ibaadihee idhaa hum yastabshiroon
Wa'in kaanoo min qabli ay yunazzala `alayhim min qablihee lamubliseen
Fanzur ilaa aathaari rahmatillaahi kayfa yuhyil-arda ba`da mawtihaa, inna dhaalika lamuhyil-mawtaa, wahuwa `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Wala'in arsalnaa reehan fara'awhu musfarral lazalloo mim ba`dihee yakfuroon
Fa'innaka laa tusmi`ul-mawtaa walaa tusmi`us-summad-du`aa'a idhaa wallaw mudbireen
Wamaa anta bihaadil-`umyi `an dalaalatihim, in tusmi`u illaa may yu'minu bi'aayaatinaa fahum muslimoon
Allaahul-ladhee khalaqakum min da`fin thumma ja`ala mim ba`di da`fin quwwatan thumma ja`ala mim ba`di quwwatin da`faw washaybah, yakhluqu maa yashaa', wahuwal-`aleemul-qadeer
Wayawma taqoomus-saa`atu yuqsimul-mujrimoona maa labithoo ghayra saa`ah, kadhaalika kaanoo yu'fakoon
Waqaalal-ladheena ootul-`ilma wal-eemaana laqad labithtum fee kitaabillaahi ilaa yawmil-ba`th, fahaadhaa yawmul-ba`thi walaakinnakum kuntum laa ta`lamoon
Fayawma'idhil laa yanfa`ul-ladheena zalamoo ma`dhiratuhum walaa hum yusta`taboon
Walaqad darabnaa lin-naasi fee haadhal-qur'aani min kulli mathal, wala'in ji'tahum bi'aayatil layaqoolannal-ladheena kafaroo in antum illaa mubtiloon
Kadhaalika yatba`ullaahu `alaa quloobil-ladheena laa ya`lamoon
Fasbir inna wa`dallaahi haqquw walaa yastakhiffannakal-ladheena laa yooqinoon

Alif laam meem
Tilka aayaatul-kitaabil-hakeem
Hudaw warahmatal lil-muhsineen
Al-ladheena yuqeemoonas-salaata wayu'toonaz-zakaata wahum bil-aakhirati hum yooqinoon
Ulaa'ika `alaa hudam mir rabbihim wa'ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
Waminan-naasi may yashtaree lahwal-hadeethi liyudilla `an sabeelillaahi bighayri `ilm, wayattakhidhahaa huzuwaa, ulaa'ika lahum `adhaabum muheen
Wa'idhaa tutlaa `alayhi aayaatunaa wallaa mustakbiran ka'al lam yasma`haa ka'anna fee udhunayhi waqraa, fabashshirhu bi`adhaabin aleem
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati lahum jannaatun-na`eem
Khaalideena feehaa, wa`dallaahi haqqaa, wahuwal-`azeezul-hakeem
Khalaqas-samaawaati bighayri `amadin tarawnahaa wa'alqaa fil-ardi rawaasiya an tameeda bikum wabaththa feehaa min kulli daabbah, wa'anzalnaa minas-samaa'i maa'an fa'ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjin kareem
Haadhaa khalqullaahi fa'aroonee maadhaa khalaqal-ladheena min doonih, baliz-zaalimoona fee dalaalim mubeen
Walaqad aataynaa luqmaanal-hikmata anishkur lillaah, wamay yashkur fa'innamaa yashkuru linafsih, waman kafara fa'innallaaha ghaniyyun hameed
Wa'idh qaala luqmaanu libnihee wahuwa ya`izuhoo yaabunayya laa tushrik billaah, innash-shirka lazulmun `azeem
Wawassaynal-insaana biwaalidayh, hamalathu ummuhoo wahnan `alaa wahniw wafisaaluhoo fee `aamayni anishkur lee waliwaalidayk, ilayyal-maseer
Wa'in jaahadaaka `alaa an tushrika bee maa laysa laka bihee `ilmun falaa tuti`humaa wasaahibhumaa fid-dunyaa ma`roofaa, wattabi` sabeela man anaaba ilayy, thumma ilayya marji`ukum fa'unabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta`maloon
Yaabunayya innahaa in taku mithqaala habbatim min khardalin fatakun fee sakhratin aw fis-samaawaati aw fil-ardi ya'ti bihallaah, innallaaha lateefun khabeer
Yaabunayya aqimis-salaata wa'mur bil-ma`roofi wanha `anil-munkari wasbir `alaa maa asaabak, inna dhaalika min `azmil-umoor
Walaa tusa``ir khaddaka lin-naasi walaa tamshi fil-ardi marahaa, innallaaha laa yuhibbu kulla mukhtaalin fakhoor
Waqsid fee mashyika waghdud min sawtik, inna ankaral-aswaati lasawtul-hameer
Alam taraw annallaaha sakhkhara lakum maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ardi wa'asbagha `alaykum ni`amahoo zaahirataw wabaatinah, waminan-naasi may yujaadilu fillaahi bighayri `ilmiw walaa hudaw walaa kitaabim muneer
Wa'idhaa qeela lahumuttabi`oo maa anzalallaahu qaaloo bal nattabi`u maa wajadnaa `alayhi aabaa'anaa, awalaw kaanash-shaytaanu yad`oohum ilaa `adhaabis-sa`eer
Wamay yuslim wajhahoo ilallaahi wahuwa muhsinun faqadistamsaka bil-`urwatil-wuthqaa, wa'ilallaahi `aaqibatul-umoor
Waman kafara falaa yahzunka kufruh, ilaynaa marji`uhum fanunabbi'uhum bimaa `amiloo, innallaaha `aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
Numatti`uhum qaleelan thumma nadtarruhum ilaa `adhaabin ghaleez
Wala'in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda layaqoolunnallaah, qulil-hamdu lillaah, bal aktharuhum laa ya`lamoon
Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, innallaaha huwal-ghaniyyul-hameed
Walaw anna maa fil-ardi min shajaratin aqlaamuw wal-bahru yamudduhoo mim ba`dihee sab`atu abhurim maa nafidat kalimaatullaah, innallaaha `azeezun hakeem
Maa khalqukum walaa ba`thukum illaa kanafsiw waahidah, innallaaha samee`um baseer
Alam tara annallaaha yoolijul-layla fin-nahaari wayoolijun-nahaara fil-layli wasakhkharash-shamsa wal-qamar, kulluy yajree ilaa ajalim musammaw wa'annallaaha bimaa ta`maloona khabeer
Dhaalika bi'annallaaha huwal-haqqu wa'anna maa yad`oona min doonihil-baatilu wa'annallaaha huwal-`aliyyul-kabeer
Alam tara annal-fulka tajree fil-bahri bini`matillaahi liyuriyakum min aayaatih, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil likulli sabbaarin shakoor
Wa'idhaa ghashiyahum mawjun kaz-zulali da`awullaaha mukhliseena lahud-deen, falammaa najjaahum ilal-barri faminhum muqtasid, wamaa yajhadu bi'aayaatinaa illaa kullu khattaarin kafoor
Yaa ayyuhan-naasuttaqoo rabbakum wakhshaw yawmal laa yajzee waalidun `aw waladih, walaa mawloodun huwa jaazin `aw waalidihee shay'aa, inna wa`dallaahi haqqun falaa taghurrannakumul-hayaatud-dunyaa, walaa yaghurrannakum billaahil-gharoor
Innallaaha `indahoo `ilmus-saa`ah, wayunazzilul-ghayth, waya`lamu maa fil-arhaam, wamaa tadree nafsum maadhaa taksibu ghadaa, wamaa tadree nafsum bi'ayyi ardin tamoot, innallaaha `aleemun khabeer

Alif laam meem
Tanzeelul-kitaabi laa rayba feehi mir rabbil-`aalameen
Am yaqooloonaftaraah, bal huwal-haqqu mir rabbika litundhira qawmam maa ataahum min nadheerim min qablika la`allahum yahtadoon
Allaahul-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa fee sittati ayyaamin thummastawaa `alal-`arsh, maa lakum min doonihee miw waliyyiw walaa shafee`, afalaa tatadhakkaroon
Yudabbirul-amra minas-samaa'i ilal-ardi thumma ya`ruju ilayhi fee yawmin kaana miqdaaruhoo alfa sanatim mimmaa ta`uddoon
Dhaalika `aalimul-ghaybi wash-shahaadatil-`azeezur-raheem
Al-ladhee ahsana kulla shay'in khalaqahoo wabada'a khalqal-insaani min teen
Thumma ja`ala naslahoo min sulaalatim mim maa'im maheen
Thumma sawwaahu wanafakha feehi mir roohihee waja`ala lakumus-sam`a wal-absaara wal-af'idah, qaleelam maa tashkuroon
Waqaaloo a'idhaa dalalnaa fil-ardi a'innaa lafee khalqin jadeed, bal hum biliqaa'i rabbihim kaafiroon
Qul yatawaffaakum malakul-mawtil-ladhee wukkila bikum thumma ilaa rabbikum turja`oon
Walaw taraa idhil-mujrimoona naakisoo ru'oosihim `inda rabbihim, rabbanaa absarnaa wasami`naa farji`naa na`mal saalihan innaa mooqinoon
Walaw shi'naa la'aataynaa kulla nafsin hudaahaa walaakin haqqal-qawlu minnee la'amla'anna jahannama minal-jinnati wan-naasi ajma`een
Fadhooqoo bimaa naseetum liqaa'a yawmikum haadhaa, innaa naseenaakum wadhooqoo `adhaabal-khuldi bimaa kuntum ta`maloon
Innamaa yu'minu bi'aayaatinal-ladheena idhaa dhukkiroo bihaa kharroo sujjadaw wasabbahoo bihamdi rabbihim wahum laa yastakbiroon
Tatajaafaa junoobuhum `anil-madaaji`i yad`oona rabbahum khawfaw watama`aa, wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Falaa ta`lamu nafsum maa ukhfiya lahum min qurrati a`yun, jazaa'am bimaa kaanoo ya`maloon
Afaman kaana mu'minan kaman kaana faasiqaa, laa yastawoon
Ammal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati falahum jannaatul-ma'waa, nuzulam bimaa kaanoo ya`maloon
Wa'ammal-ladheena fasaqoo fama'waahumun-naaru kullamaa araadoo ay yakhrujoo minhaa u`eedoo feehaa waqeela lahum dhooqoo `adhaaban-naaril-ladhee kuntum bihee tukadhdhiboon
Walanudheeqannahum minal-`adhaabil-adnaa doonal-`adhaabil-akbari la`allahum yarji`oon
Waman azlamu mimman dhukkira bi'aayaati rabbihee thumma a`rada `anhaa, innaa minal-mujrimeena muntaqimoon
Walaqad aataynaa moosal-kitaaba falaa takun fee miryatim mil liqaa'ihee waja`alnaahu hudal libanee israa'eel
Waja`alnaa minhum a'immatay yahdoona bi'amrinaa lammaa sabaroo, wakaanoo bi'aayaatinaa yooqinoon
Inna rabbaka huwa yafsilu baynahum yawmal-qiyaamati feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
Awalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknaa min qablihim minal-qurooni yamshoona fee masaakinihim, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaat, afalaa yasma`oon
Awalam yaraw annaa nasooqul-maa'a ilal-ardil-juruzi fanukhriju bihee zar`an ta'kulu minhu an`aamuhum wa'anfusuhum, afalaa yubsiroon
Wayaqooloona mataa haadhal-fathu in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul yawmal-fathi laa yanfa`ul-ladheena kafaroo eemaanuhum walaa hum yunzaroon
Fa'a`rid `anhum wantazir innahum muntaziroon

Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyuttaqillaaha walaa tuti`il-kaafireena wal-munaafiqeen, innallaaha kaana `aleeman hakeemaa
Wattabi` maa yoohaa ilayka mir rabbik, innallaaha kaana bimaa ta`maloona khabeeraa
Watawakkal `alallaah, wakafaa billaahi wakeelaa
Maa ja`alallaahu lirajulim min qalbayni fee jawfih, wamaa ja`ala azwaajakumullaa'ee tuzaahiroona minhunna ummahaatikum, wamaa ja`ala ad`iyaa'akum abnaa'akum, dhaalikum qawlukum bi'afwaahikum, wallaahu yaqoolul-haqqa wahuwa yahdis-sabeel
Ud`oohum li'aabaa'ihim huwa aqsatu `indallaah, fa'il lam ta`lamoo aabaa'ahum fa'ikhwaanukum fid-deeni wamawaaleekum, walaysa `alaykum junaahun feemaa akhta'tum bihee walaakim maa ta`ammadat quloobukum, wakaanallaahu ghafoorar raheemaa
An-nabiyyu awlaa bil-mu'mineena min anfusihim wa'azwaajuhoo ummahaatuhum, wa'ulul-arhaami ba`duhum awlaa biba`din fee kitaabillaahi minal-mu'mineena wal-muhaajireena illaa an taf`aloo ilaa awliyaa'ikum ma`roofaa, kaana dhaalika fil-kitaabi mastooraa
Wa'idh akhadhnaa minan-nabiyyeena meethaaqahum waminka wamin noohiw wa'ibraaheema wamoosaa wa`eesabni maryam, wa'akhadhnaa minhum meethaaqan ghaleezaa
Liyas'alas-saadiqeena `an sidqihim, wa'a`adda lil-kaafireena `adhaaban aleemaa
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanudhkuroo ni`matallaahi `alaykum idh jaa'atkum junoodun fa'arsalnaa `alayhim reehaw wajunoodal lam tarawhaa, wakaanallaahu bimaa ta`maloona baseeraa
Idh jaa'ookum min fawqikum wamin asfala minkum wa'idh zaaghatil-absaaru wabalaghatil-quloobul-hanaajira watazunnoona billaahiz-zunoonaa
Hunaalikabtuliyal-mu'minoona wazulziloo zilzaalan shadeedaa
Wa'idh yaqoolul-munaafiqoona wal-ladheena fee quloobihim maradum maa wa`adanallaahu warasooluhoo illaa ghurooraa
Wa'idh qaalat taa'ifatum minhum yaa ahla yathriba laa muqaama lakum farji`oo, wayasta'dhinu fareequm minhumun-nabiyya yaqooloona inna buyootanaa `awrah, wamaa hiya bi`awrah, iy yureedoona illaa firaaraa
Walaw dukhilat `alayhim min aqtaarihaa thumma su'ilul-fitnata la'aatawhaa wamaa talabbathoo bihaa illaa yaseeraa
Walaqad kaanoo `aahadullaaha min qablu laa yuwalloonal-adbaar, wakaana `ahdullaahi mas'oolaa
Qul lay yanfa`akumul-firaaru in farartum minal-mawti awil-qatli wa'idhal laa tumatta`oona illaa qaleelaa
Qul man dhal-ladhee ya`simukum minallaahi in araada bikum soo'an aw araada bikum rahmah, walaa yajidoona lahum min doonillaahi waliyyaw walaa naseeraa
Qad ya`lamullaahul-mu`awwiqeena minkum wal-qaa'ileena li'ikhwaanihim halumma ilaynaa, walaa ya'toonal-ba'sa illaa qaleelaa
Ashihhatan `alaykum, fa'idhaa jaa'al-khawfu ra'aytahum yanzuroona ilayka tadooru a`yunuhum kal-ladhee yughshaa `alayhi minal-mawt, fa'idhaa dhahabal-khawfu salaqookum bi'alsinatin hidaadin ashihhatan `alal-khayr, ulaa'ika lam yu'minoo fa'ahbatallaahu a`maalahum, wakaana dhaalika `alallaahi yaseeraa
Yahsaboonal-ahzaaba lam yadhhaboo, wa'iy ya'til-ahzaabu yawaddoo law annahum baadoona fil-a`raabi yas'aloona `an ambaa'ikum, walaw kaanoo feekum maa qaataloo illaa qaleelaa
Laqad kaana lakum fee rasoolillaahi uswatun hasanatul liman kaana yarjullaaha wal-yawmal-aakhira wadhakarallaaha katheeraa
Walammaa ra'al-mu'minoonal-ahzaaba qaaloo haadhaa maa wa`adanallaahu warasooluhoo wasadaqallaahu warasooluh, wamaa zaadahum illaa eemaanaw watasleemaa
Minal-mu'mineena rijaalun sadaqoo maa `aahadullaaha `alayh, faminhum man qadaa nahbahoo waminhum may yantazir, wamaa baddaloo tabdeelaa
Liyajziyallaahus-saadiqeena bisidqihim wayu`adhdhibal-munaafiqeena in shaa'a aw yatooba `alayhim, innallaaha kaana ghafoorar raheemaa
Waraddallaahul-ladheena kafaroo bighayzihim lam yanaaloo khayraa, wakafallaahul-mu'mineenal-qitaal, wakaanallaahu qawiyyan `azeezaa
Wa'anzalal-ladheena zaaharoohum min ahlil-kitaabi min sayaaseehim waqadhafa fee quloobihimur-ru`ba fareeqan taqtuloona wata'siroona fareeqaa
Wa'awrathakum ardahum wadiyaarahum wa'amwaalahum wa'ardal lam tata'oohaa, wakaanallaahu `alaa kulli shay'in qadeeraa
Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu qul li'azwaajika in kuntunna turidnal-hayaatad-dunyaa wazeenatahaa fata`aalayna umatti`kunna wa'usarrihkunna saraahan jameelaa
Wa'in kuntunna turidnallaaha warasoolahoo wad-daaral-aakhirata fa'innallaaha a`adda lil-muhsinaati minkunna ajran `azeemaa
Yaanisaa'an-nabiyyi may ya'ti minkunna bifaahishatim mubayyinatiy yudaa`af lahal-`adhaabu di`fayn, wakaana dhaalika `alallaahi yaseeraa
Wamay yaqnut minkunna lillaahi warasoolihee wata`mal saalihan nu'tihaa ajrahaa marratayni wa'a`tadnaa lahaa rizqan kareemaa
Yaanisaa'an-nabiyyi lastunna ka'ahadim minan-nisaa'i inittaqaytunna falaa takhda`na bil-qawli fayatma`al-ladhee fee qalbihee maraduw waqulna qawlam ma`roofaa
Waqarna fee buyootikunna walaa tabarrajna tabarrujal-jaahiliyyatil-oolaa wa'aqimnas-salaata wa'aateenaz-zakaata wa'ati`nallaaha warasoolah, innamaa yureedullaahu liyudhhiba `ankumur-rijsa ahlal-bayti wayutahhirakum tatheeraa
Wadhkurna maa yutlaa fee buyootikunna min aayaatillaahi wal-hikmah, innallaaha kaana lateefan khabeeraa
Innal-muslimeena wal-muslimaati wal-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaati wal-qaaniteena wal-qaanitaati was-saadiqeena was-saadiqaati was-saabireena was-saabiraati wal-khaashi`eena wal-khaashi`aati wal-mutasaddiqeena wal-mutasaddiqaati was-saa'imeena was-saa'imaati wal-haafizeena furoojahum wal-haafizaati wadh-dhaakireenallaaha katheeraw wadh-dhaakiraati a`addallaahu lahum maghfirataw wa'ajran `azeemaa
Wamaa kaana limu'miniw walaa mu'minatin idhaa qadallaahu warasooluhoo amran ay yakoona lahumul-khiyaratu min amrihim, wamay ya`sillaaha warasoolahoo faqad dalla dalaalam mubeenaa
Wa'idh taqoolu lilladhee an`amallaahu `alayhi wa'an`amta `alayhi amsik `alayka zawjaka wattaqillaaha watukhfee fee nafsika mallaahu mubdeehi watakhshan-naas, wallaahu ahaqqu an takhshaah, falammaa qadaa zaydum minhaa wataraa, zawwajnaakahaa likay laa yakoona `alal-mu'mineena harajun fee azwaaji ad`iyaa'ihim idhaa qadaw minhunna wataraa, wakaana amrullaahi maf`oolaa
Maa kaana `alan-nabiyyi min harajin feemaa faradallaahu lah, sunnatallaahi fil-ladheena khalaw min qabl, wakaana amrullaahi qadaram maqdooraa
Al-ladheena yuballighoona risaalaatillaahi wayakhshawnahoo walaa yakhshawna ahadan illallaah, wakafaa billaahi haseebaa
Maa kaana muhammadun abaa ahadim mir rijaalikum walaakir rasoolallaahi wakhaataman-nabiyyeen, wakaanallaahu bikulli shay'in `aleemaa
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanudhkurullaaha dhikran katheeraa
Wasabbihoohu bukrataw wa'aseelaa
Huwal-ladhee yusallee `alaykum wamalaa'ikatuhoo liyukhrijakum minaz-zulumaati ilan-noor, wakaana bil-mu'mineena raheemaa
Tahiyyatuhum yawma yalqawnahoo salaam, wa'a`adda lahum ajran kareemaa
Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu innaa arsalnaaka shaahidaw wamubashshiraw wanadheeraa
Wadaa`iyan ilallaahi bi'idhnihee wasiraajam muneeraa
Wabashshiril-mu'mineena bi'anna lahum minallaahi fadlan kabeeraa
Walaa tuti`il-kaafireena wal-munaafiqeena wada` adhaahum watawakkal `alallaah, wakafaa billaahi wakeelaa
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa nakahtumul-mu'minaati thumma tallaqtumoohunna min qabli an tamassoohunna famaa lakum `alayhinna min `iddatin ta`taddoonahaa, famatti`oohunna wasarrihoohunna saraahan jameelaa
Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu innaa ahlalnaa laka azwaajakallaatee aatayta ujoorahunna wamaa malakat yameenuka mimmaa afaa'allaahu `alayka wabanaati `ammika wabanaati `ammaatika wabanaati khaalika wabanaati khaalaatikallaatee haajarna ma`ak, wamra'atam mu'minatan iw wahabat nafsahaa lin-nabiyyi in araadan-nabiyyu ay yastankihahaa khaalisatal laka min doonil-mu'mineen, qad `alimnaa maa faradnaa `alayhim fee azwaajihim wamaa malakat aymaanuhum likaylaa yakoona `alayka haraj, wakaanallaahu ghafoorar raheemaa
Turjee man tashaa'u minhunna watu'wee ilayka man tashaa', wamanibtaghayta mimman `azalta falaa junaaha `alayk, dhaalika adnaa an taqarra a`yunuhunna walaa yahzanna wayardayna bimaa aataytahunna kulluhunn, wallaahu ya`lamu maa fee quloobikum, wakaanallaahu `aleeman haleemaa
Laa yahillu lakan-nisaa'u mim ba`du walaa an tabaddala bihinna min azwaajiw walaw a`jabaka husnuhunna illaa maa malakat yameenuk, wakaanallaahu `alaa kulli shay'ir raqeebaa
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tadkhuloo buyootan-nabiyyi illaa ay yu'dhana lakum ilaa ta`aamin ghayra naazireena inaahu walaakin idhaa du`eetum fadkhuloo fa'idhaa ta`imtum fantashiroo walaa musta'niseena lihadeeth, inna dhaalikum kaana yu'dhin-nabiyya fayastahyee minkum, wallaahu laa yastahyee minal-haqq, wa'idhaa sa'altumoohunna mataa`an fas'aloohunna miw waraa'i hijaab, dhaalikum atharu liquloobikum waquloobihinn, wamaa kaana lakum an tu'dhoo rasoolallaahi walaa an tankihoo azwaajahoo mim ba`dihee abadaa, inna dhaalikum kaana `indallaahi `azeemaa
In tubdoo shay'an aw tukhfoohu fa'innallaaha kaana bikulli shay'in `aleemaa
Laa junaaha `alayhinna fee aabaa'ihinna walaa abnaa'ihinna walaa ikhwaanihinna walaa abnaa'i ikhwaanihinna walaa abnaa'i akhawaatihinna walaa nisaa'ihinna walaa maa malakat aymaanuhunn, wattaqeenallaah, innallaaha kaana `alaa kulli shay'in shaheedaa
Innallaaha wamalaa'ikatahoo yusalloona `alan-nabiyy, yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo salloo `alayhi wasallimoo tasleemaa
Innal-ladheena yu'dhoonallaaha warasoolahoo la`anahumullaahu fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati wa'a`adda lahum `adhaabam muheenaa
Wal-ladheena yu'dhoonal-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaati bighayri maktasaboo faqadihtamaloo buhtaanaw wa'ithmam mubeenaa
Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu qul li'azwaajika wabanaatika wanisaa'il-mu'mineena yudneena `alayhinna min jalaabeebihinn, dhaalika adnaa ay yu`rafna falaa yu'dhayn, wakaanallaahu ghafoorar raheemaa
La'il lam yantahil-munaafiqoona wal-ladheena fee quloobihim maraduw wal-murjifoona fil-madeenati lanughriyannaka bihim thumma laa yujaawiroonaka feehaa illaa qaleelaa
Mal`ooneen, aynamaa thuqifoo ukhidhoo waquttiloo taqteelaa
Sunnatallaahi fil-ladheena khalaw min qabl, walan tajida lisunnatillaahi tabdeelaa
Yas'alukan-naasu `anis-saa`ah, qul innamaa `ilmuhaa `indallaah, wamaa yudreeka la`allas-saa`ata takoonu qareebaa
Innallaaha la`anal-kaafireena wa'a`adda lahum sa`eeraa
Khaalideena feehaa abadaa, laa yajidoona waliyyaw walaa naseeraa
Yawma tuqallabu wujoohuhum fin-naari yaqooloona yaalaytanaa ata`nallaaha wa'ata`nar-rasoolaa
Waqaaloo rabbanaa innaa ata`naa saadatanaa wakubaraa'anaa fa'adalloonas-sabeelaa
Rabbanaa aatihim di`fayni minal-`adhaabi wal-`anhum la`nan kabeeraa
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa takoonoo kal-ladheena aadhaw moosaa fabarra'ahullaahu mimmaa qaaloo, wakaana `indallaahi wajeehaa
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanuttaqullaaha waqooloo qawlan sadeedaa
Yuslih lakum a`maalakum wayaghfir lakum dhunoobakum, wamay yuti`illaaha warasoolahoo faqad faaza fawzan `azeemaa
Innaa `aradnal-amaanata `alas-samaawaati wal-ardi wal-jibaali fa'abayna ay yahmilnahaa wa'ashfaqna minhaa wahamalahal-insaan, innahoo kaana zalooman jahoolaa
Liyu`adhdhiballaahul-munaafiqeena wal-munaafiqaati wal-mushrikeena wal-mushrikaati wayatooballaahu `alal-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaat, wakaanallaahu ghafoorar raheemaa

Al-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ardi walahul-hamdu fil-aakhirah, wahuwal-hakeemul-khabeer
Ya`lamu maa yaliju fil-ardi wamaa yakhruju minhaa wamaa yanzilu minas-samaa'i wamaa ya`ruju feehaa, wahuwar-raheemul-ghafoor
Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo laa ta'teenas-saa`ah, qul balaa warabbee lata'tiyannakum `aalimil-ghaybi laa ya`zubu `anhu mithqaalu dharratin fis-samaawaati walaa fil-ardi walaa asgharu min dhaalika walaa akbaru illaa fee kitaabim mubeen
Liyajziyal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaat, ulaa'ika lahum maghfiratuw warizqun kareem
Wal-ladheena sa`aw fee aayaatinaa mu`aajizeena ulaa'ika lahum `adhaabum mir rijzin aleem
Wayaral-ladheena ootul-`ilmal-ladhee unzila ilayka mir rabbika huwal-haqqa wayahdee ilaa siraatil-`azeezil-hameed
Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo hal nadullukum `alaa rajuliy yunabbi'ukum idhaa muzziqtum kulla mumazzaqin innakum lafee khalqin jadeed
Aftaraa `alallaahi kadhiban am bihee jinnah, balil-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati fil-`adhaabi wad-dalaalil-ba`eed
Afalam yaraw ilaa maa bayna aydeehim wamaa khalfahum minas-samaa'i wal-ard, in nasha' nakhsif bihimul-arda aw nusqit `alayhim kisafam minas-samaa', inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal likulli `abdim muneeb
Walaqad aataynaa daawooda minnaa fadlaa, yaajibaalu awwibee ma`ahoo wat-tayr, wa'alannaa lahul-hadeed
Ani`mal saabighaatiw waqaddir fis-sardi wa`maloo saalihaa, innee bimaa ta`maloona baseer
Walisulaymaanar-reeha ghuduwwuhaa shahruw warawaahuhaa shahr, wa'asalnaa lahoo `aynal-qitr, waminal-jinni may ya`malu bayna yadayhi bi'idhni rabbih, wamay yazigh minhum `an amrinaa nudhiqhu min `adhaabis-sa`eer
Ya`maloona lahoo maa yashaa'u mim mahaareeba watamaatheela wajifaanin kal-jawaabi waqudoorir raasiyaat, i`maloo aala daawooda shukraa, waqaleelum min `ibaadiyash-shakoor
Falammaa qadaynaa `alayhil-mawta maa dallahum `alaa mawtihee illaa daabbatul-ardi ta'kulu minsa'atah, falammaa kharra tabayyanatil-jinnu al law kaanoo ya`lamoonal-ghayba maa labithoo fil-`adhaabil-muheen
Laqad kaana lisaba'in fee maskanihim aayah, jannataani `ay yameeniw washimaal, kuloo mir rizqi rabbikum washkuroo lah, baldatun tayyibatuw warabbun ghafoor
Fa'a`radoo fa'arsalnaa `alayhim saylal-`arimi wabaddalnaahum bijannatayhim jannatayni dhawaatay ukulin khamtiw wa'athliw washay'im min sidrin qaleel
Dhaalika jazaynaahum bimaa kafaroo, wahal nujaazee illal-kafoor
Waja`alnaa baynahum wabaynal-qural-latee baaraknaa feehaa quran zaahirataw waqaddarnaa feehas-sayr, seeroo feehaa layaaliya wa'ayyaaman aamineen
Faqaaloo rabbanaa baa`id bayna asfaarinaa wazalamoo anfusahum faja`alnaahum ahaadeetha wamazzaqnaahum kulla mumazzaq, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil likulli sabbaarin shakoor
Walaqad saddaqa `alayhim ibleesu zannahoo fattaba`oohu illaa fareeqam minal-mu'mineen
Wamaa kaana lahoo `alayhim min sultaanin illaa lina`lama may yu'minu bil-aakhirati mimman huwa minhaa fee shakk, warabbuka `alaa kulli shay'in hafeez
Qulid`ul-ladheena za`amtum min doonillaah, laa yamlikoona mithqaala dharratin fis-samaawaati walaa fil-ardi wamaa lahum feehimaa min shirkiw wamaa lahoo minhum min zaheer
Walaa tanfa`ush-shafaa`atu `indahoo illaa liman adhina lah, hattaa idhaa fuzzi`a `an quloobihim qaaloo maadhaa qaala rabbukum, qaalul-haqq, wahuwal-`aliyyul-kabeer
Qul may yarzuqukum minas-samaawaati wal-ard, qulillaahu wa'innaa aw iyyaakum la`alaa hudan aw fee dalaalim mubeen
Qul laa tus'aloona `ammaa ajramnaa walaa nus'alu `ammaa ta`maloon
Qul yajma`u baynanaa rabbunaa thumma yaftahu baynanaa bil-haqq, wahuwal-fattaahul-`aleem
Qul arooniyal-ladheena alhaqtum bihee shurakaa'a kallaa, bal huwallaahul-`azeezul-hakeem
Wamaa arsalnaaka illaa kaaffatal lin-naasi basheeraw wanadheeraw walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya`lamoon
Wayaqooloona mataa haadhal-wa`du in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul lakum mee`aadu yawmil laa tasta'khiroona `anhu saa`ataw walaa tastaqdimoon
Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo lan nu'mina bihaadhal-qur'aani walaa bil-ladhee bayna yadayh, walaw taraa idhiz-zaalimoona mawqoofoona `inda rabbihim, yarji`u ba`duhum ilaa ba`dinil-qawl, yaqoolul-ladheenastud`ifoo lilladheenastakbaroo lawlaa antum lakunnaa mu'mineen
Qaalal-ladheenastakbaroo lilladheenastud`ifoo anahnu sadadnaakum `anil-hudaa ba`da idh jaa'akum bal kuntum mujrimeen
Waqaalal-ladheenastud`ifoo lilladheenastakbaroo bal makrul-layli wan-nahaari idh ta'muroonanaa an nakfura billaahi wanaj`ala lahoo andaadaa, wa'asarrun-nadaamata lammaa ra'awul-`adhaab, waja`alnal-aghlaala fee a`naaqil-ladheena kafaroo, hal yujzawna illaa maa kaanoo ya`maloon
Wamaa arsalnaa fee qaryatim min nadheerin illaa qaala mutrafoohaa innaa bimaa ursiltum bihee kaafiroon
Waqaaloo nahnu aktharu amwaalaw wa'awlaadaw wamaa nahnu bimu`adhdhabeen
Qul inna rabbee yabsutur-rizqa limay yashaa'u wayaqdiru walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya`lamoon
Wamaa amwaalukum walaa awlaadukum bil-latee tuqarribukum `indanaa zulfaa illaa man aamana wa`amila saalihan fa'ulaa'ika lahum jazaa'ud-di`fi bimaa `amiloo wahum fil-ghurufaati aaminoon
Wal-ladheena yas`awna fee aayaatinaa mu`aajizeena ulaa'ika fil-`adhaabi muhdaroon
Qul inna rabbee yabsutur-rizqa limay yashaa'u min `ibaadihee wayaqdiru lah, wamaa anfaqtum min shay'in fahuwa yukhlifuh, wahuwa khayrur-raaziqeen
Wayawma yahshuruhum jamee`an thumma yaqoolu lil-malaa'ikati ahaa'ulaa'i iyyaakum kaanoo ya`budoon
Qaaloo subhaanaka anta waliyyunaa min doonihim, bal kaanoo ya`budoonal-jinna aktharuhum bihim mu'minoon
Fal-yawma laa yamliku ba`dukum liba`din naf`aw walaa darraa, wanaqoolu lilladheena zalamoo dhooqoo `adhaaban-naaril-latee kuntum bihaa tukadhdhiboon
Wa'idhaa tutlaa `alayhim aayaatunaa bayyinaatin qaaloo maa haadhaa illaa rajuluy yureedu ay yasuddakum `ammaa kaana ya`budu aabaa'ukum, waqaaloo maa haadhaa illaa ifkum muftaraa, waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo lil-haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum in haadhaa illaa sihrum mubeen
Wamaa aataynaahum min kutubiy yadrusoonahaa wamaa arsalnaa ilayhim qablaka min nadheer
Wakadhdhabal-ladheena min qablihim wamaa balaghoo mi`shaara maa aataynaahum fakadhdhaboo rusulee, fakayfa kaana nakeer
Qul innamaa a`izukum biwaahidah, an taqoomoo lillaahi mathnaa wafuraadaa thumma tatafakkaroo, maa bisaahibikum min jinnah, in huwa illaa nadheerul lakum bayna yaday `adhaabin shadeed
Qul maa sa'altukum min ajrin fahuwa lakum, in ajriya illaa `alallaah, wahuwa `alaa kulli shay'in shaheed
Qul inna rabbee yaqdhifu bil-haqq, `allaamul-ghuyoob
Qul jaa'al-haqqu wamaa yubdi'ul-baatilu wamaa yu`eed
Qul in dalaltu fa'innamaa adillu `alaa nafsee, wa'inihtadaytu fabimaa yoohee ilayya rabbee, innahoo samee`un qareeb
Walaw taraa idh fazi`oo falaa fawta wa'ukhidhoo mim makaanin qareeb
Waqaaloo aamannaa bih, wa'annaa lahumut-tanaawushu mim makaanim ba`eed
Waqad kafaroo bihee min qabl, wayaqdhifoona bil-ghaybi mim makaanim ba`eed
Waheela baynahum wabayna maa yashtahoona kamaa fu`ila bi'ashyaa`ihim min qabl, innahum kaanoo fee shakkim mureeb

Al-hamdu lillaahi faatiris-samaawaati wal-ardi jaa`ilil-malaa'ikati rusulan ulee ajnihatim mathnaa wathulaatha warubaa`, yazeedu fil-khalqi maa yashaa', innallaaha `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Maa yaftahillaahu lin-naasi mir rahmatin falaa mumsika lahaa, wamaa yumsik falaa mursila lahoo mim ba`dih, wahuwal-`azeezul-hakeem
Yaa ayyuhan-naasudhkuroo ni`matallaahi `alaykum, hal min khaaliqin ghayrullaahi yarzuqukum minas-samaa'i wal-ard, laa ilaaha illaa huw, fa'annaa tu'fakoon
Wa'iy yukadhdhibooka faqad kudhdhibat rusulum min qablik, wa'ilallaahi turja`ul-umoor
Yaa ayyuhan-naasu inna wa`dallaahi haqqun falaa taghurrannakumul-hayaatud-dunyaa, walaa yaghurrannakum billaahil-gharoor
Innash-shaytaana lakum `aduwwun fattakhidhoohu `aduwwaa, innamaa yad`oo hizbahoo liyakoonoo min ashaabis-sa`eer
Alladheena kafaroo lahum `adhaabun shadeed, wal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati lahum maghfiratuw wa'ajrun kabeer
Afaman zuyyina lahoo soo'u `amalihee fara'aahu hasanaa, fa'innallaaha yudillu may yashaa'u wayahdee may yashaa', falaa tadhhab nafsuka `alayhim hasaraat, innallaaha `aleemum bimaa yasna`oon
Wallaahul-ladhee arsalar-riyaaha fatutheeru sahaaban fasuqnaahu ilaa baladim mayyitin fa'ahyaynaa bihil-arda ba`da mawtihaa, kadhaalikan-nushoor
Man kaana yureedul-`izzata falillaahil-`izzatu jamee`aa, ilayhi yas`adul-kalimut-tayyibu wal-`amalus-saalihu yarfa`uh, wal-ladheena yamkuroonas-sayyi'aati lahum `adhaabun shadeed, wamakru ulaa'ika huwa yaboor
Wallaahu khalaqakum min turaabin thumma min nutfatin thumma ja`alakum azwaajaa, wamaa tahmilu min unthaa walaa tada`u illaa bi`ilmih, wamaa yu`ammaru mim mu`ammariw walaa yunqasu min `umurihee illaa fee kitaab, inna dhaalika `alallaahi yaseer
Wamaa yastawil-bahraan, haadhaa `adhbun furaatun saa'ighun sharaabuhoo wahaadhaa milhun ujaaj, wamin kullin ta'kuloona lahman tariyyaw watastakhrijoona hilyatan talbasoonahaa, wataral-fulka feehi mawaakhira litabtaghoo min fadlihee wala`allakum tashkuroon
Yoolijul-layla fin-nahaari wayoolijun-nahaara fil-layl, wasakhkharash-shamsa wal-qamara kulluy yajree li'ajalim musammaa, dhaalikumullaahu rabbukum lahul-mulk, wal-ladheena tad`oona min doonihee maa yamlikoona min qitmeer
In tad`oohum laa yasma`oo du`aa'akum, walaw sami`oo mastajaaboo lakum, wayawmal-qiyaamati yakfuroona bishirkikum, walaa yunabbi'uka mithlu khabeer
