Wasalaamun `alal-mursaleen
Wal-hamdu lillaahi rabbil-`aalameen

Saad, wal-qur'aani dhidh-dhikr
Balil-ladheena kafaroo fee `izzatiw washiqaaq
Kam ahlaknaa min qablihim min qarnin fanaadaw walaata heena manaas
Wa`ajiboo an jaa'ahum mundhirum minhum, waqaalal-kaafiroona haadhaa saahirun kadhdhaab
Aja`alal-aalihata ilaahaw waahidaa, inna haadhaa lashay'un `ujaab
Wantalaqal-mala'u minhum animshoo wasbiroo `alaa aalihatikum, inna haadhaa lashay'uy yuraad
Maa sami`naa bihaadhaa fil-millatil-aakhirah, in haadhaa illakhtilaaq
A'unzila `alayhidh-dhikru mim bayninaa, bal hum fee shakkim min dhikree, bal lammaa yadhooqoo `adhaab
Am `indahum khazaa'inu rahmati rabbikal-`azeezil-wahhaab
Am lahum mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa baynahumaa, falyartaqoo fil-asbaab
Jundum maa hunaalika mahzoomum minal-ahzaab
Kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu noohiw wa`aaduw wafir`awnu dhul-awtaad
Wathamoodu waqawmu lootiw wa'ashaabu l'aykah, ulaa'ikal-ahzaab
In kullun illaa kadhdhabar-rusula fahaqqa `iqaab
Wamaa yanzuru haa'ulaa'i illaa sayhataw waahidatam maa lahaa min fawaaq
Waqaaloo rabbanaa `ajjil lanaa qittanaa qabla yawmil-hisaab
Isbir `alaa maa yaqooloona wadhkur `abdanaa daawooda dhal-ayd, innahoo awwaab
Innaa sakhkharnal-jibaala ma`ahoo yusabbihna bil-`ashiyyi wal-ishraaq
Wat-tayra mahshoorah, kullul lahoo awwaab
Washadadnaa mulkahoo wa'aataynaahul-hikmata wafaslal-khitaab
Wahal ataaka naba'ul-khasm, idh tasawwarul-mihraab
Idh dakhaloo `alaa daawooda fafazi`a minhum qaaloo laa takhaf, khasmaani baghaa ba`dunaa `alaa ba`din fahkum baynanaa bil-haqqi walaa tushtit wahdinaa ilaa sawaa'is-siraat
Inna haadhaa akhee, lahoo tis`uw watis`oona na`jataw waliya na`jatuw waahidah, faqaala akfilneehaa wa`azzanee fil-khitaab
Qaala laqad zalamaka bisu'aali na`jatika ilaa ni`aajih, wa'inna katheeram minal-khulataa'i layabghee ba`duhum `alaa ba`din illal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati waqaleelum maa hum, wazanna daawoodu annamaa fatannaahu fastaghfara rabbahoo wakharra raaki`aw wa'anaab
Faghafarnaa lahoo dhaalik, wa'inna lahoo `indanaa lazulfaa wahusna ma'aab
Yaadaawoodu innaa ja`alnaaka khaleefatan fil-ardi fahkum baynan-naasi bil-haqqi walaa tattabi`il-hawaa fayudillaka `an sabeelillaah, innal-ladheena yadilloona `an sabeelillaahi lahum `adhaabun shadeedum bimaa nasoo yawmal-hisaab
Wamaa khalaqnas-samaa'a wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa baatilaa, dhaalika zannul-ladheena kafaroo fawaylul lilladheena kafaroo minan-naar
Am naj`alul-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati kal-mufsideena fil-ard, am naj`alul-muttaqeena kal-fujjaar
Kitaabun anzalnaahu ilayka mubaarakul liyaddabbaroo aayaatihee waliyatadhakkara ulul-albaab
Wawahabnaa lidaawooda sulaymaan, ni`mal-`abd, innahoo awwaab
Idh `urida `alayhi bil-`ashiyyis-saafinaatul-jiyaad
Faqaala innee ahbabtu hubbal-khayri `an dhikri rabbee, hattaa tawaarat bil-hijaab
Ruddoohaa `alayy, fatafiqa masham bis-sooqi wal-a`naaq
Walaqad fatannaa sulaymaana wa'alqaynaa `alaa kursiyyihee jasadan thumma anaab
Qaala rabbighfir lee wahab lee mulkal laa yambaghee li'ahadim mim ba`dee, innaka antal-wahhaab
Fasakhkharnaa lahur-reeha tajree bi'amrihee rukhaa'an haythu asaab
Wash-shayaateena kulla bannaa'iw waghawwaas
Wa'aakhareena muqarraneena fil-asfaad
Haadhaa `ataa'unaa famnun aw amsik bighayri hisaab
Wa'inna lahoo `indanaa lazulfaa wahusna ma'aab
Wadhkur `abdanaa ayyoob, idh naadaa rabbahoo annee massaniyash-shaytaanu binusbiw wa`adhaab
Urkud birijlik, haadhaa mughtasalum baariduw washaraab
Wawahabnaa lahoo ahlahoo wamithlahum ma`ahum rahmatam minnaa wadhikraa li'ulil-albaab
Wakhudh biyadika dighthan fadrib bihee walaa tahnath, innaa wajadnaahu saabiraa, ni`mal-`abd, innahoo awwaab
Wadhkur `ibaadanaa ibraaheema wa'ishaaqa waya`qooba ulil-aydee wal-absaar
Innaa akhlasnaahum bikhaalisatin dhikrad-daar
Wa'innahum `indanaa laminal-mustafaynal-akhyaar
Wadhkur ismaa`eela wal-yasa`a wadhal-kifl, wakullum minal-akhyaar
Haadhaa dhikr, wa'inna lil-muttaqeena lahusna ma'aab
Jannaati `adnim mufattahatal lahumul-abwaab
Muttaki'eena feehaa yad`oona feehaa bifaakihatin katheeratiw washaraab
Wa`indahum qaasiraatut-tarfi atraab
Haadhaa maa too`adoona liyawmil-hisaab
Inna haadhaa larizqunaa maa lahoo min nafaad
Haadhaa, wa'inna lit-taagheena lasharra ma'aab
Jahannam, yaslawnahaa, fabi'sal-mihaad
Haadhaa falyadhooqoohu hameemuw waghassaaq
Wa'aakharu min shaklihee azwaaj
Haadhaa fawjum muqtahimum ma`akum, laa marhabam bihim, innahum saalun-naar
Qaaloo bal antum laa marhabam bikum, antum qaddamtumoohu lanaa, fabi'sal-qaraar
Qaaloo rabbanaa man qaddama lanaa haadhaa fazidhu `adhaaban di`fan fin-naar
Waqaaloo maa lanaa laa naraa rijaalan kunnaa na`udduhum minal-ashraar
Attakhadhnaahum sikhriyyan am zaaghat `anhumul-absaar
Inna dhaalika lahaqqun takhaasumu ahlin-naar
Qul innamaa ana mundhir, wamaa min ilaahin illallaahul-waahidul-qahhaar
Rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa baynahumal-`azeezul-ghaffaar
Qul huwa naba'un `azeem
Antum `anhu mu`ridoon
Maa kaana liya min `ilmim bil-mala'il-a`laa idh yakhtasimoon
Iy yoohaa ilayya illaa annamaa ana nadheerum mubeen
Idh qaala rabbuka lil-malaa'ikati innee khaaliqum basharam min teen
Fa'idhaa sawwaytuhoo wanafakhtu feehi mir roohee faqa`oo lahoo saajideen
Fasajadal-malaa'ikatu kulluhum ajma`oon
Illaa iblees, istakbara wakaana minal-kaafireen
Qaala yaa ibleesu maa mana`aka an tasjuda limaa khalaqtu biyadayy, astakbarta am kunta minal-`aaleen
Qaala ana khayrum minhu khalaqtanee min naariw wakhalaqtahoo min teen
Qaala fakhruj minhaa fa'innaka rajeem
Wa'inna `alayka la`natee ilaa yawmid-deen
Qaala rabbi fa'anzirnee ilaa yawmi yub`athoon
Qaala fa'innaka minal-munzareen
Ilaa yawmil-waqtil-ma`loom
Qaala fabi`izzatika la'ughwiyannahum ajma`een
Illaa `ibaadaka minhumul-mukhlaseen
Qaala fal-haqq, wal-haqqa aqool
La'amla'anna jahannama minka wamimman tabi`aka minhum ajma`een
Qul maa as'alukum `alayhi min ajriw wamaa ana minal-mutakallifeen
In huwa illaa dhikrul lil-`aalameen
Walata`lamunna naba'ahoo ba`da heen

Tanzeelul-kitaabi minallaahil-`azeezil-hakeem
Innaa anzalnaa ilaykal-kitaaba bil-haqqi fa`budillaaha mukhlisal lahud-deen
Alaa lillaahid-deenul-khaalis, wal-ladheenattakhadhoo min doonihee awliyaa', maa na`buduhum illaa liyuqarriboonaa ilallaahi zulfaa, innallaaha yahkumu baynahum fee maa hum feehi yakhtalifoon, innallaaha laa yahdee man huwa kaadhibun kaffaar
Law araadallaahu ay yattakhidha waladal lastafaa mimmaa yakhluqu maa yashaa'u subhaanah, huwallaahul-waahidul-qahhaar
Khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqq, yukawwirul-layla `alan-nahaari wayukawwirun-nahaara `alal-layli wasakhkharash-shamsa wal-qamar, kulluy yajree li'ajalim musammaa, alaa huwal-`azeezul-ghaffaar
Khalaqakum min nafsiw waahidatin thumma ja`ala minhaa zawjahaa wa'anzala lakum minal-an`aami thamaaniyata azwaaj, yakhluqukum fee butooni ummahaatikum khalqam mim ba`di khalqin fee zulumaatin thalaath, dhaalikumullaahu rabbukum lahul-mulk, laa ilaaha illaa huw, fa'annaa tusrafoon
In takfuroo fa'innallaaha ghaniyyun `ankum, walaa yardaa li`ibaadihil-kufr, wa'in tashkuroo yardahu lakum, walaa taziru waaziratuw wizra ukhraa, thumma ilaa rabbikum marji`ukum fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta`maloon, innahoo `aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
Wa'idhaa massal-insaana durrun da`aa rabbahoo muneeban ilayhi thumma idhaa khawwalahoo ni`matam minhu nasiya maa kaana yad`oo ilayhi min qablu waja`ala lillaahi andaadal liyudilla `an sabeelih, qul tamatta` bikufrika qaleelaa, innaka min ashaabin-naar
Amman huwa qaanitun aanaa'al-layli saajidaw waqaa'imay yahdharul-aakhirata wayarjoo rahmata rabbih, qul hal yastawil-ladheena ya`lamoona wal-ladheena laa ya`lamoon, innamaa yatadhakkaru ulul-albaab
Qul yaa`ibaadil-ladheena aamanuttaqoo rabbakum, lilladheena ahsanoo fee haadhihid-dunyaa hasanah, wa'ardullaahi waasi`ah, innamaa yuwaffas-saabiroona ajrahum bighayri hisaab
Qul innee umirtu an a`budallaaha mukhlisal lahud-deen
Wa'umirtu li'an akoona awwalal-muslimeen
Qul innee akhaafu in `asaytu rabbee `adhaaba yawmin `azeem
Qulillaaha a`budu mukhlisal lahoo deenee
Fa`budoo maa shi'tum min doonih, qul innal-khaasireenal-ladheena khasiroo anfusahum wa'ahleehim yawmal-qiyaamah, alaa dhaalika huwal-khusraanul-mubeen
Lahum min fawqihim zulalum minan-naari wamin tahtihim zulal, dhaalika yukhawwifullaahu bihee `ibaadah, yaa`ibaadi fattaqoon
Wal-ladheenajtanabut-taaghoota ay ya`budoohaa wa'anaaboo ilallaahi lahumul-bushraa, fabashshir `ibaad
Al-ladheena yastami`oonal-qawla fayattabi`oona ahsanah, ulaa'ikal-ladheena hadaahumullaahu wa'ulaa'ika hum ulul-albaab
Afaman haqqa `alayhi kalimatul-`adhaab, afa'anta tunqidhu man fin-naar
Laakinil-ladheenattaqaw rabbahum lahum ghurafum min fawqihaa ghurafum mabniyyatun tajree min tahtihal-anhaar, wa`dallaah, laa yukhlifullaahul-mee`aad
Alam tara annallaaha anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fasalakahoo yanaabee`a fil-ardi thumma yukhriju bihee zar`am mukhtalifan alwaanuhoo thumma yaheeju fataraahu musfarran thumma yaj`aluhoo hutaamaa, inna fee dhaalika ladhikraa li'ulil-albaab
Afaman sharahallaahu sadrahoo lil-islaami fahuwa `alaa noorim mir rabbih, fawaylul lil-qaasiyati quloobuhum min dhikrillaah, ulaa'ika fee dalaalim mubeen
Allaahu nazzala ahsanal-hadeethi kitaabam mutashaabiham mathaaniya taqsha`irru minhu juloodul-ladheena yakhshawna rabbahum, thumma taleenu julooduhum waquloobuhum ilaa dhikrillaah, dhaalika hudallaahi yahdee bihee may yashaa', wamay yudlilillaahu famaa lahoo min haad
Afamay yattaqee biwajhihee soo'al-`adhaabi yawmal-qiyaamah, waqeela liz-zaalimeena dhooqoo maa kuntum taksiboon
Kadhdhabal-ladheena min qablihim fa'ataahumul-`adhaabu min haythu laa yash`uroon
Fa'adhaaqahumullaahul-khizya fil-hayaatid-dunyaa, wala`adhaabul-aakhirati akbar, law kaanoo ya`lamoon
Walaqad darabnaa lin-naasi fee haadhal-qur'aani min kulli mathalil la`allahum yatadhakkaroon
Qur'aanan `arabiyyan ghayra dhee `iwajil la`allahum yattaqoon
Daraballaahu mathalar rajulan feehi shurakaa'u mutashaakisoona warajulan salamal lirajulin hal yastawiyaani mathalaa, al-hamdu lillaah, bal aktharuhum laa ya`lamoon
Innaka mayyituw wa'innahum mayyitoon
Thumma innakum yawmal-qiyaamati `inda rabbikum takhtasimoon
Faman azlamu mimman kadhaba `alallaahi wakadhdhaba bis-sidqi idh jaa'ah, alaysa fee jahannama mathwal lil-kaafireen
Wal-ladhee jaa'a bis-sidqi wasaddaqa bihee ulaa'ika humul-muttaqoon
Lahum maa yashaa'oona `inda rabbihim, dhaalika jazaa'ul-muhsineen
Liyukaffirallaahu `anhum aswa'al-ladhee `amiloo wayajziyahum ajrahum bi'ahsanil-ladhee kaanoo ya`maloon
Alaysallaahu bikaafin `abdah, wayukhawwifoonaka bil-ladheena min doonih, wamay yudlilillaahu famaa lahoo min haad
Wamay yahdillaahu famaa lahoo mim mudill, alaysallaahu bi`azeezin dhintiqaam
Wala'in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda layaqoolunnallaah, qul afara'aytum maa tad`oona min doonillaahi in araadaniyallaahu bidurrin hal hunna kaashifaatu durrihee aw araadanee birahmatin hal hunna mumsikaatu rahmatih, qul hasbiyallaah, `alayhi yatawakkalul-mutawakkiloon
Qul yaaqawmi`maloo `alaa makaanatikum innee `aamil, fasawfa ta`lamoon
May ya'teehi `adhaabuy yukhzeehi wayahillu `alayhi `adhaabum muqeem
Innaa anzalnaa `alaykal-kitaaba lin-naasi bil-haqq, famanihtadaa falinafsih, waman dalla fa'innamaa yadillu `alayhaa, wamaa anta `alayhim biwakeel
Allaahu yatawaffal-anfusa heena mawtihaa wal-latee lam tamut fee manaamihaa, fayumsikul-latee qadaa `alayhal-mawta wayursilul-ukhraa ilaa ajalim musammaa, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy yatafakkaroon
Amittakhadhoo min doonillaahi shufa`aa', qul awalaw kaanoo laa yamlikoona shay'aw walaa ya`qiloon
Qul lillaahish-shafaa`atu jamee`aa, lahoo mulkus-samaawaati wal-ard, thumma ilayhi turja`oon
Wa'idhaa dhukirallaahu wahdahushma'azzat quloobul-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirah, wa'idhaa dhukiral-ladheena min doonihee idhaa hum yastabshiroon
Qulillaahumma faatiras-samaawaati wal-ardi `aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahaadati anta tahkumu bayna `ibaadika fee maa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
Walaw anna lilladheena zalamoo maa fil-ardi jamee`aw wamithlahoo ma`ahoo laftadaw bihee min soo'il-`adhaabi yawmal-qiyaamah, wabadaa lahum minallaahi maa lam yakoonoo yahtasiboon
Wabadaa lahum sayyi'aatu maa kasaboo wahaaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
Fa'idhaa massal-insaana durrun da`aanaa, thumma idhaa khawwalnaahu ni`matam minnaa qaala innamaa ooteetuhoo `alaa `ilm, bal hiya fitnatuw walaakinna aktharahum laa ya`lamoon
Qad qaalahal-ladheena min qablihim famaa aghnaa `anhum maa kaanoo yaksiboon
Fa'asaabahum sayyi'aatu maa kasaboo, wal-ladheena zalamoo min haa'ulaa'i sayuseebuhum sayyi'aatu maa kasaboo wamaa hum bimu`jizeen
Awalam ya`lamoo annallaaha yabsutur-rizqa limay yashaa'u wayaqdir, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy yu'minoon
Qul yaa`ibaadiyal-ladheena asrafoo `alaa anfusihim laa taqnatoo mir rahmatillaah, innallaaha yaghfirudh-dhunooba jamee`aa, innahoo huwal-ghafoorur-raheem
Wa'aneeboo ilaa rabbikum wa'aslimoo lahoo min qabli ay ya'tiyakumul-`adhaabu thumma laa tunsaroon
Wattabi`oo ahsana maa unzila ilaykum mir rabbikum min qabli ay ya'tiyakumul-`adhaabu baghtataw wa'antum laa tash`uroon
An taqoola nafsuy yaahasrataa `alaa maa farrattu fee jambillaahi wa'in kuntu laminas-saakhireen
Aw taqoola law annallaaha hadaanee lakuntu minal-muttaqeen
Aw taqoola heena taral-`adhaaba law anna lee karratan fa'akoona minal-muhsineen
Balaa qad jaa'atka aayaatee fakadhdhabta bihaa wastakbarta wakunta minal-kaafireen
Wayawmal-qiyaamati taral-ladheena kadhaboo `alallaahi wujoohuhum muswaddah, alaysa fee jahannama mathwal lil-mutakabbireen
Wayunajjillaahul-ladheenattaqaw bimafaazatihim, laa yamassuhumus-soo'u walaa hum yahzanoon
Allaahu khaaliqu kulli shay'iw wahuwa `alaa kulli shay'iw wakeel
Lahoo maqaaleedus-samaawaati wal-ard, wal-ladheena kafaroo bi'aayaatillaahi ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon
Qul afaghayrallaahi ta'muroonnee a`budu ayyuhal-jaahiloon
Walaqad oohiya ilayka wa'ilal-ladheena min qablik, la'in ashrakta layahbatanna `amaluka walatakoonanna minal-khaasireen
Balillaaha fa`bud wakum minash-shaakireen
Wamaa qadarullaaha haqqa qadrih, wal-ardu jamee`an qabdatuhoo yawmal-qiyaamati was-samaawaatu matwiyyaatum biyameenih, subhaanahoo wata`aalaa `ammaa yushrikoon
Wanufikha fis-soori fasa`iqa man fis-samaawaati waman fil-ardi illaa man shaa'allaah, thumma nufikha feehi ukhraa fa'idhaa hum qiyaamuy yanzuroon
Wa'ashraqatil-ardu binoori rabbihaa wawudi`al-kitaabu wajee'a bin-nabiyyeena wash-shuhadaa'i waqudiya baynahum bil-haqqi wahum laa yuzlamoon
Wawuffiyat kullu nafsim maa `amilat wahuwa a`lamu bimaa yaf`aloon
Waseeqal-ladheena kafaroo ilaa jahannama zumaraa, hattaa idhaa jaa'oohaa futihat abwaabuhaa waqaala lahum khazanatuhaa alam ya'tikum rusulum minkum yatloona `alaykum aayaati rabbikum wayundhiroonakum liqaa'a yawmikum haadhaa, qaaloo balaa walaakin haqqat kalimatul-`adhaabi `alal-kaafireen
Qeeladkhuloo abwaaba jahannama khaalideena feehaa, fabi'sa mathwal-mutakabbireen
Waseeqal-ladheenattaqaw rabbahum ilal-jannati zumaraa, hattaa idhaa jaa'oohaa wafutihat abwaabuhaa waqaala lahum khazanatuhaa salaamun `alaykum tibtum fadkhuloohaa khaalideen
Waqaalul-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee sadaqanaa wa`dahoo wa'awrathanal-arda natabawwa'u minal-jannati haythu nashaa', fani`ma ajrul-`aamileen
Wataral-malaa'ikata haaffeena min hawlil-`arshi yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim, waqudiya baynahum bil-haqqi waqeelal-hamdu lillaahi rabbil-`aalameen

Haa meem
Tanzeelul-kitaabi minallaahil-`azeezil-`aleem
Ghaafiridh-dhambi waqaabilit-tawbi shadeedil-`iqaabi dhit-tawl, laa ilaaha illaa huw, ilayhil-maseer
Maa yujaadilu fee aayaatillaahi illal-ladheena kafaroo falaa yaghrurka taqallubuhum fil-bilaad
Kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu noohiw wal-ahzaabu mim ba`dihim, wahammat kullu ummatim birasoolihim liya'khudhoohu wajaadaloo bil-baatili liyudhidoo bihil-haqqa fa'akhadhtuhum, fakayfa kaana `iqaab
Wakadhaalika haqqat kalimatu rabbika `alal-ladheena kafaroo annahum ashaabun-naar
Alladheena yahmiloonal-`arsha waman hawlahoo yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wayu'minoona bihee wayastaghfiroona lilladheena aamanoo, rabbanaa wasi`ta kulla shay'ir rahmataw wa`ilman faghfir lilladheena taaboo wattaba`oo sabeelaka waqihim `adhaabal-jaheem
Rabbanaa wa'adkhilhum jannaati `adninil-latee wa`attahum waman salaha min aabaa'ihim wa'azwaajihim wadhurriyyaatihim, innaka antal-`azeezul-hakeem
Waqihimus-sayyi'aat, waman taqis-sayyi'aati yawma'idhin faqad rahimtah, wadhaalika huwal-fawzul-`azeem
Innal-ladheena kafaroo yunaadawna lamaqtullaahi akbaru mim maqtikum anfusakum idh tud`awna ilal-eemaani fatakfuroon
Qaaloo rabbanaa amattanathnatayni wa'ahyaytanathnatayni fa`tarafnaa bidhunoobinaa fahal ilaa khuroojim min sabeel
Dhaalikum bi'annahoo idhaa du`iyallaahu wahdahoo kafartum, wa'iy yushrak bihee tu'minoo, fal-hukmu lillaahil-`aliyyil-kabeer
Huwal-ladhee yureekum aayaatihee wayunazzilu lakum minas-samaa'i rizqaa, wamaa yatadhakkaru illaa may yuneeb
Fad`ullaaha mukhliseena lahud-deena walaw karihal-kaafiroon
Rafee`ud-darajaati dhul-`arsh, yulqir-rooha min amrihee `alaa may yashaa'u min `ibaadihee liyundhira yawmat-talaaq
Yawma hum baarizoon, laa yakhfaa `alallaahi minhum shay', limanil-mulkul-yawm, lillaahil-waahidil-qahhaar
Al-yawma tujzaa kullu nafsim bimaa kasabat, laa zulmal-yawm, innallaaha saree`ul-hisaab
Wa'andhirhum yawmal-aazifati idhil-quloobu ladal-hanaajiri kaazimeen, maa liz-zaalimeena min hameemiw walaa shafee`iy yutaa`
Ya`lamu khaa'inatal-a`yuni wamaa tukhfis-sudoor
Wallaahu yaqdee bil-haqq, wal-ladheena yad`oona min doonihee laa yaqdoona bishay', innallaaha huwas-samee`ul-baseer
Awalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fayanzuroo kayfa kaana `aaqibatul-ladheena kaanoo min qablihim, kaanoo hum ashadda minhum quwwataw wa'aathaaran fil-ardi fa'akhadhahumullaahu bidhunoobihim, wamaa kaana lahum minallaahi miw waaq
Dhaalika bi'annahum kaanat ta'teehim rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati fakafaroo fa'akhadhahumullaah, innahoo qawiyyun shadeedul-`iqaab
Walaqad arsalnaa moosaa bi'aayaatinaa wasultaanim mubeen
Ilaa fir`awna wahaamaana waqaaroona faqaaloo saahirun kadhdhaab
Falammaa jaa'ahum bil-haqqi min `indinaa qaaluqtuloo abnaa'al-ladheena aamanoo ma`ahoo wastahyoo nisaa'ahum, wamaa kaydul-kaafireena illaa fee dalaal
Waqaala fir`awnu dharoonee aqtul moosaa walyad`u rabbah, innee akhaafu ay yubaddila deenakum aw ay yuzhira fil-ardil-fasaad
Waqaala moosaa innee `udhtu birabbee warabbikum min kulli mutakabbiril laa yu'minu biyawmil-hisaab
Waqaala rajulum mu'min, min aali fir`awna yaktumu eemaanahoo ataqtuloona rajulan ay yaqoola rabbiyallaahu waqad jaa'akum bil-bayyinaati mir rabbikum, wa'iy yaku kaadhiban fa`alayhi kadhibuh, wa'iy yaku saadiqay yusibkum ba`dul-ladhee ya`idukum, innallaaha laa yahdee man huwa musrifun kadhdhaab
Yaaqawmi lakumul-mulkul-yawma zaahireena fil-ard, famay yansurunaa mim ba'sillaahi in jaa'anaa, qaala fir`awnu maa ureekum illaa maa araa wamaa ahdeekum illaa sabeelar-rashaad
Waqaalal-ladhee aamana yaaqawmi innee akhaafu `alaykum mithla yawmil-ahzaab
Mithla da'bi qawmi noohiw wa`aadiw wathamooda wal-ladheena mim ba`dihim, wamallaahu yureedu zulmal lil-`ibaad
Wayaaqawmi innee akhaafu `alaykum yawmat-tanaad
Yawma tuwalloona mudbireen, maa lakum minallaahi min `aasim, wamay yudlilillaahu famaa lahoo min haad
Walaqad jaa'akum yoosufu min qablu bil-bayyinaati famaa ziltum fee shakkim mimmaa jaa'akum bih, hattaa idhaa halaka qultum lay yab`athallaahu mim ba`dihee rasoolaa, kadhaalika yudillullaahu man huwa musrifum murtaab
Al-ladheena yujaadiloona fee aayaatillaahi bighayri sultaanin ataahum, kabura maqtan `indallaahi wa`indal-ladheena aamanoo, kadhaalika yatba`ullaahu `alaa kulli qalbi mutakabbirin jabbaar
Waqaala fir`awnu yaahaamaanubni lee sarhal la`allee ablughul-asbaab
Asbaabas-samaawaati fa'attali`a ilaa ilaahi moosaa wa'innee la'azunnuhoo kaadhibaa, wakadhaalika zuyyina lifir`awna soo'u `amalihee wasudda `anis-sabeel, wamaa kaydu fir`awna illaa fee tabaab
Waqaalal-ladhee aamana yaaqawmittabi`ooni ahdikum sabeelar-rashaad
Yaaqawmi innamaa haadhihil-hayaatud-dunyaa mataa`, wa'innal-aakhirata hiya daarul-qaraar
Man `amila sayyi'atan falaa yujzaa illaa mithlahaa, waman `amila saaliham min dhakarin aw unthaa wahuwa mu'minun fa'ulaa'ika yadkhuloonal-jannata yurzaqoona feehaa bighayri hisaab
Wayaaqawmi maa lee ad`ookum ilan-najaati watad`oonanee ilan-naar
Tad`oonanee li'akfura billaahi wa'ushrika bihee maa laysa lee bihee `ilmuw wa'ana ad`ookum ilal-`azeezil-ghaffaar
Laa jarama annamaa tad`oonanee ilayhi laysa lahoo da`watun fid-dunyaa walaa fil-aakhirati wa'anna maraddanaa ilallaahi wa'annal-musrifeena hum ashaabun-naar
Fasatadhkuroona maa aqoolu lakum, wa'ufawwidu amree ilallaah, innallaaha baseerum bil-`ibaad
Fawaqaahullaahu sayyi'aati maa makaroo wahaaqa bi'aali fir`awna soo'ul-`adhaab
An-naaru yu`radoona `alayhaa ghuduwwaw wa`ashiyyaa, wayawma taqoomus-saa`ah, adkhiloo aala fir`awna ashaddal-`adhaab
Wa'idh yatahaajjoona fin-naari fayaqoolud-du`afaa'u lilladheenastakbaroo innaa kunnaa lakum taba`an fahal antum mughnoona `annaa naseebam minan-naar
Qaalal-ladheenastakbaroo innaa kullun feehaa innallaaha qad hakama baynal-`ibaad
Waqaalal-ladheena fin-naari likhazanati jahannamad`oo rabbakum yukhaffif `annaa yawmam minal-`adhaab
Qaaloo awalam taku ta'teekum rusulukum bil-bayyinaat, qaaloo balaa, qaaloo fad`oo, wamaa du`aa'ul-kaafireena illaa fee dalaal
Innaa lanansuru rusulanaa wal-ladheena aamanoo fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wayawma yaqoomul-ashhaad
Yawma laa yanfa`uz-zaalimeena ma`dhiratuhum walahumul-la`natu walahum soo'ud-daar
Walaqad aataynaa moosal-hudaa wa'awrathnaa banee israa'eelal-kitaab
Hudaw wadhikraa li'ulil-albaab
Fasbir inna wa`dallaahi haqquw wastaghfir lidhambika wasabbih bihamdi rabbika bil-`ashiyyi wal-ibkaar
Innal-ladheena yujaadiloona fee aayaatillaahi bighayri sultaanin ataahum in fee sudoorihim illaa kibrum maa hum bibaaligheeh, fasta`idh billaah, innahoo huwas-samee`ul-baseer
Lakhalqus-samaawaati wal-ardi akbaru min khalqin-naasi walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya`lamoon
Wamaa yastawil-a`maa wal-baseeru wal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati walal-musee', qaleelam maa tatadhakkaroon
Innas-saa`ata la'aatiyatul laa rayba feehaa, walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa yu'minoon
Waqaala rabbukumud`oonee astajib lakum, innal-ladheena yastakbiroona `an `ibaadatee sayadkhuloona jahannama daakhireen
Allaahul-ladhee ja`ala lakumul-layla litaskunoo feehi wan-nahaara mubsiraa, innallaaha ladhoo fadlin `alan-naasi walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa yashkuroon
Dhaalikumullaahu rabbukum khaaliqu kulli shay', laa ilaaha illaa huw, fa'annaa tu'fakoon
Kadhaalika yu'fakul-ladheena kaanoo bi'aayaatillaahi yajhadoon
Allaahul-ladhee ja`ala lakumul-arda qaraaraw was-samaa'a binaa'aw wasawwarakum fa'ahsana suwarakum warazaqakum minat-tayyibaat, dhaalikumullaahu rabbukum, fatabaarakallaahu rabbul-`aalameen
Huwal-hayyu laa ilaaha illaa huwa fad`oohu mukhliseena lahud-deen, al-hamdu lillaahi rabbil-`aalameen
Qul innee nuheetu an a`budal-ladheena tad`oona min doonillaahi lammaa jaa'aniyal-bayyinaatu mir rabbee wa'umirtu an uslima lirabbil-`aalameen
Huwal-ladhee khalaqakum min turaabin thumma min nutfatin thumma min `alaqatin thumma yukhrijukum tiflan thumma litablughoo ashuddakum thumma litakoonoo shuyookhaa, waminkum may yutawaffaa min qablu walitablughoo ajalam musammaw wala`allakum ta`qiloon
Huwal-ladhee yuhyee wayumeet, fa'idhaa qadaa amran fa'innamaa yaqoolu lahoo kun fayakoon
Alam tara ilal-ladheena yujaadiloona fee aayaatillaah, annaa yusrafoon
Alladheena kadhdhaboo bil-kitaabi wabimaa arsalnaa bihee rusulanaa, fasawfa ya`lamoon
Idhil-aghlaalu fee a`naaqihim was-salaasil, yushaboon
Fil-hameemi thumma fin-naari yusjaroon
Thumma qeela lahum ayna maa kuntum tushrikoon
Min doonillaah, qaaloo dalloo `annaa bal lam nakun nad`oo min qablu shay'aa, kadhaalika yudillullaahul-kaafireen
Dhaalikum bimaa kuntum tafrahoona fil-ardi bighayril-haqqi wabimaa kuntum tamrahoon
Udkhuloo abwaaba jahannama khaalideena feehaa, fabi'sa mathwal-mutakabbireen
Fasbir inna wa`dallaahi haqq, fa'immaa nuriyannaka ba`dal-ladhee na`iduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa'ilaynaa yurja`oon
Walaqad arsalnaa rusulam min qablika minhum man qasasnaa `alayka waminhum mal lam naqsus `alayk, wamaa kaana lirasoolin ay ya'tiya bi'aayatin illaa bi'idhnillaah, fa'idhaa jaa'a amrullaahi qudiya bil-haqqi wakhasira hunaalikal-mubtiloon
Allaahul-ladhee ja`ala lakumul-an`aama litarkaboo minhaa waminhaa ta'kuloon
Walakum feehaa manaafi`u walitablughoo `alayhaa haajatan fee sudoorikum wa`alayhaa wa`alal-fulki tuhmaloon
Wayureekum aayaatih, fa'ayya aayaatillaahi tunkiroon
Afalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fayanzuroo kayfa kaana `aaqibatul-ladheena min qablihim, kaanoo akthara minhum wa'ashadda quwwataw wa'aathaaran fil-ardi famaa aghnaa `anhum maa kaanoo yaksiboon
Falammaa jaa'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati farihoo bimaa `indahum minal-`ilmi wahaaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
Falammaa ra'aw ba'sanaa, qaaloo aamannaa billaahi wahdahoo wakafarnaa bimaa kunnaa bihee mushrikeen
Falam yaku yanfa`uhum eemaanuhum lammaa ra'aw ba'sanaa, sunnatallaahil-latee qad khalat fee `ibaadih, wakhasira hunaalikal-kaafiroon

Haa meem
Tanzeelum minar-rahmaanir-raheem
Kitaabun fussilat aayaatuhoo qur'aanan `arabiyyal liqawmiy ya`lamoon
Basheeraw wanadheeraa, fa'a`rada aktharuhum fahum laa yasma`oon
Waqaaloo quloobunaa fee akinnatim mimmaa tad`oonaa ilayhi wafee aadhaaninaa waqruw wamim bayninaa wabaynika hijaabun fa`mal innanaa `aamiloon
Qul innamaa ana basharum mithlukum yoohaa ilayya annamaa ilaahukum ilaahuw waahidun fastaqeemoo ilayhi wastaghfirooh, wawaylul lil-mushrikeen
Al-ladheena laa yu'toonaz-zakaata wahum bil-aakhirati hum kaafiroon
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati lahum ajrun ghayru mamnoon
Qul a'innakum latakfuroona bil-ladhee khalaqal-arda fee yawmayni wataj`aloona lahoo andaadaa, dhaalika rabbul-`aalameen
Waja`ala feehaa rawaasiya min fawqihaa wabaaraka feehaa waqaddara feehaa aqwaatahaa fee arba`ati ayyaam, sawaa'al lis-saa'ileen
Thummastawaa ilas-samaa'i wahiya dukhaanun faqaala lahaa walil'ardi'tiyaa taw`an aw karhaa, qaalataa ataynaa taa'i`een
Faqadaahunna sab`a samaawaatin fee yawmayni wa'awhaa fee kulli samaa'in amrahaa, wazayyannas-samaa'ad-dunyaa bimasaabeeh, wahifzaa, dhaalika taqdeerul-`azeezil-`aleem
Fa'in a`radoo faqul andhartukum saa`iqatam mithla saa`iqati `aadiw wathamood
Idh jaa'athumur-rusulu mim bayni aydeehim wamin khalfihim allaa ta`budoo illallaah, qaaloo law shaa'a rabbunaa la'anzala malaa'ikatan fa'innaa bimaa ursiltum bihee kaafiroon
Fa'ammaa `aadun fastakbaroo fil-ardi bighayril-haqqi waqaaloo man ashaddu minnaa quwwah, awalam yaraw annallaahal-ladhee khalaqahum huwa ashaddu minhum quwwah, wakaanoo bi'aayaatinaa yajhadoon
Fa'arsalnaa `alayhim reehan sarsaran fee ayyaamin nahisaatil linudheeqahum `adhaabal-khizyi fil-hayaatid-dunyaa, wala`adhaabul-aakhirati akhzaa wahum laa yunsaroon
Wa'ammaa thamoodu fahadaynaahum fastahabbul-`amaa `alal-hudaa fa'akhadhathum saa`iqatul-`adhaabil-hooni bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
Wanajjaynal-ladheena aamanoo wakaanoo yattaqoon
Wayawma yuhsharu a`daa'ullaahi ilan-naari fahum yooza`oon
Hattaa idhaa maa jaa'oohaa shahida `alayhim sam`uhum wa'absaaruhum wajulooduhum bimaa kaanoo ya`maloon
Waqaaloo lijuloodihim lima shahittum `alaynaa, qaaloo antaqanallaahul-ladhee antaqa kulla shay'iw wahuwa khalaqakum awwala marratiw wa'ilayhi turja`oon
Wamaa kuntum tastatiroona ay yashhada `alaykum sam`ukum walaa absaarukum walaa juloodukum walaakin zanantum annallaaha laa ya`lamu katheeram mimmaa ta`maloon
Wadhaalikum zannukumul-ladhee zanantum birabbikum ardaakum fa'asbahtum minal-khaasireen
Fa'iy yasbiroo fan-naaru mathwal lahum, wa'iy yasta`tiboo famaa hum minal-mu`tabeen
Waqayyadnaa lahum quranaa'a fazayyanoo lahum maa bayna aydeehim wamaa khalfahum wahaqqa `alayhimul-qawlu fee umamin qad khalat min qablihim minal-jinni wal-ins, innahum kaanoo khaasireen
Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo laa tasma`oo lihaadhal-qur'aani wal-ghaw feehi la`allakum taghliboon
Falanudheeqannal-ladheena kafaroo `adhaaban shadeedaw walanajziyannahum aswa'al-ladhee kaanoo ya`maloon
Dhaalika jazaa'u a`daa'illaahin-naaru lahum feehaa daarul-khuld, jazaa'am bimaa kaanoo bi'aayaatinaa yajhadoon
Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo rabbanaa arinal-ladhayni adallaanaa minal-jinni wal-insi naj`alhumaa tahta aqdaaminaa liyakoonaa minal-asfaleen
Innal-ladheena qaaloo rabbunallaahu thummastaqaamoo tatanazzalu `alayhimul-malaa'ikatu allaa takhaafoo walaa tahzanoo wa'abshiroo bil-jannatil-latee kuntum too`adoon
Nahnu awliyaa'ukum fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wafil-aakhirah, walakum feehaa maa tashtahee anfusukum walakum feehaa maa tadda`oon
Nuzulam min ghafoorir raheem
Waman ahsanu qawlam mimman da`aa ilallaahi wa`amila saalihaw waqaala innanee minal-muslimeen
Walaa tastawil-hasanatu walas-sayyi'ah, idfa` bil-latee hiya ahsanu fa'idhal-ladhee baynaka wabaynahoo `adaawatun ka'annahoo waliyyun hameem
Wamaa yulaqqaahaa illal-ladheena sabaroo, wamaa yulaqqaahaa illaa dhoo hazzin `azeem
Wa'immaa yanzaghannaka minash-shaytaani nazghun fasta`idh billaah, innahoo huwas-samee`ul-`aleem
Wamin aayaatihil-laylu wan-nahaaru wash-shamsu wal-qamar, laa tasjudoo lish-shamsi walaa lil-qamari wasjudoo lillaahil-ladhee khalaqahunna in kuntum iyyaahu ta`budoon
Fa'inistakbaroo fal-ladheena `inda rabbika yusabbihoona lahoo bil-layli wan-nahaari wahum laa yas'amoon
Wamin aayaatihee annaka taral-arda khaashi`atan fa'idhaa anzalnaa `alayhal-maa'ahtazzat warabat, innal-ladhee ahyaahaa lamuhyil-mawtaa, innahoo `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Innal-ladheena yulhidoona fee aayaatinaa laa yakhfawna `alaynaa, afamay yulqaa fin-naari khayrun am may ya'tee aaminay yawmal-qiyaamah, i`maloo maa shi'tum innahoo bimaa ta`maloona baseer
Innal-ladheena kafaroo bidh-dhikri lammaa jaa'ahum, wa'innahoo lakitaabun `azeez
Laa ya'teehil-baatilu mim bayni yadayhi walaa min khalfih, tanzeelum min hakeemin hameed
Maa yuqaalu laka illaa maa qad qeela lir-rusuli min qablik, inna rabbaka ladhoo maghfiratiw wadhoo `iqaabin aleem
Walaw ja`alnaahu qur'aanan a`jamiyyal laqaaloo lawlaa fussilat aayaatuh, a'a`jamiyyuw wa`arabiyy, qul huwa lilladheena aamanoo hudaw washifaa', wal-ladheena laa yu'minoona fee aadhaanihim waqruw wahuwa `alayhim `amaa, ulaa'ika yunaadawna mim makaanim ba`eed
Walaqad aataynaa moosal-kitaaba fakhtulifa feeh, walawlaa kalimatun sabaqat mir rabbika laqudiya baynahum, wa'innahum lafee shakkim minhu mureeb
Man `amila saalihan falinafsihee waman asaa'a fa`alayhaa, wamaa rabbuka bizallaamil lil-`abeed
Ilayhi yuraddu `ilmus-saa`ah, wamaa takhruju min thamaraatim min akmaamihaa wamaa tahmilu min unthaa walaa tada`u illaa bi`ilmih, wayawma yunaadeehim ayna shurakaa'ee qaaloo aadhannaaka maa minnaa min shaheed
Wadalla `anhum maa kaanoo yad`oona min qablu wazannoo maa lahum mim mahees
Laa yas'amul-insaanu min du`aa'il-khayr, wa'im massahush-sharru faya'oosun qanoot
Wala'in adhaqnaahu rahmatam minnaa mim ba`di darraa'a massathu layaqoolanna haadhaa lee wamaa azunnus-saa`ata qaa'imataw wala'ir ruji`tu ilaa rabbee inna lee `indahoo lal-husnaa, falanunabbi'annal-ladheena kafaroo bimaa `amiloo, walanudheeqannahum min `adhaabin ghaleez
Wa'idhaa an`amnaa `alal-insaani a`rada wana'aa bijaanibih, wa'idhaa massahush-sharru fadhoo du`aa'in `areed
Qul ara'aytum in kaana min `indillaahi thumma kafartum bihee man adallu mimman huwa fee shiqaaqim ba`eed
Sanureehim aayaatinaa fil-aafaaqi wafee anfusihim hattaa yatabayyana lahum annahul-haqq, awalam yakfi birabbika annahoo `alaa kulli shay'in shaheed
Alaa innahum fee miryatim mil liqaa'i rabbihim, alaa innahoo bikulli shay'im muheet

Haa meem
`Ayn seen qaaf
Kadhaalika yoohee ilayka wa'ilal-ladheena min qablikallaahul-`azeezul-hakeem
Lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wahuwal-`aliyyul-`azeem
Takaadus-samaawaatu yatafattarna min fawqihinna wal-malaa'ikatu yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wayastaghfiroona liman fil-ard, alaa innallaaha huwal-ghafoorur-raheem
Wal-ladheenattakhadhoo min doonihee awliyaa'allaahu hafeezun `alayhim, wamaa anta `alayhim biwakeel
Wakadhaalika awhaynaa ilayka qur'aanan `arabiyyal litundhira ummal-quraa waman hawlahaa watundhira yawmal-jam`i laa rayba feeh, fareequn fil-jannati wafareequn fis-sa`eer
Walaw shaa'allaahu laja`alahum ummataw waahidataw walaakiy yudkhilu may yashaa'u fee rahmatih, waz-zaalimoona maa lahum miw waliyyiw walaa naseer
Amittakhadhoo min doonihee awliyaa', fallaahu huwal-waliyyu wahuwa yuhyil-mawtaa, wahuwa `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Wamakhtalaftum feehi min shay'in fahukmuhoo ilallaah, dhaalikumullaahu rabbee `alayhi tawakkalt, wa'ilayhi uneeb
Faatirus-samaawaati wal-ard, ja`ala lakum min anfusikum azwaajaw waminal-an`aami azwaajaa, yadhra'ukum feeh, laysa kamithlihee shay', wahuwas-samee`ul-baseer
Lahoo maqaaleedus-samaawaati wal-ard, yabsutur-rizqa limay yashaa'u wayaqdir, innahoo bikulli shay'in `aleem
Shara`a lakum minad-deeni maa wassaa bihee noohaw wal-ladhee awhaynaa ilayka wamaa wassaynaa bihee ibraaheema wamoosaa wa`eesaa an aqeemud-deena walaa tatafarraqoo feeh, kabura `alal-mushrikeena maa tad`oohum ilayh, allaahu yajtabee ilayhi may yashaa'u wayahdee ilayhi may yuneeb
Wamaa tafarraqoo illaa mim ba`di maa jaa'ahumul-`ilmu baghyam baynahum, walawlaa kalimatun sabaqat mir rabbika ilaa ajalim musammal laqudiya baynahum, wa'innal-ladheena oorithul-kitaaba mim ba`dihim lafee shakkim minhu mureeb
Falidhaalika fad`, wastaqim kamaa umirt, walaa tattabi` ahwaa'ahum, waqul aamantu bimaa anzalallaahu min kitaab, wa'umirtu li'a`dila baynakum, allaahu rabbunaa warabbukum, lanaa a`maalunaa walakum a`maalukum, laa hujjata baynanaa wabaynakum, allaahu yajma`u baynanaa, wa'ilayhil-maseer
Wal-ladheena yuhaajjoona fillaahi mim ba`di mastujeeba lahoo hujjatuhum daahidatun `inda rabbihim wa`alayhim ghadabuw walahum `adhaabun shadeed
Allaahul-ladhee anzalal-kitaaba bil-haqqi wal-meezaan, wamaa yudreeka la`allas-saa`ata qareeb
Yasta`jilu bihal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bihaa, wal-ladheena aamanoo mushfiqoona minhaa waya`lamoona annahal-haqq, alaa innal-ladheena yumaaroona fis-saa`ati lafee dalaalim ba`eed
Allaahu lateefum bi`ibaadihee yarzuqu may yashaa', wahuwal-qawiyyul-`azeez
Man kaana yureedu harthal-aakhirati nazid lahoo fee harthih, waman kaana yureedu harthad-dunyaa nu'tihee minhaa wamaa lahoo fil-aakhirati min naseeb
Am lahum shurakaa'u shara`oo lahum minad-deeni maa lam ya'dham bihillaah, walawlaa kalimatul-fasli laqudiya baynahum, wa'innaz-zaalimeena lahum `adhaabun aleem
Taraz-zaalimeena mushfiqeena mimmaa kasaboo wahuwa waaqi`um bihim, wal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati fee rawdaatil-jannaat, lahum maa yashaa'oona `inda rabbihim, dhaalika huwal-fadlul-kabeer
Dhaalikal-ladhee yubashshirullaahu `ibaadahul-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaat, qul laa as'alukum `alayhi ajran illal-mawaddata fil-qurbaa, wamay yaqtarif hasanatan nazid lahoo feehaa husnaa, innallaaha ghafoorun shakoor
Am yaqooloonaftaraa `alallaahi kadhibaa, fa'iy yasha'illaahu yakhtim `alaa qalbik, wayamhullaahul-baatila wayuhiqqul-haqqa bikalimaatih, innahoo `aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
Wahuwal-ladhee yaqbalut-tawbata `an `ibaadihee waya`foo `anis-sayyi'aati waya`lamu maa taf`aloon
Wayastajeebul-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati wayazeeduhum min fadlih, wal-kaafiroona lahum `adhaabun shadeed
Walaw basatallaahur-rizqa li`ibaadihee labaghaw fil-ardi walaakiy yunazzilu biqadarim maa yashaa', innahoo bi`ibaadihee khabeerum baseer
Wahuwal-ladhee yunazzilul-ghaytha mim ba`di maa qanatoo wayanshuru rahmatah, wahuwal-waliyyul-hameed
Wamin aayaatihee khalqus-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa baththa feehimaa min daabbah, wahuwa `alaa jam`ihim idhaa yashaa'u qadeer
Wamaa asaabakum mim museebatin fabimaa kasabat aydeekum waya`foo `an katheer
Wamaa antum bimu`jizeena fil-ard, wamaa lakum min doonillaahi miw waliyyiw walaa naseer
Wamin aayaatihil-jawaari fil-bahri kal-a`laam
Iy yasha' yuskinir-reeha fayazlalna rawaakida `alaa zahrih, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil likulli sabbaarin shakoor
Aw yoobiqhunna bimaa kasaboo waya`fu `an katheer
Waya`lamal-ladheena yujaadiloona fee aayaatinaa, maa lahum mim mahees
Famaa ooteetum min shay'in famataa`ul-hayaatid-dunyaa, wamaa `indallaahi khayruw wa'abqaa lilladheena aamanoo wa`alaa rabbihim yatawakkaloon
Wal-ladheena yajtaniboona kabaa'iral-ithmi wal-fawaahisha wa'idhaa maa ghadiboo hum yaghfiroon
Wal-ladheenastajaaboo lirabbihim wa'aqaamus-salaah, wa'amruhum shooraa baynahum, wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Wal-ladheena idhaa asaabahumul-baghyu hum yantasiroon
Wajazaa'u sayyi'atin sayyi'atum mithluhaa, faman `afaa wa'aslaha fa'ajruhoo `alallaah, innahoo laa yuhibbuz-zaalimeen
Walamanintasara ba`da zulmihee fa'ulaa'ika maa `alayhim min sabeel
Innamas-sabeelu `alal-ladheena yazlimoonan-naasa wayabghoona fil-ardi bighayril-haqq, ulaa'ika lahum `adhaabun aleem
Walaman sabara waghafara inna dhaalika lamin `azmil-umoor
Wamay yudlilillaahu famaa lahoo miw waliyyim mim ba`dih, wataraz-zaalimeena lammaa ra'awul-`adhaaba yaqooloona hal ilaa maraddim min sabeel
Wataraahum yu`radoona `alayhaa khaashi`eena minadh-dhulli yanzuroona min tarfin khafiyy, waqaalal-ladheena aamanoo innal-khaasireenal-ladheena khasiroo anfusahum wa'ahleehim yawmal-qiyaamah, alaa innaz-zaalimeena fee `adhaabim muqeem
Wamaa kaana lahum min awliyaa'a yansuroonahum min doonillaah, wamay yudlilillaahu famaa lahoo min sabeel
Istajeeboo lirabbikum min qabli ay ya'tiya yawmul laa maradda lahoo minallaah, maa lakum mim malja'iy yawma'idhiw wamaa lakum min nakeer
Fa'in a`radoo famaa arsalnaaka `alayhim hafeezaa, in `alayka illal-balaagh, wa'innaa idhaa adhaqnal-insaana minnaa rahmatan fariha bihaa, wa'in tusibhum sayyi'atum bimaa qaddamat aydeehim fa'innal-insaana kafoor
Lillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ard, yakhluqu maa yashaa', yahabu limay yashaa'u inaathaw wayahabu limay yashaa'udh-dhukoor
Aw yuzawwijuhum dhukraanaw wa'inaathaa, wayaj`alu may yashaa'u `aqeemaa, innahoo `aleemun qadeer
Wamaa kaana libasharin ay yukallimahullaahu illaa wahyan aw miw waraa'i hijaabin aw yursila rasoolan fayoohiya bi'idhnihee maa yashaa', innahoo `aliyyun hakeem
Wakadhaalika awhaynaa ilayka rooham min amrinaa, maa kunta tadree mal-kitaabu walal-eemaanu walaakin ja`alnaahu nooran nahdee bihee man nashaa'u min `ibaadinaa, wa'innaka latahdee ilaa siraatim mustaqeem
Siraatillaahil-ladhee lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, alaa ilallaahi taseerul-umoor

Haa meem
Wal-kitaabil-mubeen
Innaa ja`alnaahu qur'aanan `arabiyyal la`allakum ta`qiloon
Wa'innahoo fee ummil-kitaabi ladaynaa la`aliyyun hakeem
Afanadribu `ankumudh-dhikra safhan an kuntum qawmam musrifeen
Wakam arsalnaa min nabiyyin fil-awwaleen
Wamaa ya'teehim min nabiyyin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
Fa'ahlaknaa ashadda minhum batshaw wamadaa mathalul-awwaleen
Wala'in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda layaqoolunna khalaqahunnal-`azeezul-`aleem
Al-ladhee ja`ala lakumul-arda mahdaw waja`ala lakum feehaa subulal la`allakum tahtadoon
Wal-ladhee nazzala minas-samaa'i maa'am biqadar, fa'ansharnaa bihee baldatam maytaa, kadhaalika tukhrajoon
Wal-ladhee khalaqal-azwaaja kullahaa waja`ala lakum minal-fulki wal-an`aami maa tarkaboon
Litastawoo `alaa zuhoorihee thumma tadhkuroo ni`mata rabbikum idhastawaytum `alayhi wataqooloo subhaanal-ladhee sakhkhara lanaa haadhaa wamaa kunnaa lahoo muqrineen
Wa'innaa ilaa rabbinaa lamunqaliboon
Waja`aloo lahoo min `ibaadihee juz'aa, innal-insaana lakafoorum mubeen
Amittakhadha mimmaa yakhluqu banaatiw wa'asfaakum bil-baneen
Wa'idhaa bushshira ahaduhum bimaa daraba lir-rahmaani mathalan zalla wajhuhoo muswaddaw wahuwa kazeem
Awamay yunashsha'u fil-hilyati wahuwa fil-khisaami ghayru mubeen
Waja`alul-malaa'ikatal-ladheena hum `ibaadur-rahmaani inaathaa, ashahidoo khalqahum, satuktabu shahaadatuhum wayus'aloon
Waqaaloo law shaa'ar-rahmaanu maa `abadnaahum, maa lahum bidhaalika min `ilmin in hum illaa yakhrusoon
Am aataynaahum kitaabam min qablihee fahum bihee mustamsikoon
Bal qaaloo innaa wajadnaa aabaa'anaa `alaa ummatiw wa'innaa `alaa aathaarihim muhtadoon
Wakadhaalika maa arsalnaa min qablika fee qaryatim min nadheerin illaa qaala mutrafoohaa innaa wajadnaa aabaa'anaa `alaa ummatiw wa'innaa `alaa aathaarihim muqtadoon
Qaala awalaw ji'tukum bi'ahdaa mimmaa wajattum `alayhi aabaa'akum, qaaloo innaa bimaa ursiltum bihee kaafiroon
Fantaqamnaa minhum fanzur kayfa kaana `aaqibatul-mukadhdhibeen
Wa'idh qaala ibraaheemu li'abeehi waqawmihee innanee baraa'um mimmaa ta`budoon
Illal-ladhee fataranee fa'innahoo sayahdeen
Waja`alahaa kalimatam baaqiyatan fee `aqibihee la`allahum yarji`oon
Bal matta`tu haa'ulaa'i wa'aabaa'ahum hattaa jaa'ahumul-haqqu warasoolum mubeen
Walammaa jaa'ahumul-haqqu qaaloo haadhaa sihruw wa'innaa bihee kaafiroon
Waqaaloo lawlaa nuzzila haadhal-qur'aanu `alaa rajulim minal-qaryatayni `azeem
Ahum yaqsimoona rahmata rabbik, nahnu qasamnaa baynahum ma`eeshatahum fil-hayaatid-dunyaa warafa`naa ba`dahum fawqa ba`din darajaatil liyattakhidha ba`duhum ba`dan sukhriyyaa, warahmatu rabbika khayrum mimmaa yajma`oon
Walawlaa ay yakoonan-naasu ummataw waahidatal laja`alnaa limay yakfuru bir-rahmaani libuyootihim suqufam min fiddatiw wama`aarija `alayhaa yazharoon
Walibuyootihim abwaabaw wasururan `alayhaa yattaki'oon
Wazukhrufaa, wa'in kullu dhaalika lammaa mataa`ul-hayaatid-dunyaa, wal-aakhiratu `inda rabbika lil-muttaqeen
Wamay ya`shu `an dhikrir-rahmaani nuqayyid lahoo shaytaanan fahuwa lahoo qareen
Wa'innahum layasuddoonahum `anis-sabeeli wayahsaboona annahum muhtadoon
Hattaa idhaa jaa'anaa qaala yaalayta baynee wabaynaka bu`dal-mashriqayni fabi'sal-qareen
Walay yanfa`akumul-yawma iz zalamtum annakum fil-`adhaabi mushtarikoon
Afa'anta tusmi`us-summa aw tahdil-`umya waman kaana fee dalaalim mubeen
Fa'immaa nadhhabanna bika fa'innaa minhum muntaqimoon
Aw nuriyannakal-ladhee wa`adnaahum fa'innaa `alayhim muqtadiroon
Fastamsik bil-ladhee oohiya ilayk, innaka `alaa siraatim mustaqeem
Wa'innahoo ladhikrul laka waliqawmik, wasawfa tus'aloon
Was'al man arsalnaa min qablika mir rusulinaa, aja`alnaa min doonir-rahmaani aalihatay yu`badoon
Walaqad arsalnaa moosaa bi'aayaatinaa ilaa fir`awna wamala'ihee faqaala innee rasoolu rabbil-`aalameen
Falammaa jaa'ahum bi'aayaatinaa idhaa hum minhaa yadhakoon
Wamaa nureehim min aayatin illaa hiya akbaru min ukhtihaa, wa'akhadhnaahum bil-`adhaabi la`allahum yarji`oon
Waqaaloo yaa ayyuhas-saahirud`u lanaa rabbaka bimaa `ahida `indak, innanaa lamuhtadoon
Falammaa kashafnaa `anhumul-`adhaaba idhaa hum yankuthoon
Wanaadaa fir`awnu fee qawmihee qaala yaaqawmi alaysa lee mulku misra wahaadhihil-anhaaru tajree min tahtee, afalaa tubsiroon
Am ana khayrum min haadhal-ladhee huwa maheenuw walaa yakaadu yubeen
Falawlaa ulqiya `alayhi aswiratum min dhahabin aw jaa'a ma`ahul-malaa'ikatu muqtarineen
Fastakhaffa qawmahoo fa'ataa`ooh, innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen
Falammaa aasafoonantaqamnaa minhum fa'aghraqnaahum ajma`een
Faja`alnaahum salafaw wamathalal lil-aakhireen
Walammaa duribabnu maryama mathalan idhaa qawmuka minhu yasiddoon
Waqaaloo a'aalihatunaa khayrun am huw, maa daraboohu laka illaa jadalaa, bal hum qawmun khasimoon
In huwa illaa `abdun an`amnaa `alayhi waja`alnaahu mathalal libanee israa'eel
Walaw nashaa'u laja`alnaa minkum malaa'ikatan fil-ardi yakhlufoon
Wa'innahoo la`ilmul lis-saa`ati falaa tamtarunna bihaa wattabi`oon, haadhaa siraatum mustaqeem
Walaa yasuddannakumush-shaytaan, innahoo lakum `aduwwum mubeen
Walammaa jaa'a `eesaa bil-bayyinaati qaala qad ji'tukum bil-hikmati wali'ubayyina lakum ba`dal-ladhee takhtalifoona feeh, fattaqullaaha wa'atee`oon
Innallaaha huwa rabbee warabbukum fa`budooh, haadhaa siraatum mustaqeem
Fakhtalafal-ahzaabu mim baynihim, fawaylul lilladheena zalamoo min `adhaabi yawmin aleem
Hal yanzuroona illas-saa`ata an ta'tiyahum baghtataw wahum laa yash`uroon
Al-akhillaa'u yawma'idhim ba`duhum liba`din `aduwwun illal-muttaqeen
Yaa`ibaadi laa khawfun `alaykumul-yawma walaa antum tahzanoon
Alladheena aamanoo bi'aayaatinaa wakaanoo muslimeen
Udkhulul-jannata antum wa'azwaajukum tuhbaroon
Yutaafu `alayhim bisihaafim min dhahabiw wa'akwaab, wafeehaa maa tashtaheehil-anfusu wataladhdhul-a`yun, wa'antum feehaa khaalidoon
Watilkal-jannatul-latee oorithtumoohaa bimaa kuntum ta`maloon
Lakum feehaa faakihatun katheeratum minhaa ta'kuloon
Innal-mujrimeena fee `adhaabi jahannama khaalidoon
Laa yufattaru `anhum wahum feehi mublisoon
Wamaa zalamnaahum walaakin kaanoo humuz-zaalimeen
Wanaadaw yaamaaliku liyaqdi `alaynaa rabbuk, qaala innakum maakithoon
Laqad ji'naakum bil-haqqi walaakinna aktharakum lil-haqqi kaarihoon
Am abramoo amran fa'innaa mubrimoon
Am yahsaboona annaa laa nasma`u sirrahum wanajwaahum, balaa warusulunaa ladayhim yaktuboon
Qul in kaana lir-rahmaani walad, fa'ana awwalul-`aabideen
Subhaana rabbis-samaawaati wal-ardi rabbil-`arshi `ammaa yasifoon
Fadharhum yakhoodoo wayal`aboo hattaa yulaaqoo yawmahumul-ladhee yoo`adoon
Wahuwal-ladhee fis-samaa'i ilaahuw wafil-ardi ilaah, wahuwal-hakeemul-`aleem
Watabaarakal-ladhee lahoo mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa baynahumaa, wa`indahoo `ilmus-saa`ah, wa'ilayhi turja`oon
Walaa yamlikul-ladheena yad`oona min doonihish-shafaa`ata illaa man shahida bil-haqqi wahum ya`lamoon
Wala'in sa'altahum man khalaqahum layaqoolunnallaahu fa'annaa yu'fakoon
Waqeelihee yaarabbi inna haa'ulaa'i qawmul laa yu'minoon
Fasfah `anhum waqul salaam, fasawfa ya`lamoon

Haa meem
Wal-kitaabil-mubeen
Innaa anzalnaahu fee laylatim mubaarakatin innaa kunnaa mundhireen
Feehaa yufraqu kullu amrin hakeem
Amram min `indinaa, innaa kunnaa mursileen
Rahmatam mir rabbik, innahoo huwas-samee`ul-`aleem
Rabbis-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa baynahumaa, in kuntum mooqineen
Laa ilaaha illaa huwa yuhyee wayumeet, rabbukum warabbu aabaa'ikumul-awwaleen
Bal hum fee shakkiy yal`aboon
Fartaqib yawma ta'tis-samaa'u bidukhaanim mubeen
Yaghshan-naas, haadhaa `adhaabun aleem
Rabbanakshif `annal-`adhaaba innaa mu'minoon
Annaa lahumudh-dhikraa waqad jaa'ahum rasoolum mubeen
Thumma tawallaw `anhu waqaaloo mu`allamum majnoon
Innaa kaashiful-`adhaabi qaleelan innakum `aa'idoon
Yawma nabtishul-batshatal-kubraa, innaa muntaqimoon
Walaqad fatannaa qablahum qawma fir`awna wajaa'ahum rasoolun kareem
An addoo ilayya `ibaadallaah, innee lakum rasoolun ameen
Wa'al laa ta`loo `alallaah, innee aateekum bisultaanim mubeen
Wa'innee `udhtu birabbee warabbikum an tarjumoon
Wa'il lam tu'minoo lee fa`taziloon
Fada`aa rabbahoo anna haa'ulaa'i qawmum mujrimoon
Fa'asri bi`ibaadee laylan innakum muttaba`oon
Watrukil-bahra rahwaa, innahum jundum mughraqoon
Kam tarakoo min jannaatiw wa`uyoon
Wazuroo`iw wamaqaamin kareem
Wana`matin kaanoo feehaa faakiheen
Kadhaalik, wa'awrathnaahaa qawman aakhareen
Famaa bakat `alayhimus-samaa'u wal-ard, wamaa kaanoo munzareen
Walaqad najjaynaa banee israa'eela minal-`adhaabil-muheen
Min fir`awn, innahoo kaana `aaliyam minal-musrifeen
Walaqadikhtarnaahum `alaa `ilmin `alal-`aalameen
Wa'aataynaahum minal-aayaati maa feehi balaa'um mubeen
Inna haa'ulaa'i layaqooloon
In hiya illaa mawtatunal-oolaa wamaa nahnu bimunshareen
Fa'too bi'aabaa'inaa in kuntum saadiqeen
Ahum khayrun am qawmu tubba`iw wal-ladheena min qablihim, ahlaknaahum innahum kaanoo mujrimeen
Wamaa khalaqnas-samaawaati wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa laa`ibeen
Maa khalaqnaahumaa illaa bil-haqqi walaakinna aktharahum laa ya`lamoon
Inna yawmal-fasli meeqaatuhum ajma`een
Yawma laa yughnee mawlan `am mawlan shay'aw walaa hum yunsaroon
Illaa mar rahimallaah, innahoo huwal-`azeezur-raheem
Inna shajarataz-zaqqoom
Ta`aamul-atheem
Kal-muhli yaghlee fil-butoon
Kaghalyil-hameem
Khudhoohu fa`tiloohu ilaa sawaa'il-jaheem
Thumma subboo fawqa ra'sihee min `adhaabil-hameem
Dhuq, innaka antal-`azeezul-kareem
Inna haadhaa maa kuntum bihee tamtaroon
Innal-muttaqeena fee maqaamin ameen
Fee jannaatiw wa`uyoon
Yalbasoona min sundusiw wa'istabraqim mutaqaabileen
Kadhaalik, wazawwajnaahum bihoorin `een
Yad`oona feehaa bikulli faakihatin aamineen
Laa yadhooqoona feehal-mawta illal-mawtatal-oolaa, wawaqaahum `adhaabal-jaheem
Fadlam mir rabbik, dhaalika huwal-fawzul-`azeem
Fa'innamaa yassarnaahu bilisaanika la`allahum yatadhakkaroon
Fartaqib innahum murtaqiboon

Haa meem
Tanzeelul-kitaabi minallaahil-`azeezil-hakeem
Inna fis-samaawaati wal-ardi la'aayaatil lil-mu'mineen
Wafee khalqikum wamaa yabuththu min daabbatin aayaatul liqawmiy yooqinoon
Wakhtilaafil-layli wan-nahaari wamaa anzalallaahu minas-samaa'i mir rizqin fa'ahyaa bihil-arda ba`da mawtihaa watasreefir-riyaahi aayaatul liqawmiy ya`qiloon
Tilka aayaatullaahi natloohaa `alayka bil-haqq, fabi'ayyi hadeethim ba`dallaahi wa'aayaatihee yu'minoon
Waylul likulli affaakin atheem
Yasma`u aayaatillaahi tutlaa `alayhi thumma yusirru mustakbiran ka'al lam yasma`haa, fabashshirhu bi`adhaabin aleem
Wa'idhaa `alima min aayaatinaa shay'anittakhadhahaa huzuwaa, ulaa'ika lahum `adhaabum muheen
Miw waraa'ihim jahannam, walaa yughnee `anhum maa kasaboo shay'aw walaa mattakhadhoo min doonillaahi awliyaa', walahum `adhaabun `azeem
Haadhaa hudaa, wal-ladheena kafaroo bi'aayaati rabbihim lahum `adhaabum mir rijzin aleem
Allaahul-ladhee sakhkhara lakumul-bahra litajriyal-fulku feehi bi'amrihee walitabtaghoo min fadlihee wala`allakum tashkuroon
Wasakhkhara lakum maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ardi jamee`am minh, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy yatafakkaroon
Qul lilladheena aamanoo yaghfiroo lilladheena laa yarjoona ayyaamallaahi liyajziya qawmam bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
Man `amila saalihan falinafsih, waman asaa'a fa`alayhaa, thumma ilaa rabbikum turja`oon
Walaqad aataynaa banee israa'eelal-kitaaba wal-hukma wan-nubuwwata warazaqnaahum minat-tayyibaati wafaddalnaahum `alal-`aalameen
Wa'aataynaahum bayyinaatim minal-amr, famakhtalafoo illaa mim ba`di maa jaa'ahumul-`ilmu baghyam baynahum, inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum yawmal-qiyaamati feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
Thumma ja`alnaaka `alaa sharee`atim minal-amri fattabi`haa walaa tattabi` ahwaa'al-ladheena laa ya`lamoon
Innahum lay yughnoo `anka minallaahi shay'aa, wa'innaz-zaalimeena ba`duhum awliyaa'u ba`d, wallaahu waliyyul-muttaqeen
Haadhaa basaa'iru lin-naasi wahudaw warahmatul liqawmiy yooqinoon
Am hasibal-ladheenajtarahus-sayyi'aati an naj`alahum kal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati sawaa'am mahyaahum wamamaatuhum, saa'a maa yahkumoon
Wakhalaqallaahus-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqqi walitujzaa kullu nafsim bimaa kasabat wahum laa yuzlamoon
Afara'ayta manittakhadha ilaahahoo hawaahu wa'adallahullaahu `alaa `ilmiw wakhatama `alaa sam`ihee waqalbihee waja`ala `alaa basarihee ghishaawah, famay yahdeehi mim ba`dillaah, afalaa tadhakkaroon
Waqaaloo maa hiya illaa hayaatunad-dunyaa namootu wanahyaa wamaa yuhlikunaa illad-dahr, wamaa lahum bidhaalika min `ilm, in hum illaa yazunnoon
Wa'idhaa tutlaa `alayhim aayaatunaa bayyinaatim maa kaana hujjatahum illaa an qaalu'too bi'aabaa'inaa in kuntum saadiqeen
Qulillaahu yuhyeekum thumma yumeetukum thumma yajma`ukum ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati laa rayba feehi walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya`lamoon
Walillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ard, wayawma taqoomus-saa`atu yawma'idhiy yakhsarul-mubtiloon
Wataraa kulla ummatin jaathiyah, kullu ummatin tud`aa ilaa kitaabihaa, al-yawma tujzawna maa kuntum ta`maloon
Haadhaa kitaabunaa yantiqu `alaykum bil-haqq, innaa kunnaa nastansikhu maa kuntum ta`maloon
Fa'ammal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati fayudkhiluhum rabbuhum fee rahmatih, dhaalika huwal-fawzul-mubeen
Wa'ammal-ladheena kafaroo, afalam takun aayaatee tutlaa `alaykum fastakbartum wakuntum qawmam mujrimeen
Wa'idhaa qeela inna wa`dallaahi haqquw was-saa`atu laa rayba feehaa qultum maa nadree mas-saa`atu in nazunnu illaa zannaw wamaa nahnu bimustayqineen
Wabadaa lahum sayyi'aatu maa `amiloo wahaaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
Waqeelal-yawma nansaakum kamaa naseetum liqaa'a yawmikum haadhaa wama'waakumun-naaru wamaa lakum min naasireen
Dhaalikum bi'annakumuttakhadhtum aayaatillaahi huzuwaw wagharratkumul-hayaatud-dunyaa, fal-yawma laa yukhrajoona minhaa walaa hum yusta`taboon
Falillaahil-hamdu rabbis-samaawaati warabbil-ardi rabbil-`aalameen
Walahul-kibriyaa'u fis-samaawaati wal-ard, wahuwal-`azeezul-hakeem

Haa meem
Tanzeelul-kitaabi minallaahil-`azeezil-hakeem
Maa khalaqnas-samaawaati wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa illaa bil-haqqi wa'ajalim musammaa, wal-ladheena kafaroo `ammaa undhiroo mu`ridoon
Qul ara'aytum maa tad`oona min doonillaahi aroonee maadhaa khalaqoo minal-ardi am lahum shirkun fis-samaawaat, u'toonee bikitaabim min qabli haadhaa aw athaaratim min `ilmin in kuntum saadiqeen
Waman adallu mimmay yad`oo min doonillaahi mal laa yastajeebu lahoo ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati wahum `an du`aa'ihim ghaafiloon
Wa'idhaa hushiran-naasu kaanoo lahum a`daa'aw wakaanoo bi`ibaadatihim kaafireen
Wa'idhaa tutlaa `alayhim aayaatunaa bayyinaatin qaalal-ladheena kafaroo lil-haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum haadhaa sihrum mubeen
Am yaqooloonaftaraah, qul iniftaraytuhoo falaa tamlikoona lee minallaahi shay'aa, huwa a`lamu bimaa tufeedoona feeh, kafaa bihee shaheedam baynee wabaynakum, wahuwal-ghafoorur-raheem
Qul maa kuntu bid`am minar-rusuli wamaa adree maa yuf`alu bee walaa bikum, in attabi`u illaa maa yoohaa ilayya wamaa ana illaa nadheerum mubeen
Qul ara'aytum in kaana min `indillaahi wakafartum bihee washahida shaahidum mim banee israa'eela `alaa mithlihee fa'aamana wastakbartum, innallaaha laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo lilladheena aamanoo law kaana khayram maa sabaqoonaa ilayh, wa'idh lam yahtadoo bihee fasayaqooloona haadhaa ifkun qadeem
Wamin qablihee kitaabu moosaa imaamaw warahmah, wahaadhaa kitaabum musaddiqul lisaanan `arabiyyal liyundhiral-ladheena zalamoo, wabushraa lil-muhsineen
Innal-ladheena qaaloo rabbunallaahu thummastaqaamoo falaa khawfun `alayhim walaa hum yahzanoon
Ulaa'ika ashaabul-jannati khaalideena feehaa, jazaa'am bimaa kaanoo ya`maloon
Wawassaynal-insaana biwaalidayhi ihsaanaa, hamalathu ummuhoo kurhaw wawada`athu kurhaa, wahamluhoo wafisaaluhoo thalaathoona shahraa, hattaa idhaa balagha ashuddahoo wabalagha arba`eena sanatan qaala rabbi awzi`nee an ashkura ni`matakal-latee an`amta `alayya wa`alaa waalidayya wa'an a`mala saalihan tardaahu wa'aslih lee fee dhurriyyatee, innee tubtu ilayka wa'innee minal-muslimeen
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena nataqabbalu `anhum ahsana maa `amiloo wanatajaawazu `an sayyi'aatihim fee ashaabil-jannah, wa`das-sidqil-ladhee kaanoo yoo`adoon
Wal-ladhee qaala liwaalidayhi uffil lakumaa ata`idaaninee an ukhraja waqad khalatil-quroonu min qablee, wahumaa yastagheethaanillaaha waylaka aamin, inna wa`dallaahi haqq, fayaqoolu maa haadhaa illaa asaateerul-awwaleen
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena haqqa `alayhimul-qawlu fee umamin qad khalat min qablihim minal-jinni wal-ins, innahum kaanoo khaasireen
Walikullin darajaatum mimmaa `amiloo, waliyuwaffiyahum a`maalahum wahum laa yuzlamoon
Wayawma yu`radul-ladheena kafaroo `alan-naar, adhhabtum tayyibaatikum fee hayaatikumud-dunyaa wastamta`tum bihaa, fal-yawma tujzawna `adhaabal-hooni bimaa kuntum tastakbiroona fil-ardi bighayril-haqqi wabimaa kuntum tafsuqoon
Wadhkur akhaa `aad, idh andhara qawmahoo bil-ahqaafi waqad khalatin-nudhuru mim bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihee allaa ta`budoo illallaah, innee akhaafu `alaykum `adhaaba yawmin `azeem
Qaaloo aji'tanaa lita'fikanaa `an aalihatinaa, fa'tinaa bimaa ta`idunaa in kunta minas-saadiqeen
Qaala innamal-`ilmu `indallaah, wa'uballighukum maa ursiltu bihee walaakinnee araakum qawman tajhaloon
Falammaa ra'awhu `aaridam mustaqbila awdiyatihim qaaloo haadhaa `aaridum mumtirunaa, bal huwa masta`jaltum bih, reehun feehaa `adhaabun aleem
Tudammiru kulla shay'im bi'amri rabbihaa fa'asbahoo laa yuraa illaa masaakinuhum, kadhaalika najzil-qawmal-mujrimeen
Walaqad makkannaahum feemaa im makkannaakum feehi waja`alnaa lahum sam`aw wa'absaaraw wa'af'idah, famaa aghnaa `anhum sam`uhum walaa absaaruhum walaa af'idatuhum min shay'in idh kaanoo yajhadoona bi'aayaatillaahi wahaaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
Walaqad ahlaknaa maa hawlakum minal-quraa wasarrafnal-aayaati la`allahum yarji`oon
Falawlaa nasarahumul-ladheenattakhadhoo min doonillaahi qurbaanan aalihah, bal dalloo `anhum, wadhaalika ifkuhum wamaa kaanoo yaftaroon
Wa'idh sarafnaa ilayka nafaram minal-jinni yastami`oonal-qur'aan, falammaa hadaroohu qaaloo ansitoo, falammaa qudiya wallaw ilaa qawmihim mundhireen
Qaaloo yaaqawmanaa innaa sami`naa kitaaban unzila mim ba`di moosaa musaddiqal limaa bayna yadayhi yahdee ilal-haqqi wa'ilaa tareeqim mustaqeem
Yaaqawmanaa ajeeboo daa`iyallaahi wa'aaminoo bihee yaghfir lakum min dhunoobikum wayujirkum min `adhaabin aleem
Wamal laa yujib daa`iyallaahi falaysa bimu`jizin fil-ardi walaysa lahoo min doonihee awliyaa', ulaa'ika fee dalaalim mubeen
Awalam yaraw annallaahal-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda walam ya`ya bikhalqihinna biqaadirin `alaa ay yuhyil-mawtaa, balaa innahoo `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Wayawma yu`radul-ladheena kafaroo `alan-naar, alaysa haadhaa bil-haqq, qaaloo balaa warabbinaa, qaala fadhooqul-`adhaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon
Fasbir kamaa sabara ulul-`azmi minar-rusuli walaa tasta`jil lahum, ka'annahum yawma yarawna maa yoo`adoona lam yalbathoo illaa saa`atam min nahaar, balaagh, fahal yuhlaku illal-qawmul-faasiqoon

Alladheena kafaroo wasaddoo `an sabeelillaahi adalla a`maalahum
Wal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati wa'aamanoo bimaa nuzzila `alaa muhammadiw wahuwal-haqqu mir rabbihim, kaffara `anhum sayyi'aatihim wa'aslaha baalahum
Dhaalika bi'annal-ladheena kafaruttaba`ul-baatila wa'annal-ladheena aamanuttaba`ul-haqqa mir rabbihim, kadhaalika yadribullaahu lin-naasi amthaalahum
Fa'idhaa laqeetumul-ladheena kafaroo fadarbar-riqaab, hattaa idhaa athkhantumoohum fashuddul-wathaaq, fa'immaa mannam ba`du wa'immaa fidaa'an hattaa tada`al-harbu awzaarahaa dhaalik, walaw yashaa'ullaahu lantasara minhum walaakil liyabluwa ba`dakum biba`d, wal-ladheena qutiloo fee sabeelillaahi falay yudilla a`maalahum
Sayahdeehim wayuslihu baalahum
Wayudkhiluhumul-jannata `arrafahaa lahum
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo in tansurullaaha yansurkum wayuthabbit aqdaamakum
Wal-ladheena kafaroo fata`sal lahum wa'adalla a`maalahum
Dhaalika bi'annahum karihoo maa anzalallaahu fa'ahbata a`maalahum
Afalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fayanzuroo kayfa kaana `aaqibatul-ladheena min qablihim, dammarallaahu `alayhim, walilkaafireena amthaaluhaa
Dhaalika bi'annallaaha mawlal-ladheena aamanoo wa'annal-kaafireena laa mawlaa lahum
Innallaaha yudkhilul-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaar, wal-ladheena kafaroo yatamatta`oona waya'kuloona kamaa ta'kulul-an`aamu wan-naaru mathwal lahum
Waka'ayyim min qaryatin hiya ashaddu quwwatam min qaryatikal-latee akhrajatk, ahlaknaahum falaa naasira lahum
Afaman kaana `alaa bayyinatim mir rabbihee kaman zuyyina lahoo soo'u `amalihee wattaba`oo ahwaa'ahum
Mathalul-jannatil-latee wu`idal-muttaqoon, feehaa anhaarum mim maa'in ghayri aasin, wa'anhaarum mil labanil lam yataghayyar ta`muh, wa'anhaarum min khamril ladhdhatil lish-shaaribeen, wa'anhaarum min `asalim musaffaa, walahum feehaa min kullith-thamaraati wamaghfiratum mir rabbihim, kaman huwa khaalidun fin-naari wasuqoo maa'an hameeman faqatta`a am`aa'ahum
Waminhum may yastami`u ilayk, hattaa idhaa kharajoo min `indika qaaloo lilladheena ootul-`ilma maadhaa qaala aanifaa, ulaa'ikal-ladheena taba`allaahu `alaa quloobihim wattaba`oo ahwaa'ahum
Wal-ladheenahtadaw zaadahum hudaw wa'aataahum taqwaahum
Fahal yanzuroona illas-saa`ata an ta'tiyahum baghtah, faqad jaa'a ashraatuhaa, fa'annaa lahum idhaa jaa'athum dhikraahum
Fa`lam annahoo laa ilaaha illallaahu wastaghfir lidhambika walilmu'mineena wal-mu'minaat, wallaahu ya`lamu mutaqallabakum wamathwaakum
Wayaqoolul-ladheena aamanoo lawlaa nuzzilat soorah, fa'idhaa unzilat sooratum muhkamatuw wadhukira feehal-qitaalu ra'aytal-ladheena fee quloobihim maraduy yanzuroona ilayka nazaral-maghshiyyi `alayhi minal-mawt, fa'awlaa lahum
Taa`atuw waqawlum ma`roof, fa'idhaa `azamal-amr, falaw sadaqullaaha lakaana khayral lahum
Fahal `asaytum in tawallaytum an tufsidoo fil-ardi watuqatti`oo arhaamakum
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena la`anahumullaahu fa'asammahum wa'a`maa absaarahum
Afalaa yatadabbaroonal-qur'aana am `alaa quloobin aqfaaluhaa
Innal-ladheenartaddoo `alaa adbaarihim mim ba`di maa tabayyana lahumul-hudash-shaytaanu sawwala lahum, wa'amlaa lahum
Dhaalika bi'annahum qaaloo lilladheena karihoo maa nazzalallaahu sanutee`ukum fee ba`dil-amr, wallaahu ya`lamu israarahum
Fakayfa idhaa tawaffathumul-malaa'ikatu yadriboona wujoohahum wa'adbaarahum
Dhaalika bi'annahumuttaba`oo maa askhatallaaha wakarihoo ridwaanahoo fa'ahbata a`maalahum
Am hasibal-ladheena fee quloobihim maradun al lay yukhrijallaahu adghaanahum
Walaw nashaa'u la'araynaakahum fala`araftahum biseemaahum, walata`rifannahum fee lahnil-qawl, wallaahu ya`lamu a`maalakum
Walanabluwannakum hattaa na`lamal-mujaahideena minkum was-saabireena wanabluwa akhbaarakum
Innal-ladheena kafaroo wasaddoo `an sabeelillaahi washaaqqur-rasoola mim ba`di maa tabayyana lahumul-hudaa lay yadurrullaaha shay'aa, wasayuhbitu a`maalahum
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo atee`ullaaha wa'atee`ur-rasoola walaa tubtiloo a`maalakum
Innal-ladheena kafaroo wasaddoo `an sabeelillaahi thumma maatoo wahum kuffaarun falay yaghfirallaahu lahum
Falaa tahinoo watad`oo ilas-salm, wa'antumul-a`lawn, wallaahu ma`akum walay yatirakum a`maalakum
Innamal-hayaatud-dunyaa la`ibuw walahw, wa'in tu'minoo watattaqoo yu'tikum ujoorakum walaa yas'alkum amwaalakum
Iy yas'alkumoohaa fayuhfikum tabkhaloo wayukhrij adghaanakum
Haa'antum haa'ulaa'i tud`awna litunfiqoo fee sabeelillaah, faminkum may yabkhal, wamay yabkhal fa'innamaa yabkhalu `an nafsih, wallaahul-ghaniyyu wa'antumul-fuqaraa', wa'in tatawallaw yastabdil qawman ghayrakum thumma laa yakoonoo amthaalakum

Innaa fatahnaa laka fatham mubeenaa
Liyaghfira lakallaahu maa taqaddama min dhambika wamaa ta'akhkhara wayutimma ni`matahoo `alayka wayahdiyaka siraatam mustaqeemaa
Wayansurakallaahu nasran `azeezaa
Huwal-ladhee anzalas-sakeenata fee quloobil-mu'mineena liyazdaadoo eemaanam ma`a eemaanihim, walillaahi junoodus-samaawaati wal-ard, wakaanallaahu `aleeman hakeemaa
Liyudkhilal-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaati jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa wayukaffira `anhum sayyi'aatihim, wakaana dhaalika `indallaahi fawzan `azeemaa
Wayu`adhdhibal-munaafiqeena wal-munaafiqaati wal-mushrikeena wal-mushrikaatiz-zaanneena billaahi zannas-saw', `alayhim daa'iratus-saw', waghadiballaahu `alayhim wala`anahum wa'a`adda lahum jahannam, wasaa'at maseeraa
Walillaahi junoodus-samaawaati wal-ard, wakaanallaahu `azeezan hakeemaa
Innaa arsalnaaka shaahidaw wamubashshiraw wanadheeraa
Litu'minoo billaahi warasoolihee watu`azziroohu watuwaqqirooh, watusabbihoohu bukrataw wa'aseelaa
Innal-ladheena yubaayi`oonaka innamaa yubaayi`oonallaah, yadullaahi fawqa aydeehim, faman nakatha fa'innamaa yankuthu `alaa nafsih, waman awfaa bimaa `aahada `alayhullaaha fasayu'teehi ajran `azeemaa
Sayaqoolu lakal-mukhallafoona minal-a`raabi shaghalatnaa amwaalunaa wa'ahloonaa fastaghfir lanaa, yaqooloona bi'alsinatihim maa laysa fee quloobihim, qul famay yamliku lakum minallaahi shay'an in araada bikum darran aw araada bikum naf`aa, bal kaanallaahu bimaa ta`maloona khabeeraa
Bal zanantum al lay yanqalibar-rasoolu wal-mu'minoona ilaa ahleehim abadaw wazuyyina dhaalika fee quloobikum wazanantum zannas-saw', wakuntum qawmam booraa
Wamal lam yu'mim billaahi warasoolihee fa'innaa a`tadnaa lil-kaafireena sa`eeraa
Walillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ard, yaghfiru limay yashaa'u wayu`adhdhibu may yashaa', wakaanallaahu ghafoorar raheemaa
Sayaqoolul-mukhallafoona idhantalaqtum ilaa maghaanima lita'khudhoohaa dharoonaa nattabi`kum, yureedoona ay yubaddiloo kalaamallaah, qul lan tattabi`oonaa kadhaalikum qaalallaahu min qabl, fasayaqooloona bal tahsudoonanaa, bal kaanoo laa yafqahoona illaa qaleelaa
Qul lil-mukhallafeena minal-a`raabi satud`awna ilaa qawmin ulee ba'sin shadeedin tuqaatiloonahum aw yuslimoon, fa'in tutee`oo yu'tikumullaahu ajran hasanaa, wa'in tatawallaw kamaa tawallaytum min qablu yu`adhdhibkum `adhaaban aleemaa
Laysa `alal-a`maa harajuw walaa `alal-a`raji harajuw walaa `alal-mareedi haraj, wamay yuti`illaaha warasoolahoo yudkhilhu jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaar, wamay yatawalla yu`adhdhibhu `adhaaban aleemaa
Laqad radiyallaahu `anil-mu'mineena idh yubaayi`oonaka tahtash-shajarati fa`alima maa fee quloobihim fa'anzalas-sakeenata `alayhim wa'athaabahum fathan qareebaa
Wamaghaanima katheeratay ya'khudhoonahaa, wakaanallaahu `azeezan hakeemaa
Wa`adakumullaahu maghaanima katheeratan ta'khudhoonahaa fa`ajjala lakum haadhihee wakaffa aydiyan-naasi `ankum, walitakoona aayatal lil-mu'mineena wayahdiyakum siraatam mustaqeemaa
Wa'ukhraa lam taqdiroo `alayhaa qad ahaatallaahu bihaa, wakaanallaahu `alaa kulli shay'in qadeeraa
Walaw qaatalakumul-ladheena kafaroo lawallawul-adbaara thumma laa yajidoona waliyyaw walaa naseeraa
Sunnatallaahil-latee qad khalat min qabl, walan tajida lisunnatillaahi tabdeelaa
Wahuwal-ladhee kaffa aydiyahum `ankum wa'aydiyakum `anhum bibatni makkata mim ba`di an azfarakum `alayhim, wakaanallaahu bimaa ta`maloona baseeraa
Humul-ladheena kafaroo wasaddookum `anil-masjidil-haraami wal-hadya ma`koofan ay yablugha mahillah, walawlaa rijaalum mu'minoona wanisaa'um mu'minaatul lam ta`lamoohum an tata'oohum fatuseebakum minhum ma`arratum bighayri `ilm, liyudkhilallaahu fee rahmatihee may yashaa', law tazayyaloo la`adhdhabnal-ladheena kafaroo minhum `adhaaban aleemaa
Idh ja`alal-ladheena kafaroo fee quloobihimul-hamiyyata hamiyyatal-jaahiliyyati fa'anzalallaahu sakeenatahoo `alaa rasoolihee wa`alal-mu'mineena wa'alzamahum kalimatat-taqwaa wakaanoo ahaqqa bihaa wa'ahlahaa, wakaanallaahu bikulli shay'in `aleemaa
Laqad sadaqallaahu rasoolahur-ru'yaa bil-haqq, latadkhulunnal-masjidal-haraama in shaa'allaahu aamineena muhalliqeena ru'oosakum wamuqassireena laa takhaafoon, fa`alima maa lam ta`lamoo faja`ala min dooni dhaalika fathan qareebaa
Huwal-ladhee arsala rasoolahoo bil-hudaa wadeenil-haqqi liyuzhirahoo `alad-deeni kullih, wakafaa billaahi shaheedaa
Muhammadur rasoolullaah, wal-ladheena ma`ahoo ashiddaa'u `alal-kuffaari ruhamaa'u baynahum taraahum rukka`an sujjaday yabtaghoona fadlam minallaahi waridwaanaa, seemaahum fee wujoohihim min atharis-sujood, dhaalika mathaluhum fit-tawraah, wamathaluhum fil-injeel, kazar`in akhraja shat'ahoo fa'aazarahoo fastaghlaza fastawaa `alaa sooqihee yu`jibuz-zurraa`a liyagheeza bihimul-kuffaar, wa`adallaahul-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati minhum maghfirataw wa'ajran `azeemaa

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tuqaddimoo bayna yadayillaahi warasoolihee wattaqullaah, innallaaha samee`un `aleem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tarfa`oo aswaatakum fawqa sawtin-nabiyyi walaa tajharoo lahoo bil-qawli kajahri ba`dikum liba`din an tahbata a`maalukum wa'antum laa tash`uroon
Innal-ladheena yaghuddoona aswaatahum `inda rasoolillaahi ulaa'ikal-ladheenamtahanallaahu quloobahum lit-taqwaa, lahum maghfiratuw wa'ajrun `azeem
Innal-ladheena yunaadoonaka miw waraa'il-hujuraati aktharuhum laa ya`qiloon
Walaw annahum sabaroo hattaa takhruja ilayhim lakaana khayral lahum, wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo in jaa'akum faasiqum binaba'in fatabayyanoo an tuseeboo qawmam bijahaalatin fatusbihoo `alaa maa fa`altum naadimeen
Wa`lamoo anna feekum rasoolallaah, law yutee`ukum fee katheerim minal-amri la`anittum walaakinnallaaha habbaba ilaykumul-eemaana wazayyanahoo fee quloobikum wakarraha ilaykumul-kufra wal-fusooqa wal-`isyaan, ulaa'ika humur-raashidoon
Fadlam minallaahi wani`mah, wallaahu `aleemun hakeem
Wa'in taa'ifataani minal-mu'mineenaqtataloo fa'aslihoo baynahumaa, fa'im baghat ihdaahumaa `alal-ukhraa faqaatilul-latee tabghee hattaa tafee'a ilaa amrillaah, fa'in faa'at fa'aslihoo baynahumaa bil-`adli wa'aqsitoo, innallaaha yuhibbul-muqsiteen
Innamal-mu'minoona ikhwatun fa'aslihoo bayna akhawaykum wattaqullaaha la`allakum turhamoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa yaskhar qawmum min qawmin `asaa ay yakoonoo khayram minhum walaa nisaa'um min nisaa'in `asaa ay yakunna khayram minhunn, walaa talmizoo anfusakum walaa tanaabazoo bil-alqaab, bi'salismul-fusooqu ba`dal-eemaan, wamal lam yatub fa'ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanujtaniboo katheeram minaz-zann, inna ba`daz-zanni ithmuw walaa tajassasoo walaa yaghtab ba`dukum ba`daa, ayuhibbu ahadukum ay ya'kula lahma akheehi maytan fakarihtumooh, wattaqullaah, innallaaha tawwaabur raheem
Yaa ayyuhan-naasu innaa khalaqnaakum min dhakariw wa'unthaa waja`alnaakum shu`oobaw waqabaa'ila lita`aarafoo, inna akramakum `indallaahi atqaakum, innallaaha `aleemun khabeer
Qaalatil-a`raabu aamannaa, qul lam tu'minoo walaakin qooloo aslamnaa walammaa yadkhulil-eemaanu fee quloobikum, wa'in tutee`ullaaha warasoolahoo laa yalitkum min a`maalikum shay'aa, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
Innamal-mu'minoonal-ladheena aamanoo billaahi warasoolihee thumma lam yartaaboo wajaahadoo bi'amwaalihim wa'anfusihim fee sabeelillaah, ulaa'ika humus-saadiqoon
Qul atu`allimoonallaaha bideenikum, wallaahu ya`lamu maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wallaahu bikulli shay'in `aleem
Yamunnoona `alayka an aslamoo, qul laa tamunnoo `alayya islaamakum, balillaahu yamunnu `alaykum an hadaakum lil-eemaani in kuntum saadiqeen
Innallaaha ya`lamu ghaybas-samaawaati wal-ard, wallaahu baseerum bimaa ta`maloon

Qaaf, wal-qur'aanil-majeed
Bal `ajiboo an jaa'ahum mundhirum minhum faqaalal-kaafiroona haadhaa shay'un `ajeeb
A'idhaa mitnaa wakunnaa turaabaa, dhaalika raj`um ba`eed
Qad `alimnaa maa tanqusul-ardu minhum, wa`indanaa kitaabun hafeez
Bal kadhdhaboo bil-haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum fahum fee amrim mareej
Afalam yanzuroo ilas-samaa'i fawqahum kayfa banaynaahaa wazayyannaahaa wamaa lahaa min furooj
Wal-arda madadnaahaa wa'alqaynaa feehaa rawaasiya wa'ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjim baheej
Tabsirataw wadhikraa likulli `abdim muneeb
Wanazzalnaa minas-samaa'i maa'am mubaarakan fa'ambatnaa bihee jannaatiw wahabbal-haseed
Wan-nakhla baasiqaatil lahaa tal`un nadeed
Rizqal lil-`ibaadi wa'ahyaynaa bihee baldatam maytaa, kadhaalikal-khurooj
Kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu noohiw wa'ashaabur-rassi wathamood
Wa`aaduw wafir`awnu wa'ikhwaanu loot
Wa'ashaabul-aykati waqawmu tubba`, kullun kadhdhabar-rusula fahaqqa wa`eed
Afa`ayeenaa bil-khalqil-awwal, bal hum fee labsim min khalqin jadeed
Walaqad khalaqnal-insaana wana`lamu maa tuwaswisu bihee nafsuh, wanahnu aqrabu ilayhi min hablil-wareed
