Sabbaha lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, wahuwal-`azeezul-hakeem
Lahoo mulkus-samaawaati wal-ard, yuhyee wayumeet, wahuwa `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Huwal-awwalu wal-aakhiru waz-zaahiru wal-baatin, wahuwa bikulli shay'in `aleem
Huwal-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda fee sittati ayyaamin thummastawaa `alal-`arsh, ya`lamu maa yaliju fil-ardi wamaa yakhruju minhaa wamaa yanzilu minas-samaa'i wamaa ya`ruju feehaa, wahuwa ma`akum ayna maa kuntum, wallaahu bimaa ta`maloona baseer
Lahoo mulkus-samaawaati wal-ard, wa'ilallaahi turja`ul-umoor
Yoolijul-layla fin-nahaari wayoolijun-nahaara fil-layl, wahuwa `aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
Aaminoo billaahi warasoolihee wa'anfiqoo mimmaa ja`alakum mustakhlafeena feeh, fal-ladheena aamanoo minkum wa'anfaqoo lahum ajrun kabeer
Wamaa lakum laa tu'minoona billaah, war-rasoolu yad`ookum litu'minoo birabbikum waqad akhadha meethaaqakum in kuntum mu'mineen
Huwal-ladhee yunazzilu `alaa `abdihee aayaatim bayyinaatil liyukhrijakum minaz-zulumaati ilan-noor, wa'innallaaha bikum lara'oofur raheem
Wamaa lakum allaa tunfiqoo fee sabeelillaahi walillaahi meeraathus-samaawaati wal-ard, laa yastawee minkum man anfaqa min qablil-fathi waqaatal, ulaa'ika a`zamu darajatam minal-ladheena anfaqoo mim ba`du waqaataloo, wakullaw wa`adallaahul-husnaa, wallaahu bimaa ta`maloona khabeer
Man dhal-ladhee yuqridullaaha qardan hasanan fayudaa`ifahoo lahoo walahoo ajrun kareem
Yawma taral-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaati yas`aa nooruhum bayna aydeehim wabi'aymaanihim bushraakumul-yawma jannaatun tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa, dhaalika huwal-fawzul-`azeem
Yawma yaqoolul-munaafiqoona wal-munaafiqaatu lilladheena aamanunzuroonaa naqtabis min noorikum, qeelarji`oo waraa'akum fal-tamisoo nooraa, faduriba baynahum bisooril lahoo baab, baatinuhoo feehir-rahmatu wazaahiruhoo min qibalihil-`adhaab
Yunaadoonahum alam nakum ma`akum, qaaloo balaa walaakinnakum fatantum anfusakum watarabbastum wartabtum wagharratkumul-amaaniyyu hattaa jaa'a amrullaahi wagharrakum billaahil-gharoor
Fal-yawma laa yu'khadhu minkum fidyatuw walaa minal-ladheena kafaroo, ma'waakumun-naar, hiya mawlaakum, wabi'sal-maseer
Alam ya'ni lilladheena aamanoo an takhsha`a quloobuhum lidhikrillaahi wamaa nazala minal-haqqi walaa yakoonoo kal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba min qablu fataala `alayhimul-amadu faqasat quloobuhum, wakatheerum minhum faasiqoon
I`lamoo annallaaha yuhyil-arda ba`da mawtihaa, qad bayyannaa lakumul-aayaati la`allakum ta`qiloon
Innal-mussaddiqeena wal-mussaddiqaati wa'aqradullaaha qardan hasanay yudaa`afu lahum walahum ajrun kareem
Wal-ladheena aamanoo billaahi warusulihee ulaa'ika humus-siddeeqoon, wash-shuhadaa'u `inda rabbihim, lahum ajruhum wanooruhum, wal-ladheena kafaroo wakadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa ulaa'ika ashaabul-jaheem
I`lamoo annamal-hayaatud-dunyaa la`ibuw walahwuw wazeenatuw watafaakhurum baynakum watakaathurun fil-amwaali wal-awlaad, kamathali ghaythin a`jabal-kuffaara nabaatuhoo thumma yaheeju fataraahu musfarran thumma yakoonu hutaamaa, wafil-aakhirati `adhaabun shadeeduw wamaghfiratum minallaahi waridwaan, wamal-hayaatud-dunyaa illaa mataa`ul-ghuroor
Saabiqoo ilaa maghfiratim mir rabbikum wajannatin `arduhaa ka`ardis-samaa'i wal-ardi u`iddat lilladheena aamanoo billaahi warusulih, dhaalika fadlullaahi yu'teehi may yashaa', wallaahu dhul-fadlil-`azeem
Maa asaaba mim museebatin fil-ardi walaa fee anfusikum illaa fee kitaabim min qabli an nabra'ahaa, inna dhaalika `alallaahi yaseer
Likaylaa ta'saw `alaa maa faatakum walaa tafrahoo bimaa aataakum, wallaahu laa yuhibbu kulla mukhtaalin fakhoor
Al-ladheena yabkhaloona waya'muroonan-naasa bil-bukhl, wamay yatawalla fa'innallaaha huwal-ghaniyyul-hameed
Laqad arsalnaa rusulanaa bil-bayyinaati wa'anzalnaa ma`ahumul-kitaaba wal-meezaana liyaqooman-naasu bil-qist, wa'anzalnal-hadeeda feehi ba'sun shadeeduw wamanaafi`u lin-naasi waliya`lamallaahu may yansuruhoo warusulahoo bil-ghayb, innallaaha qawiyyun `azeez
Walaqad arsalnaa noohaw wa'ibraaheema waja`alnaa fee dhurriyyatihiman-nubuwwata wal-kitaaba faminhum muhtad, wakatheerum minhum faasiqoon
Thumma qaffaynaa `alaa aathaarihim birusulinaa waqaffaynaa bi`eesabni maryama wa'aataynaahul-injeela waja`alnaa fee quloobil-ladheenattaba`oohu ra'fataw warahmah, warahbaaniyyatanibtada`oohaa maa katabnaahaa `alayhim illabtighaa'a ridwaanillaahi famaa ra`awhaa haqqa ri`aayatihaa, fa'aataynal-ladheena aamanoo minhum ajrahum, wakatheerum minhum faasiqoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanuttaqullaaha wa'aaminoo birasoolihee yu'tikum kiflayni mir rahmatihee wayaj`al lakum nooran tamshoona bihee wayaghfir lakum, wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
Li'allaa ya`lama ahlul-kitaabi allaa yaqdiroona `alaa shay'im min fadlillaahi wa'annal-fadla biyadillaahi yu'teehi may yashaa', wallaahu dhul-fadlil-`azeem

Qad sami`allaahu qawlal-latee tujaadiluka fee zawjihaa watashtakee ilallaah, wallaahu yasma`u tahaawurakumaa, innallaaha samee`um baseer
Alladheena yuzaahiroona minkum min nisaa'ihim maa hunna ummahaatihim, in ummahaatuhum illallaa'ee waladnahum, wa'innahum layaqooloona munkaram minal-qawli wazooraa, wa'innallaaha la`afuwwun ghafoor
Wal-ladheena yuzaahiroona min nisaa'ihim thumma ya`oodoona limaa qaaloo fatahreeru raqabatim min qabli ay yatamaassaa, dhaalikum too`azoona bih, wallaahu bimaa ta`maloona khabeer
Famal lam yajid fasiyaamu shahrayni mutataabi`ayni min qabli ay yatamaassaa, famal lam yastati` fa'it`aamu sitteena miskeenaa, dhaalika litu'minoo billaahi warasoolih, watilka hudoodullaah, walilkaafireena `adhaabun aleem
Innal-ladheena yuhaaddoonallaaha warasoolahoo kubitoo kamaa kubital-ladheena min qablihim waqad anzalnaa aayaatim bayyinaat, walilkaafireena `adhaabum muheen
Yawma yab`athuhumullaahu jamee`an fayunabbi'uhum bimaa `amiloo, ahsaahullaahu wanasooh, wallaahu `alaa kulli shay'in shaheed
Alam tara annallaaha ya`lamu maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, maa yakoonu min najwaa thalaathatin illaa huwa raabi`uhum walaa khamsatin illaa huwa saadisuhum walaa adnaa min dhaalika walaa akthara illaa huwa ma`ahum ayna maa kaanoo, thumma yunabbi'uhum bimaa `amiloo yawmal-qiyaamah, innallaaha bikulli shay'in `aleem
Alam tara ilal-ladheena nuhoo `anin-najwaa thumma ya`oodoona limaa nuhoo `anhu wayatanaajawna bil-ithmi wal-`udwaani wama`siyatir-rasool, wa'idhaa jaa'ooka hayyawka bimaa lam yuhayyika bihillaahu wayaqooloona fee anfusihim lawlaa yu`adhdhibunallaahu bimaa naqool, hasbuhum jahannam, yaslawnahaa, fabi'sal-maseer
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa tanaajaytum falaa tatanaajaw bil-ithmi wal-`udwaani wama`siyatir-rasooli watanaajaw bil-birri wat-taqwaa, wattaqullaahal-ladhee ilayhi tuhsharoon
Innaman-najwaa minash-shaytaani liyahzunal-ladheena aamanoo walaysa bidaarrihim shay'an illaa bi'idhnillaah, wa`alallaahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa qeela lakum tafassahoo fil-majaalisi fafsahoo yafsahillaahu lakum, wa'idhaa qeelanshuzoo fanshuzoo yarfa`illaahul-ladheena aamanoo minkum wal-ladheena ootul-`ilma darajaat, wallaahu bimaa ta`maloona khabeer
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa naajaytumur-rasoola faqaddimoo bayna yaday najwaakum sadaqah, dhaalika khayrul lakum wa'athar, fa'il lam tajidoo fa'innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
A'ashfaqtum an tuqaddimoo bayna yaday najwaakum sadaqaat, fa'idh lam taf`aloo wataaballaahu `alaykum fa'aqeemus-salaata wa'aatuz-zakaata wa'atee`ullaaha warasoolah, wallaahu khabeerum bimaa ta`maloon
Alam tara ilal-ladheena tawallaw qawman ghadiballaahu `alayhim, maa hum minkum walaa minhum wayahlifoona `alal-kadhibi wahum ya`lamoon
A`addallaahu lahum `adhaaban shadeedaa, innahum saa'a maa kaanoo ya`maloon
Ittakhadhoo aymaanahum junnatan fasaddoo `an sabeelillaahi falahum `adhaabum muheen
Lan tughniya `anhum amwaaluhum walaa awlaaduhum minallaahi shay'aa, ulaa'ika ashaabun-naar, hum feehaa khaalidoon
Yawma yab`athuhumullaahu jamee`an fayahlifoona lahoo kamaa yahlifoona lakum wayahsaboona annahum `alaa shay', alaa innahum humul-kaadhiboon
Istahwadha `alayhimush-shaytaanu fa'ansaahum dhikrallaah, ulaa'ika hizbush-shaytaan, alaa inna hizbash-shaytaani humul-khaasiroon
Innal-ladheena yuhaaddoonallaaha warasoolahoo ulaa'ika fil-adhalleen
Kataballaahu la'aghlibanna ana warusulee, innallaaha qawiyyun `azeez
Laa tajidu qawmay yu'minoona billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri yuwaaddoona man haaddallaaha warasoolahoo walaw kaanoo aabaa'ahum aw abnaa'ahum aw ikhwaanahum aw `asheeratahum, ulaa'ika kataba fee quloobihimul-eemaana wa'ayyadahum biroohim minh, wayudkhiluhum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa, radiyallaahu `anhum waradoo `anh, ulaa'ika hizbullaah, alaa inna hizballaahi humul-muflihoon

Sabbaha lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wahuwal-`azeezul-hakeem
Huwal-ladhee akhrajal-ladheena kafaroo min ahlil-kitaabi min diyaarihim li'awwalil-hashr, maa zanantum ay yakhrujoo wazannoo annahum maani`atuhum husoonuhum minallaahi fa'ataahumullaahu min haythu lam yahtasiboo waqadhafa fee quloobihimur-ru`ba yukhriboona buyootahum bi'aydeehim wa'aydil-mu'mineena fa`tabiroo yaa ulil-absaar
Walawlaa an kataballaahu `alayhimul-jalaa'a la`adhdhabahum fid-dunyaa, walahum fil-aakhirati `adhaabun-naar
Dhaalika bi'annahum shaaqqullaaha warasoolah, wamay yushaaqqillaaha fa'innallaaha shadeedul-`iqaab
Maa qata`tum mil leenatin aw taraktumoohaa qaa'imatan `alaa usoolihaa fabi'idhnillaahi waliyukhziyal-faasiqeen
Wamaa afaa'allaahu `alaa rasoolihee minhum famaa awjaftum `alayhi min khayliw walaa rikaabiw walaakinnallaaha yusallitu rusulahoo `alaa may yashaa', wallaahu `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Maa afaa'allaahu `alaa rasoolihee min ahlil-quraa falillaahi walir-rasooli walidhil-qurbaa wal-yataamaa wal-masaakeeni wabnis-sabeeli kay laa yakoona doolatam baynal-aghniyaa'i minkum, wamaa aataakumur-rasoolu fakhudhoohu wamaa nahaakum `anhu fantah, wattaqullaah, innallaaha shadeedul-`iqaab
Lil-fuqaraa'il-muhaajireenal-ladheena ukhrijoo min diyaarihim wa'amwaalihim yabtaghoona fadlam minallaahi waridwaanaw wayansuroonallaaha warasoolah, ulaa'ika humus-saadiqoon
Wal-ladheena tabawwa'ud-daara wal-eemaana min qablihim yuhibboona man haajara ilayhim walaa yajidoona fee sudoorihim haajatam mimmaa ootoo wayu'thiroona `alaa anfusihim walaw kaana bihim khasaasah, wamay yooqa shuhha nafsihee fa'ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
Wal-ladheena jaa'oo mim ba`dihim yaqooloona rabbanaghfir lanaa wali'ikhwaaninal-ladheena sabaqoonaa bil-eemaani walaa taj`al fee quloobinaa ghillal lilladheena aamanoo rabbanaa innaka ra'oofur raheem
Alam tara ilal-ladheena naafaqoo yaqooloona li'ikhwaanihimul-ladheena kafaroo min ahlil-kitaabi la'in ukhrijtum lanakhrujanna ma`akum walaa nutee`u feekum ahadan abadaw wa'in qootiltum lanansurannakum, wallaahu yashhadu innahum lakaadhiboon
La'in ukhrijoo laa yakhrujoona ma`ahum, wala'in qootiloo laa yansuroonahum, wala'in nasaroohum layuwallunnal-adbaara thumma laa yunsaroon
La'antum ashaddu rahbatan fee sudoorihim minallaah, dhaalika bi'annahum qawmul laa yafqahoon
Laa yuqaatiloonakum jamee`an illaa fee quram muhassanatin aw miw waraa'i judur, ba'suhum baynahum shadeed, tahsabuhum jamee`aw waquloobuhum shattaa, dhaalika bi'annahum qawmul laa ya`qiloon
Kamathalil-ladheena min qablihim qareeban dhaaqoo wabaala amrihim, walahum `adhaabun aleem
Kamathalish-shaytaani idh qaala lil-insaanikfur, falammaa kafara qaala innee baree'um minka innee akhaafullaaha rabbal-`aalameen
Fakaana `aaqibatahumaa annahumaa fin-naari khaalidayni feehaa, wadhaalika jazaa'uz-zaalimeen
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanuttaqullaaha waltanzur nafsum maa qaddamat lighad, wattaqullaah, innallaaha khabeerum bimaa ta`maloon
Walaa takoonoo kal-ladheena nasullaaha fa'ansaahum anfusahum, ulaa'ika humul-faasiqoon
Laa yastawee ashaabun-naari wa'ashaabul-jannah, ashaabul-jannati humul-faa'izoon
Law anzalnaa haadhal-qur'aana `alaa jabalil lara'aytahoo khaashi`am mutasaddi`am min khashyatillaah, watilkal-amthaalu nadribuhaa lin-naasi la`allahum yatafakkaroon
Huwallaahul-ladhee laa ilaaha illaa huw, `aalimul-ghaybi wash-shahaadah, huwar-rahmaanur-raheem
Huwallaahul-ladhee laa ilaaha illaa huw, al-malikul-quddoosus-salaamul-mu'minul-muhayminul-`azeezul-jabbaarul-mutakabbir, subhaanallaahi `ammaa yushrikoon
Huwallaahul-khaaliqul-baari'ul-musawwiru lahul-asmaa'ul-husnaa, yusabbihu lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, wahuwal-`azeezul-hakeem

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tattakhidhoo `aduwwee wa`aduwwakum awliyaa'a tulqoona ilayhim bil-mawaddati waqad kafaroo bimaa jaa'akum minal-haqq, yukhrijoonar-rasoola wa'iyyaakum an tu'minoo billaahi rabbikum, in kuntum kharajtum jihaadan fee sabeelee wabtighaa'a mardaatee tusirroona ilayhim bil-mawaddati wa'ana a`lamu bimaa akhfaytum wamaa a`lantum, wamay yaf`alhu minkum faqad dalla sawaa'as-sabeel
Iy yathqafookum yakoonoo lakum a`daa'aw wayabsutoo ilaykum aydiyahum wa'alsinatahum bis-soo'i wawaddoo law takfuroon
Lan tanfa`akum arhaamukum walaa awlaadukum yawmal-qiyaamah, yafsilu baynakum, wallaahu bimaa ta`maloona baseer
Qad kaanat lakum uswatun hasanatun fee ibraaheema wal-ladheena ma`ah, idh qaaloo liqawmihim innaa bura'aa'u minkum wamimmaa ta`budoona min doonillaah, kafarnaa bikum wabadaa baynanaa wabaynakumul-`adaawatu wal-baghdaa'u abadan hattaa tu'minoo billaahi wahdahoo illaa qawla ibraaheema li'abeehi la'astaghfiranna laka wamaa amliku laka minallaahi min shay', rabbanaa `alayka tawakkalnaa wa'ilayka anabnaa wa'ilaykal-maseer
Rabbanaa laa taj`alnaa fitnatal lilladheena kafaroo waghfir lanaa rabbanaa, innaka antal-`azeezul-hakeem
Laqad kaana lakum feehim uswatun hasanatul liman kaana yarjullaaha wal-yawmal-aakhir, wamay yatawalla fa'innallaaha huwal-ghaniyyul-hameed
`Asallaahu ay yaj`ala baynakum wabaynal-ladheena `aadaytum minhum mawaddah, wallaahu qadeer, wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
Laa yanhaakumullaahu `anil-ladheena lam yuqaatilookum fid-deeni walam yukhrijookum min diyaarikum an tabarroohum watuqsitoo ilayhim, innallaaha yuhibbul-muqsiteen
Innamaa yanhaakumullaahu `anil-ladheena qaatalookum fid-deeni wa'akhrajookum min diyaarikum wazaaharoo `alaa ikhraajikum an tawallawhum, wamay yatawallahum fa'ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa jaa'akumul-mu'minaatu muhaajiraatin famtahinoohunn, allaahu a`lamu bi'eemaanihinna fa'in `alimtumoohunna mu'minaatin falaa tarji`oohunna ilal-kuffaar, laa hunna hillul lahum walaa hum yahilloona lahunn, wa'aatoohum maa anfaqoo, walaa junaaha `alaykum an tankihoohunna idhaa aataytumoohunna ujoorahunn, walaa tumsikoo bi`isamil-kawaafiri was'aloo maa anfaqtum walyas'aloo maa anfaqoo, dhaalikum hukmullaah, yahkumu baynakum, wallaahu `aleemun hakeem
Wa'in faatakum shay'um min azwaajikum ilal-kuffaari fa`aaqabtum fa'aatul-ladheena dhahabat azwaajuhum mithla maa anfaqoo, wattaqullaahal-ladhee antum bihee mu'minoon
Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu idhaa jaa'akal-mu'minaatu yubaayi`naka `alaa al laa yushrikna billaahi shay'aw walaa yasriqna walaa yazneena walaa yaqtulna awlaadahunna walaa ya'teena bibuhtaaniy yaftareenahoo bayna aydeehinna wa'arjulihinna walaa ya`seenaka fee ma`roofin fabaayi`hunna wastaghfir lahunnallaah, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tatawallaw qawman ghadiballaahu `alayhim qad ya'isoo minal-aakhirati kamaa ya'isal-kuffaaru min ashaabil-quboor

Sabbaha lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wahuwal-`azeezul-hakeem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo lima taqooloona maa laa taf`aloon
Kabura maqtan `indallaahi an taqooloo maa laa taf`aloon
Innallaaha yuhibbul-ladheena yuqaatiloona fee sabeelihee saffan ka'annahum bunyaanum marsoos
Wa'idh qaala moosaa liqawmihee yaaqawmi lima tu'dhoonanee waqat ta`lamoona annee rasoolullaahi ilaykum, falammaa zaaghoo azaaghallaahu quloobahum, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmal-faasiqeen
Wa'idh qaala `eesabnu maryama yaabanee israa'eela innee rasoolullaahi ilaykum musaddiqal limaa bayna yadayya minat-tawraati wamubashshiram birasooliy ya'tee mim ba`dismuhoo ahmad, falammaa jaa'ahum bil-bayyinaati qaaloo haadhaa sihrum mubeen
Waman azlamu mimmaniftaraa `alallaahil-kadhiba wahuwa yud`aa ilal-islaam, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
Yureedoona liyutfi'oo noorallaahi bi'afwaahihim, wallaahu mutimmu noorihee walaw karihal-kaafiroon
Huwal-ladhee arsala rasoolahoo bil-hudaa wadeenil-haqqi liyuzhirahoo `alad-deeni kullihee walaw karihal-mushrikoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo hal adullukum `alaa tijaaratin tunjeekum min `adhaabin aleem
Tu'minoona billaahi warasoolihee watujaahidoona fee sabeelillaahi bi'amwaalikum wa'anfusikum, dhaalikum khayrul lakum in kuntum ta`lamoon
Yaghfir lakum dhunoobakum wayudkhilkum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru wamasaakina tayyibatan fee jannaati `adn, dhaalikal-fawzul-`azeem
Wa'ukhraa tuhibboonahaa, nasrum minallaahi wafathun qareeb, wabashshiril-mu'mineen
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo koonoo ansaarallaahi kamaa qaala `eesabnu maryama lil-hawaariyyeena man ansaaree ilallaah, qaalal-hawaariyyoona nahnu ansaarullaahi fa'aamanat taa'ifatum mim banee israa'eela wakafarat taa'ifah, fa'ayyadnal-ladheena aamanoo `alaa `aduwwihim fa'asbahoo zaahireen

Yusabbihu lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ardil-malikil-quddoosil-`azeezil-hakeem
Huwal-ladhee ba`atha fil-ummiyyeena rasoolam minhum yatloo `alayhim aayaatihee wayuzakkeehim wayu`allimuhumul-kitaaba wal-hikmata wa'in kaanoo min qablu lafee dalaalim mubeen
Wa'aakhareena minhum lammaa yalhaqoo bihim, wahuwal-`azeezul-hakeem
Dhaalika fadlullaahi yu'teehi may yashaa', wallaahu dhul-fadlil-`azeem
Mathalul-ladheena hummilut-tawraata thumma lam yahmiloohaa kamathalil-himaari yahmilu asfaaraa, bi'sa mathalul-qawmil-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatillaah, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
Qul yaa ayyuhal-ladheena haadoo in za`amtum annakum awliyaa'u lillaahi min doonin-naasi fatamannawul-mawta in kuntum saadiqeen
Walaa yatamannawnahoo abadam bimaa qaddamat aydeehim, wallaahu `aleemum biz-zaalimeen
Qul innal-mawtal-ladhee tafirroona minhu fa'innahoo mulaaqeekum thumma turaddoona ilaa `aalimil-ghaybi wash-shahaadati fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta`maloon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa noodiya lis-salaati miy yawmil-jumu`ati fas`aw ilaa dhikrillaahi wadharul-bay`, dhaalikum khayrul lakum in kuntum ta`lamoon
Fa'idhaa qudiyatis-salaatu fantashiroo fil-ardi wabtaghoo min fadlillaahi wadhkurullaaha katheeral la`allakum tuflihoon
Wa'idhaa ra'aw tijaaratan aw lahwaninfaddoo ilayhaa watarakooka qaa'imaa, qul maa `indallaahi khayrum minal-lahwi waminat-tijaarah, wallaahu khayrur-raaziqeen

Idhaa jaa'akal-munaafiqoona qaaloo nashhadu innaka larasoolullaah, wallaahu ya`lamu innaka larasooluh, wallaahu yashhadu innal-munaafiqeena lakaadhiboon
Ittakhadhoo aymaanahum junnatan fasaddoo `an sabeelillaah, innahum saa'a maa kaanoo ya`maloon
Dhaalika bi'annahum aamanoo thumma kafaroo fatubi`a `alaa quloobihim fahum laa yafqahoon
Wa'idhaa ra'aytahum tu`jibuka ajsaamuhum, wa'iy yaqooloo tasma` liqawlihim, ka'annahum khushubum musannadah, yahsaboona kulla sayhatin `alayhim, humul-`aduwwu fahdharhum, qaatalahumullaah, annaa yu'fakoon
Wa'idhaa qeela lahum ta`aalaw yastaghfir lakum rasoolullaahi lawwaw ru'oosahum wara'aytahum yasuddoona wahum mustakbiroon
Sawaa'un `alayhim astaghfarta lahum am lam tastaghfir lahum, lay yaghfirallaahu lahum, innallaaha laa yahdil-qawmal-faasiqeen
Humul-ladheena yaqooloona laa tunfiqoo `alaa man `inda rasoolillaahi hattaa yanfaddoo, walillaahi khazaa'inus-samaawaati wal-ardi walaakinnal-munaafiqeena laa yafqahoon
Yaqooloona la'ir raja`naa ilal-madeenati layukhrijannal-a`azzu minhal-adhall, walillaahil-`izzatu walirasoolihee walilmu'mineena walaakinnal-munaafiqeena laa ya`lamoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tulhikum amwaalukum walaa awlaadukum `an dhikrillaah, wamay yaf`al dhaalika fa'ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon
Wa'anfiqoo mim maa razaqnaakum min qabli ay ya'tiya ahadakumul-mawtu fayaqoola rabbi lawlaa akhkhartanee ilaa ajalin qareeb, fa'assaddaqa wa'akum minas-saaliheen
Walay yu'akhkhirallaahu nafsan idhaa jaa'a ajaluhaa, wallaahu khabeerum bimaa ta`maloon

Yusabbihu lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Huwal-ladhee khalaqakum faminkum kaafiruw waminkum mu'min, wallaahu bimaa ta`maloona baseer
Khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqqi wasawwarakum fa'ahsana suwarakum, wa'ilayhil-maseer
Ya`lamu maa fis-samaawaati wal-ardi waya`lamu maa tusirroona wamaa tu`linoon, wallaahu `aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
Alam ya'tikum naba'ul-ladheena kafaroo min qabl, fadhaaqoo wabaala amrihim walahum `adhaabun aleem
Dhaalika bi'annahoo kaanat ta'teehim rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati faqaaloo abasharuy yahdoonanaa, fakafaroo watawallaw wastaghnallaah, wallaahu ghaniyyun hameed
Za`amal-ladheena kafaroo al lay yub`athoo, qul balaa warabbee latub`athunna thumma latunabba'unna bimaa `amiltum, wadhaalika `alallaahi yaseer
Fa'aaminoo billaahi warasoolihee wan-nooril-ladhee anzalnaa, wallaahu bimaa ta`maloona khabeer
Yawma yajma`ukum liyawmil-jam`i dhaalika yawmut-taghaabun, wamay yu'mim billaahi waya`mal saalihay yukaffir `anhu sayyi'aatihee wayudkhilhu jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa abadaa, dhaalikal-fawzul-`azeem
Wal-ladheena kafaroo wakadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa ulaa'ika ashaabun-naari khaalideena feehaa, wabi'sal-maseer
Maa asaaba mim museebatin illaa bi'idhnillaah, wamay yu'mim billaahi yahdi qalbah, wallaahu bikulli shay'in `aleem
Wa'atee`ullaaha wa'atee`ur-rasool, fa'in tawallaytum fa'innamaa `alaa rasoolinal-balaaghul-mubeen
Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huw, wa`alallaahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo inna min azwaajikum wa'awlaadikum `aduwwal lakum fahdharoohum, wa'in ta`foo watasfahoo wataghfiroo fa'innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
Innamaa amwaalukum wa'awlaadukum fitnah, wallaahu `indahoo ajrun `azeem
Fattaqullaaha mastata`tum wasma`oo wa'atee`oo wa'anfiqoo khayral li'anfusikum, wamay yooqa shuhha nafsihee fa'ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
In tuqridullaaha qardan hasanay yudaa`ifhu lakum wayaghfir lakum, wallaahu shakoorun haleem
`Aalimul-ghaybi wash-shahaadatil-`azeezul-hakeem

Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu idhaa tallaqtumun-nisaa'a fatalliqoohunna li`iddatihinna wa'ahsul-`iddah, wattaqullaaha rabbakum, laa tukhrijoohunna mim buyootihinna walaa yakhrujna illaa ay ya'teena bifaahishatim mubayyinah, watilka hudoodullaah, wamay yata`adda hudoodallaahi faqad zalama nafsah, laa tadree la`allallaaha yuhdithu ba`da dhaalika amraa
Fa'idhaa balaghna ajalahunna fa'amsikoohunna bima`roofin aw faariqoohunna bima`roofiw wa'ashhidoo dhaway `adlim minkum wa'aqeemush-shahaadata lillaah, dhaalikum yoo`azu bihee man kaana yu'minu billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhir, wamay yattaqillaaha yaj`al lahoo makhrajaa
Wayarzuqhu min haythu laa yahtasib, wamay yatawakkal `alallaahi fahuwa hasbuh, innallaaha baalighu amrih, qad ja`alallaahu likulli shay'in qadraa
Wallaa'ee ya'isna minal-maheedi min nisaa'ikum inirtabtum fa`iddatuhunna thalaathatu ashhuriw wallaa'ee lam yahidn, wa'ulaatul-ahmaali ajaluhunna ay yada`na hamlahunn, wamay yattaqillaaha yaj`al lahoo min amrihee yusraa
Dhaalika amrullaahi anzalahoo ilaykum, wamay yattaqillaaha yukaffir `anhu sayyi'aatihee wayu`zim lahoo ajraa
Askinoohunna min haythu sakantum miw wujdikum walaa tudaarroohunna litudayyiqoo `alayhinn, wa'in kunna ulaati hamlin fa'anfiqoo `alayhinna hattaa yada`na hamlahunn, fa'in arda`na lakum fa'aatoohunna ujoorahunn, wa'tamiroo baynakum bima`roof, wa'in ta`aasartum fasaturdi`u lahoo ukhraa
Liyunfiq dhoo sa`atim min sa`atih, waman qudira `alayhi rizquhoo falyunfiq mimmaa aataahullaah, laa yukallifullaahu nafsan illaa maa aataahaa, sayaj`alullaahu ba`da `usriy yusraa
Waka'ayyim min qaryatin `atat `an amri rabbihaa warusulihee fahaasabnaahaa hisaaban shadeedaw wa`adhdhabnaahaa `adhaaban nukraa
Fadhaaqat wabaala amrihaa wakaana `aaqibatu amrihaa khusraa
A`addallaahu lahum `adhaaban shadeedan fattaqullaaha yaa ulil-albaabil-ladheena aamanoo, qad anzalallaahu ilaykum dhikraa
Rasoolay yatloo `alaykum aayaatillaahi mubayyinaatil liyukhrijal-ladheena aamanoo wa`amilus-saalihaati minaz-zulumaati ilan-noor, wamay yu'mim billaahi waya`mal saalihay yudkhilhu jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa abadaa, qad ahsanallaahu lahoo rizqaa
Allaahul-ladhee khalaqa sab`a samaawaatiw waminal-ardi mithlahunn, yatanazzalul-amru baynahunna lita`lamoo annallaaha `alaa kulli shay'in qadeeruw wa'annallaaha qad ahaata bikulli shay'in `ilmaa

Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu lima tuharrimu maa ahallallaahu lak, tabtaghee mardaata azwaajik, wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
Qad faradallaahu lakum tahillata aymaanikum, wallaahu mawlaakum, wahuwal-`aleemul-hakeem
Wa'idh asarran-nabiyyu ilaa ba`di azwaajihee hadeethaa, falammaa nabba'at bihee wa'azharahullaahu `alayhi `arrafa ba`dahoo wa'a`rada `am ba`d, falammaa nabba'ahaa bihee qaalat man amba'aka haadhaa, qaala nabba'aniyal-`aleemul-khabeer
In tatoobaa ilallaahi faqad saghat quloobukumaa, wa'in tazaaharaa `alayhi fa'innallaaha huwa mawlaahu wajibreelu wasaalihul-mu'mineen, wal-malaa'ikatu ba`da dhaalika zaheer
`Asaa rabbuhoo in tallaqakunna ay yubdilahoo azwaajan khayram minkunna muslimaatim mu'minaatin qaanitaatin taa'ibaatin `aabidaatin saa'ihaatin thayyibaatiw wa'abkaaraa
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo qoo anfusakum wa'ahleekum naaraw waqooduhan-naasu wal-hijaaratu `alayhaa malaa'ikatun ghilaazun shidaadul laa ya`soonallaaha maa amarahum wayaf`aloona maa yu'maroon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena kafaroo laa ta`tadhirul-yawm, innamaa tujzawna maa kuntum ta`maloon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo tooboo ilallaahi tawbatan nasoohaa, `asaa rabbukum ay yukaffira `ankum sayyi'aatikum wayudkhilakum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru yawma laa yukhzillaahun-nabiyya wal-ladheena aamanoo ma`ah, nooruhum yas`aa bayna aydeehim wabi'aymaanihim yaqooloona rabbanaa atmim lanaa nooranaa waghfir lanaa, innaka `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu jaahidil-kuffaara wal-munaafiqeena waghluz `alayhim, wama'waahum jahannam, wabi'sal-maseer
Daraballaahu mathalal lilladheena kafarumra'ata noohiw wamra'ata loot, kaanataa tahta `abdayni min `ibaadinaa saalihayni fakhaanataahumaa falam yughniyaa `anhumaa minallaahi shay'aw waqeeladkhulan-naara ma`ad-daakhileen
Wadaraballaahu mathalal lilladheena aamanumra'ata fir`awn, idh qaalat rabbibni lee `indaka baytan fil-jannati wanajjinee min fir`awna wa`amalihee wanajjinee minal-qawmiz-zaalimeen
Wamaryamabnata `imraanal-latee ahsanat farjahaa fanafakhnaa feehi mir roohinaa wasaddaqat bikalimaati rabbihaa wakutubihee wakaanat minal-qaaniteen

Tabaarakal-ladhee biyadihil-mulk, wahuwa `alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Al-ladhee khalaqal-mawta wal-hayaata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu `amalaa, wahuwal-`azeezul-ghafoor
Al-ladhee khalaqa sab`a samaawaatin tibaaqaa, maa taraa fee khalqir-rahmaani min tafaawut, farji`il-basara hal taraa min futoor
Thummarji`il-basara karratayni yanqalib ilaykal-basaru khaasi'aw wahuwa haseer
Walaqad zayyannas-samaa'ad-dunyaa bimasaabeeha waja`alnaahaa rujoomal lish-shayaateeni wa'a`tadnaa lahum `adhaabas-sa`eer
Walilladheena kafaroo birabbihim `adhaabu jahannam, wabi'sal-maseer
Idhaa ulqoo feehaa sami`oo lahaa shaheeqaw wahiya tafoor
Takaadu tamayyazu minal-ghayz, kullamaa ulqiya feehaa fawjun sa'alahum khazanatuhaa alam ya'tikum nadheer
Qaaloo balaa qad jaa'anaa nadheerun fakadhdhabnaa waqulnaa maa nazzalallaahu min shay', in antum illaa fee dalaalin kabeer
Waqaaloo law kunnaa nasma`u aw na`qilu maa kunnaa fee ashaabis-sa`eer
Fa`tarafoo bidhambihim, fasuhqal li'ashaabis-sa`eer
Innal-ladheena yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi lahum maghfiratuw wa'ajrun kabeer
Wa'asirroo qawlakum awijharoo bih, innahoo `aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
Alaa ya`lamu man khalaq, wahuwal-lateeful-khabeer
Huwal-ladhee ja`ala lakumul-arda dhaloolan famshoo fee manaakibihaa wakuloo mir rizqih, wa'ilayhin-nushoor
A'amintum man fis-samaa'i ay yakhsifa bikumul-arda fa'idhaa hiya tamoor
Am amintum man fis-samaa'i ay yursila `alaykum haasibaa, fasata`lamoona kayfa nadheer
Walaqad kadhdhabal-ladheena min qablihim fakayfa kaana nakeer
Awalam yaraw ilat-tayri fawqahum saaffaatiw wayaqbidn, maa yumsikuhunna illar-rahmaan, innahoo bikulli shay'im baseer
Amman haadhal-ladhee huwa jundul lakum yansurukum min doonir-rahmaan, inil-kaafiroona illaa fee ghuroor
Amman haadhal-ladhee yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqah, bal lajjoo fee `utuwwiw wanufoor
Afamay yamshee mukibban `alaa wajhihee ahdaa ammay yamshee sawiyyan `alaa siraatim mustaqeem
Qul huwal-ladhee ansha'akum waja`ala lakumus-sam`a wal-absaara wal-af'idah, qaleelam maa tashkuroon
Qul huwal-ladhee dhara'akum fil-ardi wa'ilayhi tuhsharoon
Wayaqooloona mataa haadhal-wa`du in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul innamal-`ilmu `indallaah, wa'innamaa ana nadheerum mubeen
Falammaa ra'awhu zulfatan see'at wujoohul-ladheena kafaroo waqeela haadhal-ladhee kuntum bihee tadda`oon
Qul ara'aytum in ahlakaniyallaahu wamam ma`iya aw rahimanaa famay yujeerul-kaafireena min `adhaabin aleem
Qul huwar-rahmaanu aamannaa bihee wa`alayhi tawakkalnaa, fasata`lamoona man huwa fee dalaalim mubeen
Qul ara'aytum in asbaha maa'ukum ghawran famay ya'teekum bimaa'im ma`een

Noon, wal-qalami wamaa yasturoon
Maa anta bini`mati rabbika bimajnoon
Wa'inna laka la'ajran ghayra mamnoon
Wa'innaka la`alaa khuluqin `azeem
Fasatubsiru wayubsiroon
Bi'ayyikumul-maftoon
Inna rabbaka huwa a`lamu biman dalla `an sabeelih, wahuwa a`lamu bil-muhtadeen
Falaa tuti`il-mukadhdhibeen
Waddoo law tudhinu fayudhinoon
Walaa tuti` kulla hallaafim maheen
Hammaazim mashshaa'im binameem
Mannaa`il lil-khayri mu`tadin atheem
`Utullim ba`da dhaalika zaneem
An kaana dhaa maaliw wabaneen
Idhaa tutlaa `alayhi aayaatunaa qaala asaateerul-awwaleen
Sanasimuhoo `alal-khurtoom
Innaa balawnaahum kamaa balawnaa ashaabal-jannah, idh aqsamoo layasrimunnahaa musbiheen
Walaa yastathnoon
Fataafa `alayhaa taa'ifum mir rabbika wahum naa'imoon
Fa'asbahat kas-sareem
Fatanaadaw musbiheen
Anighdoo `alaa harthikum in kuntum saarimeen
Fantalaqoo wahum yatakhaafatoon
Al laa yadkhulannahal-yawma `alaykum miskeen
Waghadaw `alaa hardin qaadireen
Falammaa ra'awhaa qaaloo innaa ladaal-loon
Bal nahnu mahroomoon
Qaala awsatuhum alam aqul lakum lawlaa tusabbihoon
Qaaloo subhaana rabbinaa innaa kunnaa zaalimeen
Fa'aqbala ba`duhum `alaa ba`diy yatalaawamoon
Qaaloo yaawaylanaa innaa kunnaa taagheen
`Asaa rabbunaa ay yubdilanaa khayram minhaa innaa ilaa rabbinaa raaghiboon
Kadhaalikal-`adhaab, wala`adhaabul-aakhirati akbar, law kaanoo ya`lamoon
Inna lil-muttaqeena `inda rabbihim jannaatin-na`eem
Afanaj`alul-muslimeena kal-mujrimeen
Maa lakum, kayfa tahkumoon
Am lakum kitaabun feehi tadrusoon
Inna lakum feehi lamaa takhayyaroon
Am lakum aymaanun `alaynaa baalighatun ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati inna lakum lamaa tahkumoon
Salhum ayyuhum bidhaalika za`eem
Am lahum shurakaa', falya'too bishurakaa'ihim in kaanoo saadiqeen
Yawma yukshafu `an saaqiw wayud`awna ilas-sujoodi falaa yastatee`oon
Khaashi`atan absaaruhum tarhaquhum dhillah, waqad kaanoo yud`awna ilas-sujoodi wahum saalimoon
Fadharnee wamay yukadhdhibu bihaadhal-hadeeth, sanastadrijuhum min haythu laa ya`lamoon
Wa'umlee lahum, inna kaydee mateen
Am tas'aluhum ajran fahum mim maghramim muthqaloon
Am `indahumul-ghaybu fahum yaktuboon
Fasbir lihukmi rabbika walaa takun kasaahibil-hoot, idh naadaa wahuwa makzoom
Lawlaa an tadaarakahoo ni`matum mir rabbihee lanubidha bil-`araa'i wahuwa madhmoom
Fajtabaahu rabbuhoo faja`alahoo minas-saaliheen
Wa'iy yakaadul-ladheena kafaroo layuzliqoonaka bi'absaarihim lammaa sami`udh-dhikra wayaqooloona innahoo lamajnoon
Wamaa huwa illaa dhikrul lil-`aalameen

Al-haaqqah
Mal-haaqqah
Wamaa adraaka mal-haaqqah
Kadhdhabat thamoodu wa`aadum bil-qaari`ah
Fa'ammaa thamoodu fa'uhlikoo bit-taaghiyah
Wa'ammaa `aadun fa'uhlikoo bireehin sarsarin `aatiyah
